7.7.42: te tvanyonyaṁ susaṁrabdhāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kauravaiḥ saha ॥42॥
7.7.50: saṁyamya tu tato droṇaḥ samavasthāpya cāhave ॥50॥
7.7.53: tathā paryacarad droṇaḥ pāṇḍavānāṁ bale balī,
7.7.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇābhiṣekaparvaṇi droṇaparākrame saptamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥7॥
7.8.1: vyathitāḥ pāṇḍavā dr̥ṣṭvā na cainaṁ paryavārayan ॥1॥
7.8.14: tataḥ punarapi droṇo nāma viśrāvayan yudhi,
7.8.15: kālavad vyacarad droṇo yuveva sthaviro balī ॥15॥
7.8.17: prākampanta raṇe yodhā gāvaḥ śītārditā iva ॥17॥
7.8.32: hato rukmaratho rājan kr̥tvā karma suduṣkaram ॥32॥
7.8.33: sainyānāṁ ca tato rājannācārye nihate yudhi ॥33॥
7.8.34: dyāṁ dharāṁ khaṁ diśo vāpi pradiśaścānunādayan,
aho dhigiti bhūtānāṁ śabdaḥ samabhavad bhr̥śam ॥34॥
7.8.35: devatāḥ pitaraścaiva pūrve ye cāsya bāndhavāḥ,
7.8.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇābhiṣekaparvaṇi droṇavadhaśravaṇe aṣṭamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥8॥
7.9.1: kiṁ kurvāṇaṁ raṇe droṇaṁ jaghnuḥ pāṇḍavasr̥ñjayāḥ,
7.9.5: kurvāṇaṁ dāruṇaṁ karma raṇe yattaṁ mahāratham ॥5॥
7.9.6: vyaktaṁ hi daivaṁ balavat pauruṣāditi me matiḥ,
yad droṇo nihataḥ śūraḥ pārṣatena mahātmanā ॥6॥
7.9.9: na nūnaṁ paraduḥkhena mriyate ko’pi sañjaya,
yatra droṇamahaṁ śrutvā hataṁ jīvāmi mandadhīḥ ॥9॥
7.9.10: daivameva paraṁ manye nanvanarthaṁ hi pauruṣam,
7.9.11: yacchrutvā nihataṁ droṇaṁ śatadhā na vidīryate,
7.9.12: brāhmaṇā rājaputrāśca sa kathaṁ mr̥tyunā hr̥taḥ,
7.9.14: mandānāṁ mama putrāṇāṁ jayāśā yasya vikrame ॥14॥
7.9.22: sa satyasandho balavān droṇaḥ kimakarod yudhi,
7.9.23: ke nu taṁ raudrakarmāṇaṁ yuddhe pratyudyayū rathāḥ,
nanu rukmarathaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā prādravanti sma pāṇḍavāḥ ॥23॥
7.9.26: na hyahaṁ paripaśyāmi vadhe kañcana śuṣmiṇaḥ ॥26॥
7.9.30: kṣatraṁ ca brahma caiveha yo’bhyatiṣṭhat parantapaḥ ॥30॥
7.9.31: sa kathaṁ brāhmaṇo vr̥ddhaḥ śastreṇa vadhamāptavān,
7.9.33: divi śakra iva śreṣṭho mahāsattvo mahābalaḥ ॥33॥
7.9.34: sa kathaṁ nihataḥ pārthaiḥ kṣudramatsyairyathā timiḥ,
7.9.35: na yasya vijayākāṅkṣī viṣayaṁ prāpya jīvati,
yaṁ dvau na jahataḥ śabdau jīvamānaṁ kadācana ॥35॥
7.9.39: ke nu paścādavartanta gacchanto durgamāṁ gatim,
ke’rakṣan dakṣiṇaṁ cakraṁ savyaṁ ke ca mahātmanaḥ ॥39॥
7.9.40: purastāt ke ca vīrasya yudhyamānasya saṁyuge,
7.9.41: droṇasya samare vīrāḥ ke’kurvanta parāṁ dhr̥tim,
7.9.42: rakṣitārastataḥ śūnye kaccit tairna hataḥ paraiḥ,
na sa pr̥ṣṭhamarestrāsād raṇe śauryāt pradarśayet ॥42॥
7.9.43: parāmapyāpadaṁ prāpya sa kathaṁ nihataḥ paraiḥ,
7.9.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇābhiṣekaparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭraśoke navamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥9॥
7.10.6: sa labdhvā śanakaiḥ sañjñāṁ vepamāno mahīpatiḥ,
7.10.10: yo hyeko hi mahāvīryo nirdahed ghoracakṣuṣā,
7.10.11: dāntaṁ bahumataṁ loke ke śūrāḥ paryavārayan ॥11॥
7.10.13: yaḥ karoti mahat karma śatrūṇāṁ vai mahābalaḥ ॥13॥
7.10.20: gāṇḍīvaṁ dhārayan dhīmān kīdr̥śaṁ vo manastadā ॥20॥
7.10.21: yadā’’yāt kathamāsīt tu tadā pārthaṁ samīkṣatām ॥21॥
7.10.22: kaccid gāṇḍīvaśabdena na praṇaśyati vai balam,
7.10.24: ko hi gāṇḍīvadhanvānaṁ raṇe soḍhuṁ naro’rhati,
7.10.25: ke tatra nājahurdroṇaṁ ke kṣudrāḥ prādravan bhayāt ॥25॥
7.10.26: ke vā tatra tanūṁstyaktvā pratīpaṁ mr̥tyumāvrajan,
7.10.27: na ca vegaṁ sitāśvasya visahiṣyanti māmakāḥ,
7.10.28: viṣvakseno yasya yantā yasya yoddhā dhanañjayaḥ,
aśakyaḥ sa ratho jetuṁ manye devāsurairapi ॥28॥
7.10.34: satyaṁ dhr̥tiśca śauryaṁ ca brahmacaryaṁ ca kevalam,
7.10.42: tyajantaṁ tumule prāṇān ke śūrāḥ samavārayan ॥42॥
7.10.47: yasminnastrāṇi satyaṁ ca brahmacaryaṁ ca sarvadā ॥47॥
7.10.50: yadābhyadhāvad vai droṇaṁ tadā’’sīd vo manaḥ katham ॥50॥
7.10.51: yad droṇamādravan saṅkhye ke śūrāstān nyavārayan ॥51॥
7.10.54: śatād viśiṣṭaṁ yaṁ yuddhe samamanyanta vr̥ṣṇayaḥ,
7.10.57: tān droṇaṁ hantumāyātān ke vīrāḥ paryavārayan ॥57॥
7.10.62: nirdahantaṁ raṇe yodhān dārayantaṁ ca sarvataḥ,
7.10.64: ya imāṁ pr̥thivīṁ kr̥tsnāṁ carmavat samaveṣṭayat,
7.10.67: na pūrve nāpare cakruridaṁ kecana mānavāḥ,
7.10.68: jātaṁ cāpi janiṣyantaṁ dvitīyaṁ cāpi sāmpratam ॥68॥
7.10.69: gatiṁ yasya na yāsyanti mānuṣā lokavāsinaḥ ॥69॥
7.10.71: prepsantaṁ samare droṇaṁ ke vīrāḥ paryavārayan ॥71॥
7.10.72: māyāvī rākṣaso vīro yasmānmama mahad bhayam ॥72॥
7.10.73: pārthānāṁ jayakāmaṁ taṁ putrāṇāṁ mama kaṇṭakam,
7.10.74: ete cānye ca bahavo yeṣāmarthāya sañjaya,
tyaktāraḥ saṁyuge prāṇān kiṁ teṣāmajitaṁ yudhi ॥74॥
7.10.75: hitārthī cāpi pārthānāṁ kathaṁ teṣāṁ parājayaḥ ॥75॥
7.10.76: nārāyaṇo raṇe nātho divyo divyātmakaḥ prabhuḥ ॥76॥
7.10.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇābhiṣekaparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭravākye daśamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥10॥
7.11.1: kr̥tavān yāni govindo yathā nānyaḥ pumān kvacit ॥1॥
7.11.5: pralambaṁ narakaṁ jambhaṁ pīṭhaṁ cāpi mahāsuram,
7.11.9: ārādhitaḥ sadāreṇa sa cāsmai pradadau varān ॥9॥
7.11.11: amr̥ṣyamāṇā rājāno yasya jātyā hayā iva,
7.11.13: arghye vivadamānaṁ ca jaghāna paśuvat tadā ॥13॥
7.11.23: rājñāṁ cāpyajitaṁ kañcit kr̥ṣṇeneha na śuśruma ॥23॥
7.11.26: nānto vikramayuktasya buddhyā yuktasya vā punaḥ,
7.11.32: api vā hyeṣa pāṇḍūnāṁ yotsyate’rthāya sañjaya ॥32॥
7.11.33: sa yadā tāta saṁnahyet pāṇḍavārthāya sañjaya,
na tadā pratisaṁyoddhā bhavitā tatra kaścana ॥33॥
7.11.34: yadi sma kuravaḥ sarve jayeyurnāma pāṇḍavān,
7.11.35: tataḥ sarvān naravyāghro hatvā narapatīn raṇe,
kauravāṁśca mahābāhuḥ kuntyai dadyāt sa medinīm ॥35॥
7.11.36: yasya yantā hr̥ṣīkeśo yoddhā yasya dhanañjayaḥ,
rathasya tasya kaḥ saṅkhye pratyanīko bhaved rathaḥ ॥36॥
7.11.38: arjune vijayo nityaṁ kr̥ṣṇe kīrtiśca śāśvatī ॥38॥
7.11.40: mohād duryodhanaḥ kr̥ṣṇaṁ yo na vettīha keśavam,
7.11.41: na veda kr̥ṣṇaṁ dāśārhamarjunaṁ caiva pāṇḍavam,
7.11.44: bhīṣmasya ca vadhastāta droṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ,
na hyeva brahmacaryeṇa na vedādhyayanena ca ॥44॥
7.11.46: bhīṣmadroṇau hatau śrutvā kiṁ nu jīvāmi sañjaya,
yāṁ tāṁ śriyamasūyāmaḥ purā dr̥ṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhire ॥46॥
7.11.48: pakvānāṁ hi vadhe sūta vajrāyante tr̥ṇānyuta,
7.11.49: prāptaḥ prakr̥tito dharmo na dharmo māmakān prati ॥49॥
7.11.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇābhiṣekaparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭravilāpe ekādaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥11॥
7.12.1: yathā sa nyapatad droṇaḥ sūditaḥ pāṇḍusr̥ñjayaiḥ ॥1॥
7.12.2: madhye sarvasya sainyasya putraṁ te vākyamabravīt ॥2॥
7.12.4: karomi kāmaṁ kaṁ te’dya pravr̥ṇīṣva yamicchasi ॥4॥
7.12.6: dadāsi ced varaṁ mahyaṁ jīvagrāhaṁ yudhiṣṭhiram,
7.12.7: tataḥ kurūṇāmācāryaḥ śrutvā putrasya te vacaḥ,
7.12.9: kimarthaṁ ca naravyāghra na vadhaṁ tasya kāṅkṣase,
7.12.10: āhosvid dharmarājasya dveṣṭā tasya na vidyate,
yadīcchasi tvaṁ jīvantaṁ kulaṁ rakṣasi cātmanaḥ ॥10॥
7.12.11: rājyaṁ samprati dattvā ca saubhrātraṁ kartumicchasi ॥11॥
7.12.12: dhanyaḥ kuntīsuto rājā sujātaṁ cāsya dhīmataḥ,
ajātaśatrutā satyā tasya yat snihyate bhavān ॥12॥
7.12.13: sahasā niḥsr̥toṁ bhāvo yo’sya nityaṁ hr̥di sthitaḥ ॥13॥
7.12.15: hate yudhiṣṭhire pārthā hanyuḥ sarvān hi no dhruvam ॥15॥
7.12.16: na ca śakyā raṇe sarve nihantumamarairapi,
ya eva teṣāṁ śeṣaḥ syāt sa evāsmān na śeṣayet ॥16॥
7.12.16d1: yadi sarve haniṣyante pāṇḍavāḥ sasutā mr̥dhe,
tataḥ kr̥tsnaṁ vaśe kr̥tvā niḥśeṣaṁ nr̥pamaṇḍalam.
7.12.18: so’yaṁ mama jayo vyaktaṁ dīrghakālaṁ bhaviṣyati,
7.12.19: taṁ varaṁ sāntaraṁ tasmai dadau sañcintya buddhimān ॥19॥
7.12.20: na ced yudhiṣṭhiraṁ vīraḥ pālayatyarjuno yudhi,
7.12.21: na hi śakyo raṇe pārthaḥ sendrairdevāsurairapi,
7.12.25: grahaṇe hi jayastasya na vadhe puruṣarṣabha,
7.12.26: ānayiṣyāmi te rājan vaśamadya na saṁśayaḥ ॥26॥
7.12.28: phālgunasya samīpe tu na hi śakyo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
7.12.29: sāntaraṁ tu pratijñāte rājño droṇena nigrahe,
7.12.30: pāṇḍaveyeṣu sāpekṣaṁ droṇaṁ jānāti te sutaḥ,
7.12.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇābhiṣekaparvaṇi droṇapratijñāyāṁ dvādaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥12॥
7.13.1: sāntare tu pratijñāte rājño droṇena nigrahe,
7.13.5: yathā tanna bhavet satyaṁ tathā nītirvidhīyatām,
7.13.7: yathā me na vadhaḥ kārya ācāryasya kadācana ॥7॥
7.13.8: tathā tava parityāgo na me rājaṁścikīrṣitaḥ,
7.13.10: na sa taṁ jīvaloke’smin kāmaṁ prāpyet kathañcana,
7.13.11: na tvāṁ droṇo nigr̥hṇīyājjīvamāne mayi dhruvam,
yadi tasya raṇe sāhyaṁ kurute vajrabhr̥t svayam ॥11॥
7.13.12: viṣṇurvā sahito devairna tvāṁ prāpsyatyasau mr̥dhe,
mayi jīvati rājendra na bhayaṁ kartumarhasi ॥12॥
7.13.13: anyacca brūyāṁ rājendra pratijñāṁ mama niścalām ॥13॥
7.13.18: tato vyūḍhānyanīkāni tava teṣāṁ ca bhārata,
7.13.20: na śekuḥ sr̥ñjayā yuddhe taddhi droṇena pālitam ॥20॥
7.13.21: na śekuḥ pāṇḍavīṁ senāṁ pālyamānāṁ kirīṭinā ॥21॥
7.13.22: āstāṁ te stimite sene rakṣyamāṇe parasparam,
7.13.25: tena muktāḥ śarā ghorā viceruḥ sarvatodiśam,
7.13.29: sa diśaḥ sarvato ruddhvā saṁvr̥tya khamajihmagaiḥ,
7.13.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇābhiṣekaparvaṇi arjunakr̥tayudhiṣṭhirāśvāsane trayodaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥13॥
7.14.1: tataḥ sa pāṇḍavānīke janayan sumahad bhayam,
7.14.4: raudrā hastavatā muktāḥ sammr̥dnanti sma sāyakāḥ ॥4॥
7.14.6: vicaran sa tadā rājan senāṁ saṅkṣobhayan prabhuḥ,
7.14.7: bhramadrathāmbude cāsmin dr̥ṣyate sma punaḥ punaḥ ॥7॥
7.14.8: sa vīraḥ satyavān prājño dharmanityaḥ sadā punaḥ,
7.14.18: nihatān prāṇinaḥ saṅkhye droṇena balinā raṇe,
7.14.23: tasya mādrīsutaḥ ketuṁ dhanuḥ sūtaṁ hayānapi,
7.14.24: sa tasya gadayā rājan rathāt sūtamapātayat ॥24॥
7.14.30: hatāśvāt sarathād rājan gr̥hya carma mahābalaḥ,
abhyāyād bhīmasenaṁ tu matto mattamiva dvipam ॥30॥
7.14.32: nipātya nakulaḥ saṅkhye śaṅkhaṁ dadhmau pratāpavān ॥32॥
7.14.33: kr̥paṁ vivyādha saptatyā lakṣma cāsyāharat tribhiḥ ॥33॥
7.14.36: taṁ bhojaḥ saptasaptatyā viddhvā’’śu niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.14.45: śikhaṇḍī tu tataḥ kruddhaḥ saumadattiṁ viśāmpate,
7.14.49: yathā viṣṇuḥ purā rājan hiraṇyākṣeṇa saṁyuge ॥49॥
7.14.53: pañcabhistasya vivyādha hayān sūtaṁ ca sāyakaiḥ ॥53॥
7.14.54: tataḥ praharṣayan senāṁ siṁhavad vinadan muhuḥ,
7.14.63: carma cādāya khaḍgaṁ ca nadan paryapatad rathāt ॥63॥
7.14.76: tataścarma ca khaḍgaṁ ca samutkṣipya mahābalaḥ,
7.14.77: tāpayāmāsa tat sainyaṁ bhuvanaṁ bhāskaro yathā ॥77॥
7.14.84: yamau ca draupadeyāśca sādhu sādhviti cukruśuḥ,
7.14.87: teṣāṁ ca priyamanvicchan sūtasya ca parābhavaram,
7.14.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇābhiṣekaparvaṇi abhimanyuparākrame caturdaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥14॥
7.15.3: na hi me tr̥ptirastīha śr̥ṇvato yuddhamuttamam,
7.15.4: sāditaṁ prekṣya yantāraṁ śalyaḥ sarvāyasīṁ gadām,
7.15.10: pāṇḍavānāṁ kurūṇāṁ ca sādhu sādhviti niḥsvanaḥ ॥10॥
7.15.14: tathaiva carato mārgān maṇḍalāni ca sarvaśaḥ,
7.15.19: gadā kṣiptā tu samare madrarājena bhārata,
vyoma dīpayamānā sā sasr̥je pāvakaṁ muhuḥ ॥19॥
7.15.20: tāpayāmāsa tat sainyaṁ maholkā patatī yathā ॥20॥
7.15.21: te gade gadināṁ śreṣṭhau samāsādya parasparam,
7.15.30: tato vihvalamānaṁ taṁ niḥśvasantaṁ punaḥ punaḥ,
7.15.34: tato madrādhipaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tava putrāḥ parāṅmukham,
7.15.37: siṁhanādān bhr̥śaṁ cakruḥ śaṅkhān dadhmuśca harṣitāḥ,
7.15.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇābhiṣekaparvaṇi śalyāpayāne pañcadaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥15॥
7.16.1: tad balaṁ sumahad dīrṇaṁ tvadīyaṁ prekṣya vīryavān,
7.16.2: śarā daśa diśo muktā vr̥ṣasenena saṁyuge,
7.16.18: alaṁ drutena vaḥ śūrā iti doṇo’bhyabhāṣata ॥18॥
7.16.18d4: na hi māmabhivarṣanti saṁyuge tāta pāṇḍavāḥ.
7.16.18d6: na māmutsahate tāta na bhīmo na ca sātyakiḥ,
7.16.18d8: yāhi svargaṁ puraskr̥tya yaśase ca jayāya ca,
7.16.20: tasya droṇo dhanuśchittvā taṁ drutaṁ samupādravat ॥20॥
7.16.24: saṁvārya ca raṇe droṇaṁ kumārastu mahābalaḥ,
7.16.26: sa madhyaṁ prāpya sainyānāṁ sarvāḥ pravicaran diśaḥ,
7.16.28: sātyakiṁ pañcabhirviddhvā matsyaṁ ca daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥28॥
7.16.31: yudhiṣṭhiraṁ sa viddhvā tu śaraiḥ saṁnataparvabhiḥ,
7.16.33: ete cānye ca bahavaḥ parīpsanto yudhiṣṭhiram,
7.16.40: adya rājā dhārtarāṣṭraḥ kr̥tārtho vai bhaviṣyati ॥40॥
7.16.41: asmin muhūrte droṇastu pāṇḍavaṁ gr̥hya harṣitaḥ,
7.16.47: na diśo nāntarikṣaṁ ca na dyaurnaiva ca medinī,
7.16.49: nājñāyata tadā śatrurna suhr̥nna ca kaścana ॥49॥
7.16.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇābhiṣekaparvaṇi prathamadivasāvahāre ṣoḍaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥16॥
7.17.1: te sene śibiraṁ gatvā nyaviśetāṁ viśāmpate,
7.17.4: iti tad vaḥ prayatatāṁ kr̥taṁ pārthena saṁyuge,
7.17.5: tata eṣyati me rājan vaśameṣa yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥5॥
7.17.13: krodhāgninā dahyamānā na śemahi sadā niśi ॥13॥
7.17.14: kartāraḥ sma vayaṁ karma yaccikīrṣāma hr̥dgatam ॥14॥
7.17.15: bhavataśca priyaṁ yat syādasmākaṁ ca yaśaskaram,
7.17.22: tato jvalanamānarcya hutvā sarve pr̥thak pr̥thak,
7.17.26: brāhmaṇāṁstarpayitvā ca niṣkān dattvā pr̥thak pr̥thak,
gāśca vāsāṁsi ca punaḥ samābhāṣya parasparam ॥26॥
7.17.29: ye vai lokāścāvratināṁ ye caiva brahmaghātinām,
madyapasya ca ye lokā gurudāraratasya ca ॥29॥
7.17.30: śaraṇāgataṁ ca tyajato yācamānaṁ tathā ghnataḥ ॥30॥
7.17.31: agāradāhināṁ caiva ye ca gāṁ nighnatāmapi,
apakāriṇāṁ ca ye lokā ye ca brahmadviṣāmapi ॥31॥
7.17.33: nyāsāpahāriṇāṁ ye ca śrutaṁ nāśayatāṁ ca ye,
7.17.36: yadi tvasukaraṁ loke karma kuryāma saṁyuge,
7.17.40: eṣa ca bhrātr̥bhiḥ sārdhaṁ suśarmā’’hvayate raṇe,
7.17.41: satyaṁ te pratijānāmi hatān viddhi parān yudhi ॥41॥
7.17.42: śrutaṁ te tattvatastāta yad droṇasya cikīrṣitam,
yathā tadanr̥taṁ tasya bhavet tat tvaṁ samācara ॥42॥
7.17.43: pratijñātaṁ ca tenaitad grahaṇaṁ me mahāratha ॥43॥
7.17.44: ayaṁ vai satyajid rājannadya tvāṁ rakṣitā yudhi,
7.17.45: hate tu puruṣavyāghre raṇe satyajiti prabho,
7.17.48: tato dauryodhanaṁ sainyaṁ mudā paramayā yutam,
7.17.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhaparvaṇi dhanañjayayāne saptadaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥17॥
7.18.1: tataḥ saṁśaptakā rājan same deśe vyavasthitāḥ,
7.18.3: sa śabdaḥ pradiśaḥ sarvā diśaḥ khaṁ ca samāvr̥ṇot,
7.18.9d1: sā senā bharataśreṣṭha niśceṣṭā śuśubhe tadā,
citra paṭe yathā nyastā kuśalaiḥ śilpibhirnaraiḥ.
7.18.9d2: sasvanā pr̥thivī sarvā tathaiva ca mahodadhiḥ.
7.18.14: ekaikastu tataḥ pārthaṁ rājan vivyādha pañcabhiḥ,
sa ca tān prativivyādha dvābhyāṁ dvābhyāṁ parākramī ॥14॥
7.18.23: vyadravanta bhayād bhītā yatra dauryodhanaṁ balam ॥23॥
7.18.25: tato bhagne bale tasmin vipralīne samantataḥ,
7.18.27: alaṁ drutena vaḥ śūrā na bhayaṁ kartumarhatha ॥27॥
7.18.28: gatvā dauryodhanaṁ sainyaṁ kiṁ vai vakṣyatha mukhyaśaḥ ॥28॥
7.18.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhaparvaṇi sudhanvavadhe aṣṭādaśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥18॥
7.19.2: naite hāsyanti saṅgrāmaṁ jīvanta iti me matiḥ ॥2॥
7.19.4: tataḥ kr̥ṣṇaḥ smitaṁ kr̥tvā pratinandya śivena tam,
7.19.6: yathā śakraratho rājan yuddhe devāsure purā ॥6॥
7.19.10: baddhvā ca bhrukuṭiṁ vakre krodhasya pratilakṣaṇam,
7.19.14: aśobhanta raṇe yodhāḥ puṣpitā iva kiṁśukāḥ ॥14॥
7.19.18: na dhvajo nārjunastatra na ratho na ca keśavaḥ,
7.19.21: kvāsi pārtha na paśye tvāṁ kaccijjīvasi śatruhan ॥21॥
7.19.22: tasya tad bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā tvaramāṇo dhanañjayaḥ,
7.19.24: praḍīnāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ kāle vr̥kṣebhya iva māriṣa ॥24॥
7.19.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhaparvaṇi arjunasaṁśaptakayuddhe ekonaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥19॥
7.20.1: pariṇāmya niśāṁ tāṁ tu bhāradvājo mahārathaḥ,
uktvā subahu rājendra vacanaṁ vai suyodhanam ॥1॥
7.20.2: niṣkrānte ca tadā pārthe saṁśaptakavadhaṁ prati ॥2॥
7.20.4: vyūḍhaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā suparṇaṁ tu bhāradvājakr̥taṁ tadā,
7.20.16: tasya prāgjyotiṣo madhye vidhivat kalpitaṁ gajam ॥16॥
7.20.23: na hi śakto raṇe droṇo vijetuṁ māṁ kathañcana ॥23॥
7.20.24: evamuktvā kiran bāṇān drupadasya suto balī,
7.20.25d1: sa hi jāto mahārāja droṇasya nidhanaṁ prati,
7.20.26: taṁ tu samprekṣya putraste durmukhaḥ śatrukarṣaṇaḥ,
7.20.27: pārṣatasya ca śūrasya durmukhasya ca bhārata ॥27॥
7.20.31: tathā pārthasya sainyāni vicchinnāni kvacit kvacit ॥31॥
7.20.33: naiva sve na pare rājannājñāyanta parasparam,
7.20.49: āhatā sahasā bhūmiścakampe ca nanāda ca ॥49॥
7.20.56: jaghānātra pitā putraṁ putraśca pitaraṁ tathā,
ityāsīt tumulaṁ yuddhaṁ na prājñāyata kiñcana ॥56॥
7.20.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe viṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥20॥
7.21.3: dr̥ṣṭvā droṇaṁ tataḥ śūraḥ satyajit satyavikramaḥ,
7.21.9: droṇastu tat samālokya caritaṁ tasya saṁyuge,
7.21.13: cukruśuḥ pāṇḍavā rājan vastrāṇi dudhuvuśca ha ॥13॥
7.21.16: tataḥ satyajitaścāpaṁ chittvā droṇo vr̥kasya ca,
7.21.18: sa tanna mamr̥ṣe droṇaḥ pāñcālyenārdito mr̥dhe,
7.21.26: ṣaḍbhiḥ sasūtaṁ sahayaṁ droṇaṁ viddhvānadad bhr̥śam ॥26॥
7.21.28: tasya cānadato droṇaḥ śiraḥ kāyāt sakuṇḍalam,
7.21.29: pañcālān sr̥ñjayān pāṇḍūn bhāradvājaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥29॥
7.21.32: raudrā hastavatā muktāḥ pramathnanti sma sāyakāḥ ॥32॥
7.21.38: sa śūraḥ satyavāk prājño balavān satyavikramaḥ,
7.21.47: te droṇaṁ sahitāḥ śūrāḥ sarvataḥ pratyavārayan,
7.21.52: tato droṇaḥ satyasandhaḥ prabhinna iva kuñjaraḥ,
7.21.53: avidhyannavabhiḥ kṣemaṁ sa hataḥ prāpatad rathāt ॥53॥
7.21.54: sa madhyaṁ prāpya sainyānāṁ sarvāḥ pravicaran diśaḥ,
7.21.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhaparvaṇi droṇayuddhe ekaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥21॥
7.22.2: āryāṁ yuddhe matiṁ kr̥tvā kṣatriyāṇāṁ yaśaskarīm,
7.22.3: sa hi vīronnataḥ śūro yo bhagneṣu nivartate,
aho nāsīt pumān kaścid dr̥ṣṭvā droṇaṁ vyavasthitam ॥3॥
7.22.7: tān dr̥ṣṭvā calitān saṅkhye praṇunnān droṇasāyakaiḥ,
7.22.12: yathā tu bhagnā droṇena vāteneva mahādrumāḥ ॥12॥
7.22.19: na cāpi pāṇḍavā yuddhe bhajyeranniti me matiḥ,
7.22.20: smaramāṇā na hāsyanti saṅgrāmamiti me matiḥ ॥20॥
7.22.21: varān varān hi kaunteyo rathodārān haniṣyati ॥21॥
7.22.22: āyasena ca daṇḍena vrātān vrātān haniṣyati ॥22॥
7.22.28: kokā iva mahānāgaṁ mā vai hanyuryatavratam ॥28॥
7.22.29: bhrātr̥bhiḥ sahito rājan prāyād droṇarathaṁ prati ॥29॥
7.22.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhaparvaṇi droṇayuddhe dvāviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥22॥
7.23.5: siddhiṁ cāsya parāṁ kāṅkṣan śoṇāśvaḥ saṁnyavartata ॥5॥
7.23.21: teṣāṁ tu ṣaṭ sahasrāṇi ye śikhaṇḍinamanvayuḥ,
7.23.28: sutasomaṁ tu yaḥ saumyaṁ pārthaḥ putramajījanat,
7.23.35: ūhuḥ sutumule yuddhe hayāḥ kr̥ṣṇāḥ svalaṅkr̥tāḥ ॥35॥
7.23.39: astrāṇāṁ ca dhanurvede bāhme vede ca pāragam,
7.23.47: rājānaṁ rocamānaṁ te hayāḥ saṅkhye samāvahan ॥47॥
7.23.59: aśvaiśca dhanuṣā caiva śuklaiḥ śuklo nyavartata ॥59॥
7.23.63: yaṁ tu sarvamanuṣyebhyaḥ prāhuḥ śūrataraṁ nr̥pam,
7.23.69: bhinne kapāṭe pāṇḍyānāṁ vidruteṣu ca bandhuṣu ॥69॥
7.23.70: bhīṣmādavāpya bāstrāṇi droṇād rāmāt kr̥pāt tathā,
7.23.71: iyeṣa dvārakāṁ hantuṁ kr̥tsnāṁ jetuṁ ca medinīm,
7.23.92: tad divyamajaraṁ caiva phālgunārthāya vai dhanuḥ ॥92॥
7.23.95: raudraṁ dhanurvaraṁ śreṣṭhaṁ lebhe yad rohiṇīsutaḥ,
tat tuṣṭaḥ pradadau rāmaḥ saubhadrāya mahātmane ॥95॥
7.23.96: ete cānye ca bahavo dhvajā hemavibhūṣitāḥ,
7.23.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhaparvaṇi hayadhvajādikathane trayoviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥23॥
7.24.5: yukta eva hi bhāgyena dhruvamutpadyate naraḥ,
sa tathā’’kr̥ṣyate tena na yathā svayamicchati ॥5॥
7.24.7: adya me kekayā labdhāḥ kāśikāḥ kosalāśca ye,
7.24.8: pr̥thivī bhūyasī tāta mama pārthasya no tathā,
iti māmabravīt sūta mando duryodhanaḥ purā ॥8॥
7.24.12: duryodhanena tat sarvaṁ prāptaṁ sūta mayā saha ॥12॥
7.24.13: nr̥śaṁsaṁ tu paraṁ nu syāt tyaktvā duryodhanaṁ yadi,
putraśeṣaṁ cikīrṣeyaṁ kr̥tsnaṁ na maraṇaṁ vrajet ॥13॥
7.24.14: yo hi dharmaṁ parityajya bhavatyarthaparo naraḥ,
so’smācca hīyate lokāt kṣudrabhāvaṁ ca gacchati ॥14॥
7.24.15: avaśeṣaṁ na paśyāmi kakude mr̥dite sati ॥15॥
7.24.17: vyaktameva ca me śaṁsa yathā yuddhamavartata,
ke’yudhyan ke vyapākurvan ke kṣudrāḥ prādravan bhayāt ॥17॥
7.24.18: dhanañjayaṁ ca me śaṁsa yad yaccakre ratharṣabhaḥ,
tasmād bhayaṁ no bhūyiṣṭhaṁ bhrātr̥vyācca vr̥kodarāt ॥18॥
7.24.20: kathaṁ ca vo manastāta nivr̥tteṣvabhavat tadā,
māmakānāṁ ca ye śūrāḥ ke kāṁstatra nyavārayan ॥20॥
7.24.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhaparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭravākye caturviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥24॥
7.25.3: tāṁstu śūrān maheṣvāsān krūraṁ karma cikīrṣataḥ,
7.25.6: taṁ ca bhīmo’tudad bāṇaistadā’’sīt tumulaṁ mahat ॥6॥
7.25.7: rājyaṁ mr̥tyubhayaṁ tyaktvā pratyatiṣṭhan parān yudhi ॥7॥
7.25.8: kr̥tavarmā śineḥ pautraṁ droṇaṁ prepsuṁ viśāmpate,
7.25.9: kr̥tavarmā ca śaineyaṁ matto mattamiva dvipam ॥9॥
7.25.18: tathaiva rājā bāhlīko rājānaṁ drupadaṁ śaraiḥ,
7.25.30: taṁ kruddhaṁ prativivyādha prativindhyaḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.25.33: dhanurdhvajaṁ ca sūtaṁ ca chittvā droṇāntikaṁ yayau ॥33॥
7.25.35: sa lakṣmaṇasyeṣvasanaṁ chittvā lakṣma ca bhārata,
7.25.37: vidhūya tad bāṇajālaṁ babhau tava suto balī ॥37॥
7.25.41: tasya tad vibabhau vaktraṁ sanālamiva paṅkajam ॥41॥
7.25.43: sa ca tāṁśchādayāmāsa śarajālaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥43॥
7.25.44: naiva karṇo na te pañca dadr̥śurbāṇasaṁvr̥tāḥ,
7.25.50: sa tyaktvā saśaraṁ cāpaṁ rathād bhūmimupāgamat ॥50॥
7.25.51: vārdhakṣemiṁ tu vārṣṇeyaṁ kr̥paḥ śāradvataḥ śaraiḥ,
7.25.54: punaḥ patākāṁ sūtaṁ ca chatraṁ cāpātayad rathāt ॥54॥
7.25.56: rathaṁ ca svaṁ samāsthāya dhanurādāya cāparam,
svayaṁ yacchan hayān rājan vyadhamat pāṇḍavīṁ camūm ॥56॥
7.25.60: ātudan prarujan bhañjan nighnan vidrāvayan kṣipan,
7.25.63: padātīnāṁ ca bhadraṁ te tava teṣāṁ ca saṅkule ॥63॥
7.25.64: naitādr̥śo dr̥ṣṭapūrvaḥ saṅgrāmo naiva ca śrutaḥ,
7.25.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhaparvaṇi dvandvayuddhe pañcaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥25॥
7.26.4: sa nāga iva nāgena govr̥ṣeṇeva govr̥ṣaḥ,
7.26.6: te gajā girisaṅkāśāḥ kṣarantaḥ sarvato madam,
7.26.8: sa teṣu visr̥jan bāṇān bhīmo nāgeṣvaśobhata,
7.26.13: bhallābhyāṁ kārmukaṁ caiva kṣipraṁ ciccheda pāṇḍavaḥ ॥13॥
7.26.18: tasmin nipatite vīre samprādravata sā camūḥ,
7.26.30: aho dhiṅ nihato bhīmaḥ kuñjareṇeti māriṣa,
7.26.31: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā hataṁ matvā vr̥kodaram ॥31॥
7.26.32: taṁ rathaṁ rathināṁ śreṣṭhāḥ parivārya parantapāḥ ॥32॥
7.26.40: sa kuñjarastho rathibhiḥ śuśubhe sarvato vr̥taḥ ॥40॥
7.26.43: śineḥ pautrasya tu rathaṁ parigr̥hya mahādvipaḥ ॥43॥
7.26.47: tamekaṁ dviradaṁ saṅkhye menire śataśo dvipān,
7.26.62: paricikṣepa tān nāgaḥ sa ripūn savyadakṣiṇam ॥62॥
7.26.63: gopāla iva daṇḍena yathā paśugaṇān vane,
7.26.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhaparvaṇi bhagadattayuddhe ṣaḍviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥26॥
7.27.2: rajo dr̥ṣṭvā samadbhūtaṁ śrutvā ca gajaniḥsvanam,
7.27.8: dr̥ptaṁ saṅkhye dvipabalād vayasā cāpi vismitam,
7.27.13: kiṁ nu śreyaskaraṁ karma bhavedadyeti cintayan,
iha vā vinivarteyaṁ gaccheyaṁ vā yudhiṣṭhiram ॥13॥
7.27.17: vadhena tu narāgryāṇāmakarot tāṁ mr̥ṣā tadā ॥17॥
7.27.19: naiva kuntīsutaḥ pārtho naiva kr̥ṣṇo janārdanaḥ,
na hayā na ratho rājan dr̥śyante sma śaraiścitāḥ ॥19॥
7.27.28: dr̥ṣṭvā tat karma pārthasya vāsavasyeva mādhavaḥ,
7.27.29: karmaitat pārtha śakreṇa yamena dhanadena ca,
duṣkaraṁ samare yat te kr̥tamadyeti me matiḥ ॥29॥
7.27.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhe saptaviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥27॥
7.28.2: taṁ prayāntaṁ kuruśreṣṭhaṁ svān bhrātr̥̄n droṇatāpitān,
7.28.5: kiṁ nu saṁśaptakān hanmi svān rakṣāmyahitārditān,
iti me tvaṁ mataṁ vetsi tatra kiṁ sukr̥taṁ bhavet ॥5॥
7.28.8: sāśvaṁ sasūtaṁ tvaritaḥ pārthaḥ praiṣīd yamakṣayam ॥8॥
7.28.17: tathā vikṣobhyamāṇā sā pārthena tava vāhinī,
7.28.18: matiṁ kr̥tvā raṇe krūrāṁ vīrā jayaparājaye ॥18॥
7.28.19: ārcchat pārtho guruṁ bhāraṁ sarvabhārasaho yudhi ॥19॥
7.28.23: kalpitābhyāṁ yathāśāstraṁ rathena ca gajena ca,
7.28.25: sa cāpi śaravarṣaṁ taṁ śaravarṣeṇa vāsaviḥ,
7.28.26: tataḥ prāgjyotiṣo rājā śaravarṣaṁ nivārya tat,
śarairjaghne mahābāhuṁ pārthaṁ kr̥ṣṇaṁ ca māriṣa ॥26॥
7.28.30: sa tu nāgo dviparathān hayāṁścāmr̥dya māriṣa,
7.28.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhaparvaṇi bhagadattayuddhe aṣṭāviṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥28॥
7.29.1: prāgjyotiṣo vā pārthasya tanme śaṁsa yathātatham ॥1॥
7.29.6: tasya pārtho dhanuśchittvā parivāraṁ nihatya ca,
7.29.8: tato nāgasya tad varma vyadhamat pākaśāsaniḥ,
7.29.9: śīrṇavarmā sa tu gajaḥ śaraiḥ subhr̥śamarditaḥ,
7.29.11: tataśchatraṁ dhvajaṁ caiva chittvā rājño’rjunaḥ śaraiḥ,
7.29.16: tasya pārtho dhanuśchittvā tūṇīrān saṁnikr̥tya ca,
7.29.22: ityuktvā puṇḍarīkākṣa pratijñāṁ svāṁ na rakṣasi ॥22॥
7.29.23: yadyahaṁ vyasanī vā syāmaśakto vā nivāraṇe,
tatastvayaivaṁ kāryaṁ syānna tatkāryaṁ mayi sthite ॥23॥
7.29.25: śr̥ṇu guhyamidaṁ pārtha purā vr̥ttaṁ yathānagha ॥25॥
7.29.27: ekā mūrtistapaścaryāṁ kurute me bhuvi sthitā,
7.29.29: varārhebhyo varān śreṣṭhāṁstasmin kāle dadāti sā ॥29॥
7.29.30: taṁ tu kālamanuprāptaṁ viditvā pr̥thivī tadā,
7.29.33: avocaṁ caitadastraṁ vai hyamoghaṁ bhavatu kṣame,
7.29.36: tasmāt prāgjyotiṣaṁ prāptaṁ tadastraṁ pārtha māmakam,
7.29.38: yathāhaṁ jaghnivān pūrvaṁ hitārthaṁ narakaṁ tathā ॥38॥
7.29.41: sa samāsādya taṁ nāgaṁ bāṇo vajra ivācalam,
7.29.43: sa tu viṣṭabhya gātrāṇi dantābhyāmavaniṁ yayau,
7.29.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhaparvaṇi bhagadattavadhe ekonatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥29॥
7.30.3: tau sametyārjunaṁ vīrau puraḥ paścācca dhanvinau,
7.30.4: vr̥ṣakasya hayān sūtaṁ dhanuśchatraṁ rathaṁ dhvajam,
tilaśo vyadhamat pārthaḥ saubalasya śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥4॥
7.30.13: yaśo daśa diśaḥ puṇyaṁ gamayitvā vyavasthitau ॥13॥
7.30.24: tat tamo bhairavaṁ ghoraṁ bhayakartr̥ mahāhave,
7.30.26: evaṁ bahuvidhā māyāḥ saubalasya kr̥tāḥ kr̥tāḥ ॥26॥
7.30.29: sā hanyamānā pārthena tava putrasya vāhinī ॥29॥
7.30.32: gāṇḍīvasya ca nirghoṣaḥ śruto dakṣiṇato mayā,
7.30.37: te hanyamānāḥ pārthena tvadīyā vyathitā bhr̥śam,
7.30.38: śalabhā iva sampetuḥ saṁvr̥ṇvānā diśo daśa ॥38॥
7.30.40: na ca dvitīyaṁ vyasr̥jat kuñjarāśvanareṣu saḥ,
7.30.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhaparvaṇi śakunipalāyane triṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥30॥
7.31.1: calitānāṁ drutānāṁ ca kathamāsīnmano hi vaḥ ॥1॥
7.31.7: droṇaṁ droṇamiti hyeke mā droṇamiti cāpare,
7.31.8: yaṁ yaṁ pramathate droṇaḥ pañcālānāṁ rathavrajam,
7.31.9: vīrāḥ samāsadan vīrān kurvanto bhairavaṁ ravam ॥9॥
7.31.11: tyaktvā prāṇān nyavartanta ghnanto droṇaṁ mahāhave ॥11॥
7.31.16: droṇena caratā saṅkhye prabhagnāni śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥16॥
7.31.18: naiva tasyopamā kāciditi me niścitā matiḥ ॥18॥
7.31.21: mayaikena hi yudhyasva kruddhaḥ prahara cāśu mām ॥21॥
7.31.23: dhanurdhvajaṁ ca chatraṁ ca dviṣataḥ sa nyakr̥ntata ॥23॥
7.31.29: dakṣiṇena tu senāyāḥ kurute kadanaṁ balī,
7.31.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhaparvaṇi nīlavadhe ekatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥31॥
7.32.1: so’bhyāhanad guruṁ ṣaṣṭyā karṇaṁ ca daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥1॥
7.32.5: droṇaṁ pañcāśateṣūṇāṁ karṇaṁ ca daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.32.11: bāhyaṁ mr̥tyubhayaṁ kr̥tvā tāvakān pāṇḍavā yayuḥ,
7.32.17: babhramuḥ samare nāgā mr̥dnantaḥ śataśo narān,
7.32.19: hanti smātra pitā putraṁ rathenābhyetya saṁyuge ॥19॥
7.32.24: hā tāta hā putra sakhe kvāsi tiṣṭha kva dhāvasi,
7.32.35: tataḥ senāpatiḥ śīghramayaṁ kāla iti bruvan ॥35॥
7.32.38: ityāsīt tumulaḥ śabdo durdharṣasya rathaṁ prati,
tato droṇaḥ kr̥paḥ karṇo drauṇī rājā jayadrathaḥ ॥38॥
7.32.40: śarārtā na jahurdroṇaṁ pañcālāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha,
7.32.43: abhyayāt tatra yatrāsau droṇaḥ pāṇḍūn pramardati,
7.32.51: kuravaḥ karṇa karṇeti hāheti ca vicukruśuḥ,
7.32.57: te nikr̥ttāyudhāḥ śūrā nirviṣā bhujagā iva ॥57॥
7.32.62: jahāra sadyo bhallena vipāṭasya śiro rathāt,
7.32.64: varāsinā karṇapakṣān jaghāna daśa pañca ca,
7.32.67: ādāya karṇaṁ vivyādha trisaptatyā nadan raṇe,
7.32.69: tato duryodhano droṇo rājā caiva jayadrathaḥ ॥69॥
7.32.73: tāvakānāṁ pareṣāṁ ca tyaktvā prāṇānabhūd raṇaḥ,
7.32.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi saṁśaptakavadhaparvaṇi dvādaśadivasāvahāre dvātriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥32॥
7.33.1: droṇe ca moghasaṅkalpe rakṣite ca yudhiṣṭhire ॥1॥
7.33.7: tathā hi nāgrahīḥ prāptaṁ samīpe’dya yudhiṣṭhiram ॥7॥
7.33.8: icchataste na mucyeta cakṣuḥprāpto raṇe ripuḥ,
7.33.9: varaṁ dattvā mama prītaḥ paścād vikr̥tavānasi,
7.33.10: nāīse māṁ tathā jñātuṁ ghaṭamānaṁ tava priye ॥10॥
7.33.11: nālaṁ lokā raṇe jetuṁ pālyamānaṁ kirīṭinā ॥11॥
7.33.12: tatra kasya balaṁ krāmedanyatra tryambakāt prabhoḥ ॥12॥
7.33.15: na hyajñātamasādhyaṁ vā tasya saṅkhye’sti kiñcana,
7.33.17: tādr̥śo yādr̥śo nānyaḥ śruto dr̥ṣṭo’pi vā kvacit ॥17॥
7.33.18: tatra droṇena vihito vyūho rājan vyarocata,
7.33.20: sa kr̥tvā duṣkaraṁ karma hatvā vīrān sahasraśaḥ,
7.33.22: raṇe vinihataṁ śrutvā bhr̥śaṁ me dīryate manaḥ ॥22॥
7.33.26: tat te kārtsnyena vakṣyāmi śr̥ṇu rājan samāhitaḥ ॥26॥
7.33.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhasaṅkṣepakathane trayastriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥33॥
7.34.2: naiva bhūto na bhavitā naiva tulyaguṇaḥ pumān ॥2॥
7.34.3: sadaiva tridivaṁ prāpto rājā kila yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥3॥
7.34.6: nakule’prātirūpyaṁ ca śauryaṁ ca niyatāni ṣaṭ ॥6॥
7.34.8: ye ca kr̥ṣṇe guṇāḥ sphītāḥ pāṇḍaveṣu ca ye guṇāḥ,
7.34.12: sthiro bhava mahārāja śokaṁ dhāraya durdharam,
7.34.25: tāvakānāṁ pareṣāṁ ca mr̥tyuṁ kr̥tvā nivartanam ॥25॥
7.34.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi cakravyūhanirmāṇe catustriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥34॥
7.35.6: ete cānye ca sagaṇāḥ kr̥tāstrā yuddhadurmadāḥ,
7.35.9: na śekuḥ pramukhe sthātuṁ bhāradvājasya pāṇḍavāḥ ॥9॥
7.35.12: aśakyaṁ tu tamanyena droṇaṁ matvā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
7.35.14: etya no nārjuno garhed yathā tāta tathā kuru,
cakravyūhasya na vayaṁ vidmo bhedaṁ kathañcana ॥14॥
7.35.15: tvaṁ vārjuno vā kr̥ṣṇo vā bhindyāt pradyumna eva vā,
7.35.16: pitr̥̄ṇāṁ mātulānāṁ ca sainyānāṁ caiva sarvaśaḥ ॥16॥
7.35.20: bhindhyanīkaṁ yudhāṁ śreṣṭha dvāraṁ sañjanayasva naḥ,
vayaṁ tvānugamiṣyāmo yena tvaṁ tāta yāsyasi ॥20॥
7.35.21: dhanañjayasamaṁ yuddhe tvāṁ vayaṁ tāta saṁyuge,
7.35.23: sakr̥d bhinnaṁ tvayā vyūhaṁ tatra tatra punaḥ punaḥ,
7.35.25: tat karmādya kariṣyāmi hitaṁ yad vaṁśayordvayoḥ,
mātulasya ca yat prītiṁ kariṣyati pituśca me ॥25॥
7.35.27: nāhaṁ pārthena jātaḥ syāṁ na ca jātaḥ subhadrayā,
yadi me saṁyuge kaścijjīvito nādya mucyate ॥27॥
7.35.29: evaṁ te bhāṣamāṇasya balaṁ saubhadra vardhatām,
7.35.31: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā sa yantāramacodayat,
7.35.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi abhimanyupratijñāyāṁ pañcatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥35॥
7.36.4: ācāryo hi kr̥tī droṇaḥ paramāstre kr̥taśramaḥ,
7.36.5: sārathe ko nvayaṁ droṇaḥ samagraṁ kṣatrameva vā ॥5॥
7.36.6: yodhayeyaṁ raṇamukhe na me kṣatre’dya vismayaḥ ॥6॥
7.36.7: api viśvajitaṁ viṣṇuṁ mātulaṁ prāpya sūtaja ॥7॥
7.36.21: te hanyamānā vivaśā nānāliṅgaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.36.30: dviṣacchirobhiḥ pr̥thivīṁ sa vai tastāra phālguniḥ ॥30॥
7.36.40: tathā nirmathitaṁ tena tryaṅgaṁ tava balaṁ mahat ॥40॥
7.36.42: evamekena tāṁ senāṁ saubhadreṇa śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥42॥
7.36.45: hatān putrān pitr̥̄n bhrātr̥̄n bandhūn sambandhinastathā ॥45॥
7.36.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi abhimanyuparākrame ṣaṭtriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥36॥
7.37.3: tamādravata mā bhaiṣṭa kṣipraṁ rakṣata kauravam ॥3॥
7.37.5: droṇo drauṇiḥ kr̥paḥ karṇaḥ kr̥tavarmā ca saubalaḥ,
7.37.14: abhimanyoḥ pareṣāṁ ca nāsīt kaścit parāṅmukhaḥ ॥14॥
7.37.28: tasya bhittvā tanutrāṇaṁ dehaṁ nirbhidya cāśugaḥ,
7.37.31: aśvatthāmā ca viṁśatyā kr̥tavarmā ca saptabhiḥ ॥31॥
7.37.34: śalyo rājan rathopasthe niṣasāda mumoha ca ॥34॥
7.37.35: taṁ hi dr̥ṣṭvā tathā viddhaṁ saubhadreṇa yaśasvinā,
7.37.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi abhimanyuparākrame saptatriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥37॥
7.38.1: ārjuniṁ māmakāḥ saṅkhye ke tvenaṁ samavārayan ॥1॥
7.38.2: śr̥ṇu rājan kumārasya raṇe vikrīḍitaṁ mahat,
7.38.5: chatraṁ dhvajaṁ niyantāraṁ triveṇuṁ talpameva ca ॥5॥
7.38.6: cakraṁ yugaṁ ca tūṇīraṁ hyanukarṣaṁ ca sāyakaiḥ,
7.38.7: laghuhastaḥ praciccheda dadr̥śe taṁ na kaścana,
7.38.9: ārjuneḥ karma tad dr̥ṣṭvā sampraṇeduḥ samantataḥ,
7.38.13: bruvantaśca na no jīvan mokṣyase jīvitāditi ॥13॥
7.38.14: yo yo’smai prāharat pūrvaṁ taṁ taṁ vivyādha patribhiḥ ॥14॥
7.38.17: dūramasya guruṁ bhāraṁ sādhvasaṁ ca punaḥ punaḥ,
7.38.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi abhimanyuparākrame aṣṭātriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥38॥
7.39.1: dvaidhībhavati me cittaṁ hriyā tuṣṭyā ca sañjaya,
mama putrasya yat sainyaṁ saubhadraḥ samavārayat ॥1॥
7.39.2: vistareṇaiva me śaṁsa sarvaṁ gāvalgaṇe punaḥ,
7.39.3: ekasya ca bahūnāṁ ca yathā’’sīt tumulo raṇaḥ ॥3॥
7.39.5: droṇaṁ karṇaṁ kr̥paṁ śalyaṁ drauṇiṁ bhojaṁ br̥hadbalam,
7.39.11: eṣa gacchati saubhadraḥ pārthānāṁ prathito yuvā,
nandayan suhr̥daḥ sarvān rājānaṁ ca yudhiṣṭhiram ॥11॥
7.39.12: nakulaṁ sahadevaṁ ca bhīmasenaṁ ca pāṇḍavam,
7.39.13: nāsya yuddhe samaṁ manye kañcidanyaṁ dhanurdharam,
7.39.14: ārjuniṁ prati saṅkruddho droṇaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā smayanniva ॥14॥
7.39.17: kimaṅga punarevānyo martyaḥ satyaṁ bravīmi vaḥ ॥17॥
7.39.25: tau ca śrutvā mr̥tau vyaktaṁ pāṇḍoḥ kṣetrodbhavāḥ sutāḥ,
7.39.26: śivena māṁ dhyāhi rājanneṣa hanmi ripūṁstava ॥26॥
7.39.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi duḥśāsanayuddhe ekonacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥39॥
7.40.3: yat sabhāyāṁ tvayā rājño dhr̥tarāṣṭrasya śr̥ṇvataḥ,
7.40.9: amarṣitāyāḥ kr̥ṣṇāyāḥ kāṅkṣitasya ca me pituḥ,
7.40.10: na hi me mokṣyase jīvan yadi notsr̥jase raṇam,
7.40.24: atha caite susaṁrabdhāḥ siṁhā iva balotkaṭāḥ ॥24॥
7.40.28: taṁ tathā nāśakat kaścid droṇād vārayituṁ rathī ॥28॥
7.40.37: vāditrāṇi ca sañjaghnuḥ saubhadraṁ cāpi tuṣṭuvuḥ ॥37॥
7.40.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi karṇaduḥśāsanaparābhave catvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥40॥
7.41.5: bhrātaraṁ nihataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā rājan karṇo vyathāṁ yayau ॥5॥
7.41.9: abhimanyoḥ śarai rājan na prājñāyata kiñcana ॥9॥
7.41.10: tāvakānāṁ tu yodhānāṁ vadhyatāṁ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
anyatra saindhavād rājan na sma kaścidatiṣṭhata ॥10॥
7.41.15: te ghorā raudrakarmāṇo vipāṭhā bahavaḥ śitāḥ,
7.41.22: sa śabdo bharataśreṣṭha diśaḥ sarvā vyanādayat,
7.41.24: taṁ tadā nānupaśyāmaḥ sainye ca rajasā’’vr̥te ॥24॥
7.41.25: kṣaṇena bhūyaḥ paśyāmaḥ sūryaṁ madhyandine yathā ॥25॥
7.41.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi abhimanyuparākrame ekacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥41॥
7.42.4: tenaiva tu pathā yāntaḥ pitaro mātulaiḥ saha ॥4॥
7.42.6: tatastad vimukhaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tava sūnormahad balam,
7.42.10: atyadbhutamahaṁ manye balaṁ śauryaṁ ca saindhave,
tasya prabrūhi me vīryaṁ karma cāgryaṁ mahātmanaḥ ॥10॥
7.42.11: kiṁ dattaṁ hutamiṣṭaṁ vā kiṁ sutaptamatho tapaḥ,
7.42.11d1: damo vā brahmacaryaṁ vā sūta yaccāsya sattama,
7.42.11d2: naivaṁ kr̥taṁ mahat karma bhīṣmeṇājñāsiṣaṁ tathā.
7.42.12: mānāt sa taptavān rājā varārthī sumahat tapaḥ ॥12॥
7.42.18: dadāmi te varaṁ saumya vinā pārthaṁ dhanañjayam ॥18॥
7.42.22: dr̥ṣṭvā tu kṣatriyā bhāraṁ saindhave sarvamāhitam,
7.42.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi jayadrathayuddhe dvicatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥42॥
7.43.7: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ tathā ṣaṣṭyā virāṭaṁ daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥7॥
7.43.12: tat tasya lāghavaṁ jñātvā bhīmo bhallaistribhistribhiḥ,
dhanurdhvajaṁ ca cchatraṁ ca kṣitau kṣipramapātayat ॥12॥
7.43.13: so’nyadādāya balavān sajyaṁ kr̥tvā ca kārmukam,
7.43.19: yo yo hi yatate bhettuṁ droṇānīkaṁ tavāhitaḥ,
taṁ tameva varaṁ prāpya saindhavaḥ pratyavārayat ॥19॥
7.43.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi jayadrathayuddhe tricatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥43॥
7.44.4: teṣāṁ tasya ca sammardo dāruṇaḥ samapadyata,
7.44.9: abravīcca na me jīvañjīvato yudhi mokṣyase ॥9॥
7.44.10: vivyādha hr̥di saubhadraḥ sa papāta vyasuḥ kṣitau ॥10॥
7.44.13: teṣāṁ śarān seṣvasanān śarīrāṇi śirāṁsi ca,
7.44.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi abhimanyuparākrame catuścatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥44॥
7.45.2: sa śakra iva vikrāntaḥ śakrasūnoḥ suto balī,
7.45.10: alaṁ trāsena vaḥ śūrā naiṣa kaścinmayi sthite,
7.45.12: tribhiśca dakṣiṇe bāhau savye ca niśitaistribhiḥ ॥12॥
7.45.14: dr̥ṣṭvā rukmarathaṁ rugṇaṁ putraṁ śalyasya māninam,
7.45.20: sasūtāśvadhvajaṁ tasya syandanaṁ taṁ ca māriṣa,
7.45.23: ekadhā śatadhā rājan dr̥śyate sma sahasradhā,
7.45.25: prāṇāḥ prāṇabhr̥tāṁ saṅkhye preṣitāni śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.45.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi duryodhanaparājaye pañcacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥45॥
7.46.1: yathā vadasi me sūta ekasya bahubhiḥ saha,
saṅgrāmaṁ tumulaṁ ghoraṁ jayaṁ caiva mahātmanaḥ ॥1॥
7.46.2: kiṁ tu nātyadbhutaṁ teṣāṁ yeṣāṁ dharmo vyapāśrayaḥ ॥2॥
7.46.7: te tu pautreṇa te rājan prāyaśo vimukhīkr̥tāḥ ॥7॥
7.46.10: sa tu tān pramamāthaiko viṣvagvāto yathāmbudān ॥10॥
7.46.11: pautraṁ tava ca durdharṣaṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ priyadarśanam,
7.46.15: sudr̥ṣṭaḥ kriyatāṁ loko hyamuṁ lokaṁ gamiṣyasi,
7.46.18: tato duryodhanaḥ kruddhaḥ priye putre nipātite ॥18॥
7.46.19: tato droṇaḥ kr̥paḥ karṇo droṇaputro br̥hadbalaḥ ॥19॥
7.46.20: kr̥tavarmā ca hārdikyaḥ ṣaḍ rathāḥ paryavārayan,
7.46.27: yukte tasmin hate vīrāḥ prāyaśo vimukhā’bhavan ॥27॥
7.46.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi lakṣmaṇavadhe ṣaṭcatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥46॥
7.47.4: taṁ tu droṇaḥ kr̥paḥ karṇo drauṇiśca sa br̥hadbalaḥ,
kr̥tavarmā ca hārdikyaḥ ṣaḍ rathāḥ paryavārayan ॥4॥
7.47.10: sa karṇaṁ karṇinā karṇe pītena ca śitena ca,
7.47.14: sa tu bāṇaiḥ śitaistūrṇaṁ pratyavidhyata māriṣa,
7.47.17: aśvatthāmā tathāṣṭau ca parīpsan pitaraṁ raṇe ॥17॥
7.47.18: karṇo dvāviṁśatiṁ bhallān kr̥tavarmā ca viṁśatim,
7.47.20: sa tasyāśvān dhvajaṁ cāpaṁ sūtaṁ cāpātayat kṣitau ॥20॥
7.47.23: babhañja ca sahasrāṇi daśa rājñāṁ mahātmanām,
7.47.24: tathā br̥hadbalaṁ hatvā saubhadro vyacarad raṇe,
7.47.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi br̥hadbalavadhe saptacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥47॥
7.48.1: sa karṇaṁ karṇinā karṇe punarvivyādha phālguniḥ,
7.48.11: pitā tavāhavaṁ tyaktvā gataḥ kāpuruṣo yathā,
diṣṭyā tvamapi jānīṣe yoddhuṁ na tvadya mokṣyase ॥11॥
7.48.16: sūryabhāsaṁ ca pañcaitān hatvā vivyādha saubalam,
7.48.17: sarva enaṁ vimathnīmaḥ puraikaikaṁ hinasti naḥ,
7.48.18: purā sarvān pramathnāti brūhyasya vadhamāśu naḥ,
7.48.22: ati māṁ nandayatyeṣa saubhadro vicaran raṇe ॥22॥
7.48.23: antaraṁ yasya saṁrabdhā na paśyanti mahārathāḥ,
7.48.28: śakyaṁ tvasya dhanuśchettuṁ jyāṁ ca bāṇaiḥ samāhitaiḥ ॥28॥
7.48.29: etat kuru maheṣvāsa rādheya yadi śakyate ॥29॥
7.48.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi abhimanyuvirathakaraṇe aṣṭacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥48॥
7.49.8: kekayānāṁ rathān sapta hatvā ca daśa kuñjarān ॥8॥
7.49.16: taṁ tathā patitaṁ śūraṁ tāvakāḥ paryavārayan,
dāvaṁ dagdhvā yathā śāntaṁ pāvakaṁ śiśirātyaye ॥16॥
7.49.19: taṁ bhūmau patitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tāvakāste mahārathāḥ,
7.49.22: eko’yaṁ nihataḥ śete naiṣa dharmo mato hi naḥ ॥22॥
7.49.32: tāvakānāṁ parā prītiḥ pāṇḍūnāṁ cābhavad vyathā ॥32॥
7.49.35: svargameṣa gataḥ śūro yo hato na parāṅmukhaḥ,
saṁstambhayata mā bhaiṣṭa vijeṣyāmo raṇe ripūn ॥35॥
7.49.38: hatvā daśa sahasrāṇi kausalyaṁ ca mahāratham,
7.49.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhe ekonapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥49॥
7.50.1: vayaṁ tu pravaraṁ hatvā teṣāṁ taiḥ śarapīḍitāḥ,
7.50.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi tr̥tīyadivasāvahāre samarabhūmivarṇane pañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥50॥
7.51.3: abhimanyau hate vīre bhrātuḥ putre mahārathe ॥3॥
7.51.3d1: eṣa jitvā kr̥paṁ śalyaṁ rājānaṁ ca suyodhanam,
7.51.4d4: vikrīḍitaṁ raṇe tena nighnatā vai parān varān,
7.51.12: yo hi bhojye puraskāryo yāneṣu śayaneṣu ca,
7.51.15: alubdho matimān hrīmān kṣamāvān rūpavān balī,
7.51.19: bhayaṁ tu sumahat prāptaṁ dhārtarāṣṭrān mahābalān,
7.51.20: vyaktaṁ duryodhano dr̥ṣṭvā śocan hāsyati jīvitam ॥20॥
7.51.21: na me jayaḥ prītikaro na rājyaṁ
7.51.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirapralāpe ekapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥51॥
7.52.5: mayā proktaḥ sa saṅgrāme dvāraṁ sañjanayasva naḥ,
7.52.6: idaṁ caivāsamaṁ yuddhamīdr̥śaṁ yat kr̥taṁ paraiḥ ॥6॥
7.52.10: svargameṣa gataḥ śūraḥ śatrūn hatvā bahūn raṇe,
7.52.13: ta ete nihatāḥ saṅkhye tulyarūpā narairnarāḥ ॥13॥
7.52.14: naiṣāṁ paśyāmi hantāraṁ prāṇināṁ saṁyuge kvacit,
7.52.15: jetavyamiti cānyonyaṁ yeṣāṁ nityaṁ hr̥di sthitam,
atha ceme hatāḥ prājñāḥ śerate vigatāyuṣaḥ ॥15॥
7.52.16: mr̥tā iti ca śabdo’yaṁ vartate ca tato’rthavat,
7.52.18: atra me saṁśayaḥ prāptaḥ kutaḥ sañjñā mr̥tā iti,
kasya mr̥tyuḥ kuto mr̥tyuḥ kena mr̥tyurimāḥ prajāḥ ॥18॥
7.52.26: purā kr̥tayuge tāta āsīd rājā hyakampanaḥ,
7.52.27: śrīmān kr̥tāstro medhāvī yudhi śakropamo balī ॥27॥
7.52.28: vyasyan bāṇasahasrāṇi yodheṣu ca gajeṣu ca ॥28॥
7.52.29: sa karma duṣkaraṁ kr̥tvā saṅgrāme śatrutāpanaḥ,
7.52.30: sa rājā pretakr̥tyāni tasya kr̥tvā śucānvitaḥ,
7.52.32: sa tu rājā mahābhāgo dr̥ṣṭvā devarṣisattamam,
7.52.33: śatrubhirvijayaṁ saṅkhye putrasya ca vadhaṁ tathā ॥33॥
7.52.36: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā nārado varadaḥ prabhuḥ,
7.52.38: prajāḥ sr̥ṣṭvā tadā brahmā ādisarge pitāmahaḥ,
7.52.39: tasya cintā samutpannā saṁhāraṁ prati pārthiva,
7.52.40: tena sarvā diśo vyāptāḥ sāntardeśā didhakṣatā ॥40॥
7.52.41: carācaraṁ jagat sarvaṁ dadāha bhagavān prabhuḥ ॥41॥
7.52.42: tato hatāni bhūtāni carāṇi sthāvarāṇi ca,
7.52.45: kiṁ kurmaḥ kāmaṁ kāmārha kāmājjāto’si putraka,
kariṣyāmi priyaṁ sarvaṁ brūhi sthāṇo yadicchasi ॥45॥
7.53.2: tāstaveha punaḥ krodhāt prajā dahyanti sarvaśaḥ,
tā dr̥ṣṭtvā mama kāruṇyaṁ prasīda bhagavan prabho ॥2॥
7.53.3: saṁhartuṁ na ca me kāma etadevaṁ bhavediti,
pr̥thivyā hitakāmaṁ tu tato māṁ manyurāviśat ॥3॥
7.53.4: iyaṁ hi māṁ sahā devī bhārārtā samacūcudat,
7.53.7: tava prasādād bhagavannidaṁ vartet tridhā jagat,
7.53.9: sthāvaraṁ jaṅgamaṁ caiva niḥśeṣaṁ kurute jagat ॥9॥
7.53.10: prasīda bhagavan sa tvaṁ roṣo na syād varo mama ॥10॥
7.53.11: sarve hi sr̥ṣṭā naśyanti tava deva kathañcana,
7.53.12: tat paśya deva subhr̥śaṁ prajānāṁ hitakāmyayā,
7.53.15: śrutvā hi vacanaṁ devaḥ prajānāṁ hitakāraṇe,
7.53.16: pravr̥ttaṁ ca nivr̥ttaṁ ca kathayāmāsa vai prabhuḥ ॥16॥
7.53.19: sā niḥsr̥tya tathā khebhyo dakṣiṇāṁ diśamāśritā,
7.53.20: mr̥tyo iti mahīpāla jahi cemāḥ prajā iti ॥20॥
7.53.20d1: uktavān madhuraṁ vākyaṁ sāntvayitvā punaḥ punaḥ,
7.53.21: tvaṁ hi saṁhārabuddhyātha prādurbhūtā ruṣo mama,
7.53.22: mama tvaṁ hi niyogena tataḥ śreyo hyavāpsyasi,
evamuktā tu sā tena mr̥tyuḥ kamalalocanā ॥22॥
7.53.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi mr̥tyukathane tripañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥53॥
7.54.2: tvayā sr̥ṣṭā kathaṁ nārī īdr̥śī vadatāṁ vara,
krūraṁ karmāhitaṁ kuryāṁ tadeva kimu jānatī ॥2॥
7.54.3: priyān putrān vayasyāṁśca bhrātr̥̄n mātr̥̄ḥ pitr̥̄n patīn ॥3॥
7.54.5: yamasya bhavanaṁ deva gaccheyaṁ na surottama ॥5॥
7.54.7: pradiśemaṁ varaṁ deva tvaṁ mahyaṁ bhagavan prabho ॥7॥
7.54.9: na hi śakṣyāmi deveśa prāṇān prāṇabhr̥tāṁ priyān,
7.54.10: gaccha saṁhara sarvāstvaṁ prajā mā te vicāraṇā ॥10॥
7.54.11: bhava tvaninditā loke kuruṣva vacanaṁ mama ॥11॥
7.54.15: sā kanyāpi jagāmātha samīpāt tasya dhīmataḥ ॥15॥
7.54.17: sā tatra paramaṁ tīvraṁ cacāra vratamuttamam,
sā tadā hyekapādena tasthau padmāni ṣoḍaśa ॥17॥
7.54.18: pañca cābdāni kāruṇyāt prajānāṁ tu hitaiṣiṇī,
7.54.19: tasthau padmāni ṣaṭ caiva sapta caikaṁ ca pārthiva ॥19॥
7.54.20: tataḥ padmāyutaṁ tāta mr̥gaiḥ saha cacāra sā,
7.54.21: apsu varṣasahasrāṇi sapta caikaṁ ca sānayat,
7.54.22: sā pūrvaṁ kauśikīṁ puṇyāṁ jagāma niyamaidhitā,
7.54.23: pañcagaṅgāsu sā puṇyā kanyā vetasakeṣu ca,
7.54.24: tato gatvā tu sā gaṅgāṁ mahāmeruṁ ca kevalam,
7.54.25: tatrāṅguṣṭhena sā tasthau nikharvaṁ paramā śubhā ॥25॥
7.54.32: ārtā cānāgasī nārī yācāmi bhava me gatiḥ,
7.54.33: adharmo nāsti te mr̥tyo saṁharantyā imāḥ prajāḥ,
mayā coktaṁ mr̥ṣā bhadre bhavitā na kathañcana ॥33॥
7.54.35: ahaṁ ca vibudhāścaiva punardāsyāma te varam ॥35॥
7.54.37: yadyevametat kartavyaṁ mayā na syād vinā prabho ॥37॥
7.54.38: tavājñā mūrdhni me nyastā yat te vakṣyāmi tacchr̥ṇu,
7.54.39: tathā bhaviṣyate mr̥tyo sādhu saṁhara bhoḥ prajāḥ,
7.54.41: tvaṁ vai dharmastvaṁ hi dharmasya ceśā,
7.54.54: puṇyaṁ yaśasyaṁ svargyaṁ ca dhanyamāyuṣyameva ca,
7.54.55: kṣatradharmaṁ ca vijñāya śūrāṇāṁ ca parāṁ gatim ॥55॥
7.54.57: asinā gadayā śaktyā dhanuṣā ca mahārathaḥ,
7.54.58: tasmāt parāṁ dhr̥tiṁ kr̥tvā bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha pāṇḍava,
7.54.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate draṇeparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi mr̥tyuprajāpatisaṁvāde catuḥpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥54॥
7.55.4: kiyantyo dakṣiṇā dattāḥ kaiśca dattā mahātmabhiḥ,
7.55.5: śaibyasya nr̥pateḥ putraḥ sr̥ñjayā nāma nāmataḥ,
7.55.6: tau kadācid gr̥haṁ tasya praviṣṭau taddidr̥kṣayā,
7.55.7: taṁ kadācit sukhāsīnaṁ tābhyāṁ saha śucismitā,
7.55.10: utāho bhāḥ svidarkasya jvalanasya śikhā tviyam,
7.55.14: hr̥dayena mayā pūrvaṁ vr̥tāṁ vai vr̥tavānasi,
yasmād vr̥tā tvayā vipra mā gāḥ svargaṁ yathepsayā ॥14॥
7.55.16: na tveṣā niścitā niṣṭhā niṣṭhā saptapadī smr̥tā ॥16॥
7.55.17: anutpanne ca kāryārthe māṁ tvaṁ vyāhr̥tavānasi,
tasmāt tvamapi na svargaṁ gamiṣyasi mayā vinā ॥17॥
7.55.18: anyonyamevaṁ śaptvā vai tasthatustatra tau tadā,
7.55.22: varaṁ vr̥ṇīṣva bhadraṁ te yādr̥śaṁ putramīpsitam,
tathoktaḥ prāñjalī rājā putraṁ vavre guṇānvitam ॥22॥
7.55.23: yasya mūtraṁ purīṣaṁ ca kledaḥ svedaśca kāñcanam ॥23॥
7.55.23d1: sarvaṁ bhavet prasādād vai tādr̥śaṁ tanayaṁ vr̥ṇe,
7.55.26: tasya rājño’pi yad veśma bāhyāścopaskarāśca ye ॥26॥
7.55.27: atha dasyugaṇāḥ śrutvā dr̥ṣṭvā cainaṁ tathāvidham ॥27॥
7.55.28: kecit tatrābruvan rājñaḥ putraṁ gr̥hṇīma vai svayam ॥28॥
7.55.31: hatvā viśasya cāpaśyan lubdhā vasu na kiñcana,
tasya prāṇairvimuktasya naṣṭaṁ tad varadaṁ vasu ॥31॥
7.55.32: hatvā parasparaṁ naṣṭāḥ kumāraṁ cādbhutaṁ bhuvi ॥32॥
7.55.33: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nihataṁ putraṁ varadattaṁ mahātapāḥ ॥33॥
7.55.36d1: tyaja śokaṁ mahārāja vaiklavyaṁ tyaja buddhiman,
na mr̥taḥ śocato jīvenmuhyato vā janādhipa.
7.55.36d2: tyaja mohaṁ nr̥paśreṣṭha na hi muhyanti tvadvidhāḥ,
dhīro bhava mahārāja jñānavr̥ddho’si me mataḥ.
7.55.37: yasya caite vayaṁ gehe uṣitā brahmavādinaḥ,
āvikṣitaṁ maruttaṁ ca mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma ॥37॥
7.55.38: yasmai rājarṣaye prādād dhanaṁ sa bhagavān prabhuḥ ॥38॥
7.55.39: haimaṁ himavataḥ pādaṁ yiyakṣorvividhaiḥ sa vai,
7.55.41: yasya sarvaṁ tadā hyannaṁ mano’bhiprāyagaṁ śuci,
7.55.42: payo dadhi ghr̥taṁ kṣaudraṁ bhakṣyaṁ bhojyaṁ ca śobhanam,
7.55.45: r̥ṣīṇāṁ ca pitr̥̄ṇāṁ ca devānāṁ sukhajīvinām ॥45॥
7.55.47: tat sarvamamitaṁ vittaṁ dattaṁ viprebhya icchayā,
7.55.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye pañcapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥55॥
7.56.1: suhotraṁ nāma rājānaṁ mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma,
7.56.2: apr̥cchadātmanaḥ śreyaḥ pr̥ṣṭvā teṣāṁ mate sthitaḥ ॥2॥
7.56.7: kāmān varṣati parjanyo rūpyāṇi vividhāni ca,
7.56.8: sauvarṇān vihitān dr̥ṣṭvā tato’smayata vai tadā ॥8॥
7.56.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye ṣaṭpañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥56॥
7.57.1: rājānaṁ pauravaṁ vīraṁ mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma,
7.57.10: tatrāsya gāthā gāyanti ye purāṇavido janāḥ ॥10॥
7.57.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye saptapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥57॥
7.58.1: ya imāṁ pr̥thivīṁ sarvāṁ carmavat paryaveṣṭayat ॥1॥
7.58.2: sa śibirvai ripūn nityaṁ mukhyān nighnan sapatnajit ॥2॥
7.58.3: sa rājā vīryavān dhīmānavāpya vasu puṣkalam ॥3॥
7.58.6: yāvatyo varṣato dhārā yāvatyo divi tārakāḥ ॥6॥
7.58.7: udanvati ca yāvanti ratnāni prāṇino’pi ca ॥7॥
7.58.12: pibata snāta khādadhvamiti yad rocate janāḥ,
yasmai prādād varaṁ rudrastuṣṭaḥ puṇyena karmaṇā ॥12॥
7.58.13: akṣayaṁ dadato vittaṁ śraddhā kīrtistathā kiyāḥ,
7.58.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye aṣṭapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥58॥
7.59.1: rāmaṁ dāśarathiṁ caiva mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma,
7.59.5d1: rāmāṁ hr̥tāṁ rākṣasena bhāryāṁ śrutvā jaṭāyuṣaḥ,
7.59.7: jaghāna sa mahābāhuḥ paulastyaṁ sagaṇaṁ raṇe,
7.59.7d1: hatvā tatra ripuṁ saṅkhye bhāryayā saha saṅgataḥ,
laṅkeśvaraṁ ca cakre sa dharmātmānaṁ vibhīṣaṇam.
7.59.7d3: tatra rājan praviṣṭaḥ sa ayodhyāyāṁ mahāyaśāḥ,
7.59.7d5: bhrātaraṁ bharataṁ vīraṁ śatrughnaṁ caiva lakṣmaṇam,
7.59.12: r̥ṣīṇāṁ devatānāṁ ca mānuṣāṇāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ ॥12॥
7.59.13: nāhīyata tadā prāṇaḥ prāṇināṁ na tadanyathā ॥13॥
7.59.15: dīrghāyuṣaḥ prajāḥ sarvā yuvā na mriyate tadā,
7.59.16: havyaṁ kavyaṁ ca vividhaṁ niṣpūrtaṁ hutameva ca,
7.59.20d1: na taskarā vā vyādhirvā vividhopadravāḥ kvacit,
7.59.20d2: evaṁ loko’bhavat sarvo rāme rājyaṁ praśāsati.
7.59.22: rāmo rāmo rāma iti prajānāmabhavat kathā ॥22॥
7.59.23: rāmād rāmaṁ jagadabhūd rāme rājyaṁ praśāsati,
caturvidhāḥ prajā rāmaḥ svargaṁ nītvā divaṁ gataḥ ॥23॥
7.59.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye ekonaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥59॥
7.60.1: bhagīrathaṁ ca rājānaṁ mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma,
7.60.1d3: yasyendro vitate yajñe somaṁ pītvā madotkaṭaḥ,
7.60.3: sarvā rathagatāḥ kanyā rathāḥ sarve caturyujaḥ,
rathe rathe śataṁ nāgāḥ sarve vai hemamālinaḥ ॥3॥
7.60.4: aśve aśve śataṁ gāvo gavāṁ paścādajāvikam ॥4॥
7.60.6: tathā bhāgīrathī gaṅgā urvaśī cābhavat purā,
7.60.7: tāṁ tu gāthāṁ jaguḥ prītā gandharvāḥ sūryavarcasaḥ,
7.60.10: yo ya iccheta vipro vai yatra yatrātmanaḥ priyam,
7.60.11: nādeyaṁ brāhmaṇasyāsīd yasya yatsyāt priyaṁ dhanam,
7.60.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye ṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥60॥
7.61.3: dilīpasya tu yajñeṣu kr̥taḥ panthā hiraṇmayaḥ,
taṁ dharma iva kurvāṇāḥ sendrā devāḥ samāgaman ॥3॥
7.61.5: rasānāṁ cābhavan kulyā bhakṣyāṇāṁ cāpi parvatāḥ,
7.61.6: caṣālaṁ pracaṣālaṁ ca yasya yūpe hiraṇmaye,
7.61.7: yatra vīṇāṁ vādayati prītyā viśvāvasuḥ svayam,
7.61.10: pañca śabdā na jīryanti khaṭvāṅgasya niveśane ॥10॥
7.61.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye ekaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥61॥
7.62.2: yaṁ devāvaśvinau garbhāt pituḥ pūrvaṁ cakarṣatuḥ,
7.62.3: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā yuvanāśvasya jaṭhare sūnutāṁ gatam ॥3॥
7.62.5: māmevāyaṁ dhayatvagre iti ha smāha vāsavaḥ ॥5॥
7.62.7: tatastu dhārāṁ payaso ghr̥tasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥7॥
7.62.9: imāṁ ca pr̥thivīṁ kr̥tsnāmekāhnā sa vyajījayat ॥9॥
7.62.11: asitaṁ ca nr̥gaṁ caiva māndhātā manujo’jayat,
udeti ca yataḥ sūryo yatra ca pratitiṣṭhati ॥11॥
7.62.18: sa tāṁ brāhmaṇasātkr̥tvā jagāmāstaṁ tadā nr̥paḥ ॥18॥
7.62.19: gataḥ puṇyakr̥tāṁ lokān vyāpya svayaśasā diśaḥ,
7.62.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye dviṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥62॥
7.63.1: yayātiṁ nāhuṣaṁ caiva mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma,
7.63.8: tato gāthāmimāṁ gītvā sadāraḥ prāviśad vanam ॥8॥
7.63.9: yat pr̥thivyāṁ vrīhiyavaṁ hiraṇyaṁ paśavaḥ striyaḥ,
nālamekasya tat sarvamiti matvā śamaṁ vrajet ॥9॥
7.63.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye triṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥63॥
7.64.5: sa tu tān vaśagān kr̥tvā jitvā cemāṁ vasundharām,
7.64.6: tasmin yajñe tu viprendrāḥ santr̥ptāḥ paramārcitāḥ ॥6॥
7.64.9: ghr̥taṁ madhu payastoyaṁ dadhīni rasavanti ca,
7.64.11: tatra sma gāthā gāyanti kṣībā hr̥ṣṭāḥ paṭhanti ca,
7.64.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye catuḥṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥64॥
7.65.1: śaśabinduṁ ca rājānaṁ mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma,
7.65.6: kanyāṁ kanyāṁ śataṁ nāgā nāge nāge śataṁ rathāḥ ॥6॥
7.65.7: rathe rathe śataṁ cāśvā balino hemamālinaḥ,
7.65.11: śaśabindurimāṁ bhūmiṁ ciraṁ bhuktvā divaṁ gataḥ ॥11॥
7.65.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye pañcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥65॥
7.66.2: tasmai hyagnirvaraṁ prādāt tato vavre varaṁ gayaḥ,
7.66.4: ananyāsu savarṇāsu putrajanma ca me bhavet ॥4॥
7.66.5: annaṁ me dadataḥ śraddhā dharme me ramatāṁ manaḥ,
avighnaṁ cāstu me nityaṁ dharmakāryeṣu pāvaka ॥5॥
7.66.11: sauvarṇāṁ pr̥thivīṁ kr̥tvā ya imāṁ maṇiśarkarām,
7.66.14: nagareṣu ca rāṣṭreṣu divi vyomni ca ye’vasan ॥14॥
7.66.15: gayasya sadr̥śo yajño nāstyanya iti te’bruvan ॥15॥
7.66.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥66॥
7.67.1: sāṅkr̥tiṁ rantidevaṁ ca mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma,
7.67.4: tubhyaṁ niṣkaṁ tubhyaṁ niṣkamiti ha sma prabhāṣate ॥4॥
7.67.7: bhaviṣyati na sandeha evaṁ rājādadad vasu ॥7॥
7.67.10: r̥ṣibhyaḥ karakān kumbhān sthālīḥ piṭharameva ca,
7.67.11: vr̥kṣāṁśca vividhān dadyādannāni ca dhanāni ca,
7.67.12: tatrāsya gāthā gāyanti ye purāṇavido janāḥ,
7.67.13: dhanaṁ ca pūryamāṇaṁ naḥ kiṁ punarmanujeṣviti ॥13॥
7.67.17: tat sarvaṁ vitate yajñe brāhmaṇebhyo hyamanyata,
7.67.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye saptaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥67॥
7.68.1: dauṣyantiṁ bharataṁ cāpi mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma,
7.68.11: iṣṭvā śākuntalo rājā tarpayitvā dvijān dhanaiḥ,
sahasraṁ yatra padmānāṁ kaṇvāya bharato dadau ॥11॥
7.68.14: dāsīdāsaṁ dhanaṁ dhānyaṁ gāḥ savatsāḥ payasvinīḥ ॥14॥
7.68.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye aṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥68॥
7.69.1: pr̥thuṁ vainyaṁ ca rājānaṁ mr̥taṁ sr̥ñjaya śuśruma,
7.69.3: pr̥thuṁ vainyaṁ prajā dr̥ṣṭvā raktāḥ smeti yadabruvan,
7.69.4: sarvāḥ kāmadughā gāvaḥ puṭake puṭake madhu ॥4॥
7.69.7: nyavasanta yathākāmaṁ vr̥kṣeṣu ca guhāsu ca ॥7॥
7.69.8: pravibhāgo na rāṣṭrāṇāṁ purāṇāṁ cābhavat tadā,
7.69.11: samrāḍasi kṣatriyo’si rājā goptā pitāsi naḥ ॥11॥
7.69.14: ehyehi vasuke kṣipraṁ kṣaraibhyaḥ kāṅkṣitaṁ payaḥ,
tato dāsyāmi bhadraṁ te annaṁ yasya yathepsitam ॥14॥
7.69.17: vatso’bhūt puṣpitaḥ śālaḥ plakṣo dogdhābhavat tadā ॥17॥
7.69.19: dogdhā cāsīt tadā devo dugdhamūrjaskaraṁ priyam ॥19॥
7.69.21: kr̥ṣiṁ ca sasyaṁ ca narā duduhuḥ pr̥thivītale,
7.69.22: alābupātre ca tathā viṣaṁ dugdhā vasundharā,
7.69.23: dogdhā br̥haspatiḥ pātraṁ chando vatsaśca somarāṭ ॥23॥
7.69.27: evaṁ nikāyaistairdugdhā payo’bhīṣṭaṁ hi sā virāṭ,
7.69.29: hairaṇyānakarod rājā ye kecit pārthivā bhuvi,
7.69.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye ekonasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥69॥
7.70.2: na cāsīd vikriyā yasya prāpya śriyamanuttamām ॥2॥
7.70.3: yaḥ kṣatriyaiḥ parāmr̥ṣṭe vatse pitari cābruvan,
7.70.8: śiṣṭān baddhvā ca hatvā vai teṣāṁ mūrdhni vibhidya ca,
7.70.22: sa kaśyapasya vacanāt protsārya saritāṁ pratim,
7.70.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye saptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥70॥
7.71.2: śrutaṁ kīrtayato mahyaṁ gr̥hītaṁ te mahādyute ॥2॥
7.71.6: tat tat prapatsyase sarvaṁ na mr̥ṣāvādino vayam ॥6॥
7.71.7: prasanno yasya bhagavān na tasyāstīha durlabham ॥7॥
7.71.8: mr̥taṁ dadāni te putraṁ dasyubhirnihataṁ vr̥thā,
uddhr̥tya narakāt kaṣṭāt paśuvat prokṣitaṁ yathā ॥8॥
7.71.11: akr̥tārthaśca bhītaśca na ca sānnāhiko hataḥ,
7.71.13: brahmacaryeṇa yān kāṁścit prajñayā ca śrutena ca,
7.71.14: na tu svargādayaṁ lokaḥ kāmyate svargavāsibhiḥ ॥14॥
7.71.18: evaṁ jñātvā sthiro bhūtvā jahyarīn dhairyamāpnuhi,
jīvanta eva naḥ śocyā na tu svargagato’nagha ॥18॥
7.71.20: etad buddhvā budhāḥ śokaṁ na śokaḥ śoka ucyate ॥20॥
7.71.21: evaṁ vidvān samuttiṣṭha prayato bhava mā śucaḥ,
7.71.22: sr̥ñjayasya tu taṁ putraṁ mr̥taṁ sañjīvitaṁ punaḥ ॥22॥
7.71.23: evaṁ vidvān mahārāja mā śucaḥ sādhayāmyaham,
7.71.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi abhimanyuvadhaparvaṇi ṣoḍaśarājakīye ekasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥71॥
7.72.0d1: abhimanyau hate cāpi bāle balavatāṁ vare.
7.72.0d3: kena vā kathitaḥ tasya praśāntaḥ sutapāvakaḥ.
7.72.3: prāyāt sa śibiraṁ jiṣṇurjaitramāsthāya taṁ ratham,
7.72.4: kiṁ nu me hr̥dayaṁ trastaṁ vāk ca sajjati keśava,
7.72.5: bhuvi ye dikṣu cātyugrā utpātāstrāsayanti mām ॥5॥
7.72.6: api svasti bhaved rājñaḥ sāmātyasya gurormama ॥6॥
7.72.7: vyaktaṁ śivaṁ tava bhrātuḥ sāmātyasya bhaviṣyati,
7.72.12: maṅgalyāni ca gītāni na gāyanti paṭhanti ca ॥12॥
7.72.13: yodhāścāpi hi māṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nivartante hyadhomukhāḥ ॥13॥
7.72.14: karmāṇi ca yathāpūrvaṁ kr̥tvā nābhivadanti mām,
api svasti bhavedadya bhrātr̥bhyo mama mādhava ॥14॥
7.72.15: na hi śuddhyati me bhāvo dr̥ṣṭvā svajanamākulam,
7.72.16: na ca māmadya saubhadraḥ prahr̥ṣṭo bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha,
7.72.17: evaṁ saṅkathayantau tau praviṣṭau śibiraṁ svakam,
7.72.19: na cābhimanyuṁ paśyāmi na ca māṁ pratinandatha ॥19॥
7.72.20: na ca vastasya bhettāsti vinā saubhadramarbhakam ॥20॥
7.72.24: sadā mama priyaṁ brūta kathamāyodhane hataḥ ॥24॥
7.72.25: subhadrāyāḥ priyaṁ putraṁ draupadyāḥ keśavasya ca,
7.72.27: yadi putraṁ na paśyāmi yāsyāmi yamasādanam ॥27॥
7.72.32: na ca pūrvaṁ prahartāraṁ saṅgrāme naṣṭasambhramam ॥32॥
7.72.33: yadi putraṁ na paśyāmi yāsyāmi yamasādanam,
7.72.34: pradyumnasya priyaṁ nityaṁ keśavasya mamaiva ca ॥34॥
7.72.35: yadi putraṁ na paśyāmi yāsyāmi yamasādanam,
7.72.37: aśr̥ṇvataḥ svanaṁ tasya kā śāntirhr̥dayasya me,
7.72.38: apaśyato hi vīrasya kā śāntirhr̥dayasya me,
7.72.39: nādyāhaṁ yadi paśyāmi kā śāntirhr̥dayasya me,
7.72.42: bodhayantyadya taṁ nūnaṁ śvāpadā vikr̥taiḥ svanaiḥ,
7.72.44: bhāgyahīnasya kālena yathā me nīyase balāt,
sā ca saṁyamanī nūnaṁ sadā sukr̥tināṁ gatiḥ ॥44॥
7.72.46: evaṁ vilapya bahudhā bhinnapoto vaṇig yathā ॥46॥
7.72.50: iha me syāt paritrāṇaṁ piteti sa punaḥ punaḥ ॥50॥
7.72.51: athavā matprasūtaḥ sa svasrīyo mādhavasya ca ॥51॥
7.72.52: subhadrāyāṁ ca sambhūto na caivaṁ vaktumarhati,
7.72.55: upāyāntaṁ ripūn hatvā so’dya māṁ kiṁ na paśyati,
nūnaṁ sa pātitaḥ śete dharaṇyāṁ rudhirokṣitaḥ ॥55॥
7.72.57: raṇe vinihataṁ śrutvā śokārtā vai vinaṅkṣyati,
7.72.58: draupadī caiva duḥkhārte te ca vakṣyāmi kiṁ nvaham,
7.72.62: āgamiṣyati vaḥ kṣipraṁ phalaṁ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ ॥62॥
7.72.63: iti tān paribhāṣan vai vaiśyāputro mahāmatiḥ ॥63॥
7.72.71: sa ca vīrān raṇe hatvā rājaputrān mahābalān,
7.72.72: dharmakr̥dbhiḥ kr̥to dharmaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṁ raṇe kṣayaḥ ॥72॥
7.72.73: ime te bhrātaraḥ sarve dīnā bharatasattama,
7.72.74: viditaṁ veditavyaṁ te na śokaṁ kartumarhasi ॥74॥
7.72.75: tato’bravīt tadā bhrātr̥̄n sarvān pārthaḥ sagadgadān ॥75॥
7.72.78: kathaṁ ca vaḥ kr̥tāstrāṇāṁ sarveṣāṁ śastrapāṇinām,
7.72.79: putrasya pāṇḍupañcālān mayā gupto bhavet tataḥ ॥79॥
7.72.80: kathaṁ ca vo rathasthānāṁ śaravarṣāṇi muñcatām,
7.72.81: aho vaḥ pauruṣaṁ nāsti na ca vo’sti parākramaḥ,
7.72.86: na bhāṣituṁ śaknuvanti draṣṭuṁ vā suhr̥do’rjunam,
7.72.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi pratijñāparvaṇi arjunakope dvisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥72॥
7.73.2: vyūḍhānīkā vayaṁ droṇaṁ vārayāmaḥ sma sarvaśaḥ,
7.73.4: te pīḍyamānā droṇena droṇānīkaṁ na śaknumaḥ,
prativīkṣitumapyājau bhettuṁ tat kuta eva tu ॥4॥
7.73.5: uktavantaḥ sma taṁ tāta bhindhyanīkamiti prabho ॥5॥
7.73.6: sa tathā nodito’smābhiḥ sadaśva iva vīryavān,
7.73.7: prāviśat tadbalaṁ bālaḥ suparṇa iva sāgaram ॥7॥
7.73.10: tato droṇaḥ kr̥paḥ karṇo drauṇiḥ kausalya eva ca,
kr̥tavarmā ca saubhadraṁ ṣaḍ rathāḥ paryavārayan ॥10॥
7.73.11: parivārya tu taiḥ sarvairyudhi bālo mahārathaiḥ,
7.73.14: br̥hadbalaṁ ca rājānaṁ svargeṇājau prayojya ha ॥14॥
7.73.15d1: gataḥsukr̥tināṁ lokān ye ca svargajitāṁ śubhāḥ,
7.73.17: hā putra iti niḥśvasya vyathito nyapatad bhuvi,
7.73.20: satyaṁ vaḥ pratijānāmi śvo’smi hantā jayadratham,
na ced vadhabhayād bhīto dhārtarāṣṭrān prahāsyati ॥20॥
7.73.21: na cāsmān śaraṇaṁ gacchet kr̥ṣṇaṁ vā puruṣottamam,
bhavantaṁ vā mahārāja śvo’smi hantā jayadratham ॥21॥
7.73.22: pāpaṁ bālavadhe hetuṁ śvo’smi hantā jayadratham ॥22॥
7.73.23: rakṣamāṇāśca taṁ saṅkhye ye māṁ yotsyanti kecana,
7.73.24: mā sma puṇyakr̥tāṁ lokān prāpnuyāṁ śūrasammatān ॥24॥
7.73.25: ye lokā mātr̥hantr̥̄ṇāṁ ye cāpi pitr̥ghātinām,
gurudāragatānāṁ ye piśunānāṁ ca ye sadā ॥25॥
7.73.26: sādhūnasūyatāṁ ye ca ye cāpi parivādinām,
ye ca nikṣepahartr̥̄ṇāṁ ye ca viśvāsaghātinām ॥26॥
7.73.27: brahmaghnānāṁ ca ye lokā ye ca goghātināmapi ॥27॥
7.73.28: pāyasaṁ vā yavānnaṁ vā śākaṁ kr̥sarameva vā,
7.73.30: avamanyamāno yān yāti vr̥ddhān sādhūn gurūṁstathā,
spr̥śato brāhmaṇaṁ gāṁ ca pādenāgniṁ ca yā bhavet ॥30॥
7.73.31: yā’psu śleṣma purīṣaṁ ca mūtraṁ vā muñcatāṁ gatiḥ,
tāṁ gaccheyaṁ gatiṁ kaṣṭāṁ na ceddhanyāṁ jayadratham ॥31॥
7.73.32: utkocināṁ mr̥ṣoktīnāṁ vañcakānāṁ ca yā gatiḥ ॥32॥
7.73.33: ātmāpahāriṇāṁ yā ca yā ca mithyābhiśaṁsinām,
7.73.34: tāṁ gaccheyaṁ gatiṁ ghorāṁ na ceddhanyāṁ jayadratham ॥34॥
7.73.35: saṁśritaṁ cāpi yastyaktvā sādhuṁ tadvacane ratam,
7.73.36: arhate prātiveśyāya śrāddhaṁ yo na dadāti ca,
7.73.37: teṣāṁ gatimiyāṁ kṣipraṁ na ceddhanyāṁ jayadratham ॥37॥
7.73.38: bhuñjānānāṁ tu savyena utsaṅge cāpi khādatām,
7.73.39: ye cāvarjayatāṁ lokāḥ svapatāṁ ca tathoṣasi,
7.73.40: ṣaṇmāsaṁ tatra vasatāṁ tathā śāstraṁ vinindatām ॥40॥
7.73.41: agāradāhināṁ caiva garadānāṁ ca ye matāḥ ॥41॥
7.73.43: yā ca vai bahuyājināṁ brāhmaṇānāṁ śvavr̥ttinām,
āsyamaithunikānāṁ ca ye divā maithune ratāḥ ॥43॥
7.73.44: brāhmaṇasya pratiśrutya yo vai lobhād dadāti na,
teṣāṁ gatiṁ gamiṣyāmi śvo na hanyāṁ jayadratham ॥44॥
7.73.46: yadi vyuṣṭāmimāṁ rātriṁ śvo na hanyāṁ jayadratham,
imāṁ cāpyaparāṁ bhūyaḥ pratijñāṁ me nibodhata ॥46॥
7.73.48: tadapi mamaripuṁ taṁ rakṣituṁ naiva śaktāḥ ॥48॥
7.73.51: pradadhmau tatra saṅkruddho devadattaṁ ca phālgunaḥ ॥51॥
7.73.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi pratijñāparvaṇi arjunapratijñāyāṁ trisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥73॥
7.74.1: śrutvā tu taṁ mahāśabdaṁ pāṇḍūnāṁ jayagr̥ddhinām,
7.74.3: jagāma samitiṁ rājñāṁ saindhavo vimr̥śan bahu,
7.74.4: yo’sau pāṇḍoḥ kila kṣetre jātaḥ śakreṇa kāminā ॥4॥
7.74.5: tat svasti vo’stu yāsyāmi svagr̥haṁ jīvitepsayā ॥5॥
7.74.8: na trāyeyurbhavanto māṁ samastāḥ patayaḥ kṣiteḥ ॥8॥
7.74.9: praharṣaṁ pāṇḍaveyānāṁ śrutvā mama mahad bhayam,
7.74.10: tathā hi hr̥ṣṭāḥ krośanti śokakāle sma pāṇḍavāḥ ॥10॥
7.74.12: adarśanaṁ gamiṣyāmi na māṁ drakṣyanti pāṇḍavāḥ ॥12॥
7.74.14: na bhetavyaṁ naravyāghra ko hi tvāṁ puruṣarṣabha,
7.74.19: tvaṁ cāpi rathināṁ śreṣṭhaḥ svayaṁ śūro’mitadyute,
sa kathaṁ pāṇḍaveyebhyo bhayaṁ paśyasi saindhava ॥19॥
7.74.20: yattā yotsyanti mā bhaistvaṁ saindhava vyetu te bhayam ॥20॥
7.74.23: mama bravītu bhagavān viśeṣaṁ phālgunasya ca ॥23॥
7.74.26: na tu te yudhi santrāsaḥ kāryaḥ pārthāt kathañcana,
ahaṁ hi rakṣitā tāta bhayāttvāṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥26॥
7.74.27: vyūhayiṣyāmi taṁ vyūhaṁ yaṁ pārtho na tariṣyati ॥27॥
7.74.31: ahaṁ ca saha putreṇa adhruvā iti cintyatām ॥31॥
7.74.32: paryāyeṇa vayaṁ sarve kālena balinā hatāḥ,
7.74.34: apānudad bhayaṁ pārthād yuddhāya ca mano dadhe ॥34॥
7.74.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi pratijñāparvaṇi jayadrathāśvāse catuḥsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥74॥
7.75.4: ta ime śīghramāgamya pravr̥ttiṁ vedayanti naḥ ॥4॥
7.75.10: tato vimanasaḥ sarve trastāḥ kṣudramr̥gā iva,
āsan suyodhanāmātyāḥ sa ca rājā jayadrathaḥ ॥10॥
7.75.12: sa mantrakāle sammantrya sarvāṁ naiḥśreyasīṁ kriyām,
7.75.13: pratijñāto hi senāyā madhye tena vadho mama ॥13॥
7.75.14: tāṁ na devā na gandharvā nāsuroragarākṣasāḥ,
7.75.15: te māṁ rakṣata saṅgrāme mā vo mūrdhni dhanañjayaḥ,
7.75.16: atha rakṣā na me saṅkhye kriyate kurunandana,
anujānīhi māṁ rājan gamiṣyāmi gr̥hān prati ॥16॥
7.75.25: saṁvidhānaṁ ca vihitaṁ rathāśca kila sajjitāḥ ॥25॥
7.75.28: sthāsyate rakṣito vīraiḥ sindhurāṭ sa sudurmadaḥ,
dhanuṣyastre ca vīrye ca prāṇe caiva tathaurase ॥28॥
7.75.29: aviṣahyatamā hyete niścitāḥ pārtha ṣaḍ rathāḥ,
etānajitvā ṣaḍ rathān naiva prāpyo jayadrathaḥ ॥29॥
7.75.30: sahitā hi naravyāghra na śakyā jetumañjasā ॥30॥
7.75.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi pratijñāparvaṇi śrīkr̥ṣṇavākye pañcasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥75॥
7.76.1: ṣaḍ rathān dhārtarāṣṭrasya manyase yān balādhikān,
teṣāṁ vīryaṁ mamārdhena na tulyamiti me matiḥ ॥1॥
7.76.7: tathāpi bāṇairnihataṁ śvo draṣṭāsi raṇe mayā,
7.76.9: tasmin dyūtamidaṁ baddhaṁ manyate sa suyodhanaḥ,
tasmāt tasyaiva senāgraṁ bhittvā yāsyāmi saindhavam ॥9॥
7.76.13: upāttamastraṁ ghoraṁ tad draṣṭāro’tra narā yudhi ॥13॥
7.76.15: āstīryamāṇāṁ pr̥thivīṁ draṣṭāsi śvo mayā yudhi ॥15॥
7.76.17: mayā saindhavako rājā hataḥ svān śocayiṣyati ॥17॥
7.76.19: tathā prabhāte kartāsmi yathā kr̥ṣṇa suyodhanaḥ,
nānyaṁ dhanurdharaṁ loke maṁsyate matsamaṁ yudhi ॥19॥
7.76.20: gāṇḍīvaṁ ca dhanurdivyaṁ yoddhā cāhaṁ nararṣabha,
tvaṁ ca yantā hr̥ṣīkeśa kiṁ nu syādajitaṁ mayā ॥20॥
7.76.21: tava prasādād bhagavan kimivāsti raṇe mama,
aviṣahyaṁ hr̥ṣīkeśa kiṁ jānan māṁ vigarhase ॥21॥
7.76.22: yathā lakṣma sthiraṁ candre samudre ca yathā jalam,
evametāṁ pratijñāṁ me satyāṁ viddhi janārdana ॥22॥
7.76.24: tathābhiyāmi saṅgrāmaṁ na jīyeyaṁ jayāmi ca,
tena satyena saṅgrāme hataṁ viddhi jayadratham ॥24॥
7.76.25: dhruvaṁ vai brāhmaṇe satyaṁ dhruvā sādhuṣu saṁnatiḥ,
śrīrdhruvāpi ca yajñeṣu dhruvo nārāyaṇe jayaḥ ॥25॥
7.76.27: yathā prabhātāṁ rajanīṁ kalpitaḥ syād ratho mama,
tathā kāryaṁ tvayā kr̥ṣṇa kāryaṁ hi mahadudyatam ॥27॥
7.77.9: āśvāsaya subhadrāṁ tvaṁ bhaginīṁ snuṣayā saha ॥9॥
7.77.10: snuṣāṁ cāsyā vayasyāśca viśokāḥ kuru mādhava,
7.77.12: mā śokaṁ kuru vārṣṇeyi kumāraṁ prati sasnuṣā,
7.77.13: sadr̥śaṁ maraṇaṁ hyetat tava putrasya mā śucaḥ ॥13॥
7.77.15: jitvā subahuśaḥ śatrūn preṣayitvā ca mr̥tyave,
7.77.16: santo yāṁ gatimicchanti tāṁ prāptastava putrakaḥ ॥16॥
7.77.17: mā śucastanayaṁ bhadre gataḥ sa paramāṁ gatim ॥17॥
7.77.19: na hi mokṣyati pārthāt sa praviṣṭo’pyamarāvatīm ॥19॥
7.77.20: śvaḥ śiraḥ śroṣyase tasya saindhavasya raṇe hr̥tam,
samantapañcakād bāhyaṁ viśokā bhava mā rudaḥ ॥20॥
7.77.21: kṣatradharmaṁ puraskr̥tya gataḥ śūraḥ satāṁ gatim,
yāṁ gatiṁ prāpnuyāmeha ye cānye śastrajīvinaḥ ॥21॥
7.77.22: gatastava varārohe putraḥ svargaṁ jvaraṁ jahi ॥22॥
7.77.23: sahasraśo ripūn hatvā hataḥ śūro mahārathaḥ ॥23॥
7.77.24: āśvāsaya snuṣāṁ rājñi mā śucaḥ kṣatriye bhr̥śam,
śvaḥ priyaṁ sumahacchrutvā viśokā bhava nandini ॥24॥
7.77.25: yat pārthena pratijñātaṁ tat tathā na tadanyathā,
cikīrṣitaṁ hi te bharturna bhavejjātu niṣphalam ॥25॥
7.77.26: na sa bhavitā saha tairapi prabhāte ॥26॥
7.77.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi pratijñāparvaṇi subhadrāśvāsane saptasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥77॥
7.78.2: hā putra mama mandāyāḥ kathametyāsi saṁyuge,
7.78.3: mukhaṁ te dr̥śyate vatsa guṇṭhitaṁ raṇareṇunā ॥3॥
7.78.9: pāṇḍaveṣu ca nātheṣu vr̥ṣṇivīreṣu vā vibho,
7.78.11: tava putra kadā bhūyo mukhaṁ drakṣyāmi nirvraṇam ॥11॥
7.78.12: dhig balaṁ bhīmasenasya dhik pārthasya dhanuṣmatām,
dhig vīryaṁ vr̥ṣṇivīrāṇāṁ pañcālānāṁ ca dhig balam ॥12॥
7.78.13: ye tvāṁ raṇagataṁ vīraṁ na śekurabhirakṣitum ॥13॥
7.78.16: ehyehi tr̥ṣito vatsa stanau pūrṇau pibāśu me,
7.78.17: hā vīra dr̥ṣṭo naṣṭaśca dhanaṁ svapna ivāsi me,
7.78.19: vihāya phalakāle māṁ sugr̥ddhāṁ tava darśane ॥19॥
7.78.23: hatvārīn nihatānāṁ ca saṅgrāme tāṁ gatiṁ vraja ॥23॥
7.78.24: naiveśikaṁ cābhimataṁ dadatāṁ yā gatiḥ śubhā ॥24॥
7.78.25: brāhmaṇebhyaḥ śaraṇyebhyo nidhiṁ nidadhatāṁ ca yā,
yā cāpi nyastadaṇḍānāṁ tāṁ gatiṁ vraja putraka ॥25॥
7.78.26: ekapatnyaśca yāṁ yānti tāṁ gatiṁ vraja putraka ॥26॥
7.78.28: paiśunyācca nivr̥ttānāṁ tāṁ gatiṁ vraja putraka ॥28॥
7.78.29: amoghātithināṁ yā ca tāṁ gatiṁ vraja putraka ॥29॥
7.78.30: gatiḥ śokāgnidagdhānāṁ tāṁ gatiṁ vraja putraka ॥30॥
7.78.32: r̥tukāle svakāṁ bhāryāṁ gacchatāṁ yā manīṣiṇām,
parastrībhyo nivr̥ttānāṁ tāṁ gatiṁ vraja putraka ॥32॥
7.78.35: yāṁ gatiṁ sādhavo yānti tāṁ gatiṁ vraja putraka ॥35॥
7.78.37: tāḥ prakāmaṁ ruditvā ca vilapya ca suduḥkhitāḥ,
7.78.41: ye cānye’pi kule santi puruṣā no varānane,
sarve te tāṁ gatiṁ yāntu hyabhimanyoryaśasvinaḥ ॥41॥
7.78.42: kuryāma tad vayaṁ karma kriyāsu suhr̥daśca naḥ,
7.78.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi pratijñāparvaṇi subhadrāpravilāpe aṣṭasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥78॥
7.79.6: supyatāṁ pārtha bhadraṁ te kalyāṇāya vrajāmyaham,
7.79.7: śiśye ca śayane śubhre bahukr̥tyaṁ vicintayan ॥7॥
7.79.10: na pāṇḍavānāṁ śibire kaścit suṣvāpa tāṁ niśām,
7.79.14: sa ca rājā mahāvīryaḥ pārayatvarjunaḥ sa tām,
7.79.15: sa hatvā saindhavaṁ saṅkhye punaretu dhanañjayaḥ ॥15॥
7.79.18: tasmin hi vijayaḥ kr̥tsnaḥ pāṇḍavena samāhitaḥ,
yadi no’sti kr̥taṁ kiñcid yadi dattaṁ hutaṁ yadi ॥18॥
7.79.20: tasyāṁ rajanyāṁ madhye tu pratibuddho janārdanaḥ ॥20॥
7.79.23: yathā jayadrathaṁ pārtho na hanyāditi saṁyuge,
akṣauhiṇyo hi tāḥ sarvā rakṣiṣyanti jayadratham ॥23॥
7.79.25: so’pi taṁ notsahetājau hantuṁ droṇena rakṣitam,
7.79.26: na hi dārā na mitrāṇi jñātayo na ca bāndhavāḥ ॥26॥
7.79.28: udīkṣituṁ na śakto’haṁ bhavitā na ca tat tathā,
ahaṁ vijitya tān sarvān sahasā sahayadvipān ॥28॥
7.79.29: śvo nirīkṣantu me vīryaṁ trayo lokā mahāhave ॥29॥
7.79.33: jñāsyanti lokāḥ sarve māṁ suhr̥daṁ savyasācinaḥ,
yastaṁ dveṣṭi sa māṁ dveṣṭi yastaṁ cānu sa māmanu ॥33॥
7.79.34: yathā tvaṁ me prabhātāyāmasyāṁ niśi rathottamam ॥34॥
7.79.35: gadāṁ kaumodakīṁ divyāṁ śaktiṁ cakraṁ dhanuḥ śarān ॥35॥
7.79.36: āropya vai rathe sūta sarvopakaraṇāni ca,
sthānaṁ ca kalpayitvātha rathopasthe dhvajasya me ॥36॥
7.79.39: yuktān vājivarān yattaḥ kavacī tiṣṭha dāruka,
7.79.40: śrutvā ca bhairavaṁ nādamupeyāstvaṁ javena mām,
7.79.42: yasya yasya ca bībhatsurvadhe yatnaṁ kariṣyati,
āśaṁse sārathe tatra bhavitāsya dhruvo jayaḥ ॥42॥
7.79.43: jaya eva dhruvastasya kuta eva parājayaḥ,
7.79.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi pratijñāparvaṇi kr̥ṣṇadārukasambhāṣaṇe ekonāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥79॥
7.80.2: taṁ tu śokena santaptaṁ svapne kapivaradhvajam,
7.80.3: na lopayati dharmātmā bhaktyā premṇā ca sarvadā ॥3॥
7.80.4: pratyutthāya ca govindaṁ sa tasmā āsanaṁ dadau,
na cāsane svayaṁ buddhiṁ bībhatsurvyadadhāt tadā ॥4॥
7.80.5: tataḥ kr̥ṣṇo mahātejā jānan pārthasya niścayam,
7.80.6: mā viṣāde manaḥ pārtha kr̥thāḥ kālo hi durjayaḥ,
kālaḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni niyacchati pare vidhau ॥6॥
7.80.7: kimarthaṁ ca viṣādaste tad brūhi dvipadāṁ vara,
na śocyaṁ viduṣāṁ śreṣṭha śokaḥ kāryavināśanaḥ ॥7॥
7.80.8: yat tu kāryaṁ bhavet kāryaṁ karmaṇā tat samācara,
hīnaceṣṭasya yaḥ śokaḥ sa hi śatrurdhanañjaya ॥8॥
7.80.13: daśa caikā ca tāḥ kr̥ṣṇa akṣauhiṇyaḥ sudurjayāḥ,
7.80.14: kathaṁ śakyeta sandraṣṭuṁ durātmā kr̥ṣṇa saindhavaḥ ॥14॥
7.80.15: pratijñāyāṁ ca hīnāyāṁ kathaṁ jīveta madvidhaḥ ॥15॥
7.80.16: drutaṁ ca yāti savitā tata etad bravīmyaham ॥16॥
7.80.19: yena sarvān mr̥dhe daityān jaghne devo maheśvaraḥ ॥19॥
7.80.20: yadi tad viditaṁ te’dya śvo hantāsi jayadratham,
7.80.21: taṁ devaṁ manasā dhyātvā joṣamāsva dhanañjaya,
tatastasya prasādāt tvaṁ bhaktaḥ prāpsyasi tanmahat ॥21॥
7.80.24: puṇyaṁ himavataḥ pādaṁ maṇimantaṁ ca parvatam,
7.80.25: keśavena gr̥hītaḥ sa dakṣiṇe vibhunā bhuje ॥25॥
7.80.27: saricchreṣṭhāṁ ca tāṁ gaṅgāṁ vīkṣamāṇo bahūdakām ॥27॥
7.80.32: sa tuṅgaṁ śataśr̥ṅgaṁ ca śaryātivanameva ca,
7.80.34: tasmin śaile vrajan pārthaḥ sakr̥ṣṇaḥ samavaikṣata,
7.80.36: viyad dyāṁ pr̥thivīṁ caiva tathā viṣṇupadaṁ vrajan,
vismitaḥ saha kr̥ṣṇena kṣipto bāṇa ivābhyagāt ॥36॥
7.80.38: samāsādya tu taṁ śailaṁ śailāgre samavasthitam,
7.80.43: vāsudevastu taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā jagāma śirasā kṣitim,
pārthena saha dharmātmā gr̥ṇan brahma sanātanam ॥43॥
7.80.44: manasaḥ paramaṁ yoniṁ khaṁ vāyuṁ jyotiṣāṁ nidhim ॥44॥
7.80.46: yogānāṁ ca paraṁ dhāma dr̥ṣṭaṁ brahmavidāṁ nidhim,
7.80.51: kiṁ ca vāmīpsitaṁ vīrau manasaḥ kṣipramucyatām ॥51॥
7.80.52: yena kāryeṇa samprāptau yuvāṁ tat sādhayāmi kim,
7.80.55: namo bhavāya śarvāya rudrāya varadāya ca,
7.80.61: namo namaste sevyāya bhūtānāṁ prabhave sadā ॥61॥
7.80.63: namo viśvasya pataye mahatāṁ pataye namaḥ,
7.80.64: bhaktānukampine nityaṁ sidhyatāṁ no varaḥ prabho ॥64॥
7.80.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi pratijñāparvaṇi arjunasvapne aśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥80॥
7.81.3: tato’bhipūjya manasā kr̥ṣṇaṁ śarvaṁ ca pāṇḍavaḥ,
7.81.4: tataḥ pārthasya vijñāya varārthe vacanaṁ tadā,
7.81.5: yena kāmena samprāptau bhavadbhyāṁ taṁ dadāmyaham ॥5॥
7.81.6: tatra me tad dhanurdivyaṁ śaraśca nihitaḥ purā ॥6॥
7.81.7: yena devārayaḥ sarve mayā yudhi nipātitāḥ,
7.81.8: tathetyuktvā tu tau vīrau sarvapāriṣadaiḥ saha,
7.81.15: tau tajjagr̥hatuḥ prītau dhanurbāṇaṁ ca suprabham,
7.81.17: sa tad gr̥hya dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṁ tasthau sthānaṁ samāhitaḥ,
7.81.18: tasya maurvīṁ ca muṣṭiṁ ca sthānaṁ cālakṣya pāṇḍavaḥ,
7.81.19: sa sarasyeva taṁ bāṇaṁ mumocātibalaḥ prabhuḥ,
cakāra ca punarvīrastasmin sarasi tad dhanuḥ ॥19॥
7.81.21: tasya tanmatamājñāya prītaḥ prādād varaṁ bhavaḥ ॥21॥
7.81.24: prāptau svaśibiraṁ vīrau mudā paramayā yutau ॥24॥
7.81.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi pratijñāparvaṇi arjunasya punaḥ pāśupatāstraprāptau ekāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥81॥
7.82.17: tān dvijān madhusarpirbhyāṁ phalaiḥ śreṣṭhaiḥ sumaṅgalaiḥ ॥17॥
7.82.19: tathā gāḥ kapilā dogdhrīḥ savatsāḥ pāṇḍunandanaḥ,
7.82.20: mālyaṁ ca jalakumbhāṁśca jvalitaṁ ca hutāśanam ॥20॥
7.82.22: dr̥ṣṭvā spr̥ṣṭvā ca kaunteyo bāhyāṁ kakṣyāṁ tato’gamat ॥22॥
7.82.29: tato muhūrtādāsīt tu syandanānāṁ svano mahān,
7.82.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi pratijñāparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirasajjatāyāṁ dvyaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥82॥
7.83.2: sukhena rajanī vyuṣṭā kaccit te madhusūdana,
7.83.4: anujñātaśca rājñā sa prāveśayata taṁ janam,
virāṭaṁ bhīmasenaṁ ca dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca sātyakim ॥4॥
7.83.5: cedipaṁ dhr̥ṣṭaketuṁ ca drupadaṁ ca mahāratham,
7.83.7: ete cānye ca bahavaḥ kṣatriyāḥ kṣatriyarṣabham,
7.83.10: prārthayāmo jayaṁ yuddhe śāśvatāni sukhāni ca ॥10॥
7.83.11: tvaṁ hi rājyavināśaṁ ca dviṣadbhiśca nirākriyām,
kleśāṁśca vividhān kr̥ṣṇa sarvāṁstānapi veda naḥ ॥11॥
7.83.13: sa tathā kuru vārṣṇeya yathā tvayi mano mama,
7.83.14: pāraṁ titīrṣatāmadya plavo no bhava mādhava ॥14॥
7.83.15: na hi tat kurute saṅkhye rathī ripuvadhodyataḥ,
7.83.18: viṣṇo jiṣṇo hare kr̥ṣṇa vaikuṇṭha puruṣottama ॥18॥
7.83.19: varadaṁ śārṅgiṇaṁ śreṣṭhaṁ tat satyaṁ kuru mādhava ॥19॥
7.83.24: ahaṁ ca tat kariṣyāmi yathā kuntīsuto’rjunaḥ,
7.83.27: yadyasya devā goptāraḥ sendrāḥ sarve tathāpyasau,
7.83.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi pratijñāparvaṇi śrīkr̥ṣṇavākye tryaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥83॥
7.84.1: tathā tu vadatāṁ teṣāṁ prādurāsīd dhanañjayaḥ,
7.84.4: yādr̥grūpā ca te cchāyā prasannaśca janārdanaḥ ॥4॥
7.84.7: tataḥ śirobhiravaniṁ spr̥ṣṭvā sarve ca vismitāḥ,
7.84.14: taṁ tu lokavaraḥ puṁsāṁ kirīṭī hemavarmabhr̥t,
7.84.17: sa rathe rathināṁ śreṣṭhaḥ kāñcane kāñcanāvr̥taḥ,
7.84.19: atha jagrāha govindo raśmīn raśmividāṁ varaḥ,
7.84.20: sahito budhaśukrābhyāṁ tamo nighnan yathā śaśī ॥20॥
7.84.25: tatastasmin kṣaṇe rājan vividhāni śubhāni ca,
7.84.27: yuyudhānādya yuddhe me dr̥śyate vijayo dhruvaḥ,
7.84.28: so’haṁ tatra gamiṣyāmi yatra saindhavako nr̥paḥ,
7.84.29: yathā paramakaṁ kr̥tyaṁ saindhavasya vadho mama,
7.84.30: yathaiva hi mayā guptastvayā gupto bhavet tathā ॥30॥
7.84.31: na paśyāmi ca taṁ loke yastvāṁ yuddhe parājayet,
7.84.32: tvayi cāhaṁ parāśvastaḥ pradyumne vā mahārathe,
7.84.33: rājanyeva parā guptiḥ kāryā sarvātmanā tvayā ॥33॥
7.84.34: kiñcid vyāpadyate tatra yatrāhamapi ca dhruvam ॥34॥
7.84.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi pratijñāparvaṇi arjunavākye caturaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥84॥
7.85.1: abhimanyau hate tatra ke vāyudhyanta māmakāḥ ॥1॥
7.85.2: kathaṁ tat kilbiṣaṁ kr̥tvā nirbhayā brūhi māmakāḥ ॥2॥
7.85.5: kiṁ nu sañjaya saṅgrāme vr̥ttaṁ duryodhanaṁ prati,
7.85.6: na śrūyante’dya sarve te saindhavasya niveśane ॥6॥
7.85.7: stuvatāṁ nādya śrūyante putrāṇāṁ śibire mama,
7.85.8: dīnānāmadya taṁ śabdaṁ na śr̥ṇomi samīritam ॥8॥
7.85.11: anyeṣāṁ ca sutānāṁ me na tathā śrūyate dhvaniḥ ॥11॥
7.85.12: brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā yaṁ śiṣyāḥ paryupāsate,
7.85.14: sūta tasya gr̥he śabdo nādya drauṇeryathā purā ॥14॥
7.85.17: śrūyate so’dya na tathā kekayānāṁ ca veśmasu,
7.85.18: nr̥tyatāṁ śrūyate tāta gaṇānāṁ so’dya na svanaḥ,
7.85.19: saumadattiṁ śrutanidhiṁ teṣāṁ na śrūyate dhvaniḥ,
7.85.21: vāditranāditānāṁ ca so’dya na śrūyate mahān,
7.85.24: śamaṁ ced yācamānaṁ tvaṁ pratyākhyāsyasi keśavam,
7.85.26: tato duḥśāsanasyaiva karṇasya ca mataṁ dvayoḥ,
anvavartata māṁ hitvā kr̥ṣṭaḥ kālena durmatiḥ ॥26॥
7.85.27: na hyahaṁ dyūtamicchāmi viduro na praśaṁsati,
saindhavo necchati dyūtaṁ bhīṣmo na dyūtamicchati ॥27॥
7.85.28: aśvatthāmā kr̥po droṇo dyūtaṁ necchanti sañjaya ॥28॥
7.85.30: kulīnāḥ sammatāḥ prājñāḥ sukhaṁ prāpsyanti pāṇḍavāḥ ॥30॥
7.85.31: dharmāpekṣī naro nityaṁ sarvatra labhate sukham,
7.85.32: arhāste pr̥thivīṁ bhoktuṁ samarthāḥ sādhane’pi ca,
7.85.33: santi me jñātayastāta yeṣāṁ śroṣyanti pāṇḍavāḥ ॥33॥
7.85.35: tvadarthaṁ bruvatāṁ tāta kariṣyanti vaco hi te ॥35॥
7.85.36: kaṁ vā tvaṁ manyase teṣāṁ yastān brūyādato’nyathā,
kr̥ṣṇo na dharmaṁ sañjahyāt sarve te hi tadanvayāḥ ॥36॥
7.85.38: na ca me śrutavān mūḍho manye kālasya paryayam ॥38॥
7.85.42: yamau ca puruṣavyāghrau mantrī ca madhusūdanaḥ,
ka etāñjātu yudhyeta loke’smin vai jijīviṣuḥ ॥42॥
7.85.43: divyamastraṁ vikurvāṇān prasahed vā parān mama,
7.85.46: hatau hi puruṣavyāghrau bhīṣmadroṇau tvamāttha vai,
7.85.48: śūnyān dr̥ṣṭvā rathopasthān manye śocanti putrakāḥ,
himātyaye yathā kakṣaṁ śuṣkaṁ vāterito mahān ॥48॥
7.85.49: agnirdahet tathā senāṁ māmikāṁ sa dhanañjayaḥ,
ācakṣva mama tat sarvaṁ kuśalo hyasi sañjayaḥ ॥49॥
7.85.50: abhimanyau hate tāta kathamāsīnmano hi vaḥ ॥50॥
7.85.51: na jātu tasya karmāṇi yudhi gāṇḍīvadhanvanaḥ,
apakr̥tya mahat tāta soḍhuṁ śakṣyanti māmakāḥ ॥51॥
7.85.52: kinnu duryodhanaḥ kr̥tyaṁ karṇaḥ kr̥tyaṁ kimabravīt,
7.85.54: durnītaṁ vā sunītaṁ vā tanmamācakṣva sañjaya ॥54॥
7.85.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭravākye pañcāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥85॥
7.86.1: śuśrūṣasva sthiro bhūtvā tava hyapanayo mahān ॥1॥
7.86.2: vilāpo niṣphalo rājan mā śuco bharatarṣabha ॥2॥
7.86.4: yadi tvaṁ hi purā dyūtāt kuntīputraṁ yudhiṣṭhiram,
7.86.5: yuddhakāle punaḥ prāpte tadaiva bhavatā yadi,
nivartitāḥ syuḥ saṁrabdhā na tvāṁ vyasanamāvrajet ॥5॥
7.86.7: pañcālā vr̥ṣṇayaḥ sarve ye cānye’pi narādhipāḥ ॥7॥
7.86.8: sa kr̥tvā pitr̥karma tvaṁ putraṁ saṁsthāpya satpathe,
vartethā yadi dharmeṇa na tvāṁ vyasanamāvrajet ॥8॥
7.86.9: tvaṁ tu prājñatamo loke hitvā dharmaṁ sanātanam,
7.86.10: tat taṁ vilapitaṁ sarvaṁ mayā rājan niśāmitam,
7.86.11: nāmanyata tadā kr̥ṣṇo rājānaṁ pāṇḍavaṁ purā,
na bhīṣmaṁ naiva ca droṇaṁ yathā tvāṁ manyate’cyutaḥ ॥11॥
7.86.12: ajānāt sa yadā tu tvāṁ rājadharmādadhaścyutam,
tadāprabhr̥ti kr̥ṣṇastvāṁ na tathā bahu manyate ॥12॥
7.86.16: teṣāṁ tat tādr̥śaṁ karma tvāmāsādya suniṣphalam,
7.86.17: yat punaryuddhakāle tvaṁ putrān garhayase nr̥pa,
7.86.18: na hi rakṣanti rājāno yudhyanto jīvitaṁ raṇe,
7.86.19: yāṁ tu kr̥ṣṇārjunau senāṁ yāṁ sātyakivr̥kodarau,
rakṣeran ko nu tāṁ yudhyeccamūmanyatra kauravaiḥ ॥19॥
7.86.20: yeṣāṁ yoddhā guḍākeśo yeṣāṁ mantrī janārdanaḥ,
yeṣāṁ ca sātyakiryoddhā yeṣāṁ yoddhā vr̥kodaraḥ ॥20॥
7.86.21: ko hi tān viṣahed yoddhuṁ martyadharmā dhanurdharaḥ,
anyatra kauraveyebhyo ye vā teṣāṁ padānugāḥ ॥21॥
7.86.23: kurūṇāṁ pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṁ tat sarvaṁ śr̥ṇu tattvataḥ ॥23॥
7.86.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sañjayavākye ṣaḍaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥86॥
7.87.1: tasyāṁ niśāyāṁ vyuṣṭāyāṁ droṇaḥ śastrabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ,
7.87.3: visphārya ca dhanūṁṣyanye jyāḥ pare parimr̥jya ca,
7.87.9: kvārjunaḥ kva sa govindaḥ kva ca mānī vr̥kodaraḥ,
kva ca te suhr̥dasteṣāmāhvayante raṇe tadā ॥9॥
7.87.15: tatrasthaṁ tvāṁ na saṁsoḍhuṁ śaktā devāḥ savāsavāḥ,
kiṁ punaḥ pāṇḍavāḥ sarve samāśvasihi saindhava ॥15॥
7.87.22: dīrgho dvādaśa gavyūtiḥ paścārdhe pañca vistr̥taḥ,
7.87.24: sūcī padmasya garbhastho gūḍho vyūhaḥ kr̥taḥ punaḥ ॥24॥
7.87.28: teṣāṁ ca pr̥ṣṭhato rājā balena mahatā vr̥taḥ,
7.87.29: śakaṭasya tu rājendra bhāradvājo mukhe sthitaḥ,
anu tasyābhavad bhojo jugopainaṁ tataḥ svayam ॥29॥
7.87.33: grased vyūhaḥ kṣitiṁ sarvāmiti bhūtāni menire ॥33॥
7.87.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi kauravavyūhanirmāṇe saptāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥87॥
7.88.2: anīkānāṁ ca saṁhrāde vāditrāṇāṁ ca niḥsvane,
7.88.6: cacāla ca mahī kr̥tsnā bhaye ghore samutthite ॥6॥
7.88.13: yudhyāmi saṁhatānetān yaśo mānaṁ ca vardhayan ॥13॥
7.88.15: tato’ntaka iva kruddhaḥ savajra iva vāsavaḥ,
7.88.17: jayo jetā sthitaḥ satye pārayiṣyan mahāvratam ॥17॥
7.88.19: vidhunvan gāṇḍivaṁ saṅkhye babhau sūrya ivoditaḥ ॥19॥
7.88.20: vyavasthāpya rathaṁ rājan śaṅkhaṁ dadhmau pratāpavān ॥20॥
7.88.25: sīdanti sma narā rājan śaṅkhaśabdena māriṣa,
7.88.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi arjunaraṇapraveśe aṣṭāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥88॥
7.89.5: te cāpi rathinaḥ sarve tvaritāḥ kr̥tahastavat,
7.89.11: tataḥ kabandhaṁ kiñcit tu dhanurālambya tiṣṭhati,
7.89.14: ayaṁ pārthaḥ kutaḥ pārtha eṣa pārtha iti prabho,
7.89.20: yo yaḥ sma samare pārthaṁ pratisañcarate naraḥ,
7.89.23: abhinat phālguno bāṇau rathinaṁ ca sasārathim ॥23॥
7.89.24: pramukhe tiṣṭhamānaṁ ca na kiñcinna nihanti saḥ ॥24॥
7.89.25: yathodayan vai gagane sūryo hanti mahat tamaḥ,
7.89.27: yathā madhyandine sūryo duṣprekṣyaḥ prāṇibhiḥ sadā,
tathā dhanañjayaḥ kruddho duṣprekṣyo yudhi śatrubhiḥ ॥27॥
7.89.28: tat tathā tava putrasya sainyaṁ yudhi parantapa,
7.89.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi arjunayuddhe ekonanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥89॥
7.90.1: ke tu tatra raṇe vīrāḥ pratyudīyurdhanañjayam ॥1॥
7.90.5: tatastava suto rājan dr̥ṣṭvā sainyaṁ tathāgatam,
7.90.19: apare dantaveṣṭeṣu kumbheṣu ca kaṭeṣu ca,
śaraiḥ samarpitā nāgāḥ krauñcavad vyanadan muhuḥ ॥19॥
7.90.25: maurvīṁ dhvajaṁ dhanuścaiva yugamīṣāṁ tathaiva ca,
7.90.26: na sandadhan na cākarṣan na vimuñcan na codvahan,
maṇḍalenaiva dhanuṣā nr̥tyan pārthaḥ sma dr̥śyate ॥26॥
7.90.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi duḥśāsanasainyaparābhave navatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥90॥
7.91.2: sa tu droṇaṁ samāsādya vyūhasya pramukhe sthitam,
7.91.3: śivena dhyāhi māṁ brahman svasti caiva vadasva me,
7.91.6: nihantuṁ dvipadāṁ śreṣṭha pratijñāṁ rakṣa me prabho ॥6॥
7.91.7: māmajitvā na bībhatso śakyo jetuṁ jayadrathaḥ ॥7॥
7.91.13: vivyādha ca hayānasya dhvajaṁ sārathimeva ca ॥13॥
7.91.14: etasminnantare pārthaḥ sajyaṁ kr̥tvā mahad dhanuḥ ॥14॥
7.91.25: arjunaṁ ca trisaptatyā dhvajaṁ cāsya tribhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥25॥
7.91.26: viśeṣayiṣyan śiṣyaṁ ca droṇo rājan parākramī,
7.91.30: pārtha pārtha mahābāho na naḥ kālātyayo bhavet ॥30॥
7.91.33: tato’bravīt svayaṁ droṇaḥ kvedaṁ pāṇḍava gamyate,
nanu nāma raṇe śatrumajitvā na nivartase ॥33॥
7.91.34: gururbhavān na me śatruḥ śiṣyaḥ putrasamo’smi te,
na cāsti sa pumām̐lloke yastvāṁ yudhi parājayet ॥34॥
7.91.37: tato jayo mahārāja kr̥tavarmā ca sātvataḥ,
7.91.39: nārāyaṇāśca gopālāḥ kāmbojānāṁ ca ye gaṇāḥ ॥39॥
7.91.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi droṇātikrame ekanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥91॥
7.92.2: tāpayāmāsa tat sainyaṁ dehaṁ vyādhigaṇo yathā ॥2॥
7.92.3: aśvo viddho rathaśchinnaḥ sārohaḥ pātito gajaḥ,
7.92.4: ityāsīt tumulaṁ yuddhaṁ na prājñāyata kiñcana ॥4॥
7.92.15: atha tau vadhyamānau tu droṇena rathasattamau,
7.92.20: bhojastu prahasan pārthaṁ vāsudevaṁ ca mādhavam,
7.92.24: cintayāmāsa vārṣṇeyo na naḥ kālātyayo bhavet ॥24॥
7.92.25: tataḥ kr̥ṣṇo’bravīt pārthaṁ kr̥tavarmaṇi mā dayām,
7.92.29: tāvavidhyat tato bhojaḥ kr̥tavarmā śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.92.32: tāvanye dhanuṣī sajye kr̥tvā bhojaṁ vijaghnatuḥ ॥32॥
7.92.33: na lebhāte tu tau dvāraṁ vāritau kr̥tavarmaṇā ॥33॥
