7.92.35: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tu tathā yāntaṁ śūro rājā śrutāyudhaḥ ॥35॥
7.92.36: sa pārthaṁ tribhirānarchat saptatyā ca janārdanam ॥36॥
7.92.38: sa tanna mamr̥ṣe rājan pāṇḍaveyasya vikramam ॥38॥
7.92.43: hatāśvaṁ rathamustr̥jya sa tu rājā śrutāyudhaḥ ॥43॥
7.92.44: varuṇasyātmajo vīraḥ sa tu rājā śrutāyudhaḥ ॥44॥
7.92.49: astrasyāsya prabhāvād vai vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ,
7.92.51: ayudhyati na moktavyā sā tvayyeva patediti,
7.92.52: na cākarot sa tadvākyaṁ prāpte kāle śrutāyudhaḥ,
7.92.55: gadāṁ nivartitāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nihataṁ ca śrutāyudham ॥55॥
7.92.58: yathoktaṁ varuṇenājau tathā sa nidhanaṁ gataḥ,
7.92.59: patamānastu sa babhau parṇāśāyāḥ priyaḥ sutaḥ,
sa bhagna iva vātena bahuśākho vanaspatiḥ ॥59॥
7.92.62: tasya pārthaḥ śarān sapta preṣayāmāsa bhārata,
te taṁ śūraṁ vinirbhidya prāviśan dharaṇītalam ॥62॥
7.92.64: vāsudevaṁ tribhirviddhvā punaḥ pārthaṁ ca pañcabhiḥ,
tasya pārtho dhanuśchittvā ketuṁ ciccheda māriṣa ॥64॥
7.92.65: bhallābhyāṁ bhr̥śatīkṣṇābhyāṁ taṁ ca vivyādha pāṇḍavaḥ,
7.92.76: tataḥ sarvāṇi sainyāni vyadravanta sutasya te,
hataṁ śrutāyudhaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kāmbojaṁ ca sudakṣiṇam ॥76॥
7.92.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi śrutāyudhasudakṣiṇavadhe dvinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥92॥
7.93.1: hate sudakṣiṇe rājan vīre caiva śrutāyudhe,
7.93.3: te sma bhītāḥ palāyante vyāghrāt kṣudramr̥gā iva ॥3॥
7.93.4: te nivr̥ttāḥ punaḥ pārthaṁ sarvataḥ paryavārayan,
raṇe sapatnān nighnantaṁ jigīṣantaṁ parān yudhi ॥4॥
7.93.12: jagāma paramaṁ mohaṁ mohayan keśavaṁ raṇe ॥12॥
7.93.14: kṣate kṣāraṁ sa hi dadau pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ,
7.93.22: te jaghnustau maheṣvāsau tābhyāṁ muktāṁśca sāyakān,
7.93.23: pratasthe tatra tatraiva yodhayan vai mahārathān ॥23॥
7.93.26: tayoḥ padānugān hatvā punaḥ pañcāśataṁ rathān,
pratyagād bhāratīṁ senāṁ nighnan pārtho varān varān ॥26॥
7.93.44: te na śakyāḥ sma saṅkhyātuṁ vrātyāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ ॥44॥
7.93.45: abhyavarṣanta te sarve pāṇḍavaṁ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.93.49: balāḥ kaṅkā vr̥kā bhūmāvapiban rudhiraṁ mudā ॥49॥
7.93.52: yathāsthalaṁ ca nimnaṁ ca na syād varṣati vāsave ॥52॥
7.93.53: ṣaṭ sahasrān hayān vīrān punardaśaśatān varān ॥53॥
7.93.56: prabhinna iva mātaṅgo mr̥dnan nalavanaṁ yathā,
7.93.58: śūnyān kurvan rathopasthān mānavaiḥ saṁstaran mahīm ॥58॥
7.93.60: prāviśad bhāratīṁ senāṁ saṅkruddho vai dhanañjayaḥ,
7.93.63: āsasāda raṇe pārthaṁ keśavaṁ ca mahāratham,
7.93.65: arjuno’tha bhr̥śaṁ kruddhaḥ so’mbaṣṭhaṁ prati bhārata,
7.93.67: atha tāṁ patitāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā gr̥hyānyāṁ ca mahāgadām ॥67॥
7.93.70: adr̥śyata tadā pārtho ghanaiḥ sūrya ivāvr̥taḥ ॥70॥
7.93.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi ambaṣṭhavadhe trinavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥93॥
7.94.2: kāmbojasya ca dāyāde hate rājan sudakṣiṇe,
7.94.6: yathā sa puruṣavyāghro na hanyeta jayadrathaḥ,
tathā vidhatsva bhadraṁ te tvaṁ hi naḥ paramā gatiḥ ॥6॥
7.94.8: atikrānte hi kaunteye bhittvā sainyaṁ parantapa,
7.94.10: sarvaṁ hyadyāturaṁ manye nedamasti balaṁ mama ॥10॥
7.94.11: jānāmi tvāṁ mahābhāga pāṇḍavānāṁ hite ratam,
tathā muhyāmi ca brahman kāryavattāṁ vicintayan ॥11॥
7.94.12: yathāśakti ca te brahman vartaye vr̥ttimuttamām,
prīṇāmi ca yathāśakti tacca tvaṁ nāvabudhyase ॥12॥
7.94.14: na hyayaṁ tvāṁ vijānāmi madhudigdhamiva kṣuram ॥14॥
7.94.18: sa tathā kuru śoṇāśva yathā mucyeta saindhavaḥ,
mama cārtapralāpānāṁ mā krudhaḥ pāhi saindhavam ॥18॥
7.94.19: satyaṁ tu te pravakṣyāmi tajjuṣasva viśāmpate ॥19॥
7.94.20: alpaṁ ca vivaraṁ kr̥tvā tūrṇaṁ yāti dhanañjayaḥ ॥20॥
7.94.21: kiṁ na paśyasi bāṇaughān krośamātre kirīṭinaḥ,
paścād rathasya patitān kṣiptān śīghraṁ hi gacchataḥ ॥21॥
7.94.24: tasmād vyūhamukhaṁ hitvā nāhaṁ yotsyāmi phālgunam ॥24॥
7.94.25: gatvā yodhaya mā bhaistvaṁ tvaṁ hyasya jagataḥ patiḥ ॥25॥
7.94.26: rājā śūraḥ kr̥tī dakṣo vairamutpādya pāṇḍavaiḥ,
vīra svayaṁ prayāhyatra yatra pārtho dhanañjayaḥ ॥26॥
7.94.28: api śakyo raṇe jetuṁ vajrahastaḥ purandaraḥ,
7.94.30: sudakṣiṇaśca nihataḥ sa ca rājā śrutāyudhaḥ,
7.94.31: taṁ kathaṁ pāṇḍavaṁ yuddhe dahantamiva pāvakam,
7.94.32: kṣamaṁ ca manyase yuddhaṁ mama tenādya saṁyuge,
7.94.33: ahaṁ tu tat kariṣyāmi yathainaṁ prasahiṣyasi ॥33॥
7.94.35: eṣa te kavacaṁ rājaṁstathā badhnāmi kāñcanam,
yathā na bāṇā nāstrāṇi prahariṣyanti te raṇe ॥35॥
7.94.36: yodhayanti trayo lokāḥ sanarā nāsti te bhayam ॥36॥
7.94.37: na kr̥ṣṇo na ca kaunteyo na cānyaḥ śastrabhr̥d raṇe,
7.94.38: tvaramāṇaḥ svayaṁ yāhi na tvāsau visahiṣyati ॥38॥
7.94.39: evamuktvā tvaran droṇaḥ spr̥ṣṭvāmbhā varma bhāsvaram,
7.94.40: raṇe tasmin sumahati vijayāya sutasya te,
7.94.41: karotu svasti te brahma brahmā cāpi dvijātayaḥ,
7.94.42: tubhyaṁ rājarṣayaḥ sarve svasti kurvantu te sadā ॥42॥
7.94.44: svāhā svadhā śacī caiva svasti kurvantu te sadā,
7.94.45: vasiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapaścaiva svasti kurvantu te nr̥pa ॥45॥
7.94.47: vivasvān bhagavān svasti karotu tava sarvaśaḥ,
7.94.48: adhastād dharaṇīṁ yo’sau sadā dhārayate nr̥pa,
7.94.51: gatirbhava suraśreṣṭha trāhi no mahato bhayāt ॥51॥
7.94.52: atha pārśve sthitaṁ viṣṇuṁ śakrādīṁśca surottamān,
7.94.53: rakṣyā me satataṁ devāḥ sahendrāḥ sadvijātayaḥ,
tvaṣṭuḥ sudurdharaṁ tejo yena vr̥tro vinirmitaḥ ॥53॥
7.94.55: sa tasyaiva prasādād vo hanyādeva ripurbalī,
7.94.56: dr̥ṣṭvā jeṣyatha vr̥traṁ taṁ kṣipraṁ gacchata mandaram,
7.94.57: te gatvā sahitā devā brahmaṇā saha mandaram ॥57॥
7.94.58: so’bravīt svāgataṁ devā bruta kiṁ karavāṇyaham ॥58॥
7.94.60: tejo hr̥taṁ no vr̥treṇa gatirbhava divaukasām,
śaraṇaṁ tvāṁ prapannāḥ sma gatirbhava maheśvara ॥60॥
7.94.61: viditaṁ vo yathā devāḥ kr̥tyeyaṁ sumahābalā,
7.94.62: avaśyaṁ tu mayā kāryaṁ sāhyaṁ sarvadivaukasām,
mamedaṁ gātrajaṁ śakra kavacaṁ gr̥hya bhāsvaram ॥62॥
7.94.64: ityuktvā varadaḥ prādād varma tanmantrameva ca,
sa tena varmaṇā guptaḥ prāyād vr̥tracamūṁ prati ॥64॥
7.94.65: na sandhiḥ śakyate bhettuṁ varmabandhasya tasya tu ॥65॥
7.94.66: tato jaghāna samare vr̥traṁ devapatiḥ svayam,
taṁ ca mantramayaṁ bandhaṁ varma cāṅgirase dadau ॥66॥
7.94.68: āgniveśyo mama prādāt tena badhnāmi varma te,
7.94.70: hiraṇyagarbheṇa yathā baddhaṁ viṣṇoḥ purā raṇe ॥70॥
7.94.71: yathā ca brahmaṇā baddhaṁ saṅgrāme tārakāmaye,
śakrasya kavacaṁ divyaṁ tathā badhnāmyahaṁ tava ॥71॥
7.94.72: baddhvā tu kavacaṁ tasya mantreṇa vidhipūrvakam,
7.94.76: tataḥ śabdo mahānāsīt sainyānāṁ tava bhārata,
7.94.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi duryodhanakavacabandhane caturnavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥94॥
7.95.4: rājan kadācinnāsmābhirdr̥ṣṭaṁ tādr̥ṅ na ca śrutam,
7.95.15: tato raṇe naravyāghraḥ pārṣataḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha,
7.95.20: tathā tu yatamānasya droṇasya yudhi bhārata,
7.95.24: kālaḥ sma grasate yodhān dhr̥ṣṭadyumnena mohitān,
7.95.29: rathaṁ nāgaṁ hayaṁ cāpi pattinaśca viśāmpate,
7.95.30: pāṇḍavānāṁ tu sainyeṣu nāsti kaścit sa bhārata,
dadhāra yo raṇe bāṇān droṇacāpacyutān prabho ॥30॥
7.95.31: babhrāma pārṣataṁ sainyaṁ tatra tatraiva bhārata ॥31॥
7.95.33: tyaktvā prāṇān paraṁ śaktyā yudhyante sarvatomukhāḥ ॥33॥
7.95.40: sātyakiṁ pratyayau kruddhaḥ śūro rathavaraṁ yudhi ॥40॥
7.95.45: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ tu pāñcālyaṁ krūraiḥ sārdhaṁ prabhadrakaiḥ,
7.95.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe pañcanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥95॥
7.96.3: rakṣamāṇaḥ svakaṁ vyūhaṁ doṇo’pi saha sainikaiḥ,
ayodhayad raṇe pārthān prārthayāno mahad yaśaḥ ॥3॥
7.96.10: abhavat saṁvr̥taṁ sarvaṁ na prājñāyata kiñcana ॥10॥
7.96.13: indriyārthā yathā dehaṁ śaśvad dehavatāṁ vara ॥13॥
7.96.18: aśobhata bhr̥śaṁ lakṣmyā puṣpāḍhya iva kiṁśukaḥ ॥18॥
7.96.19: anadad bhairavaṁ nādaṁ vāhinyāḥ pramukhe tava ॥19॥
7.96.21: śakuniṁ rabhasaṁ yuddhe kr̥tavairaṁ ca bhārata,
7.96.22: tumulaḥ sa mahān rājan prāvartata janakṣayaḥ,
7.96.23: ya imāṁ pr̥thivīṁ rājan dagdhuṁ sarvāṁ samudyataḥ ॥23॥
7.96.24: śakuniḥ pāṇḍuputrābhyāṁ kr̥taḥ sa vimukhaḥ śaraiḥ,
na sma jānāti kartavyaṁ yuddhe kiñcit parākramam ॥24॥
7.96.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi dvandvayuddhe ṣaṇṇavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥96॥
7.97.1: tathā tasmin pravr̥tte tu saṅgrāme lomaharṣaṇe,
7.97.13: gr̥dhrāḥ kaṅkā bakāḥ śyenā vāyasā jambukāstathā,
7.97.16: raṇe jayaṁ prārthayānā bhr̥śaṁ yuyudhire tadā ॥16॥
7.97.20: kṣībā ivānye conmattā raṅgeṣviva ca vāraṇāḥ,
7.97.23: hayāḥ śuśubhire rājan meghā iva savidyutaḥ ॥23॥
7.97.29: doṇo drupadaputrasya khaḍgaṁ ca daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥29॥
7.97.30: dhvajaṁ kṣatraṁ ca bhallābhyāṁ tathā tau pārṣṇisārathī ॥30॥
7.97.34: sātyakiṁ prekṣya goptāraṁ pāñcālyaṁ ca mahāhave,
7.97.35: tato droṇaṁ śineḥ pautro grasantamapi sr̥ñjayān,
7.97.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi droṇadhr̥ṣṭadmumnayuddhe saptanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥97॥
7.98.1: bāṇe tasmin nikr̥tte tu dhr̥ṣṭadyumne ca mokṣite,
7.98.2: naravyāghraḥ śineḥ pautre droṇaḥ kimakarod yudhi ॥2॥
7.98.14: na sma sūryastadā bhāti na vavau ca samīraṇaḥ ॥14॥
7.98.20: ubhayostau rathau rājaṁste cāśvāstau ca sārathī ॥20॥
7.98.22: ubhayoḥ patite chatre tathaiva patitau dhvajau ॥22॥
7.98.33: tad yuddhaṁ yuyudhānasya droṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ,
7.98.38: sajyaṁ cakāra tadapi cicchedāsya ca sātyakiḥ,
7.98.39: sajyaṁ sajyaṁ dhanuścāsya ciccheda niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.98.40: na cāntaraṁ tayordr̥ṣṭaṁ sandhāne chedane’pi ca,
7.98.42: bhīṣme ca puruṣavyāghre yadidaṁ sātvatāṁ vare,
taṁ cāsya manasā droṇaḥ pūjayāmāsa vikramam ॥42॥
7.98.56: tato yuddhamabhūd rājaṁsteṣāṁ tava ca dhanvinām ॥56॥
7.98.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi droṇasātyakiyuddhe aṣṭanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥98॥
7.99.0d1: vartamāne tadā yuddhe droṇasya saha pāṇḍubhiḥ.
7.99.2: bhajyatāṁ jayatāṁ caiva jagāma tadahaḥ śanaiḥ ॥2॥
7.99.4: cakāra yatra panthānaṁ yayau yena janārdanaḥ ॥4॥
7.99.5: yatra yatra ratho yāti pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ,
7.99.9: rathe krośamatikrānte tasya te ghnanti śātravān ॥9॥
7.99.11: nendrasya na tu rudrasya nāpi vaiśravaṇasya ca ॥11॥
7.99.13: praviśya tu raṇe rājan keśavaḥ paravīrahā,
7.99.16: hatānāṁ vājināgānāṁ rathānāṁ ca naraiḥ saha,
7.99.21: ciccheda samare tūrṇaṁ dhvajau ca kanakojjvalau ॥21॥
7.99.22: athānye dhanuṣī rājan pragr̥hya samare tadā,
7.99.23: dhanuṣī cicchide tūrṇaṁ bhūya eva dhanañjayaḥ ॥23॥
7.99.25: jyeṣṭhasya ca śiraḥ kāyāt kṣurapreṇa nyakr̥ntata,
sa papāta hataḥ pr̥thvyāṁ vātarugṇa iva drumaḥ ॥25॥
7.99.26: vindaṁ tu nihataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā hyanuvindaḥ pratāpavān,
7.99.29: tasyārjunaḥ śaraiḥ ṣaḍbhirgrīvāṁ pādau bhujau śiraḥ,
7.99.30: tatastau nihatau dr̥ṣṭvā tayo rājan padānugāḥ,
7.99.34: śrāntaṁ cainaṁ samālakṣya jñātvā dūre ca saindhavam,
7.99.36: śarārditāśca glānāśca hayā dūre ca saindhavaḥ,
7.99.37: brūhi kr̥ṣṇa yathātattvaṁ tvaṁ hi prājñatamaḥ sadā,
7.99.38: mama tvanantaraṁ kr̥tyaṁ yad vai tat tvaṁ nibodha me,
hayān vimucya hi sukhaṁ viśalyān kuru mādhava ॥38॥
7.99.44: chādayantaḥ śaraiḥ pārthaṁ meghā iva divākaram ॥44॥
7.99.45: narasiṁhaṁ rathodārāḥ siṁhaṁ mattā iva dvipāḥ ॥45॥
7.99.46: yat kruddho bahulāḥ senāḥ sarvataḥ samavārayat ॥46॥
7.99.54: arjune dharaṇīṁ prāpte hayahaste ca keśave,
7.99.56: sa pārthaḥ pārthivān sarvān bhūmistho’pi rathasthitān,
7.99.58: parīpsante jalaṁ ceme peyaṁ na tvavagāhanam ॥58॥
7.99.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi vindānuvindavadhe arjunasaronirmāṇe ca ekonaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥99॥
7.100.7: sa tāni śarajālāni gadāḥ prāsāṁśca vīryavān,
7.100.9: tat tu pārthasya vikrāntaṁ vāsudevasya cobhayoḥ,
7.100.12: atha smayan hr̥ṣīkeśaḥ strīmadhya iva bhārata,
7.100.14: teṣāṁ śramaṁ ca glāniṁ ca vamathuṁ vepathuṁ vraṇān,
7.100.15: śalyānuddhr̥tya pāṇibhyāṁ parimr̥jya ca tān hayān,
7.100.17: sa taṁ rathavaraṁ śauriḥ sarvaśastrabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ,
7.100.22d1: yathā daivāsure yuddhe tr̥ṇīkr̥tya ca dānavān,
7.100.27: vilayaṁ samanuprāptā tacca rājā na budhyate,
7.100.29: tataḥ śīghrataraṁ prāyāt pāṇḍavaḥ saindhavaṁ prati,
7.100.31: vidrāvya tu tataḥ sainyaṁ pāṇḍavaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ,
7.100.37: śarārtāśca raṇe yodhāḥ śekuḥ kr̥ṣṇau na vīkṣitum ॥37॥
7.100.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sainyavismaye śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥100॥
7.101.11: tau tu dr̥ṣṭvā vyatikrāntau droṇānīkaṁ mahādyutī,
7.101.12: droṇahārdikyayoḥ kr̥ṣṇau na mokṣyete iti prabho ॥12॥
7.101.17: yadyasya samare goptā śakro devagaṇaiḥ saha,
7.101.21: tāvakā vīkṣya muktau tau vikrośanti sma sarvaśaḥ ॥21॥
7.101.40: dr̥ṣṭvā duryodhanaṁ tatra kr̥ṣṇayoḥ pramukhe sthitam ॥40॥
7.101.41: ye ca te sindhurājasya goptāraḥ pāvakopamāḥ,
te prāhr̥ṣyanta samare dr̥ṣṭvā putraṁ tava prabho ॥41॥
7.101.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi duryodhanāgame ekādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥101॥
7.102.3: kr̥tī ca satataṁ pārtha nityaṁ dveṣṭi ca bāndhavān ॥3॥
7.102.6: kathaṁ hi rājā rājyārthī tvayā gaccheta saṁyugam ॥6॥
7.102.7: diṣṭyā tvidānīṁ samprāpta eṣa te bāṇagocaram,
yathāyaṁ jīvitaṁ jahyāt tathā kuru dhanañjaya ॥7॥
7.102.8: na ca te saṁyuge vīryaṁ jānāti puruṣarṣabha ॥8॥
7.102.10: jahyenaṁ tvaṁ mahābāho yathā vr̥traṁ purandaraḥ ॥10॥
7.102.13: āryāṁ yuddhe matiṁ kr̥tvā jahi pārthāvicārayan ॥13॥
7.102.14: parikleśaṁ ca kr̥ṣṇāyā hr̥di kr̥tvā parākramam ॥14॥
7.102.16: diṣṭyā jānāti saṅgrāme yoddhavyaṁ hi tvayā saha,
diṣṭyā ca saphalāḥ pārtha sarve kāmā hyakāmitāḥ ॥16॥
7.102.17: yathendreṇa hataḥ pūrvaṁ jambho devāsure mr̥dhe ॥17॥
7.102.23: na cakāra bhayaṁ prāpte bhaye mahati māriṣa ॥23॥
7.102.27: saṁrambhamagamad bhūyaḥ sa ca tasmin parantapaḥ ॥27॥
7.102.29: dr̥ṣṭvā tu pārthaṁ saṁrabdhaṁ vāsudevaṁ ca māriṣa,
7.102.32: śokamāpuḥ pare caiva kuravaḥ sarva eva te,
amanyanta ca putraṁ te vaiśvānaramukhe hutam ॥32॥
7.102.33: tathā tu dr̥ṣṭvā yodhāste prahr̥ṣṭau kr̥ṣṇapāṇḍavau,
hato rājā hato rājetyūcire ca bhayārditāḥ ॥33॥
7.102.34: vyetu vo bhīrahaṁ kr̥ṣṇau preṣayiṣyāmi mr̥tyave ॥34॥
7.102.36: pārtha yacchikṣitaṁ te’straṁ divyaṁ pārthivameva ca,
tad darśaya mayi kṣipraṁ yadi jāto’si pāṇḍunā ॥36॥
7.102.37: yad balaṁ tava vīryaṁ ca keśavasya tathaiva ca,
tat kuruṣva mayi kṣipraṁ paśyāmastava pauruṣam ॥37॥
7.102.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi duryodhanavacane dvyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥102॥
7.103.4: teṣāṁ naiṣphalyamālokya punarnava ca pañca ca,
7.103.6: tvayā sampreṣitāḥ pārtha nārthaṁ kurvanti patriṇaḥ ॥6॥
7.103.7: muṣṭiśca te yathāpūrvaṁ bhujayośca balaṁ tava ॥7॥
7.103.8: na vā kaccidayaṁ kālaḥ prāptaḥ syādadya paścimaḥ,
7.103.9: vismayo me mahān pārtha tava dr̥ṣṭvā śarānimān,
7.103.10: śarāḥ kurvanti te nārthaṁ pārtha kādya viḍambanā ॥10॥
7.103.12: eko droṇo hi vedaitadahaṁ tasmācca sattamāt ॥12॥
7.103.13: api vajreṇa govinda svayaṁ maghavatā yudhi ॥13॥
7.103.14: jānaṁstvamapi vai kr̥ṣṇa māṁ vimohayase katham,
yad vr̥ttaṁ triṣu lokeṣu yacca keśava vartate ॥14॥
7.103.15: tathā bhaviṣyad yaccaiva tat sarvaṁ viditaṁ tava,
na tvidaṁ veda vai kaścid yathā tvaṁ madhusūdana ॥15॥
7.103.17: yattvatra vihitaṁ kāryaṁ naiṣa tad vetti mādhava,
7.103.18: paśya bāhvośca me vīryaṁ dhanuṣaśca janārdana,
7.103.19: tasmād br̥haspatiḥ prāpa tataḥ prāpa purandaraḥ ॥19॥
7.103.20: daivaṁ yadyasya varmaitad brahmaṇā vā svayaṁ kr̥tam ॥20॥
7.103.24: naitadastraṁ mayā śakyaṁ dviḥ prayoktuṁ janārdana ॥24॥
7.103.25: astraṁ māmeva hanyāddhi hanyāccāpi balaṁ mama,
7.103.28: tataḥ kruddho raṇe pārthaḥ sr̥kkiṇī parisaṁlihan,
7.103.35: atha nārjunagovindau na ratho vā vyadr̥śyata,
7.103.39: tato visphārya balavad gāṇḍīvaṁ jaghnivān ripūn,
7.103.40: pāñcajanyaṁ ca balavān dadhmau tāreṇa keśavaḥ,
7.103.41: tasya śaṅkhasya nādena dhanuṣo niḥsvanena ca,
7.103.43: te dr̥ṣṭvā sahasā pārthaṁ goptāraḥ saindhavasya tu,
7.103.45: taṁ śrutvā ninadaṁ ghoraṁ tāvakānāṁ samutthitam,
7.103.47: sa śabdo bharataśreṣṭha vyāpya sarvā diśo daśa,
7.103.49: atha kr̥ṣṇau mahābhāgau tāvakā vīkṣya daṁśitau,
7.103.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi duryodhanaparājaye tryadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥103॥
7.104.6: samāvr̥ṇvan daśa diśaḥ pārthasya niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥6॥
7.104.7: vyaśobhanta tadā śīghrā dīpayanto diśo daśa ॥7॥
7.104.10: pūrayanto divaṁ rājan pr̥thivīṁ ca sasāgarām ॥10॥
7.104.12: devadattaṁ ca kaunteyaḥ pāñcajanyaṁ ca keśavaḥ,
7.104.21: sa śabdaḥsumahān rājan diśaḥ sarvā vyanādayat,
trāsayāmāsa tat sainyaṁ yugānta iva sambhr̥taḥ ॥21॥
7.104.25: śalyasya saśaraṁ cāpaṁ muṣṭau ciccheda vīryavān ॥25॥
7.104.26: gr̥hītvā dhanuranyat tu śalyo vivyādha pāṇḍavam,
7.104.28: tataḥ śarāṇāṁ ṣaṣṭyā tu drauṇiḥ pārthamavākirat ॥28॥
7.104.29: vāsudevaṁ ca viṁśatyā punaḥ pārthaṁ ca pañcabhiḥ,
7.104.30: pratyavidhyat sa tān sarvān darśayan pāṇilāghavam,
7.104.31: saumadattiṁ tribhirviddhvā śalyaṁ ca daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥31॥
7.104.32: gautamaṁ pañcaviṁśatyā saindhavaṁ ca śatena ha ॥32॥
7.104.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe caturadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥104॥
7.105.1: pārthānāṁ māmakānāṁ ca tān mamācakṣva sañjaya ॥1॥
7.105.3: teṣāṁ tu rathamukhyānāṁ ratheṣu vividhā dhvajāḥ,
7.105.13: patākā kāñcanī sragvī dhvaje karṇasya saṁyuge ॥13॥
7.105.15: sa tena bhrājate rājan govr̥ṣeṇa mahārathaḥ ॥15॥
7.105.17: tena tasya ratho bhāti mayūreṇa mahātmanaḥ ॥17॥
7.105.19: sā sītā bhrājate tasya rathamāsthāya māriṣa ॥19॥
7.105.22: yathā devāsure yuddhe purā pūṣā sma śobhate,
7.105.24: śalasya tu mahārāja rājato dvirado mahān ॥24॥
7.105.25: sa ketuḥ śobhayāmāsa sainyaṁ te bharatarṣabha ॥25॥
7.105.32: gāṇḍīvaṁ divyakarmā tad rājan durmantrite tava,
7.105.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi dhvajavarṇane pañcādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥105॥
7.106.5: sarve droṇarathaṁ prāpya pañcālāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha,
7.106.20: bhūya eva tu viṁśatyā sāyakānāṁ samācinot,
7.106.22: tato droṇo bhr̥śaṁ kruddho dharmarājasya saṁyuge,
7.106.26: sa kr̥cchraṁ paramaṁ prāpto dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
tyaktvā tat kārmukaṁ chinnaṁ bhāradvājena saṁyuge ॥26॥
7.106.28: chittvā tu tān śarān rājan krodhasaṁraktalocanaḥ ॥28॥
7.106.30: samutkṣipya ca tāṁ hr̥ṣṭo nanāda balavad balī,
7.106.35: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā droṇāstraṁ tat samudyatam ॥35॥
7.106.36: viddhvā taṁ ca raṇe droṇaṁ pañcabhirnataparvabhiḥ ॥36॥
7.106.39: te gade sahasā mukte samāsādya parasparam ॥39॥
7.106.40: tato droṇo bhr̥śaṁ kruddho dharmarājasya māriṣa ॥40॥
7.106.43: virathaṁ taṁ samālokya vyāyudhaṁ ca viśeṣataḥ ॥43॥
7.106.46: hato rājā hato rājā bhāradvājena māriṣa ॥46॥
7.106.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirāpayāne ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥106॥
7.107.8: taṁ nihatya raṇe hr̥ṣṭo br̥hatkṣatro mahārathaḥ,
7.107.16: tāṁ tu śaktiṁ mahāvīryāṁ dorbhyāmāyamya bhārata,
7.107.17: tayā tu vīraghātinyā śaktyā tvabhihato bhr̥śam,
7.107.19: nanāda ca mahānādaṁ tarjayan pāṇḍavaṁ raṇe ॥19॥
7.107.20: mādreyastu tataḥ kruddho durmukhaṁ ca śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.107.21: taṁ raṇe rabhasaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sahadevaṁ mahābalam,
7.107.22: durmukhasya tu bhallena chittvā ketuṁ mahābalaḥ,
7.107.24: kṣurapreṇa ca tīkṣṇena kauravyasya mahad dhanuḥ,
sahadevo raṇe chittvā taṁ ca vivyādha pañcabhiḥ ॥24॥
7.107.25: hatāśvaṁ tu rathaṁ tyaktvā durmukho vimanāstadā,
7.107.28: taṁ tu hatvā mahābāhuḥ sahadevo vyarocata,
yathā dāśarathī rāmaḥ kharaṁ hatvā mahābalam ॥28॥
7.107.32: tān nivārya śarān śūraḥ śaineyaḥ kr̥tahastavat,
7.107.33: kumāre nihate tasmin māgadhasya sute prabho,
7.107.39: tato droṇo bhr̥śaṁ kruddhaḥ sahasodvr̥tya cakṣuṣī,
7.107.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe saptādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥107॥
7.108.2: te pīḍitā bhr̥śaṁ tena raudreṇa sahasā vibho,
pramūḍhā naiva vividurmr̥dhe kr̥tyaṁ sma kiñcana ॥2॥
7.108.5: sa tān prati mahārāja pañca cikṣepa sāyakān,
7.108.8: nanāda balavannādaṁ vivyādha ca śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥8॥
7.108.16: tad rakṣaḥ samare viddhaṁ kr̥tvā nādaṁ bhayāvaham,
abhyadravat tato bhīmaṁ ye ca tasya padānugāḥ ॥16॥
7.108.21: śuśubhe sarvato rājan praphulla iva kiṁśukaḥ ॥21॥
7.108.23: tiṣṭhedānīṁ raṇe pārtha paśya me’dya parākramam ॥23॥
7.108.24: parokṣaṁ mama tad vr̥ttaṁ yad bhrātā me hatastvayā ॥24॥
7.108.27: jagāma dharaṇīṁ caiva kṣudraḥ khaṁ sahasāgamat ॥27॥
7.108.31: śilāḥ khaḍgā guḍāścaiva r̥ṣṭīrvajrāṇi caiva ha,
7.108.33: hayāśca bahavo rājan pattayaśca tathā punaḥ,
rathebhyo rathinaḥ petustasya nunnāḥ sma sāyakaiḥ ॥33॥
7.108.38: taṁ śrutvā ninadaṁ ghoraṁ tava sainyasya pāṇḍavaḥ,
7.108.39: sandadhe tvāṣṭramastraṁ sa svayaṁ tvaṣṭeva mārutiḥ ॥39॥
7.108.44: prahrādaṁ samare jitvā yathā śakraṁ marudgaṇāḥ ॥44॥
7.108.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi alambuṣaparājaye aṣṭādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥108॥
7.109.1: haiḍimbiḥ prayayau tūrṇaṁ vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥1॥
7.109.8: yāṁ yāṁ ghaṭotkaco yuddhe māyāṁ darśayate nr̥pa ॥8॥
7.109.10: ta enaṁ bhr̥śasaṁvignāḥ sarvataḥ pravarā rathaiḥ ॥10॥
7.109.15: pañcabhiḥ pañcabhirviddhvā ghoraṁ nādaṁ nanāda ha ॥15॥
7.109.17: haiḍimbo rākṣasaṁ viddhvā yuddhe pañcāśatā śaraiḥ ॥17॥
7.109.20: prativivyādha tān sarvān pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
taṁ kruddhaṁ rākṣasaṁ yuddhe pratikruddhastu rākṣasaḥ ॥20॥
7.109.22: te śarā nataparvāṇo viviśū rākṣasaṁ tadā ॥22॥
7.109.26: samīkṣya tadavasthaṁ taṁ vadhāyāsya mano dadhe,
vegaṁ cakre mahāntaṁ ca rākṣasendrarathaṁ prati ॥26॥
7.109.28: samutkṣipya ca bāhubhyāmāvidhya ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥28॥
7.109.31: tataḥ sumanasaḥ pārthā hate tasmin niśācare ॥31॥
7.109.35d2: mūrdhnyupāghrāya taṁ jyeṣṭhaḥ pariṣvajya ca pāṇḍavaḥ,
7.109.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi alambuṣavadhe navādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥109॥
7.110.1: sañjayācakṣva tattvena paraṁ kautūhalaṁ hi me ॥1॥
7.110.9: tataḥ kruddho maheṣvāso bhūya eva mahābalaḥ,
7.110.11: bhāradvājaṁ raṇe dr̥ṣṭvā visr̥jantaṁ śitān śarān ॥11॥
7.110.12: taṁ tu samprekṣya te putrāḥ sainikāśca viśāmpate,
7.110.13: taṁ śrutvā ninadaṁ ghoraṁ pīḍyamānaṁ ca mādhavam,
7.110.16: abhidrava drutaṁ droṇaṁ kimu tiṣṭhasi pārṣata,
na paśyasi bhayaṁ droṇād ghoraṁ naḥ samupasthitam ॥16॥
7.110.21: pāṇḍavānāṁ ca bhadraṁ te sr̥ñjayānāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ ॥21॥
7.110.23: smayanneva tu tān vīrān droṇaḥ pratyagrahīt svayam,
7.110.25: bhāradvājaṁ ca te sarve na śekuḥ prativīkṣitum,
7.110.26: tāṁstu sarvān maheṣvāsān droṇaḥ śastrabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ,
7.110.30: droṇaṁ sma dadr̥śuḥ śūraṁ vinighnantaṁ varān varān ॥30॥
7.110.31: kekayānāṁ śataṁ hatvā vidrāvya ca samantataḥ,
7.110.35: taṁ tathā samare droṇaṁ nighnantaṁ somakān raṇe,
7.110.39: na nūnaṁ svasti pārthāya yathā nadati śaṅkharāṭ ॥39॥
7.110.42: yaḥ sa dharmaḥ purā dr̥ṣṭaḥ sadbhiḥ śaineya śāśvataḥ,
7.110.44: yo hi prītamanā nityaṁ yaśca nityamanuvrataḥ,
sa kārye sāmparāye tu niyojya iti me matiḥ ॥44॥
7.110.45: yathā ca keśavo nityaṁ pāṇḍavānāṁ parāyaṇam,
7.110.46: so’haṁ bhāraṁ samādhāsye tvayi taṁ voḍhumarhasi,
abhiprāyaṁ ca me nityaṁ na vr̥thā kartumarhasi ॥46॥
7.110.47: sa tvaṁ bhrāturvayasyasya gurorapi ca saṁyuge,
7.110.49: yo hi śaineya mitrārthe yudhyamānastyajet tanum,
pr̥thivīṁ ca dvijātibhyo yo dadyāt sa samo bhavet ॥49॥
7.110.50: śrutāśca bahavo’smābhī rājāno ye divaṁ gatāḥ,
7.110.52: raṇe santyajati prāṇān dvitīyastvaṁ ca sātyake ॥52॥
7.110.53: vikrāntasya ca vīrasya yuddhe prārthayato yaśaḥ,
śūra eva sahāyaḥ syānnetaraḥ prākr̥to janaḥ ॥53॥
7.110.54: tvadanyo hi raṇe goptā vijayasya na vidyate ॥54॥
7.110.56: prājñaḥ sarvāstravicchūro muhyate na ca saṁyuge ॥56॥
7.110.58: śiṣyo mama sakhā caiva priyo’syāhaṁ priyaśca me,
7.110.59: asmadarthaṁ ca rājendra saṁnahyed yadi keśavaḥ,
rāmo vāpyaniruddho vā pradyumno vā mahārathaḥ ॥59॥
7.110.60: gado vā sāraṇo vāpi sāmbo vā saha vr̥ṣṇibhiḥ,
7.110.61: sāhāyye viniyokṣyāmi nāsti me’nyo hi tatsamaḥ ॥61॥
7.110.63: tasya tvamevaṁ saṅkalpaṁ na vr̥thā kartumarhasi,
7.110.65: na tat sauhr̥damanyeṣu mayā śaineya lakṣitam,
7.110.66: so’bhijātyā ca bhaktyā ca sakhyasyācāryakasya ca,
7.110.68: suyodhano hi sahasā gato droṇena daṁśitaḥ,
7.110.71: mahāntaṁ ca raṇe śabdaṁ dīryamāṇāṁ ca bhāratīm ॥71॥
7.110.78: nāgānāṁ śr̥ṇu śabdaṁ ca pattīnāṁ ca sahasraśaḥ,
sādināṁ dravatāṁ caiva śr̥ṇu kampayatāṁ mahīm ॥78॥
7.110.80: aparyante bale magno jahyādapi ca jīvitam,
tasmiṁśca nihate yuddhe kathaṁ jīveta mādr̥śaḥ ॥80॥
7.110.83: tanna jānāmi vārṣṇeya yadi jīvati vā na vā,
kurūṇāṁ cāpi tat sainyaṁ sāgarapratimaṁ mahat ॥83॥
7.110.84: eka eva ca bībhatsuḥ praviṣṭastāta bhāratīm,
7.110.85: na hi me vartate buddhiradya yuddhe kathañcana,
doṇo’pi rabhaso yuddhe mama pīḍayate balam ॥85॥
7.110.86: pratyakṣaṁ te mahābāho yathāsau carati dvijaḥ,
7.110.88: nāhaṁ śocāmi dāśārhaṁ goptāraṁ jagataḥ patim ॥88॥
7.110.89: sa hi śakto raṇe tāta trīṁllokānapi saṅgatān,
7.110.91: tasya tvaṁ padavīṁ gaccha gaccheyustvādr̥śā yathā ॥91॥
7.110.95d1: yodhayet sa jagat sarvaṁ vijayeta ripūn bahun.
7.110.95d2: iti bruvanti lokeṣu janāstava guṇān sadā,
7.110.96: tat tvāṁ yadabhivakṣyāmi tat kuruṣva mahābala,
sambhāvanā hi lokasya mama pārthasya cobhayoḥ ॥96॥
7.110.97: parityajya priyān prāṇān raṇe cara vibhītavat ॥97॥
7.110.98: na hi śaineya dāśārhā raṇe rakṣanti jīvitam,
7.110.103: praviśya ca yathānyāyaṁ saṅgamya ca mahārathaiḥ,
7.110.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhiravākye daśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥110॥
7.111.1: prītiyuktaṁ ca hr̥dyaṁ ca madhurākṣarameva ca,
kālayuktaṁ ca citraṁ ca nyāyyaṁ yaccāpi bhāṣitum ॥1॥
7.111.3: nyāyayuktaṁ ca citraṁ ca phālgunārthe yaśaskaram ॥3॥
7.111.4: evaṁvidhe tathā kāle mādr̥śaṁ prekṣya sammatam,
vaktumarhasi rājendra yathā pārthaṁ tathaiva mām ॥4॥
7.111.5: na me dhanañjayasyārthe prāṇā rakṣyāḥ kathañcana,
tvatprayuktaḥ punarahaṁ kiṁ na kuryāṁ mahāhave ॥5॥
7.111.7: vijeṣye ca raṇe rājan satyametad bravīmi te ॥7॥
7.111.9: avaśyaṁ tu mayā sarvaṁ vijñāpyastvaṁ narādhipa,
vāsudevasya yad vākyaṁ phālgunasya ca dhīmataḥ ॥9॥
7.111.11: āryāṁ yuddhe matiṁ kr̥tvā yāvaddhanmi jayadratham ॥11॥
7.111.12: tvayi cāhaṁ mahābāho pradyumne vā mahārathe,
7.111.13: jānīṣe hi raṇe droṇaṁ rabhasaṁ śreṣṭhasammatam,
pratijñā cāpi te nityaṁ śrutā droṇasya mādhava ॥13॥
7.111.16: dharmarājaṁ na ced droṇo nigr̥hṇīyād raṇe balāt ॥16॥
7.111.18: asmākaṁ gamanaṁ vyaktaṁ vanaṁ prati bhavet punaḥ ॥18॥
7.111.19: so’yaṁ mama jayo vyaktaṁ vyartha eva bhaviṣyati,
yadi droṇo raṇe kruddho nigr̥hṇīyād yudhiṣṭhiram ॥19॥
7.111.20: sa tvamadya mahābāho priyārthaṁ mama mādhava,
jayārthaṁ ca yaśo’rthaṁ ca rakṣa rājānamāhave ॥20॥
7.111.21: sa bhavān mayi nikṣepo nikṣiptaḥ savyasācinā,
bhāradvājād bhayaṁ nityaṁ manyamānena vai prabho ॥21॥
7.111.22: tasyāpi ca mahābāho nityaṁ paśyāmi saṁyuge,
7.111.23: māṁ cāpi manyate yuddhe bhāradvājasya dhīmataḥ,
7.111.24: pr̥ṣṭhato notsahe kartuṁ tvāṁ vā tyaktuṁ mahīpate,
7.111.25: upalabhya raṇe krīḍed yathā śakuninā śiśuḥ,
7.111.26: tasmai tvāṁ visr̥jeyaṁ vai sa tvāṁ rakṣed yathārjunaḥ,
kuru tvamātmano guptiṁ kaste goptā gate mayi ॥26॥
7.111.27: yaḥ pratīyād raṇe droṇaṁ yāvad gacchāmi pāṇḍavam,
7.111.29: ye ca karṇamukhā rājan rathodārāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ॥29॥
7.111.31: jaṅgamāḥ sthāvarāḥ sarve nālaṁ pārthasya saṁyuge ॥31॥
7.111.32: evaṁ jñātvā mahārāja vyetu te bhīrdhanañjaye,
7.111.33: na tatra karmaṇo vyāpat kathañcidapi vidyate,
7.111.34: mayi cāpi sahāye te gacchamāne’rjunaṁ prati ॥34॥
7.111.35: ācāryo hi bhr̥śaṁ rājan nigrahe tava gr̥dhyati ॥35॥
7.111.36: pratijñāmātmano rakṣan satyāṁ kartuṁ ca bhārata,
kuruṣvādyātmano guptiṁ kaste goptā gate mayi ॥36॥
7.111.37: yasyāhaṁ pratyayāt pārtha gaccheyaṁ phālgunaṁ prati,
na hyahaṁ tvāṁ mahārāja anikṣipya mahāhave ॥37॥
7.111.38: kvacid yāsyāmi kauravya satyametad bravīmi te,
7.111.39: dr̥ṣṭvā śreyaḥ paraṁ buddhyā tato rājan praśādhi mām ॥39॥
7.111.40: na tu me śuddhyate bhāvaḥ śvetāśvaṁ prati māriṣa ॥40॥
7.111.41: gaccha tvaṁ samanujñāto yatra yāto dhanañjayaḥ ॥41॥
7.111.42: vicāryaitat svayaṁ buddhyā gamanaṁ tatra rocaya ॥42॥
7.111.43: sa tvamātiṣṭha yānāya yatra yāto dhanañjayaḥ,
7.111.44: draupadeyāśca māṁ tāta rakṣiṣyanti na saṁśayaḥ ॥44॥
7.111.47: na droṇaḥ saha sainyena kr̥tavarmā ca saṁyuge ॥47॥
7.111.48: samāsādayituṁ śakto na ca māṁ dharṣayiṣyati,
7.111.50: droṇo na sainyaṁ balavat krāmet tatra kathañcana,
7.111.51: kavacī sa śarī khaḍgī dhanvī ca varabhūṣaṇaḥ,
viśrabdhaṁ gaccha śaineya mā kārṣīrmayi sambhramam,
7.111.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirasātyakivākye ekādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥111॥
7.112.2: te māṁ bhītamiti brūyurāyāntaṁ phālgunaṁ prati ॥2॥
7.112.4: kr̥tāṁ cenmanyase rakṣāṁ svasti te’stu viśāmpate,
7.112.5: na hi me pāṇḍavāt kaścit triṣu lokeṣu vidyate,
yo me priyataro rājan satyametad bravīmi te ॥5॥
7.112.6: tasyāhaṁ padavīṁ yāsye sandeśāt tava mānada,
tvatkr̥te na ca me kiñcidakartavyaṁ kathañcana ॥6॥
7.112.7: yathā hi me gurorvākyaṁ viśiṣṭaṁ dvipadāṁ vara,
7.112.8: priye hi tava vartete bhrātarau kr̥ṣṇapāṇḍavau,
tayoḥ priye sthitaṁ caiva viddhi māṁ rājapuṅgava ॥8॥
7.112.10: tatra yāsyāmi yatrāsau rājan rājā jayadrathaḥ ॥10॥
7.112.14: anādiṣṭastu guruṇā ko nu yudhyeta mānavaḥ,
ādiṣṭastu yathā rājan ko na yudhyeta mādr̥śaḥ ॥14॥
7.112.15: abhijānāmi taṁ deśaṁ yatra yāsyāmyahaṁ prabho,
7.112.18: nāgā meghanibhā rājan kṣaranta iva toyadāḥ,
7.112.19: anyatra hi vadhādeṣāṁ nāsti rājan parājayaḥ,
7.112.21: dhanurvede gatāḥ pāraṁ muṣṭiyuddhe ca kovidāḥ,
7.112.23: nityaṁ hi samare rājan vijigīṣanti mānavān,
7.112.25: te na klāntā na ca śrāntā dr̥ḍhāvaraṇakārmukāḥ ॥25॥
7.112.26: etān pramathya saṅgrāme priyārthaṁ tava kaurava ॥26॥
7.112.32: etān hatvā śarai rājan kirātān yuddhadurmadān ॥32॥
7.112.39: kr̥paṁ ca saumadattiṁ ca droṇaṁ ca rathināṁ varam,
7.112.40: te tu sarve’dya samprāptā mama nārācagocaram ॥40॥
7.112.42: ye tvete rathino rājan dr̥śyante kāñcanadhvajāḥ ॥42॥
7.112.43: ete durvāraṇā nāma kāmbojā yadi te śrutāḥ,
7.112.47: rathe kurvantu me rājan yathāvad rathakalpakāḥ,
7.112.52: tasmād vai vājino mukhyā viśrāntāḥ śubhalakṣaṇāḥ ॥52॥
7.112.54: rathe cāsthāpayad rājā śastrāṇi vividhāni ca,
7.112.62: tataḥ sa madhuparkārhaḥ pītvā kailātakaṁ madhu ॥62॥
7.112.71: tvaṁ bhīma rakṣa rājānametat kāryatamaṁ hi te,
7.112.72: āyatyāṁ ca tadātve ca śreyo rājño’bhirakṣaṇam,
jānīṣe mama vīryaṁ tvaṁ tava cāhamarindama ॥72॥
7.112.73: tasmād bhīma nivartasva mama cedicchasi priyam,
tathoktaḥ sātyakiṁ prāha vraja tvaṁ kāryasiddhaye ॥73॥
7.112.75: gaccha gaccha dhruvaṁ pārtha dhruvo hi vijayo mama,
7.112.76: nimittāni ca dhanyāni yathā bhīma vadanti mām,
7.112.77: etāvaduktvā bhīmaṁ tu visr̥jya ca mahāyaśāḥ ॥77॥
7.112.78: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pravivikṣantaṁ sainyaṁ tava janādhipa ॥78॥
7.112.79: tataḥ prayātaḥ sahasā tava sainyaṁ sa sātyakiḥ ॥79॥
7.112.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sātyakipraveśe dvādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥112॥
7.113.1: prayāte tava sainyaṁ tu yuyudhāne yuyutsayā,
7.113.11: na kecanābhyadhāvan vai sātyakiṁ tava sainikāḥ ॥11॥
7.113.20: nānāvidhāni sainyāni tava hatvā tu sātvataḥ,
7.113.23: nivārya tu raṇe droṇo yuyudhānaṁ mahāratham,
7.113.24: sātyakistu raṇe droṇaṁ rājan vivyādha saptabhiḥ,
7.113.25: sa taṁ na mamr̥ṣe droṇaṁ yuyudhāno mahārathaḥ ॥25॥
7.113.26: siṁhanādaṁ tataḥ kr̥tvā droṇaṁ vivyādha sātyakiḥ,
7.113.30: tavācāryo raṇaṁ hitvā gataḥ kāpuruṣo yathā ॥30॥
7.113.31: tvaṁ hi me yudhyato nādya jīvan yāsyasi mādhava ॥31॥
7.113.32: yadi māṁ tvaṁ raṇe hitvā na yāsyācāryavad drutam,
7.113.33: gacchāmi svasti te brahman na me kālātyayo bhavet,
7.113.34: tasmādeva vrajāmyāśu yathā me sa gururgataḥ,
7.113.35: droṇaḥ kariṣyate yatnaṁ sarvathā mama vāraṇe ॥35॥
7.113.36: yatto yāhi raṇe sūta śr̥ṇu cedaṁ vacaḥ param,
7.113.38: bāhlikābhyāśato yuktaṁ karṇasya ca mahad balam,
7.113.43: sa vyatīyāya yatrograṁ karṇasya ca mahad balam,
taṁ droṇo’nuyayau kruddho vikiran viśikhān bahūn ॥43॥
7.113.45: praviṣṭe yuyudhāne tu sainikeṣu druteṣu ca ॥45॥
7.113.50: sa tasya dehāvaraṇaṁ bhittvā dehaṁ ca sāyakaḥ ॥50॥
7.113.52: vivyādha ca raṇe rājan sātyakiṁ satyavikramam ॥52॥
7.113.53: tataḥ praśīrṇe dhanuṣi śaktyā śaktimatāṁ varaḥ ॥53॥
7.113.56: chādayitvā raṇe rājan hārdikyaṁ sa tu sātyakiḥ,
7.113.57: sa papāta hataḥ sūto hārdikyasya mahārathāt,
7.113.58: atha bhojastu sambhrānto nigr̥hya turagān svayam,
7.113.61: sa tatra bahubhiḥ śūraiḥ saṁniruddho mahārathaiḥ ॥61॥
7.113.62: na cacāla tadā rājan sātyakiḥ satyavikramaḥ,
sandhāya ca camūṁ droṇo bhoje bhāraṁ niveśya ca ॥62॥
7.113.64: samāsādya tu hārdikyaṁ rathānāṁ pravaraṁ ratham ॥64॥
7.113.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sātyakipraveśe trayodaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥113॥
7.114.7: nānāhūtaṁ nāpyabhr̥taṁ mama sainyaṁ babhūva ha ॥7॥
7.114.8: kr̥tamānopacāraṁ ca yaśasvi ca manasvi ca ॥8॥
7.114.17: tatra śeṣaṁ na paśyāmi praviṣṭe savyasācini,
sātvate ca rathodāre mama sainyasya sañjaya ॥17॥
7.114.19: kiṁ nu vā kuravaḥ kr̥tyaṁ vidadhuḥ kālacoditāḥ,
7.114.20: grastān hi kauravān manye mr̥tyunā tāta saṅgatān,
vikramo’pi raṇe teṣāṁ na tathā dr̥śyate hi vai ॥20॥
7.114.21: na ca vārayitā kaścit tayorastīha sañjaya ॥21॥
7.114.24: na cāyodho’bhavat kaścinmama sainye tu sañjaya,
7.114.25: tathā putraiśca me tāta jñātibhiśca sabāndhavaiḥ ॥25॥
7.114.26: te ca prāpyaiva saṅgrāme nirjitāḥ savyasācinā,
7.114.27: rakṣyate yaśca saṅgrāme ye ca sañjaya rakṣiṇaḥ,
ekaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ panthā rakṣyasya saha rakṣibhiḥ ॥27॥
7.114.28: putro mama bhr̥śaṁ mūḍhaḥ kiṁ kāryaṁ pratyapadyata ॥28॥
7.114.30: dr̥ṣṭvā kāṁ vai dhr̥tiṁ yuddhe pratyapadyanta māmakāḥ ॥30॥
7.114.34: hatāṁśca yodhān sandr̥śya manye śocanti putrakāḥ ॥34॥
7.114.35: dhāvamānān raṇe vyagrān manye śocanti putrakāḥ ॥35॥
7.114.39: nirāśā vijaye sarve manye śocanti putrakāḥ ॥39॥
7.114.40: kṣaṇena dr̥ṣṭvā tau vīrau manye śocanti putrakāḥ ॥40॥
7.114.42: tasmin praviṣṭe pr̥tanāṁ śinīnāṁ pravare rathe,
7.114.44: droṇo hi balavān śreṣṭhaḥ kr̥tāstro yuddhadurmadaḥ,
7.114.46: tanme sarvaṁ samācakṣva kuśalo hyasi sañjaya ॥46॥
7.114.47: prāpya prākr̥tavad vīra na tvaṁ śocitumarhasi ॥47॥
7.114.48: mā hārṣīḥ pāṇḍavān rājanniti tanna tvayā śrutam ॥48॥
7.114.49: suhr̥dāṁ hitakāmānāṁ vākyaṁ yo na śr̥ṇoti ha,
sa mahad vyasanaṁ prāpya śocate vai yathā bhavān ॥49॥
7.114.50: yācito’si purā rājan dāśārheṇa śamaṁ prati,
na ca taṁ labdhavān kāmaṁ tvattaḥ kr̥ṣṇo mahāyaśāḥ ॥50॥
7.114.51: tava nirguṇatāṁ jñātvā pakṣapātaṁ suteṣu ca,
dvaidhībhāvaṁ tathā dharme pāṇḍaveṣu ca matsaram ॥51॥
7.114.55: na hi te sukr̥taṁ kiñcidādau madhye ca bhārata,
7.114.57: praviṣṭe tava sainyaṁ tu śaineye satyavikrame,
7.114.72: cikṣepa ca rathāt tūrṇaṁ kr̥tavarmarathaṁ prati,
7.114.74: dvābhyāṁ śarābhyāṁ hārdikyo nijaghāna dvidhā tadā,
sā chinnā patitā bhūmau śaktiḥ kanakabhūṣaṇā ॥74॥
7.114.75: śaktiṁ vinihatāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bhīmaścukrodha vai bhr̥śam ॥75॥
7.114.79: abhihatya dr̥ḍhaṁ yuddhe tān sarvān pratyavidhyata ॥79॥
7.114.80: te’pi taṁ pratyavidhyanta saptabhiḥ saptabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥80॥
7.114.82: śikhaṇḍī tu tataḥ kruddhaśchinne dhanuṣi satvaraḥ,
asiṁ jagrāha samare śatacandraṁ ca bhāsvaram ॥82॥
7.114.84: sa tasya saśaraṁ cāpaṁ chittvā rājan mahānasiḥ,
7.114.86: athānyad dhanurādāya tyaktvā tacca mahad dhanuḥ,
7.114.87: śikhaṇḍinaṁ ca vivyādha tribhiḥ pañcabhireva ca ॥87॥
7.114.90: vidarśayan balaṁ śūraḥ śārdūla iva kuñjaram ॥90॥
7.114.96: taṁ viṣaṇṇaṁ raṇe dr̥ṣṭvā tāvakāḥ puruṣarṣabha,
7.114.98: sāditaṁ tu rathopasthe dr̥ṣṭvā pārthāḥ śikhaṇḍinam,
7.114.101: te vadhyamānāḥ samare hārdikyena sma pāṇḍavāḥ,
7.114.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sātyakipraveśe kr̥tavarmaparākrame caturdaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥114॥
7.115.3: śrutvā sa ninadaṁ bhīmaṁ tāvakānāṁ mahāhave,
7.115.5: enaṁ jitvā punaḥ sūta yāsyāmi vijayaṁ prati ॥5॥
7.115.7: kr̥tavarmā tu hārdikyaḥ śaineyaṁ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.115.9: te tasya jaghnire vāhān bhallenāsyācchinad dhanuḥ,
7.115.11: tataḥ prāyāt sa tvaritaḥ sātyakiḥ satyavikramaḥ ॥11॥
7.115.12: śr̥ṇu rājan yadakarot tava sainyeṣu vīryavān,
7.115.14: dr̥ṣṭvā tu tava tat sainyaṁ rathāśvadvipasaṅkulam,
7.115.16: ete hi bahavaḥ sūta durnivārāśca saṁyuge,
7.115.16d1: na cājitvā raṇe hyetān śakyaḥ prāptuṁ jayadrathaḥ,
nāpi pārtho mayā sūta śakyaḥ prāptuṁ kathañcana.
7.115.19: tataḥ prāyācchanaiḥ sūtaḥ sātvatasya mate sthitaḥ ॥19॥
7.115.28: kṣaranto’sr̥k tathā mūtraṁ purīṣaṁ ca pradudruvuḥ ॥28॥
7.115.33: urasā dhārayan niṣkaṁ kaṇṭhasūtraṁ ca bhāsvaram,
7.115.40: acintayan vai sa śarānnātyarthaṁ sambhramād balī ॥40॥
7.115.43: jalasandhasya ciccheda vivyādha ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ,
jalasandhastu tat tyaktvā saśaraṁ vai śarāsanam ॥43॥
7.115.44: tomaraṁ vyasr̥jat tūrṇaṁ sātyakiṁ prati māriṣa,
sa nirbhidya bhujaṁ savyaṁ mādhavasya mahāraṇe ॥44॥
7.115.45: nirbhinne tu bhuje savye sātyakiḥ satyavikramaḥ ॥45॥
7.115.46: pragr̥hya tu tataḥ khaḍgaṁ jalasandho mahābalaḥ ॥46॥
7.115.47: āvidhya ca tataḥ khaḍgaṁ sātvatāyotsasarja ha ॥47॥
7.115.50: visphārya vivyadhe kruddho jalasandhaṁ śareṇa ha,
7.115.61: tataḥ pravavr̥te yuddhaṁ kurūṇāṁ sātvatasya ca,
droṇasya ca raṇe rājan ghoraṁ devāsuropamam ॥61॥
7.115.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sātyakipraveśe jalasandhavadho nāma pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥115॥
7.116.1: te kirantaḥ śaravrātān sarve yattāḥ prahāriṇaḥ,
7.116.2: taṁ droṇaḥ saptasaptatyā jaghāna niśitaiḥ śareḥ,
7.116.3: vivyādha savye pārśve tu stanābhyāmantare tathā ॥3॥
7.116.12: asravad rudhiraṁ bhūri svarasaṁ candano yathā ॥12॥
7.116.17: vivyādha sātyakiṁ tūrṇaṁ sāyakānāṁ śatena ha,
7.116.18: pīḍitaṁ nr̥patiṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tava putrā mahārathāḥ ॥18॥
7.116.26: taṁ tu śabdamatha śrutvā kr̥tavarmā mahārathaḥ ॥26॥
7.116.27: abhyayāt sahasā tatra yatrāste mādhavaḥ prabhuḥ,
7.116.28: bhartsayan sārathiṁ cāgre yāhi yāhīti satvaram,
7.116.34: avidhyat sādhudāntān vai saindhavān sātvatasya hi,
7.116.46: samāśvasya ca hārdikyo gr̥hya cānyanmahad dhanuḥ,
tasthau sa tatra balavān vārayan yudhi pāṇḍavān ॥46॥
7.116.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sātyakipraveśe duryodhanakr̥tavarmaparājaye ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥116॥
7.117.3: tato droṇaḥ śineḥ pautraṁ citraiḥ sarvāyasaiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.117.12: ājaghāna bhr̥śaṁ kruddho dhvajaṁ ca niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥12॥
7.117.19: taṁ vai na mamr̥ṣe droṇaḥ sarvaśastrabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ ॥19॥
7.117.21: anāsādya tu śaineyaṁ sā śaktiḥ kālasaṁnibhā,
7.117.22: tato droṇaṁ śineḥ pautro rājan vivyādha patriṇā,
7.117.23: droṇo’pi samare rājan mādhavasya mahad dhanuḥ,
7.117.25: ayodhayacca yad droṇaṁ raśmīn jagrāha ca svayam ॥25॥
7.117.27: tasya droṇaḥ śarān pañca preṣayāmāsa bhārata,
te ghorāḥ kavacaṁ bhittvā papuḥ śoṇitamāhave ॥27॥
7.117.30: sa rathaḥ pradrutaḥ saṅkhye maṇḍalāni sahasraśaḥ,
7.117.31: iti sma cukruśuḥ sarve rājaputrāḥ sarājakāḥ ॥31॥
7.117.33: tān dr̥ṣṭvā pradrutān saṅkhye sātvatena śarārditān,
7.117.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sātyakipraveśe sātyakiparākrame saptadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥117॥
7.118.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sudarśanavadhe aṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥118॥
7.119.7: hārdikyaṁ yodhavaryaṁ ca manye prāptaṁ dhanañjayam,
na hi me jāyate trāso dr̥ṣṭvā sainyānyanekaśaḥ ॥7॥
7.119.9: dravate tad yathā sainyaṁ tena bhagnaṁ mahātmanā ॥9॥
7.119.18: na sambhramo me vārṣṇeya vidyate satyavikrama,
yadyapi syāt tava kruddho jāmadagnyo’grataḥ sthitaḥ ॥18॥
7.119.19: droṇo vā rathināṁ śreṣṭhaḥ kr̥po madreśvaro’pi vā,
tathāpi sambhramo na syāt tvāmāśritya mahābhuja ॥19॥
7.119.22: na ca me sambhramaḥ kaścid bhūtapūrvaḥ kathañcana ॥22॥
7.119.27: adyaiṣāṁ kadanaṁ kr̥tvā priyaṁ yāsyāmi pāṇḍavam ॥27॥
7.119.28: adya drakṣyanti me vīryaṁ kauravāḥ sasuyodhanāḥ,
7.119.34: adya me kruddharūpasya nighnataśca varān varān,
7.119.36: adya snehaṁ ca bhaktiṁ ca pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu,
7.119.37: balaṁ vīryaṁ kr̥tajñatvaṁ mama jñāsyanti kauravāḥ,
7.119.41: acchinat sātyakī rājan nainaṁ te prāpnuvat śarāḥ,
7.119.43: te hanyamānā vīreṇa mlecchāḥ sātyakinā raṇe ॥43॥
7.119.45: pañca ṣaṭ sapta cāṣṭau ca bibheda yavanān śaraiḥ,
7.119.53: yavanānāṁ ca tat sainyaṁ śakānāṁ ca mahadbalam,
7.119.54: tat tasya samare karma dr̥ṣṭvānyairakr̥taṁ purā ॥54॥
7.119.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sātyakipraveśe yavanaparājaye ekonaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥119॥
7.120.1: jagāma tava sainyasya madhyena rathināṁ varaḥ ॥1॥
7.120.3: sa rathena caran mārgān dhanurabhrāmayad bhr̥śam,
7.120.6: tāvakānāṁ babhau madhye gavāṁ madhye yathā vr̥ṣaḥ ॥6॥
7.120.11: anye ca bahavaḥ śūrāḥ śastravanto durāsadāḥ ॥11॥
7.120.12: atha śabdo mahānāsīt tava sainyasya māriṣa ॥12॥
7.120.15: nādayan vai diśaḥ sarvā rathaghoṣeṇa sārathe ॥15॥
7.120.18: eṣa sainyāni śatrūṇāṁ vidhamāmi śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.120.25: na moghaḥ sāyakaḥ kaścit sātyakerabhavat prabho ॥25॥
7.120.28: babhrāma tatra tatraiva gāvaḥ śītārditā iva,
padātinaṁ rathaṁ nāgaṁ sādinaṁ turagaṁ tathā ॥28॥
7.120.29: na tādr̥k kadanaṁ rājan kr̥tavāṁstatra phālgunaḥ ॥29॥
7.120.31: tato duryodhano rājā sātvatasya tribhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥31॥
7.120.41: tān sarvān sahitān śūrān yatamānān mahārathān ॥41॥
7.120.42: tataḥ sa rathināṁ śreṣṭhastava putrasya sārathim ॥42॥
7.120.43: ājaghānāśu bhallena sa hato nyapatad bhuvi,
7.120.45: vidrutaṁ tatra tat sainyaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bhārata sātyakiḥ ॥45॥
7.120.47: prayayau sātyakī rājan śvetāśvasya rathaṁ prati,
taṁ śarānādadānaṁ ca rakṣamāṇaṁ ca sārathim,
7.120.47d1: taṁ prayāntaṁ mahābāhuṁ tāvakāḥ prekṣya māriṣa,
7.120.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sātyakipraveśe duryodhanapalāyane viṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥120॥
7.121.1: nirhrīkā mama te putrāḥ kimakurvata sañjaya ॥1॥
7.121.3: kiṁ nu vakṣyanti te kṣātraṁ sainyamadhye parājitāḥ,
7.121.4: kathaṁ ca mama putrāṇāṁ jīvatāṁ tatra sañjaya,
7.121.7: ekasya hi na paryāptaṁ yatsainyaṁ tasya sañjaya,
7.121.9: yuyudhāno na śakito hantuṁ yat puruṣarṣabhaḥ ॥9॥
7.121.11: śr̥ṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā yat te vakṣyāmi bhārata ॥11॥
7.121.12: te punaḥ saṁnyavartanta kr̥tvā saṁśaptakān mithaḥ,
parāṁ yuddhe matiṁ krūrāṁ tava putrasya śāsanāt ॥12॥
7.121.20: avadhīcca rathānīkaṁ dviradānāṁ ca tad balam ॥20॥
7.121.21: sādinaścaiva tān sarvān dasyūnapi ca sarvaśaḥ,
7.121.25: añjanasya kule jātā vāmanasya ca bhārata,
7.121.26: jātā dantivarā rājan śerate bahavo hatāḥ ॥26॥
7.121.27: tathā hayavarān rājan nijaghne tatra sātyakiḥ ॥27॥
7.121.32: abhidravata mā bhaiṣṭa na vaḥ prāpsyati sātyakiḥ ॥32॥
7.121.47: tataḥ śabdaḥ samabhavat tava sainyasya māriṣa,
7.121.48: taṁ śabdaṁ tumulaṁ śrutvā droṇo yantāramabravīt,
eṣa sūta raṇe kruddhaḥ sātvatānāṁ mahārathaḥ ॥48॥
7.121.49: dārayan bahudhā sainyaṁ raṇe carati kālavat,
7.121.50: tathā hi rathinaḥ sarve hriyante vidrutairhayaiḥ ॥50॥
7.121.51: na śaknuvanti yantāraḥ saṁyantuṁ tumule hayān ॥51॥
7.121.53: paśya yodhān raṇe bhagnān dhāvato vai tatastataḥ ॥53॥
7.121.54: ime ca saṁhatāḥ śūrāḥ pañcālāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha,
7.121.55: sthāne vā gamane vāpi dūraṁ yātaśca sātyakiḥ ॥55॥
7.121.58: yaistu duḥśāsanaḥ sārdhaṁ rathaiḥ pūrvaṁ nyavartata,
7.121.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sātyakipraveśe ekaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥121॥
7.122.2: kaccit kṣemaṁ tu nr̥pateḥ kaccijjīvati saindhavaḥ ॥2॥
7.122.4: dāsī jitāsi dyūte tvaṁ yathākāmacarī bhava,
vāsasāṁ vāhikā rājño bhrāturjyeṣṭhasya me bhava ॥4॥
7.122.5: na santi patayaḥ sarve te’dya ṣaṇḍhatilaiḥ samā,
7.122.6: svayaṁ vairaṁ mahat kr̥tvā pañcālaiḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha,
7.122.7: na jānīṣe purā tvaṁ tu gr̥hṇannakṣān durodare,
7.122.9: kva te mānaśca darpaśca kya te vīryaṁ kva garjitam,
7.122.10: śocyeyaṁ bhāratī senā rājyaṁ caiva suyodhanaḥ,
7.122.11: nanu nāma tvayā vīra dīryamāṇā bhayārditā,
7.122.12: sa tvamadya raṇaṁ hitvā bhīto harṣayase parān,
7.122.13: ko’nyaḥ sthāsyati saṅgrāme bhīto bhīte vyapāśraye,
7.122.15: yamau vā yudhi draṣṭāsi tadā tvaṁ kiṁ kariṣyasi,
7.122.16: na tulyāḥ sātyakiśarā yeṣāṁ bhītaḥ palāyase,
7.122.19: nāviśanti śarīraṁ te tāvat saṁśāmya pāṇḍavaiḥ,
yāvat te pr̥thivīṁ pārthā hatvā bhrātr̥śataṁ raṇe ॥19॥
7.122.22: sodarāṁste na gr̥hṇāti tāvat saṁśāmya pāṇḍavaiḥ,
7.122.23: ajeyāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ saṅkhye saumya saṁśāmya taiḥ saha,
na ca tat kr̥tavān mandastava bhrātā suyodhanaḥ ॥23॥
7.122.24: sa yuddhe dhr̥timāsthāya yatto yudhyasva pāṇḍavaiḥ,
tavāpi śoṇitaṁ bhīmaḥ pāsyatīti mayā śrutam ॥24॥
7.122.25: kiṁ bhīmasya na jānāsi vikramaṁ tvaṁ subāliśa ॥25॥
7.122.26: gaccha tūrṇaṁ rathenaiva yatra tiṣṭhati sātyakiḥ ॥26॥
7.122.27: tvayā hīnaṁ balaṁ hyetad vidraviṣyati bhārata,
7.122.28: śrutaṁ cāśrutavat kr̥tvā prāyād yena sa sātyakiḥ ॥28॥
7.122.31: praviśya ca raṇe droṇaḥ pāṇḍavānāṁ varūthinīm,
7.122.32: tato droṇo mahārāja nāma viśrāvya saṁyuge,
7.122.35: yada droṇo rabhasaṁ yuddhe pāñcālyaṁ nābhyavartata ॥35॥
7.122.36: saṁniruddhaṁ raṇe droṇaṁ pañcālā bīkṣya māriṣa,
7.122.40: sa bhittvā tu śaro rājan pāñcālakulanandanam,
7.122.43: citraketuḥ sudhanvā ca citravarmā ca bhārata,
7.122.47: tān vimūḍhān raṇe droṇaḥ prahasanniva bhārata ॥47॥
7.122.49: te rathebhyo hatāḥ petuḥ kṣitau rājan suvarcasaḥ ॥49॥
7.122.50: tān nihatya raṇe rājan bhāradvājaḥ pratāpavān ॥50॥
7.122.51d1: tadasya bhrājate rājan meghamadhye taḍid yathā.
7.122.56: niṣasāda rathopasthe kaśmalaṁ ca jagāma ha ॥56॥
7.122.57: taṁ vai tathāgataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaḥ parākramī,
cāpamutyr̥jya śīghraṁ tu asiṁ jagrāha vīryavān ॥57॥
7.122.61: te hi vaitastikā nāma śarā āsannayodhinaḥ ॥61॥
7.122.63: āruhya svarathaṁ vīraḥ pragr̥hya ca mahad dhanuḥ ॥63॥
7.122.69: kṣatriyāśca mahārāja ye cānye tava sainikāḥ,
7.122.70: vaśameṣyati no rājan pañcālā iti cukruśuḥ,
7.122.73: na cainaṁ pāṇḍavā yuddhe jetumutsehire prabho ॥73॥
7.122.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sātyakipraveśe droṇaparākrame dvāviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥122॥
7.123.2: sa viddhvā sātyakiṁ ṣaṣṭyā tathā ṣoḍaśabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.123.3: taṁ tu duḥśāsanaḥ śūraḥ sāyakairāvr̥ṇod bhr̥śam,
7.123.4: parjanya iva ghoṣeṇa nādayan vai diśo daśa ॥4॥
7.123.8: sātyakiṁ ca śatenājau viddhvā nādaṁ mumoca saḥ ॥8॥
7.123.9: rathaṁ sūtaṁ dhvajaṁ taṁ ca cakre’dr̥śyamajihmagaiḥ ॥9॥
7.123.10: sa tu duḥśāsanaṁ śūraṁ sāyakairāvr̥ṇod bhr̥śam,
7.123.13: te tu taṁ rathavaṁśena mahatā paryavārayan ॥13॥
7.123.14: sthirāṁ kr̥tvā matiṁ yuddhe bhūtvā saṁśaptakā mithaḥ,
7.123.22: sa tu taṁ prativivyādha pañcabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥22॥
7.123.26: tāṁ tu śaktiṁ tadā ghorāṁ tava putrasya sātyakiḥ ॥26॥
7.123.28: sātyakiṁ ca śarairviddhvā siṁhanādaṁ nanarda ha,
sātyakistu raṇe kruddho mohayitvā sutaṁ tava ॥28॥
7.123.33: dhvajaṁ ca rathaśaktiṁ ca bhallābhyāṁ paramāstravit,
7.123.36: bhīmasenena tu vadhaḥ sutānāṁ tava bhārata,
7.123.37: tato duḥśāsanaṁ jitvā sātyakiḥ saṁyuge prabho,
jagāma tvarito rājan yena yāto dhanañjayaḥ ॥37॥
7.123.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sātyakipraveśe duḥśāsanaparājaye trayoviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥123॥
7.124.1: kiṁ tasyāṁ mama senāyāṁ nāsan kecinmahārathāḥ,
ye tathā sātyakiṁ yāntaṁ naivāghnan nāpyavārayam ॥1॥
7.124.2: eko hi samare karma kr̥tavān satyavikramaḥ,
7.124.3: athavā śūnyamāsīt tat yena yātaḥ sa sātyakiḥ,
7.124.4: yat kr̥taṁ vr̥ṣṇivīreṇa karma śaṁsasi me raṇe,
7.124.6: na santi tasmāt putrā me yathā sañjaya bhāṣase,
eko vai bahulāḥ senāḥ prāmr̥dnat satyavikramaḥ ॥6॥
7.124.9: nābhūlloke samaḥ kaścit samūha iti me matiḥ ॥9॥
7.124.11: na ca vai tādr̥śo vyūha āsīt kaścid viśāmpate,
7.124.13: tadbale pāṇḍavānāṁ ca sahasrāṇi śatāni ca ॥13॥
7.124.14d2: anyonyaṁ nighnatāṁ caiva narāṇāṁ śuśruve svanaḥ.
7.124.18: te yūyaṁ sahitā bhūtvā tūrṇameva balārṇavam ॥18॥
7.124.19: bhīmasenena te rājan pāñtālyena ca noditāḥ ॥19॥
7.124.21: tathaiva tāvakā rājan prārthayanto mahad yaśaḥ ॥21॥
7.124.26: tathā yāteṣu sainyeṣu tathā kr̥cchragataḥ svayam ॥26॥
7.124.27: kaccid duryodhanaḥ sūta nākārṣīt pr̥ṣṭhato raṇam,
ekasya ca bahūnāṁ ca saṁnipātoṁ mahāhave ॥27॥
7.124.30: ekasya bahubhiḥ sārdhaṁ śr̥ṇuṣva gadato mama,
7.124.31: tatastāṁ prahitāṁ senāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā putreṇa te nr̥pa ॥31॥
7.124.36: tasya tān nighnataḥ śatrūn hemapr̥ṣṭhaṁ mahad dhanuḥ ॥36॥
7.124.39: varma cāśu samāsādya te bhittvā kṣitimāviśan,
7.124.40: yathā vr̥travadhe devāḥ purā śakraṁ maharṣayaḥ,
7.124.42: tān droṇaḥ pratijagrāha parīpsan yudhi pāṇḍavam ॥42॥
7.124.47: kruddhe’rjune tathā droṇe sātvate ca mahārathe ॥47॥
7.124.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sātyakipraveśe saṅkulayuddhe caturviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥124॥
7.125.4: varān varān hi yodhānāṁ vicinvanniva bhārata,
7.125.7: preṣayāmāsa saṅkruddhaḥ sāyakān daśa pañca ca ॥7॥
7.125.11: br̥hatkṣatreṇa tat karma kr̥taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā suduṣkaram ॥11॥
7.125.15: taṁ droṇo dvipadāṁ śreṣṭho nārācena samārpayat,
sa tasya kavacaṁ bhittvā prāviśad dharaṇītalam ॥15॥
7.125.21: dvābhyāṁ dhvajaṁ ca cchatraṁ ca cchitvā bhūmāvapātayat ॥21॥
7.125.24: vinighnan kekayān sarvān pañcālānāṁ ca vāhinīm ॥24॥
7.125.25: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā sārathī rathināṁ varam,
7.125.28: tasya droṇo dhanurmadhye kṣurapreṇa śitena ca,
7.125.30: tasya droṇo hayān hatvā caturbhiścaturaḥ śaraiḥ,
7.125.35: tomaraṁ vyasr̥jad vīraḥ śaktiṁ ca kanakojjvalām ॥35॥
7.125.38: sa tasya kavacaṁ bhittvā hr̥dayaṁ cāmitaujasaḥ,
abhyagād dharaṇīṁ bāṇo haṁsaḥ padmavanaṁ yathā ॥38॥
7.125.39: pataṅgaṁ hi graseccāṣo yathā kṣudraṁ bubhukṣitaḥ,
7.125.40: nihate cedirāje tu tat khaṇḍaṁ pitryamāviśat,
7.125.45: chādayitvā raṇe droṇo rathasthaṁ rathināṁ varam,
7.125.46: yo yaḥ sma nīyate tatra taṁ droṇo hyantakopamaḥ,
7.125.47: tato droṇo mahārāja nāma viśrāvya saṁyuge,
7.125.48: te tu nāmāṅkitā bāṇā droṇenāstāḥ śilāśitāḥ,
narān nāgān hayāṁścaiva nijaghnuḥ śataśo mr̥dhe ॥48॥
7.125.54: ghnata droṇaṁ ghnata droṇamiti te droṇamabhyayuḥ ॥54॥
7.125.55: ninīṣavo raṇe droṇaṁ yamasya sadanaṁ prati ॥55॥
7.125.58: prākrośan bhīmasenaṁ te dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca bhārata,
7.125.59: brāhmaṇena tapo nūnaṁ caritaṁ duścaraṁ mahat,
tathā hi yudhi saṅkruddho dahati kṣatriyarṣabhān ॥59॥
7.125.60: dharmo yuddhaṁ kṣatriyasya brāhmaṇasya paraṁ tapaḥ,
7.125.62: mohayan sarvabhūtāni doṇo hanti balāni naḥ ॥62॥
7.125.63: teṣāṁ tad vacanaṁ śrutvā kṣatradharmā vyavasthitaḥ,
7.125.70: tasya sūte hate te’śvā rathamādāya vidrutāḥ ॥70॥
7.125.76: kr̥cchrān duryodhano lokān pāpaḥ prāpsyati durmatiḥ,
7.125.77: śataśaḥ śerate bhūmau nikr̥ttā govr̥ṣā iva,
7.125.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi droṇaparākrame pañcaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥125॥
7.126.5: yudhiṣṭhiroṁ dadarśātha naiva pārthaṁ na mādhavam ॥5॥
7.126.7: apaśyan sātyakiṁ cāpi vr̥ṣṇīnāṁ pravaraṁ ratham,
7.126.10: tadidaṁ hyekamevāsīd dvidhā jātaṁ mamādya vai ॥10॥
7.126.17: praviṣṭo bhāratīṁ senāṁ makaraḥ sāgaraṁ yathā ॥17॥
7.126.20: gamanaṁ rocate mahyaṁ yatra yātau mahārathau,
na cāpyasahyaṁ bhīmasya vidyate bhuvi kiñcana ॥20॥
7.126.21: śakto hyeṣa raṇe yattaḥ pr̥thivyāṁ sarvadhanvinām,
7.126.22: vanavāsānnivr̥ttāḥ sma na ca yuddheṣu nirjitāḥ ॥22॥
7.126.23: ito gate bhīmasene sātvataṁ prati pāṇḍave,
7.126.26: tataḥ pratikr̥taṁ manye vidhānaṁ sātyakiṁ prati,
7.126.27: yantāramabravīd rājā bhīmaṁ prati nayasva mām,
7.126.29: kaśmalaṁ prāviśad rājā bahu tatra samādiśan,
7.126.31: tasya lakṣma na paśyāmi bhīmasenānujasya te,
7.126.33: uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha rājendra śādhi kiṁ karavāṇi te,
na hyasādhyamakāryaṁ vā vidyate mama mānada ॥33॥
7.126.34: ājñāpaya kuruśreṣṭha mā ca śoke manaḥ kr̥thāḥ,
7.126.36: nūnamadya hataḥ śete tava bhrātā dhanañjayaḥ ॥36॥
7.126.39: tasya vai gamanaṁ vidmo bhīma nāvartanaṁ punaḥ,
7.126.42: tasya lakṣma na paśyāmi tena vindāmi kaśmalam ॥42॥
7.126.43: taṁ viddhi puruṣavyāghraṁ sātvataṁ ca mahāratham,
7.126.44: pārthe tasmin hate caiva yudhyate nūnamagraṇīḥ ॥44॥
7.126.45: sahāyonāsya vai kaścit tena vindāmi kaśmalam,
tasmin kr̥ṣṇo hate nūnaṁ yudhyate yuddhakovidaḥ ॥45॥
7.126.46: na hi me śudhyate bhāvastayoreva parantapa,
sa tatra gaccha kaunteya yatra yāto dhanañjayaḥ ॥46॥
7.126.47: vacanaṁ mama dharmajña bhrātā jyeṣṭho bhavāmi te ॥47॥
7.126.49: dr̥ṣṭvā kuśalinau kr̥ṣṇau sātvataṁ caiva sātyakim,
7.126.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhiracintāyāṁ ṣaḍviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥126॥
7.127.1: tamāsthāya gatau kr̥ṣṇau na tayorvidyate bhayam ॥1॥
7.127.2: ājñāṁ tu śirasā bibhradeṣa gacchāmi mā śucaḥ,
7.127.4: viditaṁ te mahābāho yathā droṇo mahārathaḥ ॥4॥
7.127.5: na ca me gamane kr̥tyaṁ tādr̥k pārṣata vidyate ॥5॥
7.127.6: yādr̥śaṁ rakṣaṇe rājñaḥ kāryamātyayikaṁ hi naḥ,
7.127.7: prayāsye tatra yatrāsau mumūrṣuḥ saindhavaḥ sthitaḥ,
7.127.8: yāsyāmi padavīṁ bhrātuḥ sātvatasya ca dhīmataḥ,
so’dya yatto raṇe pārthaṁ parirakṣa yudhiṣṭhiram ॥8॥
7.127.11: tato nikṣipya rājānaṁ dhr̥ṣṭadyumne ca pāṇḍavam ॥11॥
7.127.12: abhivādya guruṁ jyeṣṭhaṁ prayayau yena phālgunaḥ,
7.127.19: prayāte bhīmasene tu tava sainyaṁ yuyutsayā ॥19॥
7.127.20: taṁ śrutvā ninadaṁ ghoraṁ trailokyatrāsanaṁ mahat ॥20॥
7.127.24: draupadī ca subhadrā ca paśyantyau saha bandhubhiḥ,
sa bhīma tvarayā yukto yāhi yatra dhanañjayaḥ ॥24॥
7.127.25: diśaśca pradiśaḥ pārtha sātvatasya ca kāraṇāt ॥25॥
7.127.27: jyeṣṭhena prahito bhrātrā bhrātā bhrātuḥ priyaṅkaraḥ ॥27॥
7.127.28: āhatya dundubhiṁ bhīmaḥ śaṅkhaṁ pradhmāpya cāsakr̥t,
vinadya siṁhanādena jyāṁ vikarṣan punaḥ punaḥ ॥28॥
7.127.31: ārujan virujan pārtho jyāṁ vikarṣaṁśca pāṇinā,
7.127.37: taiḥ samantād vr̥taḥ śūraiḥ samareṣu mahārathaḥ,
tān samīkṣya tu kaunteyo bhīmasenaḥ parākramī,
7.127.38: te mahāstrāṇi divyāni tatra vīrā adarśayan,
7.127.41: prādravan dviradāḥ sarve nadanto bhairavān ravān ॥41॥
7.127.46: yadi te so’nujaḥ kr̥ṣṇaḥ praviṣṭo’numate mama,
anīkaṁ na tu śakyaṁ me praveṣṭumiha vai tvayā ॥46॥
7.127.48: praviṣṭaḥ sa hi durdharṣaḥ śakrasyāpi viśed balam ॥48॥
7.127.49: tena vai paramāṁ pūjāṁ kurvatā mānito hyasi,
nārjuno’haṁ ghr̥ṇī droṇa bhīmaseno’smi te ripuḥ ॥49॥
7.127.50: pitā nastvaṁ gururbandhustathā putrāstu te vayam,
iti manyāmahe sarve bhavantaṁ praṇatāḥ sthitāḥ ॥50॥
7.127.52: eṣa te sadr̥śaṁ śatroḥ karma bhīmaḥ karomyaham,
7.127.54: taṁ punaḥ parivavruste tava putrā rathottamam ॥54॥
7.127.55: anyaṁ tu rathamāsthāya droṇaḥ praharatāṁ varaḥ,
7.127.57: te vadhyamānāḥ samare tava putrā mahārathāḥ,
7.127.66: vindānuvindau sahitau suvarmāṇaṁ ca te sutam,
7.127.67: tataḥ sudarśanaṁ vīraṁ putraṁ te bharatarṣabha,
vivyādha samare tūrṇaṁ sa papāta mamāra ca ॥67॥
7.127.69: tato vai rathaghoṣeṇa garjitena mr̥gā iva,
7.127.70: anuyāyācca kaunteyaḥ putrāṇāṁ te mahad balam ॥70॥
7.127.73: talaśabdaṁ ca sumahat kr̥tvā bhīmo mahābalaḥ ॥73॥
7.127.74: bhīṣayitvā rathānīkaṁ hatvā yodhān varān varān,
7.127.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi bhīmasenapraveśe bhīmaparākrame saptaviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥127॥
7.128.4: sa taistu saṁvr̥to bhīmaḥ prahasanniva bhārata,
udyacchan sa gadāṁ tebhyaḥ sughorāṁ siṁhavannadan,
7.128.6: jvalantī tejasā bhīmā trāsayāmāsa te sutān ॥6॥
7.128.8: taṁ ca śabdamasahyaṁ vai tasyāḥ saṁlakṣya māriṣa,
7.128.9: prādravanta raṇe bhītā vyāghraghrātā mr̥gā iva ॥9॥
7.128.10: sa tān vidrāvya kaunteyaḥ saṅkhye’mitrān durāsadān,
7.128.12: bhīmaṁ tu samare droṇo vārayitvā śarormibhiḥ,
7.128.13: droṇasya ca mahārāja bhīmasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥13॥
7.128.16: aṁse śiro bhīmasenaḥ karau kr̥tvorasi sthirau,
7.128.17: yathā hi govr̥ṣo varṣaṁ pratigr̥hṇāti līlayā,
7.128.18: sa vadhyamānaḥ samare rathaṁ droṇasya māriṣa,
7.128.19: droṇastu satvaro rājan kṣipto bhīmena saṁyuge,
7.128.20: tamāyāntaṁ tathā dr̥ṣṭvā bhagnotsāhaṁ guruṁ tadā,
gatvā vegāt punarbhīmo dhuraṁ guhya rathasya tu ॥20॥
7.128.29: rathena yattaḥ kaunteyo vegena prayayau tadā ॥29॥
7.128.33: taṁ tasya ninadaṁ ghoraṁ pārthaḥ śuśrāva nardataḥ,
7.128.34: tau śrutvā yugapad vīrau ninadaṁ tasya śuṣmiṇaḥ,
7.128.35: tataḥ pārtho mahānādaṁ muñcan vai mādhavaśca ha,
7.128.37: viśokaścābhavad rājā śrutvā taṁ ninadaṁ tayoḥ,
7.128.38: tathā tu nardamāne vai bhīmasene madotkaṭe,
7.128.39: hr̥dgataṁ manasā prāha dhyātvā dharmabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ,
dattā bhīma tvayā saṁvit kr̥taṁ guruvacastathā ॥39॥
7.128.40: na hi teṣāṁ jayo yuddhe yeṣāṁ dveṣṭāsi pāṇḍava,
7.128.41: diṣṭyā ca kuśalī vīraḥ sātyakiḥ satyavikramaḥ,
7.128.42: yena śakraṁ raṇe jitvā tarpito havyavāhanaḥ,
sa hantā dviṣatāṁ saṅkhye diṣṭyā jīvati phālgunaḥ ॥42॥
7.128.43: sa hantā ripusainyānāṁ diṣṭyā jīvati phālgunaḥ ॥43॥
7.128.44: nirjitā dhunuṣaikena diṣṭyā pārthaḥ sa jīvati ॥44॥
7.128.46: yo’vadhīd bhujavīryeṇa diṣṭyā pārthaḥ sa jīvati ॥46॥
7.128.47: jitavān yo’stravīryeṇa diṣṭyā pārthaḥ sa jīvati ॥47॥
7.128.48: mama priyaśca satataṁ diṣṭyā pārthaḥ sa jīvati ॥48॥
7.128.50: kaccit sa saindhavaṁ saṅkhye haniṣyati dhanañjayaḥ,
7.128.55: kaccid bhīṣmeṇa no vairaṁ śamamekena yāsyati,
7.128.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi bhīmasenapraveśe yudhiṣṭhiraharṣe aṣṭāviṁśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥128॥
7.129.1: ninadantaṁ tathā taṁ tu bhīmasenaṁ mahābalam,
7.129.2: na hi paśyāmyahaṁ taṁ vai triṣu lokeṣu kañcana,
7.129.3: na hi paśyāmyahaṁ yuddhe yastiṣṭhedagrataḥ pumān ॥3॥
7.129.4: rathaṁ rathena yo hanyāt kuñjaraṁ kuñjareṇa ca,
7.129.7: kālyamānāṁstu putrān me dr̥ṣṭvā bhīmena saṁyuge,
kāleneva prajāḥ sarvāḥ ke bhīmaṁ paryavārayan ॥7॥
7.129.8: na me’rjunād bhayaṁ tādr̥k kr̥ṣṇānnāpi ca sātvatāt,
7.129.10: tathā tu nardamānaṁ taṁ bhīmasenaṁ mahābalam,
7.129.12: bhīmo’pi dr̥ṣṭvā sāvegaṁ puro vaikartanaṁ sthitam ॥12॥
7.129.15: rathināṁ sādināṁ caiva tayoḥ śrutvā talasvanam,
7.129.16: khaṁ ca bhūmiṁ ca saṁruddhāṁ menire kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ,
7.129.26: athānyad dhanurādāya sajyaṁ kr̥tvā ca sūtajaḥ,
7.129.27: tasya bhīmo bhr̥śaṁ kruddhastrīn śarān nataparvaṇaḥ,
7.129.33: hatāśvāt tu rathāt karṇaḥ samāplutya viśāmpate,
7.129.34: nirjitya tu raṇe karṇaṁ bhīmasenaḥ pratāpavān,
7.129.35: tasya taṁ ninadaṁ śrutvā prahr̥ṣṭo’bhūd yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
7.129.39: mr̥dupūrvaṁ tu rādheyo dr̥ḍhapūrvaṁ tu pāṇḍavaḥ ॥39॥
7.129.39d1: dr̥ṣṭvā karṇaṁ ca pārthena bādhitaṁ bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.129.39d2: karṇaṁ kr̥cchragataṁ paśya śīghraṁ yānaṁ prayaccha ha,
tau pārthaḥ sahasā gatvā vivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.129.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi bhīmapraveśe karṇaparājaye ekonatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥129॥
7.130.2: sa rathastava putrasya tvarayā parayā yutaḥ ॥2॥
7.130.6: yadi tāvad raṇe pārtho vyatikrānto mahārathaḥ ॥6॥
7.130.9: kathaṁ droṇo jitaḥ saṅkhye dhanurvedasya pāragaḥ,
7.130.10: nāśa eva tu me nūnaṁ mandabhāgyasya saṁyuge,
7.130.11: evaṁ gate tu kr̥tye’smin brūhi yat te vivakṣitam,
yad gataṁ gatamevedaṁ śeṣaṁ cintaya mānada ॥11॥
7.130.12: tat saṁvidhīyatāṁ kṣipraṁ sādhu sañcintya no dvija ॥12॥
7.130.13: cintyaṁ bahuvidhaṁ tāta yat kr̥tyaṁ tacchr̥ṇuṣva me,
7.130.14: yāvat teṣāṁ bhayaṁ paścāt tāvadeṣāṁ puraḥsaram,
7.130.15: sā purastācca paścācca gr̥hītā bhāratī camūḥ,
7.130.16: sa no rakṣyatamastāta kruddhād bhīto dhanañjayāt,
7.130.17: na sabhāyāṁ jayo vr̥tto nāpi tatra parājayaḥ ॥17॥
7.130.18: yān sma tān glahate ghorān śakuniḥ kurusaṁsadi ॥18॥
7.130.19: akṣān sa manyamānaḥ prāk śarāste hi durāsadāḥ,
7.130.20: glahaṁ ca saindhavaṁ rājaṁstatra dyūtasya niścayaḥ ॥20॥
7.130.21: saindhave tu mahad dyūtaṁ samāsaktaṁ paraiḥ saha,
7.130.23: yatra te parameṣvāsā yattā rakṣanti saindhavam,
tatra gaccha svayaṁ śīghraṁ tāṁśca rakṣatva rakṣiṇaḥ ॥23॥
7.130.27: yau tu pūrvaṁ mahārāja vāritau kr̥tavarmaṇā,
7.130.28: pārśve bhittvā camūṁ vīrau praviṣṭau tava vāhinīm,
7.130.38: sa rathaṁ prāpya taṁ bhrāturduryodhanahayān śaraiḥ,
7.130.42: tataḥ sa hemacitraṁ taṁ gadayā syandanaṁ gadī,
7.130.43: bhaṅktvā rathaṁ sa putraste hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ,
7.130.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi duryodhanayuddhe triṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥130॥
7.131.2: yathā nāgo vane nāgaṁ matto mattamabhidravan ॥2॥
7.131.3: yau tau karṇaśca bhīmaśca samprayuddhau mahābalau,
7.131.4: pūrvaṁ hi nirjitaḥ karṇo bhīmasenena saṁyuge,
7.131.5: bhīmo vā sūtatanayaṁ pratyudyātaḥ kathaṁ raṇe,
7.131.7: bhayād yasya mahābāhorna śete bahulāḥ samāḥ,
7.131.8: kathaṁ karṇaṁ yudhāṁ śreṣṭhaṁ yodhayāmāsa pāṇḍavaḥ ॥8॥
7.131.10: bhrātr̥tvaṁ darśitaṁ pūrvaṁ ghr̥ṇī cāpi sa sūtajaḥ,
7.131.11: bhīmo vā sūtaputreṇa smaran vairaṁ purā kr̥tam,
ayudhyata kathaṁ śūraḥ karṇena saha saṁyuge ॥11॥
7.131.12: āśāste ca sadā sūta putro duryodhano mama,
7.131.13: jayāśā yatra putrasya mama mandasya saṁyuge,
7.131.14: yaṁ samāsādya putrairme kr̥taṁ vairaṁ mahārathaiḥ,
taṁ sūtatanayaṁ tāta kathaṁ bhīmo hyayodhayat ॥14॥
7.131.16: taṁ sūtatanayaṁ yuddhe kathaṁ bhīmo hyayodhayat ॥16॥
7.131.17: yo jātaḥ kuṇḍalābhyāṁ ca kavacena sahaiva ca,
7.131.34: hayān vivyādha bhīmasya pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥34॥
7.131.39: bibhrad bhīmo mahārāja na jagāma vyathāṁ raṇe ॥39॥
7.131.44: nipetuḥ sarvato vīre kūjanta iva pakṣiṇaḥ ॥44॥
7.131.49: tatra bhārata bhīmaṁ tu dr̥ṣṭavantaḥ sma sāyakaiḥ,
7.131.52: tattu bhīmo mahābāhoḥ karṇasya caritaṁ raṇe,
7.131.56: jaghāna caturaścāśvān sūtaṁ ca tvaritaḥ śaraiḥ,
7.131.58: sa vaiklavyaṁ mahat prāpya chinnadhanvā śarāhataḥ,
7.131.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi karṇaparājaye ekatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥131॥
7.132.2: kuntīputreṇa bhīmena nirjitaḥ sa tu līlayā ॥2॥
7.132.3: yasmin jayāśā mahatī putrāṇāṁ mama sañjaya,
taṁ bhīmād vimukhaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kiṁ nu duryodhano’bravīt ॥3॥
7.132.4: kathaṁ ca yuyudhe bhīmo vīryaślāghī mahābalaḥ,
karṇo vā samare tāta kimakārṣīt tataḥ param,
7.132.7: cāpaśabdaṁ tataḥ kr̥tvā talaśabdaṁ ca bhairavam,
7.132.8: punareva tayo rājan ghora āsīt samāgamaḥ,
7.132.12: tato bhīmaḥ smaran kleśānakṣadyūte vane’pi ca,
7.132.13: satataṁ ca parikleśān saputreṇa tvayā kr̥tān ॥13॥
7.132.19: tr̥ṇīkr̥tya yathā pārthāṁstava putro vavalga ha,
7.132.20: bālyāt prabhr̥ti cārighnaḥ svāni duḥkhāni cintayan,
7.132.26: karṇaḥ pratyudyayau yuddhe matto mattamiva dvipam ॥26॥
7.132.29: vyāmiśrayad raṇe karṇaḥ pāṇḍavaṁ chādayan śaraiḥ ॥29॥
7.132.42: kr̥to rājan mahārāja putrāṇāṁ te janakṣayaḥ ॥42॥
7.132.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi bhīmakarṇayuddhe dvātriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥132॥
7.133.3: sa kathaṁ pāṇḍavaṁ yuddhe bhrājamānamiva śriyā,
7.133.4: kathaṁ ca yuddhaṁ sambhūtaṁ tayoḥ prāṇadurodare,
atra manye samāyatto jayo vājaya eva ca ॥4॥
7.133.5: karṇaṁ prāpya raṇe sūta mama putraḥ suyodhanaḥ,
7.133.7: vinaṣṭān kauravān manye mama putrasya durnayaiḥ,
na hi karṇo maheṣvāsān pārthān jeṣyati sañjaya ॥7॥
7.133.8: kr̥tavān yāni yuddhāni karṇaḥ pāṇḍusutaiḥ saha,
7.133.9: na ca tad budhyate mandaḥ putro duryodhano mama ॥9॥
7.133.10: dhanaṁ dhaneśvarasyeva hr̥tvā pārthasya me sutaḥ,
7.133.13: aśakta iti matvā tu mama putrairnirākr̥taḥ ॥13॥
7.133.15: tasmānme sañjaya brūhi karṇabhīmau yathā raṇe,
7.133.20: sa kāṅkṣan bhīmasenasya vadhaṁ vaikartano bhr̥śam,
7.133.21: samutkṣipya ca rādheyaḥ sandhāya ca mahābalaḥ ॥21॥
7.133.23: taṁ ca nādaṁ tataḥ śrutvā putrāste harṣitā’bhavan ॥23॥
7.133.29: chittvā bhīmo mahārāja nādaṁ siṁha ivānadat,
7.133.34: tasya bhīmaḥ punaścāpaṁ muṣṭau ciccheda māriṣa ॥34॥
7.133.37: tathā kr̥cchragataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā karṇaṁ duryodhano nr̥paḥ ॥37॥
7.133.38: gaccha durjaya rādheyaṁ puro grasati pāṇḍavaḥ ॥38॥
7.133.41: ṣaḍbhiḥ sūtaṁ tribhiḥ ketuṁ punastaṁ cāpi saptabhiḥ,
7.133.43: sa tu taṁ virathaṁ kr̥tvā smayannatyantavairiṇam ॥43॥
7.133.45: na jahau samare bhīmaṁ kruddharūpaṁ parantapaḥ ॥45॥
7.133.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi karṇabhīmayuddhe trayastriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥133॥
7.134.5: karṇaṁ tu navabhirbhīmo bhittvā rājan stanāntare,
7.134.15: viratho rathināṁ śreṣṭho vārayāmāsa yad ripum,
7.134.24: dīrghamuṣṇaṁ śvasan vīro na kiñcit pratyapadyata,
7.134.25: te tasya kavacaṁ bhittvā svarṇacitraṁ mahaujasaḥ ॥25॥
7.134.29: te bhīmasenasya bhujaṁ savyaṁ nirbhidya patriṇaḥ ॥29॥
7.134.30: prāviśan medinīṁ bhīmāḥ krīñcaṁ patrarathā iva,
7.134.32: susrāva rudhiraṁ bhūri parvataḥ salilaṁ yathā,
7.134.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi karṇāpayāne catustriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥134॥
7.135.2: na ca karṇasamaṁ yodhaṁ loke paśyāmi kañcana ॥2॥
7.135.3: karṇo hi balavān śūro dr̥ḍhadhanvā jitaklamaḥ ॥3॥
7.135.4: iti māmabravīt sūta mando duryodhanaḥ purā,
7.135.5: kiṁ nu pāṇḍusutā rājan gatasattvā vicetasaḥ,
tatra taṁ nirjitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bhujaṅgamiva nirviṣam ॥5॥
7.135.8: na śaktāḥ pramukhe sthātuṁ nūnaṁ bhīmasya sañjaya,
7.135.12: na sa pāṇḍusuto jetuṁ śakyaḥ kenacidāhave,
droṇaṁ yaḥ sampramathyaikaḥ praviṣṭo mama vāhinīm ॥12॥
7.135.16: yat tat sabhāyāṁ bhīmena mama putravadhāśrayam ॥16॥
7.135.19: karṇo duḥśāsano’haṁ ca jeṣyāmo yudhi pāṇḍavān,
sa nūnaṁ virathaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā karṇaṁ bhīmena nirjitam ॥19॥
7.135.20: dr̥ṣṭvā bhrātr̥̄n hatān saṅkhye bhīmasenena daṁśitān ॥20॥
7.135.21: ko hi jīvitamanvicchan pratīpaṁ pāṇḍavaṁ vrajet ॥21॥
7.135.22: bhīmaṁ bhīmāyudhaṁ kruddhaṁ sākṣāt kālamiva sthitam,
7.135.23: na pārthā na ca pañcālā na ca keśavasātyakī ॥23॥
7.135.24: aho mama sutānāṁ hi vipannaṁ sūta jīvitam ॥24॥
7.135.25: tvamasya jagato mūlaṁ vināśasya na saṁśayaḥ ॥25॥
7.135.26: svayaṁ vairaṁ mahat kr̥tvā putrāṇāṁ vacane sthitaḥ,
7.135.28: yat tu kutsayase yodhān yudhyamānān mahābalān,
7.135.34: taṁ tu bhīmo’bhyayāt tūrṇaṁ vāryamāṇaḥ sutaistava ॥34॥
7.135.36: tān bāṇaiḥ pañcaviṁśatyā sāśvān rājan nararṣabhān,
7.135.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi bhīmasenaparākrame pañcatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāya ॥135॥
7.136.2: yatpratyakṣaṁ tava sutā bhīmena nihatā raṇe ॥2॥
7.136.8: tasya bhīmo hayān hatvā vinihatya ca sārathim,
7.136.10: gadāṁ gr̥hītvā samare bhīmāya prāhiṇod ruṣā ॥10॥
7.136.16: te tasya kavacaṁ bhittvā tathā bāhuṁ ca dakṣiṇam,
7.136.19: tvaradhvaṁ sarvato yattā rādheyasya rathaṁ prati,
tatastava sutā rājan śrutvā bhrāturvaco drutam ॥19॥
7.136.22: te hatā nyapatan bhūmau vātarugṇā iva drumāḥ ॥22॥
7.136.23: aśrupūrṇamukhaḥ karṇaḥ kṣattuḥ sasmāra tad vacaḥ ॥23॥
7.136.24: rathaṁ cānyaṁ samāsthāya vidhivat kalpitaṁ punaḥ,
7.136.39: sa nandayan raṇe pārthaṁ keśavaṁ ca yaśasvinam,
7.136.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi bhīmayuddhe ṣaṭtriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥136॥
7.137.11: tasya vegamasahyaṁ sa dr̥ṣṭvā karṇasya pāṇḍavaḥ,
7.137.13: yathaiva hi sa karṇena pārthaḥ pracchāditaḥ śaraiḥ,
tathaiva sa raṇe karṇaṁ chādayāmāsa pāṇḍavaḥ ॥13॥
7.137.14: dr̥ṣṭvā tu bhīmasenasya vikramaṁ yudhi bhārata,
7.137.18: karṇaṁ gacchata bhadraṁ vaḥ parīpsanto vr̥kodarāt ॥18॥
7.137.22: prajāsaṁharaṇe rājan somaṁ sapta grahā iva ॥22॥
7.137.26: te kṣiptā bhīmasenena śarā bhārata bhāratān,
7.137.32: vikarṇa tenāsi hataḥ pratijñā rakṣitā mayā ॥32॥
7.137.33: tato vinihataḥ saṅkhye yuddhadharmo hi niṣṭhuraḥ ॥33॥
7.137.35: tyājitaḥ samare prāṇāṁstasmād yuddhaṁ hi niṣṭhuram ॥35॥
7.137.37: ācakhyāviva tad yuddhaṁ vijayaṁ cātmano mahat ॥37॥
7.137.38: taṁ śrutvā tu mahānādaṁ bhīmasenasya dhanvinaḥ,
7.137.41: hatān duryodhano dr̥ṣṭvā kṣattuḥ sasmāra tad vacaḥ ॥41॥
7.137.42: iti sañcintya te putro nottaraṁ pratyapadyata ॥42॥
7.137.44: yacca karṇo’bravīt kr̥ṣṇāṁ sabhāyāṁ paruṣaṁ vacaḥ,
7.137.45: vinaṣṭāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kr̥ṣṇe śāśvataṁ narakaṁ gatāḥ ॥45॥
7.137.47: taṁ bhīmasenaḥ krodhāgniṁ trayodaśa samāḥ sthitam,
7.137.48: vilapaṁśca bahu kṣattā śamaṁ nālabhata tvayi,
7.137.49: na kr̥taṁ suhr̥dāṁ vākyaṁ daivamatra parāyaṇam ॥49॥
7.137.52: putrāṁstava mahārāja tvarayā tān jaghāna ha ॥52॥
7.137.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi bhīmayuddhe saptatriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥137॥
7.138.2: yad gataṁ tad gatamiti mamāsīnmanasi sthitam,
7.138.9: vāraṇaiḥ patitai rājan vājibhiśca naraiḥ saha,
7.138.12: utsr̥jya bhīmakarṇau ca sarvato vyadravan diśaḥ ॥12॥
7.138.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi bhīmakarṇayuddhe aṣṭātriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥138॥
7.139.1: tataḥ karṇo mahārāja bhīmaṁ viddhvā tribhiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.139.3: sa karṇaṁ karṇinā karṇe pītena niśitena ca,
7.139.6: punarasya tvaran bhīmo nārācān daśa bhārata,
7.139.8: nīlotpalamayīṁ mālāṁ dhārayan vai yathā purā ॥8॥
7.139.10: sa muhūrtāt punaḥ sañjñāṁ lebhe karṇaḥ parantapaḥ,
7.139.11: tataḥ kruddho raṇe karṇaḥ pīḍito dr̥ḍhadhanvanā,
7.139.20: tr̥tīyaṁ ca caturthaṁ ca pañcamaṁ ṣaṣṭhameva hi,
saptamaṁ cāṣṭamaṁ caiva navamaṁ daśamaṁ tathā ॥20॥
7.139.26: bhīmaṁ praikṣata rādheyo ghoraṁ ghoreṇa cakṣuṣā,
7.139.29: karṣato muñcato bāṇān nāntaraṁ dadr̥śe raṇe,
7.139.38: tatra bhārata bhīmasya balaṁ vīryaṁ parākramam ॥38॥
7.139.45: na sma sūryastadā bhāti na sma vāti samīraṇaḥ ॥45॥
7.139.46: sa bhīmaṁ chādayan bāṇaiḥ sūtaputraḥ pr̥thagvidhaiḥ ॥46॥
7.139.58: tāvadbhiratha tān bhīmo vyomni ciccheda patribhiḥ,
7.139.60: tribhiḥ śaraiḥ śaraṁ rājan pāṇḍavasya pratāpavān ॥60॥
7.139.64: so’pasr̥tya drutaṁ sūto yudhāmanyo rathaṁ yayau,
7.139.65: dhvajaṁ ciccheda rādheyaḥ patākāṁ ca vyapātayat,
7.139.67: sāpatad daśadhā chinnā karṇasya niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥67॥
7.139.71: sa dhanuḥ sūtaputrasya sajyaṁ chittvā mahānasiḥ ॥71॥
7.139.72: papāta bhuvi rājendra kruddhaḥ sarpa ivāmbarāt,
7.139.75: sa tasya caritaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā saṅgrāme vijayaiṣiṇaḥ ॥75॥
7.139.76: taṁ ca dr̥ṣṭvā rathopasthe nilīnaṁ vyathitendriyam ॥76॥
7.139.78: yadiyeṣa rathāt karṇaṁ hartuṁ tārkṣya ivoragam,
7.139.86: tamasya viśikhaiḥ karṇo vyadhamat kuñjaraṁ punaḥ ॥86॥
7.139.87: cakrāṇyaśvāṁstathā cānyad yad yat paśyati bhūtale ॥87॥
7.139.88: tat tadādāya cikṣepa kruddhaḥ karṇāya pāṇḍavaḥ,
tadasya sarvaṁ ciccheda kṣiptaṁ kṣiptaṁ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥88॥
7.139.90: rakṣamāṇaḥ pratijñāṁ tāṁ yā kr̥tā savyasācinā ॥90॥
7.139.91: tamevaṁ vyākulaṁ bhīmaṁ bhūyo bhūyaḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.139.92: vyāyudhaṁ nāvadhīccainaṁ karṇaḥ kuntyā vacaḥ smaran,
7.139.93: dhanuṣā spr̥ṣṭamātreṇa kruddhaḥ sarpa iva śvasan,
7.139.96: yatra bhojyaṁ bahuvidhaṁ bhakṣyaṁ peyaṁ ca pāṇḍava,
tatra tvaṁ durmate yogyo na yuddheṣu kadācana ॥96॥
7.139.97: ucitastvaṁ vane bhīma na tvaṁ yuddhaviśāradaḥ ॥97॥
7.139.98: kva yuddhaṁ kva munitvaṁ ca vanaṁ gaccha vr̥kodara,
7.139.99: sūdān bhr̥tyajanān dāsāṁstvaṁ gr̥he tvarayan bhr̥śam,
7.139.100: vanāya vraja kaunteya na tvaṁ yuddhaviśāradaḥ ॥100॥
7.139.101: na tvāṁ śastrasamudyoge yogyaṁ manye vr̥kodara ॥101॥
7.139.104: yoddhavyaṁ māriṣānyatra na yoddhavyaṁ ca mādr̥śaiḥ,
7.139.105: gaccha vā yatra tau kr̥ṣṇau tau tvāṁ rakṣiṣyato raṇe,
gr̥haṁ vā gaccha kaunteya kiṁ te yuddhena bālaka ॥105॥
7.139.106: uvāca karṇaṁ prahasan sarveṣāṁ śr̥ṇvatāṁ vacaḥ ॥106॥
7.139.110: evaṁ taṁ virathaṁ kr̥tvā karṇo rājan vyakatthayat ॥110॥
7.139.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi bhīmakarṇayuddhe ekonacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥139॥
7.140.1: ahanyahani me dīptaṁ yaśaḥ patati sañjaya,
hatā me bahavo yodhā manye kālasya paryayam ॥1॥
7.140.6: yuddhaṁ tu tad yathāvr̥ttaṁ tanmamācakṣva tattvataḥ ॥6॥
7.140.8: tasya me vr̥ṣṇivīrasya brūhi yuddhaṁ yathātatham,
7.140.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi alambuṣavadhe catvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥140॥
7.141.6: pratīcyāṁ diśi taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā prācyāṁ paśyāmi lāghavāt ॥6॥
7.141.14: eṣa śiṣyaḥ sakhā caiva tava satyaparākramaḥ,
7.141.16: eṣa droṇaṁ tathā bhojaṁ kr̥tavarmāṇameva ca,
7.141.21: yasya nāsti samo yodhaḥ kauraveṣu kathañcana,
7.141.22: kurusainyād vimukto vai siṁho madhyād gavāmiva,
7.141.24: eṣa duryodhanaṁ jitvā bhrātr̥bhiḥ sahitaṁ raṇe,
7.141.26: na me priyaṁ mahābāho yanmāmabhyeti sātyakiḥ ॥26॥
7.141.27: na hi jānāmi vr̥ttāntaṁ dharmarājasya keśava,
sātvatena vihīnaḥ sa yadi jīvati vā na vā ॥27॥
7.141.28: etena hi mahābāho rakṣitavyaḥ sa pārthivaḥ,
7.141.30: jñātavyaśca hi me rājā rakṣitavyaśca sātyakiḥ ॥30॥
7.141.32: na ca bhūriśravāḥ śrāntaḥ sasahāyaśca keśava ॥32॥
7.141.37: nityamāśaṁsate droṇaḥ kaccit syāt kuśalī nr̥paḥ ॥37॥
7.141.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sātyakyarjunadarśane ekacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥141॥
7.142.3: na hi me mokṣyase jīvan yadi notsr̥jase raṇam ॥3॥
7.142.4: adya tvāṁ samare hatvā nityaṁ śūrābhimāninam,
7.142.6: adya dharmasuto rājā śrutvā tvāṁ nihataṁ mayā,
7.142.7: adya me vikramaṁ pārtho vijñāsyati dhanañjayaḥ,
7.142.8: purā devāsure yuddhe śakrasya balinā yathā ॥8॥
7.142.9: adya yuddhaṁ mahāghoraṁ tava dāsyāmi sātvata,
7.142.10: adya saṁyamanīṁ yātā mayā tvaṁ nihato raṇe,
7.142.12: tatstriyo nandayiṣyāmi ye tvayā nihatā raṇe ॥12॥
7.142.13: maccakṣurviṣayaṁ prāpto na tvaṁ mādhava mokṣyase,
7.142.14: kauraveya na santrāso vidyate mama saṁyuge ॥14॥
7.142.15: nāhaṁ bhīṣayituṁ śakyo vāṅmātreṇa tu kevalam,
sa māṁ nihanyāt saṅgrāme yo māṁ kuryānnirāyudham ॥15॥
7.142.16: samāstu śāśvatīrhanyād yo māṁ hanyāddhi saṁyuge,
kiṁ vr̥thoktena bahunā karmaṇā tat samācara ॥16॥
7.142.17: śāradasyeva meghasya garjitaṁ niṣphalaṁ hi te,
śrutvā tvadgarjitaṁ vīra hāsyaṁ hi mama jāyate ॥17॥
7.142.20: sametau tau maheṣvāsau śuṣmiṇau spardhinau raṇe ॥20॥
7.142.27: nirbhindantau hi gātrāṇi vikṣarantau ca śoṇitam ॥27॥
7.142.32: anyonyasya hayān hatvā dhanuṣī vinikr̥tya ca ॥32॥
7.142.33: ārṣabhe carmaṇī citre pragr̥hya vipule śubhe ॥33॥
7.142.34: vikośau cāpyasī kr̥tvā samare tau viceratuḥ,
carantau vividhān mārgān maṇḍalāni ca bhāgaśaḥ ॥34॥
7.142.48d1: sīdantaṁ sātyakiṁ paśya pārthainaṁ parirakṣa ca.
7.142.49: praviṣṭo bhāratīṁ bhittvā tava pāṇḍava pr̥ṣṭhataḥ,
7.142.49d1: dhārtarāṣṭrāśca ye mukhyā ye ca mukhyā mahārathāḥ,
7.142.54: pariśrāntaṁ gataṁ bhūmau kr̥tvā karma suduṣkaram,
7.142.57: ityevaṁ bhāṣamāṇe tu pāṇḍave vai dhanañjaye ॥57॥
7.142.59: sa siṁha iva mātaṅgaṁ vikarṣan bhūridakṣiṇaḥ,
7.142.60: atha kośād viniṣkr̥ṣya khaḍgaṁ bhūriśravā raṇe,
7.142.62: yathā cakraṁ tu kaulālo daṇḍaviddhaṁ tu bhārata,
7.142.65: asatyo vikramaḥ pārtha yatra bhūriśravā raṇe,
7.142.69: evaṁ tu manasā rājan pārthaḥ sampūjya kauravam,
7.142.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi bhūriśravobāhucchede dvicatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥142॥
7.143.2: vegena nyapatad bhūmau pañcāsya iva pannagaḥ ॥2॥
7.143.3: sa moghaṁ kr̥tamātmānaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pārthena kauravaḥ,
7.143.5: kiṁ nu vakṣyasi rājānaṁ dharmaputraṁ yudhiṣṭhiram,
kiṁ kurvāṇo mayā saṅkhye hato bhūriśravā raṇe ॥5॥
7.143.6: astraṁ rudreṇa vā pārtha droṇenātha kr̥peṇa vā ॥6॥
7.143.11: yeṣu yeṣu naravyāghra yatra yatra ca vartate,
7.143.13: idaṁ tu yadatikṣudraṁ vārṣṇeyārthe kr̥taṁ tvayā,
7.143.14: ko hi nāma pramattāya pareṇa saha yudhyate,
īdr̥śaṁ vyasanaṁ dadyād yo na kr̥ṣṇasakho bhavet ॥14॥
7.143.15: vr̥ṣṇyandhakāḥ kathaṁ pārtha pramāṇaṁ bhavatā kr̥tāḥ ॥15॥
7.143.16: vyaktaṁ hi jīryamāṇo’pi buddhiṁ jarayate naraḥ ॥16॥
7.143.17: anarthakamidaṁ sarvaṁ yat tvayā vyāhr̥taṁ prabho,
jānanneva hr̥ṣīkeśaṁ garhase māṁ ca pāṇḍavam ॥17॥
7.143.18: na cādharmamahaṁ kuryāṁ jānaṁścaiva hi muhyase ॥18॥
7.143.19: yudhyanti kṣatriyāḥ śatrūn svaiḥ svaiḥ parivr̥tā narāḥ,
7.143.20: vayasyairatha mitraiśca te ca bāhuṁ samāśritāḥ,
sa kathaṁ sātyakiṁ śiṣyaṁ sukhasambandhameva ca ॥20॥
7.143.21: asmadarthe ca yudhyantaṁ tyaktvā prāṇān sudustyajān,
mama bāhuṁ raṇe rājan dakṣiṇaṁ yuddhadurmadam ॥21॥
7.143.21d1: nikr̥ṣyamāṇaṁ taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kathaṁ śatruvaśaṁ gatam,
7.143.22: na cātmā rakṣitavyo vai rājan raṇagatena hi,
yo yasya yujyate’rtheṣu sa vai rakṣyo narādhipa ॥22॥
7.143.23: tai rakṣyamāṇaiḥ sa nr̥po rakṣitavyo mahāmr̥dhe,
7.143.24: rakṣitaśca mayā yasmāt tasmāt krudhyasi kiṁ mayi ॥24॥
7.143.25: yacca me garhase rājannanyena saha saṅgatam,
7.143.28: svaiḥ paraiśca sametebhyaḥ sātvatena ca saṅgame,
7.143.29: bahubhiḥ saha saṅgamya nirjitya ca mahārathān,
7.143.30: īdr̥śaṁ sātyakiṁ saṅkhye nirjitya ca mahāratham,
7.143.31: tathā kr̥cchragataṁ caiva sātyakiṁ kaḥ kṣamiṣyati ॥31॥
7.143.32: tvaṁ vai vigarhayātmānamātmānaṁ yo na rakṣasi,
kathaṁ kariṣyase vīra yo vā tvāṁ saṁśrayejjanaḥ ॥32॥
7.143.35: sūrye cakṣuḥ samādhāya prasannaṁ salile manaḥ,
7.143.38: amr̥ṣyamāṇo manasā teṣāṁ tasya ca bhāṣitam ॥38॥
7.143.40: na śakyo māmako hantuṁ yo me syād bāṇagocare ॥40॥
7.143.41: na hi dharmamavijñāya yuktaṁ garhayituṁ param ॥41॥
7.143.42: yadahaṁ bāhumacchaitsaṁ na sa dharmo vigarhitaḥ ॥42॥
7.143.43: abhimanyorvadhaṁ tāta dhārmikaḥ ko nu pūjayet ॥43॥
7.143.43d2: ye me pratyakṣato vīrā hanyeranniti me matiḥ.
7.143.43d5: dhigastu kṣatradharmaṁ tu yatra tvaṁ puruṣeśvaraḥ,
ko hi nāma pumām̐lloke mādr̥śaḥ puruṣottamaḥ,
praharet tvadvidhaṁ tvadya pratijñā yadi no bhavet.
7.143.45: etat pārthasya tu vacastataḥ śrutvā mahādyutiḥ,
7.143.46: yā prītirdharmarāje me bhīme ca balināṁ vare,
nakule sahadeve ca sā me tvayi śalāgraja ॥46॥
7.143.47: mayā tvaṁ samanujñātaḥ kr̥ṣṇena ca mahātmanā,
7.143.48: ye lokā mama vimalāḥ sakr̥d vibhātā
7.143.49: utthitaḥ sa tu śaineyo vimuktaḥ saumadattinā,
7.143.52: vāryamāṇaḥ sa kr̥ṣṇena pārthena ca mahātmanā,
7.143.58: na vārṣṇeyasyāparādho bhavitavyaṁ hi tat tathā,
tasmānmanyurna vaḥ kāryaḥ krodho duḥkhataro nr̥ṇām ॥58॥
7.143.60: na hantavyo na hantavya iti yanmāṁ prabhāṣata,
7.143.61: yadā bālaḥ subhadrāyāḥ sutaḥ śastravinā kr̥taḥ,
yuṣmābhirnihato yuddhe tadā dharmaḥ kva vo gataḥ ॥61॥
7.143.62: mayā tvetat pratijñātaṁ kṣepe kasmiṁścideva hi,
yo māṁ niṣpiṣya saṅgrāme jīvan hanyāt padā ruṣā ॥62॥
7.143.64: yukto hyasya pratīghātaḥ kr̥to me kurupuṅgavāḥ ॥64॥
7.143.65: yat tu pārthena māṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pratijñāmabhirakṣatā,
7.143.66: bhavitavyaṁ hi yad bhāvi daivaṁ ceṣṭayatīva ca,
7.143.67: api cāyaṁ purā gītaḥ śloko vālmīkinā bhuvi,
na hantavyāḥ striya iti yad bravīṣi plavaṅgama ॥67॥
7.143.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi bhūriśravovadhe tricatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥143॥
7.144.3: yathā ca bhūriśravaso yatra te saṁśayo nr̥pa ॥3॥
7.144.4: atreḥ putro’bhavat somaḥ somasya tu budhaḥ smr̥taḥ,
7.144.10: tatra vai devakīṁ devīṁ vasudevārthamāśu vai,
7.144.11: tāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā devakīṁ śūro rathasthāṁ puruṣarṣabha,
7.144.13: asimudyamya keśeṣu pragr̥hya ca padā hataḥ ॥13॥
7.144.14: kr̥payā ca punastena sa jīveti visarjitaḥ ॥14॥
7.144.16: tasya tuṣṭo mahādevo varāṇāṁ varadaḥ prabhuḥ,
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa sa tu vavre varaṁ nr̥paḥ ॥16॥
7.144.17: putramicchāmi bhagavan yo nipātya śineḥ sutam,
7.144.18: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā somadattasya pārthiva,
7.144.18d3: tasya pautraṁ tu samare tvatputro mohayiṣyati,
na tu mārayituṁ śakyaḥ kr̥ṣṇasaṁrakṣito hyasau.
7.144.20: etat te kathitaṁ rājan yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi ॥20॥
7.144.21: na hi śakyo raṇe jetuṁ sātvato manujarṣabhaiḥ,
7.144.23: na tulyaṁ vr̥ṣṇibhiriha dr̥śyate kiñcana prabho,
7.144.28: api meruṁ vahet kaścit tared vā makarālayam,
7.144.29: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ yatra te saṁśayaḥ prabho,
7.144.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi sātyakipraśaṁsāyāṁ catuścatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥144॥
7.145.3: codayāśvān bhr̥śaṁ kr̥ṣṇa yato rājā jayadrathaḥ,
7.145.6: tathā nābhyeti sūryo’staṁ yathā satyaṁ bhaved vacaḥ,
7.145.13: dhruvo hi naḥ karṇa jayo bhaviṣyati ॥13॥
7.145.19: kathaṁ jīvati durdharṣe tvayi rādheya phālgunaḥ,
7.145.21: drauṇinā rakṣyamāṇaṁ ca mayā duḥśāsanena ca,
7.145.22: yudhyante bahavaḥ śūrā lambate ca divākaraḥ,
śaṅke jayadrathaṁ pārtho naiva prāpsyati mānada ॥22॥
7.145.23: sa tvaṁ karṇa mayā sārdhaṁ śūraiścānyairmahārathaiḥ,
drauṇinā tvaṁ hi sahito madreśena kr̥peṇa ca ॥23॥
7.145.27: yotsyāmi tu yathāśaktyā tvadarthaṁ jīvitaṁ mama ॥27॥
7.145.28: na hi me yudhyamānasya sāyakānasyataḥ śitān ॥28॥
7.145.30: tat kariṣyāmi kauravya jayo daive pratiṣṭhitaḥ,
7.145.32: adya yuddhaṁ kuruśreṣṭha mama pārthasya cobhayoḥ ॥32॥
7.145.39: hatabhūyiṣṭhayodhaṁ tat kr̥tvā tava balaṁ balī ॥39॥
7.145.48: dvidhā tridhāṣṭadhaikaikaṁ chittvā vivyādha tān rathān,
7.145.49: sa viddhvā daśabhiḥ pārthaṁ vāsudevaṁ ca saptabhiḥ ॥49॥
7.145.58: te mahāstrāṇi divyāni tatra rājan vyadarśayan ॥58॥
7.145.59: hatabhūyiṣṭhayodhaṁ tat kr̥tvā tava balaṁ balī ॥59॥
7.145.63: tān karṇaḥ prativivyādha ṣaṣṭyā ṣaṣṭyā mahārathaḥ ॥63॥
7.145.64: tad yuddhamabhavad rājan karṇasya bahubhiḥ saha,
7.145.73: ardhacandreṇa tīkṣṇena sa cchinnaḥ prāpatad bhuvi ॥73॥
7.145.76: karṇa pārtho’smi tiṣṭha tvaṁ karṇo’haṁ tiṣṭha phālguna ॥76॥
7.145.77: yudhyetāṁ samare vīrau citraṁ laghu ca suṣṭhu ca ॥77॥
7.145.84: taṁ tathā virathaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā rathamāropya taṁ tadā ॥84॥
7.145.89: śāradvataṁ ca viṁśatyā viddhvā pārtho nanāda ha ॥89॥
7.145.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe pañcacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥145॥
7.146.2: trāsodvignaṁ tathodbhrāntaṁ tvadīyaṁ tad balaṁ nr̥pa,
7.146.3: sa raṇe vyacarat pārthaḥ prekṣamāṇo dhanañjayaḥ ॥3॥
7.146.5: utkarṣantaṁ sr̥jantaṁ ca na sma paśyāma lāghavāt,
7.146.14: śalabhā iva te dīptamagniṁ prāpya yayuḥ kṣayam,
evaṁ sa mr̥dnan śatrūṇāṁ jīvitāni yaśāṁsi ca ॥14॥
7.146.47: visr̥jantaṁ ca kaunteyaṁ nānupaśyāma vai tadā,
tathā sarvā diśo rājan sarvāṁśca rathino raṇe ॥47॥
7.146.50: tasya tasyāntagā bāṇāḥ śarīre nyapatan prabho ॥50॥
7.146.52: evaṁ tat tava rājendra caturaṅgabalaṁ tadā,
7.146.54: saindhavaṁ tu catuḥṣaṣṭyā viddhvā siṁha ivānadat ॥54॥
7.146.59: yugapat tasya ciccheda śarābhyāṁ saindhavasya ha,
sāratheśca śiraḥ kāyād dhvajaṁ ca samalaṅkr̥tam ॥59॥
7.146.61: etasminneva kāle tu drutaṁ gacchati bhāskare,
7.146.62: eṣa madhye kr̥taḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ pārtha vīrairmahārathaiḥ,
7.146.63: na śakyaḥ saindhavo hantuṁ yato nirvyājamarjuna ॥63॥
7.146.64: astaṅgata iti vyaktaṁ drakṣyatyekaḥ sa sindhurāṭ ॥64॥
7.146.65: na gopsyati durācāraḥ sa ātmānaṁ kathañcana ॥65॥
7.146.69: te prahr̥ṣṭā raṇe rājan nāpaśyan sainikā ravim ॥69॥
7.146.70: unnāmya vaktrāṇi tadā sa ca rājā jayadrathaḥ,
7.146.74: kr̥paṁ vivyādha viṁśatyā karṇaṁ pañcāśatā śaraiḥ ॥74॥
7.146.78: tataḥ sarve mahārāja tava yodhā jayaiṣiṇaḥ,
7.146.81: te hanyamānā vīreṇa yodhā rājan raṇe tava,
prajahuḥ saindhavaṁ bhītā dvau samaṁ nāpyadhāvatām ॥81॥
7.146.82: tādr̥ṅ na bhāvī bhūto vā yaccakāra mahāyaśāḥ ॥82॥
7.146.83: tathā sa rathinaścaiva nyahan rudraḥ paśūniva ॥83॥
7.146.84: na tatra samare kaścinmayā dr̥ṣṭo narādhipa,
gajo vājī naro vāpi yo na pārthaśarāhataḥ ॥84॥
7.146.94: evaṁ tava balaṁ rājan drāvayitvā dhanañjayaḥ,
7.146.96: na gr̥hṇan na kṣipan rājan muñcannāpi ca sandadhat,
7.146.98: karṇasya tu dhanuśchittvā vr̥ṣasenasya caiva ha,
7.146.106: sa kāleneha mahatā saindhavaṁ prāptavān sutam ॥106॥
7.146.112: dharaṇyāṁ mama putrasya pātayiṣyati yaḥ śiraḥ,
tasyāpi śatadhā mūrdhā phaliṣyati na saṁśayaḥ ॥112॥
7.146.114: so’yaṁ tapyati tejasvī tapo ghoraṁ durāsadam,
