7.146.117: tavāpi śatadhā mūrdhā phaliṣyati na saṁśayaḥ ॥117॥
7.146.118: yathā cedaṁ na jānīyāt sa rājā tapasi sthitaḥ,
7.146.119: na hyasādhyamakāryaṁ vā vidyate tava kiñcana,
7.146.122: sa tu gāṇḍīvanirmuktaḥ śaraḥ śyena ivāśugaḥ,
7.146.125: samantapañcakād bāhyaṁ śiro yad vyaharat tataḥ ॥125॥
7.146.135: hataṁ jayadrathaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tava putrā narādhipa,
7.146.136: tato jayadrathe rājan hate pārthena keśavaḥ,
7.146.137: uttamaujāśca vikrāntaḥ śaṅkhān dadhmuḥ pr̥thak pr̥thak ॥137॥
7.146.138: śrutvā mahāntaṁ taṁ śabdaṁ dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
7.146.141: te tu sarve prayatnena bhāradvājaṁ jighāṁsavaḥ,
7.146.142: pāṇḍavāstu jayaṁ labdhvā saindhavaṁ vinihatya ca,
7.146.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhe ṣaṭcatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥146॥
7.147.2: saindhavaṁ nihataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā raṇe pārthena bhārata,
7.147.11: tasmin bhagne mahārāja kr̥pe śāradvate yudhi,
7.147.21: kr̥paṇaṁ svarathe sannaṁ paśya kr̥ṣṇa yathāgatam,
7.147.23: tadidaṁ narakāyādya kr̥taṁ karma mayā dhruvam ॥23॥
7.147.27: tathā vilapamāne tu savyasācini taṁ prati ॥27॥
7.147.29: upāyāntaṁ tu rādheyaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pārtho mahārathaḥ ॥29॥
7.147.31: yatra yātyeṣa tatra tvaṁ codayāśvān janārdana ॥31॥
7.147.34: na ca tāvat kṣamaḥ pārtha tava karṇena saṅgaraḥ ॥34॥
7.147.37: hate tu bhūriśravasi saindhave ca nipātite ॥37॥
7.147.39: hanta te vartayiṣyāmi yathā vr̥ttaṁ mahāraṇe,
7.147.41: atītānāgate rājan sa hi vetti janārdanaḥ,
tataḥ sūtaṁ samāhūya dārukaṁ sandideśa ha ॥41॥
7.147.42: ratho me yujyatāṁ kalyamiti rājan mahābalaḥ,
na hi devā na gandharvā na yakṣoragarākṣasāḥ ॥42॥
7.147.43: mānavā vāpi jetāraḥ kr̥ṣṇayoḥ santi kecana,
7.147.44: tayoḥ prabhāvamatulaṁ śr̥ṇu yuddhaṁ tu tat tathā,
sātyakiṁ virathaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā karṇaṁ cābhyudyataṁ raṇe ॥44॥
7.147.45: dāruko’vetya sandeśaṁ śrutvā śaṅkhasya ca svanam ॥45॥
7.147.48: yuktaṁ samāruhya ca taṁ vimānapratimaṁ ratham ॥48॥
7.147.51: naiva daivaṁ na gāndharvaṁ nāsuraṁ na ca rākṣasam ॥51॥
7.147.52: tādr̥śaṁ bhuvi no yuddhaṁ divi vā śrutamityuta,
7.147.56: mitrārthe tau parākrāntau śuṣmiṇau spardhinau raṇe ॥56॥
7.147.59: sa śaineyaṁ raṇe kruddhaḥ pradahanniva cakṣuṣā ॥59॥
7.147.61: mahatā śaravarṣeṇa gajaṁ prati gajo yathā,
7.147.62: tataḥ karṇaṁ śineḥ pautraḥ sarvapārasavaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥62॥
7.147.64: aśvāṁśca caturaḥ śvetān nijaghāna śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
chittvā dhvajaṁ rathaṁ caiva śatadhā puruṣarṣabha ॥64॥
7.147.65: cakāra virathaṁ karṇaṁ tava putrasya paśyataḥ,
7.147.67: tataḥ paryākulaṁ sarvaṁ na prājñāyata kiñcana,
tathā sātyakinā vīre virathe sūtaje kr̥te ॥67॥
7.147.68: karṇo’pi viratho rājan sātvatena kr̥taḥ śaraiḥ ॥68॥
7.147.70: tathā tu virathaṁ karṇaṁ putrāṁśca tava pārthiva ॥70॥
7.147.71: rakṣan pratijñāṁ bhīmena pārthena ca purākr̥tām ॥71॥
7.147.72: bhīmasenena tu vadhaḥ putrāṇāṁ te pratiśrutaḥ ॥72॥
7.147.73: anudyūte ca pārthena vadhaḥ karṇasya saṁśrutaḥ,
vadhe tvakurvan yatnaṁ te tasya karṇamukhāstadā ॥73॥
7.147.75: kāṅkṣatā paralokaṁ ca dharmarājasya ca priyam ॥75॥
7.147.77: kr̥ṣṇo vāpi bhavelloke pārtho vāpi dhanurdharaḥ,
śaineyo vā naravyāghra caturthastu na vidyate ॥77॥
7.147.89: etat te sarvamākhyātaṁ yanmāṁ tvaṁ parimr̥cchasi ॥89॥
7.147.92: bhīṣmaṁ pramukhataḥ kr̥tvā bhagadattaṁ ca bhārata,
evameṣa kṣayo vr̥tto rājan durmantrite tava ॥92॥
7.147.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi karṇasātyakiyuddhe saptacatvāriṁśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥147॥
7.148.1: tathā gateṣu śūreṣu teṣāṁ mama ca sañjaya,
7.148.4: evaṁ vaktā ca me vadhyastena cokto’smi bhārata ॥4॥
7.148.5: etad vrataṁ mahābāho tvayā saha kr̥taṁ mayā,
tathaitanmama kaunteya yathā tava na saṁśayaḥ ॥5॥
7.148.6: yathā bhavati tat satyaṁ tathā kuru dhanañjaya ॥6॥
7.148.8: adharmabuddhe śr̥ṇu me yat tvāṁ vakṣyāmi sāmpratam ॥8॥
7.148.9d1: raṇamutsr̥jya nirlajja gacchase vai punaḥ punaḥ,
māhātmyaṁ paśya bhīmasya karṇa janma kule tathā.
7.148.9d4: śr̥gāla iva vanyān vai kṣatraṁ tvamavamanyase.
7.148.11: kathañcid virathaṁ kr̥tvā yat tvaṁ rūkṣamabhāṣathāḥ ॥11॥
7.148.12: nāriṁ jitvātikatthante na ca jalpanti durvacaḥ ॥12॥
7.148.13: na ca kañcana nindanti santaḥ śūrā nararṣabhāḥ,
tvaṁ tu prākr̥tavijñānastat tad vadasi sūtaja ॥13॥
7.148.16: na ca tvāṁ paruṣaṁ kiñciduktavān pāṇḍunandanaḥ ॥16॥
7.148.17: yasmāt tu bahu rūkṣaṁ ca śrāvitaste vr̥kodaraḥ,
7.148.19: kuru tvaṁ sarvakr̥tyāni mahat te bhayamāgatam ॥19॥
7.148.22: dr̥ṣṭvā duryodhano mando bhr̥śaṁ tapsyati pātitam,
7.148.23: mahān sutumulaḥ śabdo babhūva rathināṁ tadā,
7.148.25: diṣṭyā sampāditā jiṣṇo pratijñā mahatī tvayā ॥25॥
7.148.27: sīdeta samare jiṣṇo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā,
na taṁ paśyāmi lokeṣu cintayan puruṣaṁ kvacit ॥27॥
7.148.28: tvadr̥te puruṣavyāghra ya etad yodhayed balam,
7.148.29: te tvāṁ prāpya raṇe kruddhā nābhyavartanta daṁśitāḥ ॥29॥
7.148.30: nedr̥śaṁ śaknuyāt kaścid raṇe kartuṁ parākramam ॥30॥
7.148.34: tava prabhāvo vārṣṇeya tavaiva vijayaḥ prabho,
7.148.36: prārthayanto jayaṁ yuddhe prathitaṁ ca mahad yaśaḥ,
7.148.39: teṣāṁ śaraiḥ svarṇapuṅkhaiḥ śastraiśca vividhaiḥ śitaiḥ,
7.148.51: tāṁśca bāṇahatān vīra paśya niṣṭanataḥ kṣitau,
7.149.1: vavande sa prahr̥ṣṭātmā hate pārthena saindhave ॥1॥
7.149.5: abravīd vāsudevaṁ ca pāṇḍavaṁ ca dhanañjayam,
7.149.8: tvayā guptena govinda ghnatā pāpaṁ jayadratham ॥8॥
7.149.9: kiṁ tu nātyadbhutaṁ teṣāṁ yeṣāṁ nastvaṁ samāśrayaḥ,
na teṣāṁ duṣkr̥taṁ kiñcit triṣu lokeṣu vidyate ॥9॥
7.149.11: sthitaḥ sarvātmanā nityaṁ priyeṣu ca hiteṣu ca,
7.149.13: bālyāt prabhr̥ti te kr̥ṣṇa karmāṇi śrutavānaham ॥13॥
7.149.14: amānuṣāṇi divyāni mahānti ca bahūni ca,
tadaivājñāsiṣaṁ śatrūn hatān prāptāṁ ca medinīm ॥14॥
7.149.15: sureśatvaṁ gataḥ śakro hatvā daityān sahasraśaḥ ॥15॥
7.149.18: ye paśyanti hr̥ṣīkeśaṁ na te muhyanti karhicit ॥18॥
7.149.19: ye prapannāḥ suraguruṁ na te muhyanti karhicit ॥19॥
7.149.21: paraṁ purāṇaṁ puruṣaṁ parāṇāṁ paramaṁ ca yat,
7.149.22: gāyanti caturo vedā yaśca vedeṣu gīyate,
7.149.28: tvaṁ tejastvaṁ paraṁ brahma tvaṁ satyaṁ tvaṁ mahat tapaḥ,
7.149.29: pralaye samanuprāpte tvāṁ vai niviśate punaḥ ॥29॥
7.149.31: api devā na jānanti guhyamādyaṁ jagatpatim ॥31॥
7.149.32: paraṁ purāṇaṁ puruṣaṁ purāṇānāṁ paraṁ ca yat ॥32॥
7.149.33: evamādiguṇānāṁ te karmaṇāṁ divi ceha ca,
7.149.42: diṣṭyā satyā pratijñeyaṁ kr̥tā hatvā jayadratham ॥42॥
7.149.45: tava kopāgninā dagdhaḥ pāpo rājā jayadrathaḥ,
7.149.47: tvāṁ hi cakṣurhaṇaṁ vīraṁ kopayitvā suyodhanaḥ,
7.149.49: yātā mr̥tyuvaśaṁ te vai yeṣāṁ kruddho’si pāṇḍava ॥49॥
7.149.50: rājyaṁ prāṇāḥ śriyaḥ putrāḥ saukhyāni vividhāni ca,
acirāt tasya naśyanti yeṣāṁ kruddho’si mānada ॥50॥
7.149.53: tau dr̥ṣṭvā muditau vīrau prāñjalī cāgrataḥ sthitau ॥53॥
7.149.54: diṣṭyā paśyāmi vāṁ śūrau vimuktau sainyasāgarāt ॥54॥
7.149.56: yuvāṁ vijayinau cāpi diṣṭyā paśyāmi saṁyuge,
7.149.57: diṣṭhyā vikarṇibhiḥ karṇo raṇe nītaḥ parābhavam,
7.149.60: mama vākyasamau caiva diṣṭyā paśyāmi vāmaham ॥60॥
7.149.61: sasvaje puruṣavyāghrau harṣād vāṣpaṁ mumoca ha ॥61॥
7.149.62: pāṇḍavānāṁ raṇe hr̥ṣṭaṁ yuddhāya tu mano dadhe ॥62॥
7.149.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhiraharṣe ekonapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥149॥
7.150.3: dr̥ṣṭvā tatkadanaṁ ghoraṁ svabalasya kr̥taṁ mahat,
7.150.5: na droṇo na ca rādheyo nāśvatthāmā kr̥po na ca,
kruddhasya samare sthātuṁ paryāptā iti māriṣa ॥5॥
7.150.6: nirjitya hi raṇe pārthaḥ sarvān mama mahārathān,
avadhīt saindhavaṁ saṅkhye na ca kaścidavārayat ॥6॥
7.150.7: na hyasya vidyate trātā sākṣādapi purandaraḥ ॥7॥
7.150.8: sa karṇo nirjitaḥ saṅkhye hataścaiva jayadrathaḥ ॥8॥
7.150.9: tr̥ṇavat tamahaṁ manye sa karṇo nirjito yudhi ॥9॥
7.150.12: kr̥tvā pramukhataḥ śūraṁ bhīṣmaṁ mama pitāmaham ॥12॥
7.150.14: akṣauhiṇīḥ sapta hatvā hato rājā jayadrathaḥ ॥14॥
7.150.21: kiṁ vakṣyati hi durdharṣaḥ sametya paralokajit ॥21॥
7.150.23: anyān bahūṁśca suhr̥do jīvitārtho’dya ko mama ॥23॥
7.150.26: iṣṭāpūrtena ca śape vīryeṇa ca sutairapi ॥26॥
7.150.27: nihatya tān raṇe sarvān pañcālān pāṇḍavaiḥ saha,
śāntiṁ labdhāsmi teṣāṁ vā raṇe gantā salokatām ॥27॥
7.150.28: so’haṁ tatra gamiṣyāmi yatra te puruṣarṣabhāḥ,
7.150.29: śreyo hi pāṇḍūn manyante na tathāsmān mahābhuja ॥29॥
7.150.33: tādr̥g rūpaṁ kr̥tamidaṁ mama kāryaṁ suhr̥ttamaiḥ,
7.150.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi duryodhanānutāpe pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥150॥
7.151.5: droṇastu tad vacaḥ śrutvā putrasya tava durmanāḥ,
7.151.9: tasmin nipatite śūre kiṁ śeṣaṁ paryupāsmahe ॥9॥
7.151.10: yān sma tān glahate tāta śakuniḥ kurusaṁsadi,
akṣān na te’kṣā niśitā bāṇāste śatrutāpanāḥ ॥10॥
7.151.11: ta ete ghnanti nastāta viśikhāḥ pārthacoditāḥ,
7.151.12: dhīrasya vāco nāśrauṣīḥ kṣemāya vadataḥ śivāḥ ॥12॥
7.151.14: svamataṁ kurute mūḍhaḥ sa śocyo nacirādiva ॥14॥
7.151.16: no cet pāpaṁ pare loke tvamarcchethāstato’dhikam ॥16॥
7.151.17: yacca tān pāṇḍavān dyūte viṣameṇa vijitya ha,
7.151.18: druhyet ko nu naro loke madanyo brāhmaṇabruvaḥ ॥18॥
7.151.21: sindhurājānamāśritya sa vo madhye kathaṁ hataḥ ॥21॥
7.151.22: kathaṁ tvayi ca karṇe ca kr̥pe śalye ca jīvati,
7.151.23: sindhurājaṁ paritrātuṁ sa vo madhye kathaṁ hataḥ ॥23॥
7.151.24: mayyeva hi viśeṣeṇa tathā duryodhana tvayi,
7.151.29: hato bhūriśravāścaiva kiṁ śeṣaṁ tatra manyase ॥29॥
7.151.30: kr̥pa eva ca durdharṣo yadi jīvati pārthiva,
yo nāgāt sindhurājasya vartma taṁ pūjayāmyaham ॥30॥
7.151.32: na te vasundharāstīti tadāhaṁ cintaye nr̥pa ॥32॥
7.151.33: imāni pāṇḍavānāṁ ca sr̥ñjayānāṁ ca bhārata,
7.151.34: kartāsmi samare karma dhārtarāṣṭra hitaṁ tava ॥34॥
7.151.36: ānr̥śaṁsye dame satye cārjave ca sthiro bhava ॥36॥
7.151.38: na caiṣāṁ vipriyaṁ kāryaṁ te hi vahniśikhopamāḥ ॥38॥
7.151.40: tvaṁ ca duryodhana balaṁ yadi śakto’si pālaya,
7.151.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi droṇavākye ekapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥151॥
7.152.4: paśya rādheya pr̥thvīśāḥ pr̥thivyāṁ pravarā yudhi ॥4॥
7.152.6: alpāvaśeṣaṁ sainyaṁ me kr̥taṁ śakrātmajena ha,
7.152.8: paśya rādheya pr̥thvīśān pr̥thivyāṁ pātitān bahūn,
7.152.9: anicchataḥ kathaṁ vīra droṇasya yudhi pāṇḍavaḥ,
7.152.11: prādāt kirīṭine dvāraṁ paśya nirguṇatāṁ mayi ॥11॥
7.152.13d1: rakṣāmi saindhavaṁ yuddhe nainaṁ prāpsyati phālgunaḥ,
7.152.15: ācāryaṁ mā vigarhasva śaktyāsau yudhyate dvijaḥ,
7.152.17: kr̥tī dakṣo yuvā śūraḥ kr̥tāstro laghuvikramaḥ,
7.152.21: tasya doṣaṁ na paśyāmi droṇasyānena hetunā ॥21॥
7.152.23: yato no yudhyamānānāṁ paraṁ śaktyā suyodhana ॥23॥
7.152.24: saindhavo nihato yuddhe daivamatra paraṁ smr̥tam,
paraṁ yatnaṁ kurvatāṁ ca tvayā sārdhaṁ raṇājire ॥24॥
7.152.25: hatvāsmākaṁ pauruṣaṁ vai daivaṁ paścāt karoti naḥ,
7.152.26: daivopasr̥ṣṭaḥ puruṣo yat karma kurute kvacit,
kr̥taṁ kr̥taṁ hi tatkarma daivena vinipātyate ॥26॥
7.152.28: dagdhā jatugr̥he cāpi dyūtena ca parājitāḥ ॥28॥
7.152.29: yatnena ca kr̥taṁ tattad daivena vinipātitam ॥29॥
7.152.30: yatatastava teṣāṁ ca daivaṁ mārgeṇa yāsyati ॥30॥
7.152.31: na teṣāṁ matipūrvaṁ hi sukr̥taṁ dr̥śyate kvacit,
duṣkr̥taṁ tava vā vīra buddhyā hīnaṁ kurūdvaha ॥31॥
7.152.34: śaṅke daivasya tat karma pauruṣaṁ yena nāśitam ॥34॥
7.152.36: tāvakānāṁ paraiḥ sārdhaṁ rājan durmantrite tava ॥36॥
7.152.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi jayadrathavadhaparvaṇi punaryuddhārambhe dvipañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥152॥
7.153.10: śarā daśa diśo rājaṁsteṣāṁ muktāḥ sahasraśaḥ,
7.153.14d1: droṇaḥ karṇaḥ kr̥paścaiva kr̥tavarmā ca sātvataḥ,
7.153.14d2: eṣā nītiḥ parā yuddhe dr̥ṣṭā tatra maharṣibhiḥ.
7.153.14d3: praviṣṭe vā mama sute pareṣāṁ vai mahad balam,
7.153.14d4: ekasya ca bahūnāṁ ca śr̥ṇu me bruvato’dbhutam.
7.153.14d5: droṇena vāryamāṇo’sau karṇena ca kr̥peṇa ca,
prāviśat pāṇḍavīṁ senāṁ makarāḥ sāgaraṁ yathā.
7.153.15: tathā tava sutaṁ madhye pratapantaṁ śarārcibhiḥ ॥15॥
7.153.18: na tādr̥śaṁ raṇe karma kr̥tavantastu tāvakāḥ ॥18॥
7.153.19: putreṇa tava sā senā pāṇḍavī mathitā raṇe ॥19॥
7.153.21: babhūva pāṇḍavī senā tava putrasya tejasā,
pāṇḍusenāṁ hatāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tava putreṇa bhārata ॥21॥
7.153.23: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca saptatyā dharmaputraṁ ca saptabhiḥ ॥23॥
7.153.25: ghaṭotkacaṁ ca samare viddhvā siṁha ivānadat,
7.153.26: sā tena pāṇḍavī senā vadhyamānā śilīmukhaiḥ ॥26॥
7.153.34: tasya tān nighnataḥ śatrūn rukmapr̥ṣṭhaṁ mahad dhanuḥ ॥34॥
7.153.35: vivyādha cainaṁ daśabhiḥ samyagastaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥35॥
7.153.36: marma bhittvā tu te sarve saṁlagnāḥ kṣitimāviśan,
7.153.37: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā tava putrasya māriṣa,
7.153.41: atha droṇo drutaṁ tatra pratyadr̥śyata saṁyuge,
7.153.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe duryodhanaparābhave tripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥153॥
7.154.1: yat tadā prāviśat pāṇḍūnācāryaḥ kupito balī,
uktvā duryodhanaṁ mandaṁ mama śāstrātigaṁ sutam ॥1॥
7.154.4: ke cāsya pr̥ṣṭhato’nvāsan vīrā vīrasya yodhinaḥ,
7.154.5: manye te samavepanta gāvo vai śiśire yathā ॥5॥
7.154.8: sāyāhne saindhavaṁ hatvā rājñā pārthaḥ sametya ca,
7.154.17: tasyāṁ rajanyāṁ ghorāyāṁ nadantyaḥ sarvataḥ śivāḥ ॥17॥
7.154.22: droṇasya ca mahārāja sr̥ñjayānāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ,
tamasā cāvr̥te loke na prājñāyata kiñcana ॥22॥
7.154.26: naiva sve na pare rājan prājñāyanta tamovr̥te ॥26॥
7.154.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe catuṣpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥154॥
7.155.1: amr̥ṣyamāṇe saṁrabdhe kā vo’bhūd vai matistadā ॥1॥
7.155.3: nihate saindhave vīre bhūriśravasi caiva ha,
7.155.5: ke cāsya pr̥ṣṭhato’gacchan vīrāḥ śūrasya yudhyataḥ ॥5॥
7.155.7: śiśire kampamānā vai kr̥śā gāva iva prabho,
7.155.15: tān sarvān preṣayāmāsa pitr̥lokaṁ sa bhārata ॥15॥
7.155.18: taṁ śibiḥ prativivyādha triṁśatā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.155.19: tasya droṇo hayān hatvā sārathiṁ ca mahātmanaḥ,
7.155.23: kaliṅgānāṁ tu taṁ śūraṁ kruddhaṁ kruddho vr̥kodaraḥ,
7.155.24: sarvāṇyasthīni sahasā prāpatan vai pr̥thak pr̥thak ॥24॥
7.155.26: tataḥ śatrurathaṁ tyaktvā bhīmo dhruvarathaṁ gataḥ,
7.155.39: durmadasya ca vīrasya duṣkarṇasya ca taṁ ratham,
7.155.40: tataḥ sutau te balinau śūrau duṣkarṇadurmadau,
muṣṭinā’’hatya saṅkruddho mamarda ca nanarda ca ॥40॥
7.155.41: tato hāhākr̥te sainye dr̥ṣṭvā bhīmaṁ nr̥pā’bruvan,
7.155.42: visañjñā vāhayan vāhān na ca dvau saha dhāvataḥ ॥42॥
7.155.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe bhīmaparākrame pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥155॥
7.156.1: prāyopaviṣṭe tu hate putre sātyakinā tadā,
7.156.2: taṁ tvaṁ sātvata santyajya dasyudharme kathaṁ rataḥ ॥2॥
7.156.3: kṣatradharmarataḥ prājñaḥ kathaṁ nu prahared raṇe ॥3॥
7.156.4: dvāveva kila vr̥ṣṇīnāṁ tatra khyātau mahārathau,
7.156.6: adya cchetsyāmi te mūḍha śiro vikramya patriṇā ॥6॥
7.156.8: na hanyāṁ narake ghore pateyaṁ vr̥ṣṇipāṁsana ॥8॥
7.156.9: dadhmau śaṅkhaṁ ca tāreṇa siṁhanādaṁ nanāda ca ॥9॥
7.156.11: kauraveya na me trāsaḥ kathañcidapi vidyate,
7.156.12: yadi sarveṇa sainyena gupto māṁ yodhayiṣyasi,
tathāpi na vyathā kācit tvayi syānmama kaurava ॥12॥
7.156.14: yadi te’sti yuyutsādya mayā saha narādhipa,
7.156.17: yasmin dānaṁ damaḥ śaucamahiṁsā hrīrdhr̥tiḥ kṣamā,
7.156.19: yadi tvāṁ sasutaṁ pāpaṁ na hanyāṁ yudhi roṣitaḥ ॥19॥
7.156.24: sāgraṁ śatasahasraṁ tu hayānāṁ tasya dhīmataḥ,
7.156.32: tataḥ pravavr̥te yuddhaṁ droṇasya saha pāṇḍavaiḥ ॥32॥
7.156.38: prādravan vai bhayād rājan sārtanādā diśo daśa ॥38॥
7.156.39: kālyamānaṁ tu tat sainyaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā droṇena phālgunaḥ,
7.156.44: yo yo hi pramukhe tasya tasthau droṇasya pūruṣaḥ ॥44॥
7.156.45: evaṁ sā pāṇḍavī senā vadhyamānā mahātmanā ॥45॥
7.156.46: samprabhagnaṁ balaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā droṇena niśi bhārata ॥46॥
7.156.48: bhīmaseno’pi taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā yāntaṁ droṇāya phālgunam ॥48॥
7.156.92: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha na me jīvan droṇaputra gamiṣyasi ॥92॥
7.156.94: na hi putreṇa haiḍimbe pitā nyāyyaḥ prabādhitum,
kāmaṁ khalu na roṣo me haiḍimbe vidyate tvayi ॥94॥
7.156.97: bhīmāt khalu samutpannaḥ kurūṇāṁ vipule kule ॥97॥
7.156.99: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha na me jīvan droṇaputra gamiṣyasi,
7.156.107: sa tenāstreṇa śailendraḥ kṣiptaḥ kṣipraṁ vyanaśyata ॥107॥
7.156.108: tataḥ sa toyado bhūtvā nīlaḥ sendrāyudho divi,
7.156.116: tiṣṭha duryodhanādya tvaṁ na kāryaḥ sambhramastvayā,
7.156.118: na tvetadadbhutaṁ manye yat te mahadidaṁ manaḥ,
7.156.124: jahi bhīmaṁ yamau cobhau dharmarājaṁ ca mātula,
asurāniva devendro jayāśā me tvayi sthitā ॥124॥
7.156.126: evamukto yayau śīghraṁ putreṇa tava saubalaḥ,
7.156.135: pureva tripuraṁ dagdhvā divi devo maheśvaraḥ ॥135॥
7.156.137: drauṇiṁ hateti mahatīṁ codayāmāsa tāṁ camūm ॥137॥
7.156.148: kruddhāḥ sma prādravan dauṇiṁ jighāṁsanto mahābalāḥ ॥148॥
7.156.155: svaṁ sūtamabravīt kruddho droṇaputrāya māṁ vaha,
7.156.166: tato bhīmātmajaṁ rakṣo dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca sānugam,
7.156.180: jaghāna surathaṁ nāma drupadasya sutaṁ vibhuḥ ॥180॥
7.156.183: jaghāna sa pr̥ṣadhraṁ ca candrasenaṁ ca māriṣa,
7.156.185: sa bhittvā hr̥dayaṁ tasya rākṣasasya mahāśaraḥ ॥185॥
7.156.186: taṁ hataṁ patitaṁ jñātvā dhr̥ṣṭadyumno mahārathaḥ ॥186॥
7.156.188: parājitya raṇe vīro droṇaputro nanāda ha,
7.156.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥156॥
7.157.14: sa tathābhihato bhīmaścakampe ca mumoha ca ॥14॥
7.157.15: prāpya cetaśca balavān gadāmasmai sasarja ha,
7.157.16: sa papāta hataḥ pr̥thvyāṁ vajrāhata ivādrirāṭ,
7.157.18: tān dr̥ṣṭvā cukrudhe bhīmo jagr̥he bhārasādhanān ॥18॥
7.157.19: te viddhā vyasavaḥ petuḥ syandanebhyo hataujasaḥ ॥19॥
7.157.21: tato vr̥karatho nāma bhrātā karṇasya viśrutaḥ ॥21॥
7.157.22: tataḥ sapta rathān vīraḥ syālānāṁ tava bhārata ॥22॥
7.157.30: yaudheyān mālavān rājan madrakāṇāṁ gaṇān yudhi,
7.157.32: sainyāni drāvayantaṁ taṁ droṇo dr̥ṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhiram,
7.157.44: te hanyamānā doṇena pañcālāḥ prādravan bhayāt,
7.157.48: tataḥ sā bhāratī senā vadhyamānā kirīṭinā,
7.157.49: droṇena vāryamāṇāste svayaṁ tava sutena ca,
7.157.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe droṇayudhiṣṭhirayuddhe saptapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥157॥
7.158.1: udīryamāṇaṁ tad dr̥ṣṭvā pāṇḍavānāṁ mahad balam,
7.158.2: ayaṁ sa kālaḥ samprāpto mitrāṇāṁ mitravatsala,
trāyasva samare karṇa sarvān yodhān mahārathān ॥2॥
7.158.7: priyaṁ tava mayā kāryamiti jīvāmi pārthiva ॥7॥
7.158.9: tava vaśyā bhaviṣyanti vanaṁ yāsyanti vā punaḥ ॥9॥
7.158.10: mayi jīvati kauravya viṣādaṁ mā kr̥thāḥ kvacit,
7.158.12: evaṁ bruvāṇaṁ karṇaṁ tu kr̥paḥ śāradvato’bravīt,
7.158.13: tvayā nāthena rādheya vacasā yadi sidhyati ॥13॥
7.158.14: na tu te vikramaḥ kaścid dr̥śyate phalameva vā ॥14॥
7.158.17: pārthena nirjitā yuddhe tvaṁ ca karṇa sahānujaḥ ॥17॥
7.158.19: abruvan karṇa yudhyasva katthase bahu sūnaja,
anuktvā vikramed yastu tad vai satpuruṣavratam ॥19॥
7.158.20: niṣphalo dr̥śyase karṇa tacca rājā na budhyate ॥20॥
7.158.21: tāvad garjasva rādheya yāvat pārthaṁ na paśyasi,
ārāt pārthaṁ hi te dr̥ṣṭvā durlabhaṁ garjitaṁ punaḥ ॥21॥
7.158.23: bāhubhiḥ kṣatriyāḥ śūrā vāgbhiḥ śūrā dvijātayaḥ,
dhanuṣā phālgunaḥ śūraḥ karṇaḥ śūro manorathaiḥ ॥23॥
7.158.24: toṣito yena rudro’pi kaḥ pārthaṁ pratighātayet,
7.158.27: yaṁ bhāraṁ puruṣo voḍhuṁ manasā hi vyavasyati ॥27॥
7.158.29: garjāmi yadyahaṁ vipra tava kiṁ tatra naśyati ॥29॥
7.158.30: vr̥thā śūrā na garjanti śāradā iva toyadāḥ,
7.158.31: utsahe manasā jetuṁ tato garjāmi gautama ॥31॥
7.158.32: paśya tvaṁ garjitasyāsya phalaṁ me vipra sānugān,
7.158.34: sadā kṣipasi vai kr̥ṣṇau dharmarājaṁ ca pāṇḍavam,
7.158.43: yeṣāmarthāya yudhyante na teṣāṁ vidyate kṣayaḥ ॥43॥
7.158.44: ete cānye ca bahavo guṇāḥ pāṇḍusutasya vai,
7.158.47: kathaṁ tān saṁyuge karṇa jetumutsahase parān,
7.158.49: abravīcca tadā karṇo guruṁ śāradvataṁ kr̥pam,
satyamuktaṁ tvayā brahman pāṇḍavān prati yad vacaḥ ॥49॥
7.158.50: ete cānye ca bahavo guṇāḥ pāṇḍusuteṣu vai,
7.158.52: mama hyamoghā datteyaṁ śaktiḥ śakreṇa vai dvija,
7.158.53: hate tu pāṇḍave kr̥ṣṇe bhrātaraścāsya sodarāḥ,
anarjunā na śakṣyanti mahīṁ bhoktuṁ kathañcana ॥53॥
7.158.56: tvaṁ tu vipraśca vr̥ddhaśca aśaktaścāpi saṁyuge,
7.158.59: atrāpi śr̥ṇu me vākyaṁ yathāvad bruvato dvija,
7.158.66: ete cānye ca rājāno devairapi sudurjayāḥ ॥66॥
7.158.68: yāṁśca tān stauṣi satataṁ duryodhanaripūn dvija,
7.158.70: yastān balavato nityaṁ manyase tvaṁ dvijādhama,
yatiṣye’haṁ yathāśakti yoddhuṁ taiḥ saha saṁyuge,
7.159.3: śūraṁ dveṣāt sudurbuddhe tvaṁ bhartsayasi mātulam ॥3॥
7.159.5: kva te vīryaṁ kva cāstrāṇi yattvāṁ nirjitya saṁyuge,
7.159.7: yaṁ hi kr̥ṣṇena sahitaṁ sarvaśastrabhr̥tāṁ varam,
jetuṁ na śaktāḥ sahitāḥ sendrā api surasurāḥ ॥7॥
7.159.10: tamudyataṁ tu vegena rājā duryodhanaḥ svayam,
7.159.13: kopaḥ khalu na kartavyaḥ sūtaputraṁ kathañcana ॥13॥
7.159.14: tvayi karṇe kr̥pe droṇe madrarāje’tha saubale,
7.159.21: tataḥ pravavr̥te yuddhaṁ karṇasya saha pāṇḍavaiḥ ॥21॥
7.159.23: ayaṁ karṇaḥ kutaḥ karṇastiṣṭha karṇa mahāraṇe ॥23॥
7.159.29: na vivyathe sūtaputro na ca trāsamagacchata,
7.159.33: śaravarṣaṁ tu tat karṇaḥ pārthivaiḥ samudīritam,
7.159.34: yathā devāsure yuddhe śakrasya saha dānavaiḥ ॥34॥
7.159.35: yadenaṁ sarvato yattā nāpnuvanti pare yudhi ॥35॥
7.159.36: yugeṣvīṣāsu cchatreṣu dhvajeṣu ca hayeṣu ca ॥36॥
7.159.41: tato duryodhano rājā dr̥ṣṭvā karṇasya vikramam ॥41॥
7.159.44: dr̥ṣṭvaitāṁ nirjitāṁ senāṁ raṇe karṇena dhīmatā,
7.159.45: na hanyāt pāṇḍavaḥ saṅkhye tathā nītirvidhīyatām ॥45॥
7.159.46: tato dauṇiḥ kr̥paḥ śalyo hārdikyaśca mahārathaḥ,
7.159.48: pratyudyayau tadā karṇaṁ yathā vr̥traṁ śatakratuḥ,
7.159.50: āśaṁsate ca bībhatsuṁ yuddhe jetuṁ sudāruṇam,
sa tu taṁ sahasā prāptaṁ nityamatyantavairiṇam ॥50॥
7.159.51: āyāntaṁ pāṇḍavaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā gajaṁ pratigajo yathā ॥51॥
7.159.57: tasya viddhasya bāṇena karāccāpaṁ papāta ha,
7.159.58: śaravr̥ṣṭiṁ tu tāṁ muktāṁ sūtaputreṇa bhārata ॥58॥
7.159.61: tataḥ pārtho maheṣvāso dr̥ṣṭvā karṇasya vikramam ॥61॥
7.159.72: adya bāṇamayaṁ varṣaṁ sr̥jato mama dhanvinaḥ,
7.159.73: tiṣṭhadhvaṁ samare śūrā bhayaṁ tyajata phālgunāt ॥73॥
7.159.75: ityuktvā prayayau rājā sainyena mahatā vr̥taḥ,
7.159.81: svayaṁ yuddhāya yad rājā pārthaṁ yātyasahāyavān ॥81॥
7.159.84: mayi jīvati gāndhāre na yuddhaṁ gantumarhasi,
7.159.85: na hi te sambhramaḥ kāryaḥ pārthasya vijayaṁ prati,
7.159.87: dharmarājapriyārthaṁ vā draupadyā vā na vidma tat ॥87॥
7.159.89: ko hi śastravidāṁ mukhyo maheśvarasamo yudhi,
śatruṁ na kṣapayecchakto yo na syād gautamīsutaḥ ॥89॥
7.159.90: tavāstragocare śaktāḥ sthātuṁ devā na dānavāḥ ॥90॥
7.159.92: ete hi somakā vipra pañcālāśca yaśasvinaḥ,
7.159.94: ādau vā yadi vā paścāt tavedaṁ karma māriṣa ॥94॥
7.159.96: evaṁ siddhā’bruvan vāco bhaviṣyati ca tat tathā,
7.159.97: na te’stragocare śaktāḥ sthātuṁ devāḥ savāsavāḥ,
kimu pārthāḥ sapāñcālāḥ satyametad bravīmi te ॥97॥
7.159.98: na tvāṁ samarthāḥ saṅgrāme pāṇḍavāḥ saha somakaiḥ,
balād yodhayituṁ vīra satyametad bravīmi te ॥98॥
7.159.99: gaccha gaccha mahābāho na naḥ kālātyayo bhavet,
7.159.100: śakto hyasi mahābāho divyena svena tejasā,
7.159.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe duryodhanavākye ekonaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥159॥
7.160.3: priyā hi pāṇḍavā nityaṁ mama cāpi pituśca me,
tathaivāvāṁ priyau teṣāṁ na tu yuddhe kurūdvaha ॥3॥
7.160.4: ahaṁ karṇaśca śalyaśca kr̥po hārdikya eva ca,
7.160.5: te cāpi kauravīṁ senāṁ nimeṣārdhāt kurūdvaha,
7.160.6: yudhyatāṁ pāṇḍavān śaktyā teṣāṁ cāsmān yuyutsatām,
7.160.7: jīvatsu pāṇḍuputreṣu taddhi satyaṁ bravīmi te ॥7॥
7.160.8: kimarthaṁ tava sainyāni na haniṣyanti bhārata ॥8॥
7.160.9: tvaṁ tu lubdhatamo rājan nikr̥tijñaśca kaurava,
7.160.10: manye tvaṁ kutsito rājan pāpātmā pāpapuruṣa,
anyānapi sa naḥ kṣudra śaṅkase pāpabhāvitaḥ ॥10॥
7.160.12: yotsye’haṁ śatrubhiḥ sārdhaṁ jeṣyāmi ca varān varān,
7.160.14: adya dharmasuto rājā dr̥ṣṭvā mama parākramam ॥14॥
7.160.16: dr̥ṣṭvā vinihatān saṅkhye pañcālān somakaiḥ saha,
ye māṁ yuddhe’bhiyotsyanti tān haniṣyāmi bhārata ॥16॥
7.160.17: na hi te vīra mokṣyante madbāhvantaramāgatāḥ,
7.160.21: dauṇiṁ prati mahārāja jalaṁ jaladharā iva,
7.160.23: parityajya raṇe dauṇiṁ vyadravanta diśo daśa,
tān dr̥ṣṭvā dravataḥ śūrān pañcālān sahasomakān ॥23॥
7.160.27: samāgaccha mayā sārdhaṁ yadi śūro’si saṁyuge,
7.160.29: te tu paṅktīkr̥tā drauṇiṁ śarā viviśurāśugāḥ,
7.160.34: na jānīṣe pratijñāṁ me viprotpattiṁ tathaiva ca ॥34॥
7.160.35: droṇaṁ hatvā kila mayā hantavyastvaṁ sudurmate,
tatastvāhaṁ na hanmyadya droṇe jīvati saṁyuge ॥35॥
7.160.37: yaste pārtheṣu vidveṣo yā bhaktiḥ kauraveṣu ca ॥37॥
7.160.38: tāṁ darśaya sthiro bhūtvā na me jīvan vimokṣyase,
7.160.39: sa vadhyaḥ sarvalokasya yathā tvaṁ puruṣādhamaḥ,
7.160.48: ayudhyetāṁ mahābāhū citraṁ laghu ca suṣṭhu ca,
7.160.49: tau prabuddhau raṇe dr̥ṣṭvā vane vanyau gajāviva,
7.160.55: śatena ca śataṁ hatvā pañcālānāṁ mahārathaḥ ॥55॥
7.160.57: te vadhyamānāḥ pañcālāḥ samare saha sr̥ñjayaiḥ ॥57॥
7.160.58: sa jitvā samare śatrūn droṇaputro mahārathaḥ ॥58॥
7.160.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe’śvatthāmaparākrame ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥160॥
7.161.10: ityāsīt tumulaḥ śabdaḥ śoṇāśvasya rathaṁ prati,
7.161.11: te hanyamānā droṇena pañcālāḥ prādravan bhayāt ॥11॥
7.161.16: tataḥ sā bhāratī senā hanyamānā kirīṭinā ॥16॥
7.161.17: droṇena vāryamāṇāste svayaṁ tava sutena ca ॥17॥
7.161.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe saṅkulayuddhe ekaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥161॥
7.162.1: somadattaṁ tu samprekṣya vidhunvānaṁ mahad dhanuḥ,
sātyakiḥ prāha yantāraṁ somadattāya māṁ vaha ॥1॥
7.162.2: na hyahatvā raṇe śatruṁ somadattaṁ mahābalam,
nivartiṣye raṇāt sūta satyametad vaco mama ॥2॥
7.162.23: somadattaṁ tu saṅkruddho raṇe vivyādha sātyakiḥ,
7.162.27: sa papāta dvidhā chinna āyasaḥ parigho mahān,
7.162.34: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nihataṁ tatra somadattaṁ mahārathāḥ,
7.162.37: sainyāni drāvayantaṁ tu droṇo dr̥ṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhiram,
7.162.45: ciccheda ca dhanurdīrghaṁ brāhmaṇasya ca pāṇḍavaḥ,
7.162.48: yatate hi sadā droṇo grahaṇe tava saṁyuge,
7.162.49: yo’sya sr̥ṣṭo vināśāya sa evainaṁ haniṣyati,
parivarjya guruṁ yāhi yatra rājā suyodhanaḥ ॥49॥
7.162.50: rājā rājñā hi yoddhavyo nārājñā yuddhamiṣyate,
7.162.54: parjanya iva gharmānte nādayan vai diśo daśa ॥54॥
7.162.55: bhīmasya nighnataḥ śatrūn pārṣṇiṁ jagrāha pāṇḍavaḥ,
7.162.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe dviṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥162॥
7.163.1: tamasā saṁvr̥te loke rajasā ca mahīpate ॥1॥
7.163.7: andhe tamasi mūḍhāni putrasya tava mantrite,
vyamuhyanta raṇe tatra tamasā saṁvr̥te sati ॥7॥
7.163.8: andhe tamasi magnānāmāsīt kiṁ vo manastadā ॥8॥
7.163.9: kathaṁ prakāśasteṣāṁ vā mama sainyasya vā punaḥ,
babhūva loke tamasā tathā sañjaya saṁvr̥te ॥9॥
7.163.10: tataḥ sarvāṇi sainyāni hataśiṣṭāni yāni vai,
7.163.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe dīpodyotane triṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥163॥
7.164.7: asajjanta tato vīrā vīreṣveva pr̥thak pr̥thak,
7.164.8: tasmin rātrimukhe ghore tava putrasya śāsanāt ॥8॥
7.164.10: tasmin praviṣṭe saṁrabdhe mama putrasya vāhinīm ॥10॥
7.164.13: droṇaṁ ca ke vyarakṣanta praviṣṭe śvetavāhane,
ke’rakṣan dakṣiṇaṁ cakraṁ ke ca droṇasya savyataḥ ॥13॥
7.164.17: hr̥ṣṭānudīrṇān saṅgrāme na tathā sūta māmakān ॥17॥
7.164.20: karṇaṁ ca vr̥ṣasenaṁ ca madrarājaṁ ca kaurava,
durdharṣaṁ dīrghabāhuṁ ca ye ca teṣāṁ padānugāḥ ॥20॥
7.164.21: droṇaṁ yattāḥ parākrāntāḥ sarve rakṣantu pr̥ṣṭhataḥ,
7.164.22: trigartānāṁ ca ye śūrā hataśiṣṭā mahārathāḥ,
7.164.23: ācāryo hi susaṁyatto bhr̥śaṁ yattāśca pāṇḍavāḥ,
taṁ rakṣata susaṁyattā nighnantaṁ śātravān raṇe ॥23॥
7.164.24: droṇo hi balavān yuddhe kṣiprahastaḥ pratāpavān,
nirjayet tridaśān yuddhe kimu pārthān sasomakān ॥24॥
7.164.25: te yūyaṁ sahitāḥ sarve bhr̥śaṁ yattā mahārathāḥ,
7.164.26: pāṇḍavīyeṣu sainyeṣu na taṁ paśyāma kañcana,
yo yodhayed raṇe droṇaṁ dhr̥ṣṭadyumnādr̥te nr̥paḥ ॥26॥
7.164.30: so’yaṁ mama jayo vyakto dīrghakālaṁ bhaviṣyati,
7.164.36: śrutaṁ vā yādr̥śaṁ yuddhamāsīd raudraṁ bhayānakam ॥36॥
7.164.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe saṅkulayuddhe catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥164॥
7.165.5: droṇaṁ prati samāyāntaṁ matto mattamiva dvipam ॥5॥
7.165.16: arjunaṁ ca yudhāṁ śreṣṭhaṁ prādravantaṁ mahāratham,
7.165.17: tathā droṇaṁ maheṣvāsaṁ nighnantaṁ śātravān raṇe,
7.165.25: dhanuściccheda bhallena taṁ ca vivyādha saptabhiḥ ॥25॥
7.165.28: tasya pārtho dhanuśchittvā hastāvāpaṁ nikr̥tya ca,
7.165.29: te tasya kavacaṁ bhittvā hemacitraṁ mahādhanam,
7.165.30: vivyādha pāṇḍavaṁ ṣaṣṭyā sūtaṁ ca navabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥30॥
7.165.31: cikṣepa bharataśreṣṭha rathe nyasya mahad dhanuḥ ॥31॥
7.165.33: etasminneva kāle tu gr̥hya pārthaḥ punardhanuḥ,
7.165.34: tatastu samare śūro vr̥ṣṇīnāṁ pravaro rathī,
7.165.35: tatastu pāṇḍavo jyeṣṭhaḥ khaḍgaṁ carma samādade,
7.165.36: tomaraṁ tu tato gr̥hya svarṇadaṇḍaṁ durāsadam,
7.165.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe yudhiṣṭhirāpayānaṁ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥165॥
7.166.1: bhūristu samare rājan śaineyaṁ rathināṁ varam,
7.166.2: vivyādha hr̥daye tasya prāsravat tasya śoṇitam ॥2॥
7.166.8: vivyādha hr̥daye tūrṇaṁ tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt ॥8॥
7.166.12: sa tu śaktyā vibhinnāṅgo nipapāta rathottamāt,
7.166.13: taṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvā hataṁ śūramaśvatthāmā mahārathaḥ,
7.166.14: tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābhāṣya śaineyaṁ sa narādhipa,
7.166.16: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha na me jīvan droṇaputra gamiṣyasi,
eṣa tvāṁ nihaniṣyāmi mahiṣaṁ ṣaṇmukho yathā ॥16॥
7.166.33: tato hāhākr̥taṁ sainyaṁ tava sarvaṁ janādhipa,
hataṁ sma menire sarve tāvakāstaṁ viśāmpate ॥33॥
7.166.37: sa bhittvā hr̥dayaṁ tasya rākṣasasya śarottamaḥ,
7.166.40: tathā tu samare viddhvā rākṣasendraṁ ghaṭotkacam,
7.166.45: atha duryodhano rājā bhīmaṁ vivyādha patribhiḥ,
7.166.46: tasya bhīmo dhanuśchittvā dhvajaṁ ca daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.166.52: dvitīyaṁ ca tr̥tīyaṁ ca caturthaṁ pañcamaṁ tathā,
7.166.53: sa tathā bhidyamāneṣu kārmukeṣu punaḥ punaḥ ॥53॥
7.166.55: aprāptāmeva tāṁ śaktiṁ tridhā ciccheda kauravaḥ ॥55॥
7.166.56: tato bhīmo mahārāja gadāṁ gurvīṁ mahāprabhām ॥56॥
7.166.57: tataḥ sā sahasā vāhāṁstava putrasya saṁyuge ॥57॥
7.166.58: sārathiṁ ca gadā gurvī mamardāsya rathaṁ punaḥ,
putrastu tava rājendra bhīmād bhītaḥ praṇaśya ca ॥58॥
7.166.59: tato bhīmo hataṁ matvā tava putraṁ mahāratham ॥59॥
7.166.61: teṣāṁ tu ninadaṁ śrutvā trastānāṁ sarvayodhinām,
bhīmasenasya nādaṁ ca śrutvā rājan mahātmanaḥ ॥61॥
7.166.62: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā hataṁ matvā suyodhanam,
7.166.64: tatrāsīt sumahad yuddhaṁ droṇasyātha paraiḥ saha,
7.166.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe duryodhanāpayāne ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥166॥
7.167.3: sajyaṁ cāsya dhanuḥ śīghraṁ ciccheda laghuhastavat ॥3॥
7.167.5: tasya karṇo hayān hatvā śaraiḥ saṁnataparvabhiḥ,
sārathiṁ cāsya bhallena drutaṁ ninye yamakṣayam ॥5॥
7.167.16: mā yudhyasva raṇe’dhīra viśiṣṭai rathibhiḥ saha ॥16॥
7.167.17: sadr̥śairyudhya mādreya vaco me mā viśaṅkithāḥ,
7.167.18: eṣo’rjuno raṇe tūrṇaṁ yudhyate kurubhiḥ saha,
tatra gacchasva mādreya gr̥haṁ vā yadi manyase ॥18॥
7.167.19: evamuktvā tu taṁ karṇo rathena rathināṁ varaḥ,
7.167.20: vadhaṁ prāptaṁ tu mādreyaṁ nāvadhīt samare’rihā,
kuntyāḥ smr̥tvā vaco rājan satyasandho mahāyaśāḥ ॥20॥
7.167.23: virāṭaṁ sahasenaṁ tu droṇaṁ vai drutamāgatam,
7.167.27: sūtaṁ dhvajaṁ ca samare śarābhyāṁ saṁnyapātayat ॥27॥
7.167.35: tataḥ sā mahatī senā prādravanniśi bhārata ॥35॥
7.167.37: prayātau tatra rājendra yatra śalyo vyavasthitaḥ,
tau tu pratyudyayau rājan rākṣasendro hyalambuṣaḥ ॥37॥
7.167.46: punaḥ sajyaṁ kr̥taṁ cāpaṁ tadapyasya dvidhācchinat,
7.167.47: pārtho’vidhyad rākṣasendraṁ sa viddhaḥ prādravad bhayāt ॥47॥
7.167.50: samprādravad balaṁ sarvaṁ putrāṇāṁ te viśāmpate ॥50॥
7.167.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe alambuṣaparābhave saptaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥167॥
7.168.2: sa tu taṁ prativivyādha daśabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥2॥
7.168.7: sa cchinnadhanvā samare vivarmā ca mahārathaḥ,
7.168.9: jaghāna caturo vāhān sārathiṁ ca narottamaḥ ॥9॥
7.168.11: tasya tatkurvataḥ karma nakulasya suto raṇe,
7.168.21: dvidhā ciccheda bhallena pītena niśitena ca ॥21॥
7.168.22: tūṇādākr̥ṣya vimalaṁ bhallaṁ pītaṁ śitaṁ dr̥ḍham ॥22॥
7.168.23: kārmuke yojayitvā taṁ drupadaṁ saṁnirīkṣya ca,
7.168.24: hr̥dayaṁ tasya bhittvā ca jagāma vasudhātalam,
7.168.26: samprādravat tadā rājan niśīthe bhairave sati ॥26॥
7.168.27: vyarājata mahī rājan vītābhrā dyauriva grahaiḥ ॥27॥
7.168.33: sa vijitya raṇe śūrān somakānāṁ mahārathān,
7.168.36: prativindhyaṁ tu samare kurvāṇaṁ karma duṣkaram,
7.168.39: tatra bhārata putraste kr̥tavān karma duṣkaram,
7.168.40: sārathiṁ cāsya bhallena dhvajaṁ ca samapātayat,
rathaṁ ca tilaśo rājan vyadhamat tasya dhanvinaḥ ॥40॥
7.168.41: patākāśca satūṇīrā raśmīn yoktrāṇi ca prabho,
7.168.44: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā virathaṁ tatra bhrātaro’sya mahārathāḥ,
7.168.45: āplutaḥ sa tato yānaṁ sutasomasya bhāsvaram,
7.168.46: tatastu tāvakāḥ sarve parivārya sutaṁ tava,
7.168.47: tataḥ pravavr̥te yuddhaṁ tava teṣāṁ ca bhārata,
7.169.1: nakulaṁ rabhasaṁ yuddhe nighnantaṁ vāhinīṁ tava,
7.169.10: nakulastu bhr̥śaṁ viddhaḥ śyālena tava dhanvinā,
7.169.14: dhvajaṁ ca tvaritaṁ chittvā rathād bhūmāvapātayat ॥14॥
7.169.15: viśikhena ca tīkṣṇena pītena niśitena ca,
7.169.16: śyenaṁ sapakṣaṁ vyādhena pātayāmāsa taṁ tadā,
7.169.17: taṁ visañjñaṁ nipatitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā śyālaṁ tavānagha ॥17॥
7.169.18: tataḥ sañcukruśuḥ pārthā ye ca teṣāṁ padānugāḥ ॥18॥
7.169.19: nirjitya ca raṇe śatruṁ nakulaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ,
abravīt sārathiṁ kruddho droṇānīkāya māṁ vaha ॥19॥
7.169.20: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā mādrīputrasya sārathiḥ,
prāyāt tena tadā rājan yatra droṇo vyavasthitaḥ ॥20॥
7.169.27: śikhaṇḍī tu mahārāja gautamasya mahad dhanuḥ ॥27॥
7.169.28: tasya kruddhaḥ kr̥po rājan śaktiṁ cikṣepa dāruṇām ॥28॥
7.169.33: vimukhaṁ tu raṇe dr̥ṣṭvā yājñaseniṁ mahāratham ॥33॥
7.169.36: dravatāṁ sādināṁ caiva gajānāṁ ca viśāmpate ॥36॥
7.169.39: agr̥hṇan bahavo rājan śalabhān vāyasā iva,
7.169.40: tasminneva pade yattā nigr̥hṇanti sma bhārata,
7.169.42: babhūva tatra sainyānāṁ śabdaḥ suvipulo niśi,
7.169.44: ādityena yathā vyāptaṁ tamo loke praṇaśyati ॥44॥
7.169.46: rajasā tamasā vyāptā dyotitāḥ prabhayā punaḥ,
astrāṇāṁ kavacānāṁ ca maṇīnāṁ ca mahātmanām ॥46॥
7.169.49: putraśca pitaraṁ mohāt sakhāyaṁ ca sakhā tathā,
7.169.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe saṅkulayuddhe ekonasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥169॥
7.170.2: sandadhāno dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṁ jyāṁ vikarṣan punaḥ punaḥ,
7.170.6: tato droṇaṁ mahārāja pāñcālyaḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
vivyādha hr̥daye tūrṇaṁ siṁhanādaṁ nanāda ca ॥6॥
7.170.7: taṁ droṇaḥ pañcaviṁśatyā viddhvā bhārata saṁyuge,
7.170.11: sa visr̥ṣṭo balavatā śaro ghoro mahāmr̥dhe,
7.170.12: taṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvā śaraṁ ghoraṁ devagandharvamānavāḥ,
7.170.14: sa cchinno bahudhā rājan sūtaputreṇa dhanvinā,
7.170.15: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ tataḥ karṇo vivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.170.18: droṇaṁ drauṇiṁ ca karṇaṁ ca vivyādha ca tavātmajam ॥18॥
7.170.19: te bhinnā dhanvinā tena dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ punarmr̥dhe,
7.170.24: tān sa viddhvā punaryodhān vīraḥ suniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
7.170.25: na tu tanmamr̥ṣe karṇo dhanuṣaśchedanaṁ tathā,
7.170.27: dr̥ṣṭvā karṇaṁ tu saṁrabdhaṁ te vīrāḥ ṣaḍratharṣabhāḥ,
7.170.29: etasminneva kāle tu dāśārho vikiran śarān,
7.170.32: sa sātyakestu balinaḥ karṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ,
7.170.38: astrairastrāṇi saṁvārya teṣāṁ karṇasya vā vibho,
7.170.39: nyapatat sa rathe mūḍho dhanurutsr̥jya vīryavān ॥39॥
7.170.40: tataḥ karṇo hataṁ matvā vr̥ṣasenaṁ mahāratham,
7.170.41: vivyādha bahubhiḥ karṇaṁ tvaramāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥41॥
7.170.42: sa karṇaṁ daśabhirviddhvā vr̥ṣasenaṁ ca saptabhiḥ,
7.170.45: śrutvā tu rathanirghoṣaṁ gāṇḍīvasya ca niḥsvanam,
7.170.46: eṣa sarvāṁ camūṁ hatvā mukhyāṁścaiva nararṣabhān,
7.170.48: eṣā vidāryate rājan bahudhā bhāratī camūḥ ॥48॥
7.170.51: viddhānāṁ śataśo rājan śrūyate niḥsvano mahān,
7.170.53: ayaṁ madhye sthito’smākaṁ sātyakiḥ sātvatāṁ varaḥ ॥53॥
7.170.54: iha cellabhyate lakṣyaṁ kr̥tsnān jeṣyāmahe parān,
7.170.55: sātyakiṁ yadi hanyāma dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca pārṣatam ॥55॥
7.170.56: asaṁśayaṁ mahārāja dhruvo no vijayo bhavet,
7.170.59: yāvat pārtho na jānāti sātyakiṁ bahubhirvr̥tam,
te tvaradhvaṁ tathā śūrāḥ śarāṇāṁ mokṣaṇe bhr̥śam ॥59॥
7.170.61: yathendraḥ samare rājan prāha viṣṇuṁ yaśasvinam ॥61॥
7.170.64: jahi kr̥ṣṇau mahābāho dharmarājaṁ ca mātula,
nakulaṁ sahadevaṁ ca bhīmasenaṁ tathaiva ca ॥64॥
7.170.65: devānāmiva devendre jayāśā tvayi me sthitā,
7.170.66: evamukto yayau pārthān putreṇa tava saubalaḥ,
mahatyā senayā sārdhaṁ saha putraiśca te vibho ॥66॥
7.170.67: tataḥ pravavr̥te yuddhaṁ tāvakānāṁ paraiḥ saha ॥67॥
7.170.69: abhyayāt tvarito yuddhe kiran śaraśatān bahūn,
7.170.70: mahad yuddhaṁ tadā’’sīt tu droṇasya niśi bhārata,
7.170.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe saṅkulayuddhe saptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥170॥
7.171.11: śrutvā ca vipulaṁ nādaṁ niśīthe lomaharṣaṇe ॥11॥
7.171.17: pañcālānāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ bharatānāṁ ca dāruṇam ॥17॥
7.171.19: sārathiṁ ca rathāt tūrṇaṁ pātayāmāsa patriṇā ॥19॥
7.171.20: hatāśve tu rathe tiṣṭhan putrastava viśāmpate,
mumoca niśitān bāṇān śaineyasya rathaṁ prati ॥20॥
7.171.22: ciccheda tarasā yuddhe tava putrasya mādhavaḥ ॥22॥
7.171.38: ninye ca caturo vāhān yamasya sadanaṁ prati,
7.171.40: tau tu viddhvā mahārāja pāṇḍavo niśitaiḥśaraiḥ ॥40॥
7.171.42: tad balaṁ bharataśreṣṭha vadhyamānaṁ tadā niśi ॥42॥
7.171.45: dhr̥ṣṭadyumno mahārāja droṇaṁ viddhvā tribhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥45॥
7.171.46: ciccheda dhanuṣastūrṇaṁ jyāṁ śareṇa śitena ha,
7.171.51: drāvayitvā tu tat sainyaṁ dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaḥ pratāpavān ॥51॥
7.171.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe saṅkulayuddhe ekasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥171॥
7.172.2: abhyetya sahasā karṇaṁ droṇaṁ ca jayatāṁ varam,
7.172.5: yadyahaṁ bhavatostyājyo na vācyo’smi tadaiva hi,
āvāṁ pāṇḍusutān saṅkhye jeṣyāva iti mānadau ॥5॥
7.172.8: vākpratodena tau vīrau praṇunnau tanayena te,
7.172.13: dr̥ṣṭvā ca samare droṇaṁ nighnantaṁ pāṇḍavīṁ camūm ॥13॥
7.172.18: pāṇḍavānāṁ raṇe yodhāḥ paralokaṁ gatāḥ pare ॥18॥
7.172.19: sā tathā pāṇḍavī senā pīḍyamānā mahātmanā,
7.172.21: tamasā saṁvr̥te loke na prājñāyata kiñcana,
7.172.22: dravamāṇaṁ tu tat sainyaṁ droṇakarṇau mahārathau,
jaghnatuḥ pr̥ṣṭhato rājan kirantau sāyakān bahūn ॥22॥
7.172.26: tāṁ tu vidravatīṁ dr̥ṣṭvā ūcatuḥ keśavārjunau,
mā vidravata vitrastā bhayaṁ tyajata pāṇḍavāḥ ॥26॥
7.172.27: droṇaṁ ca sūtaputraṁ ca prayatāvaḥ prabādhitum ॥27॥
7.172.28: etau hi balinau śūrau kr̥tāstrau jitakāśinau,
7.172.40: yatra yatra sma dr̥śyane pradīpāḥ kurusattama,
tatra tatra sma śūrāste nipatanti pataṅgavat ॥40॥
7.172.41: pāṇḍavānāṁ ca rājendra kauravāṇāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ ॥41॥
7.172.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe saṅkulayuddhe dvisaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥172॥
7.173.1: tataḥ karṇo raṇe dr̥ṣṭvā pārṣataṁ paravīrahā,
7.173.10: dr̥ṣṭvā vinirjitaṁ yuddhe pārṣataṁ te mahārathāḥ,
7.173.16: bāhū ciccheda vai karṇaḥ śiraścaiva sakuṇḍalam ॥16॥
7.173.19: te vadhyamānāḥ samare pañcālāḥ sr̥ñjayaiḥ saha,
7.173.20: api svaṁ samare yodhaṁ dhāvamānaṁ vicetasam,
7.173.21: abhyadravad drutaṁ karṇaḥ pr̥ṣṭhato vikiran śarān ॥21॥
7.173.23: droṇena ca diśaḥ sarvā vīkṣamāṇāḥ pradudruvuḥ ॥23॥
7.173.24: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā svasainyaṁ prekṣya vidrutam,
7.173.27: paśyāmi nāntaraṁ pārtha kṣapayiṣyati no dhruvam ॥27॥
7.173.30: bhavān vyavasyatu kṣipraṁ dravate hi varūthinī ॥30॥
7.173.34: sa bhavāṁstatra yātvāśu yatra karṇo mahārathaḥ,
7.173.36: r̥te tvāṁ puruṣavyāghra rākṣasād vā ghaṭotkacāt ॥36॥
7.173.37: na tu tāvadahaṁ manye prāptakālaṁ tavānagha,
7.173.39: rakṣyate śaktireṣā hi raudraṁ rūpaṁ bibharti ca,
7.173.40: sa hi bhīmena balinā jātaḥ suraparākramaḥ,
7.173.41: satataṁ cānurakto vo hitaiṣī ca ghaṭotkacaḥ,
vijeṣyati raṇe karṇamiti me nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥41॥
7.173.43: kavacī saśaraḥ khaḍgī sadhanvā ca viśāmpate,
abhivādya tataḥ kr̥ṣṇaṁ pāṇḍavaṁ ca dhanañjayam,
7.173.45: ghaṭotkaca vijānīhi yat tvāṁ vakṣyāmi putraka,
7.173.46: sa bhavān majjamānānāṁ bandhūnāṁ tvaṁ plavo bhava,
vividhāni tavāstrāṇi santi māyā ca rākṣasī ॥46॥
7.173.52: sa tvaṁ kuru mahābāho karma yuktamihātmanaḥ,
7.173.53: kathaṁ nastārayed duḥkhāt sa tvaṁ tāraya bāndhavān ॥53॥
7.173.54: ihalokāt pare loke tārayiṣyanti ye hitāḥ ॥54॥
7.173.55: tava hyatra balaṁ bhīmaṁ māyāśca tava dustarāḥ,
7.173.58: jahi karṇaṁ maheṣvāsaṁ niśīthe māyayā raṇe,
7.173.61: tadbhavān yātu karṇena dvairathaṁ yudhyatāṁ niśi,
7.173.62: jahi karṇaṁ raṇe śūraṁ sātvatena sahāyavān,
7.173.62d1: evameva mahābāho yathā vadasi māṁ prabho,
7.173.64: adya dāsyāmi saṅgrāmaṁ sūtaputrāya taṁ niśi,
7.173.65: na cātra śūrān mokṣyāmi na bhītānna kr̥tāñjalīn,
7.173.66: abhyayāt tumule karṇaṁ tava sainyaṁ vibhīṣayan ॥66॥
7.173.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe ghaṭotkacaprotsāhane trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥173॥
7.174.1: āyāntaṁ tu tathā yuktaṁ jighāṁsuṁ karṇamāhave ॥1॥
7.174.2: etad rakṣo raṇe tūrṇaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā karṇasya vikramam ॥2॥
7.174.3: abhiyāti drutaṁ karṇaṁ tad vāraya mahāratham,
vr̥taḥ sainyena mahatā yāhi yatra mahābalaḥ ॥3॥
7.174.4: rakṣa karṇaṁ raṇe yatto vr̥taḥ sainyena mānada ॥4॥
7.174.7: jaṭāsuro mama pitā rakṣasāṁ grāmaṇīḥ purā ॥7॥
7.174.9: tamabravīt tato rājā prīyamāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ,
7.174.10: tvaṁ tu gaccha mayā’’jñapto jahi yuddhe ghaṭotkacam,
7.174.13: alambuṣaṁ ca karṇaṁ ca kurusainyaṁ ca dustaram,
7.174.33: hayābhyāṁ ca gajābhyāṁ ca rathābhyāṁ ca padātibhiḥ ॥33॥
7.174.39: abhyetya ca mahābāhuḥ smayamānaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ ॥39॥
7.174.41: eṣa te nihato bandhustvayā dr̥ṣṭo’sya vikramaḥ ॥41॥
7.174.43: tiṣṭhasva tāvat suprīto yāvat karṇaṁ vadhāmyaham ॥43॥
7.174.44: evamuktvā tataḥ prāyāt karṇaṁ prati nareśvara,
7.174.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe alambuṣavadhe catuḥsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥174॥
7.175.2: kīdr̥śaṁ cābhavad rūpaṁ tasya ghorasya rakṣasaḥ,
7.175.3: kīdr̥śaṁ varma caivāsya śirastrāṇaṁ ca kīdr̥śam ॥3॥
7.175.11: dhārayan vipulaṁ kāṁsyaṁ kavacaṁ ca mahāprabham,
7.175.28: sañchindantau ca gātrāṇi sandadhānau ca sāyakān ॥28॥
7.175.33: dhanurghoṣeṇa vitrastāḥ sve pare ca tadābhavan,
ghaṭotkacaṁ yadā karṇo viśeṣayati no nr̥pa ॥33॥
7.175.43: visasarja śarān ghorān sūtaputraṁ ta āviśan,
7.175.53: tasya sarvān hayān hatvā sañchidya śatadhā ratham ॥53॥
7.175.55: na hayānna rathaṁ tasya na dhvajaṁ na ghaṭotkacam ॥55॥
7.175.56: sa tu karṇasya tad divyamastramastreṇa śātayan ॥56॥
7.175.57: so’yodhayat tadā karṇaṁ māyayā lāghavena ca ॥57॥
7.175.59: sa tu kr̥tvā virūpāṇi vadanānyaśubhāni ca ॥59॥
7.175.61: taṁ hataṁ manyamānāḥ sma prāṇadan kurupuṅgavāḥ ॥61॥
7.175.63: aṅguṣṭhamātro bhūtvā ca punareva sa rākṣasaḥ ॥63॥
7.175.66: kṣitiṁ khaṁ ca diśaścaiva māyayābhyetya daṁśitaḥ,
7.175.67: tiṣṭhedānīṁ kva me jīvan sūtaputra gamiṣyasi ॥67॥
7.175.71: śaravr̥ṣṭiṁ ca tāṁ karṇo dūrāt prāptāmaśātayat,
dr̥ṣṭvā ca vihatāṁ māyāṁ karṇena bharatarṣabha ॥71॥
7.175.75: tataḥ so’streṇa śailendro vikṣipto vai vyanaśyata,
tataḥ sa toyado bhūtvā nīlaḥ sendrāyudho divi ॥75॥
7.175.77: vyadhamat kālameghaṁ taṁ karṇo vaikartano vr̥ṣaḥ,
sa mārgaṇagaṇaiḥ karṇo diśaḥ pracchādya sarvaśaḥ ॥77॥
7.175.79: sa dr̥ṣṭvā punarāyāntaṁ rathena rathināṁ varam ॥79॥
7.175.89: sa hatvā rākṣasīṁ senāṁ śuśubhe sūtanandanaḥ,
pureva tripuraṁ dagdhvā divi devo maheśvaraḥ ॥89॥
7.175.94: sa sūtamabravīt kruddhaḥ sūtaputrāya māṁ vaha ॥94॥
7.175.95: sa yayau ghorarūpeṇa rathena rathināṁ varaḥ,
7.175.96: sa cikṣepa punaḥ kruddhaḥ sūtaputrāya rākṣasaḥ,
7.175.98: tāmavaplutya jagrāha karṇo nyasya mahad dhanuḥ,
7.175.101: evaṁ kr̥tvā raṇe karṇa āruroha rathaṁ punaḥ,
7.175.104: evaṁ sa vai mahākāyo māyayā lāghavena ca,
7.175.112: pratihatya tu tāṁ māyāṁ divyenāstreṇa rākṣasīm,
7.175.114: sa bhagnamāyo haiḍimbiḥ karṇaṁ vaikartanaṁ tadā,
7.175.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe karṇaghaṭotkacayuddhe pañcasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥175॥
7.176.3: tasya jñātirhi vikrānto brāhmaṇādo bako hataḥ ॥3॥
7.176.5: sa matta iva mātaṅgaḥ saṅkruddha iva coragaḥ ॥5॥
7.176.6: viditaṁ te mahārāja yathā bhīmena rākṣasāḥ ॥6॥
7.176.10: nivāraya balaṁ sarvaṁ vayaṁ yotsyāma pāṇḍavān ॥10॥
7.176.12: tvāṁ puraskr̥tya sagaṇaṁ vayaṁ yotsyāmahe parān,
na hi vairāntamanasaḥ sthāsyanti mama sainikāḥ ॥12॥
7.176.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe’lāyudhayuddhe ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥176॥
7.177.4d1: na drauṇirna kr̥po droṇo na śalyo na ca mādhavaḥ,
eka eva tu tenāsīd yoddhā karṇo raṇe vr̥ṣā.
7.177.6: tat karma dr̥ṣṭvā sambhrāntā haiḍimbasya raṇājire ॥6॥
7.177.11: tavaiṣa bhāgaḥ samare rājamadhye mayā kr̥taḥ,
7.177.13: evamuktaḥ sa rājñā tu rākṣaso bhīmavikramaḥ,
7.177.27: sa taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā rākṣasendraṁ bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ ॥27॥
7.177.30: te cāpi rākṣasāḥ sarve rajanyāṁ bhīmarūpiṇaḥ ॥30॥
7.177.32: taṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvā mahāghoraṁ vartamānaṁ mahāhavam ॥32॥
7.177.36: itarān rākṣasān ghnantu śāsanāt tava pāṇḍava,
7.177.41: tasmai gurvīṁ gadāṁ ghorāṁ vinadannutsasarja ha,
7.177.42: gadayā rākṣaso ghoro nijaghāna nanāda ca,
tad dr̥ṣṭvā rākṣasendrasya ghoraṁ karma bhayāvaham ॥42॥
7.177.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe’lāyudhayuddhe saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥177॥
7.178.3: jahi kṣipraṁ mahābāho paścāt karṇaṁ vadhiṣyasi ॥3॥
7.178.5: tayoḥ sutumulaṁ yuddhaṁ babhūva niśi rakṣasoḥ,
7.178.10: abhyayāt tvaritaḥ karṇaṁ viśikhān prakiran raṇe ॥10॥
7.178.12: te karṇaṁ yodhayāmāsuḥ pañcālā droṇameva tu,
7.178.15: sā hayāṁśca rathaṁ cāsya sārathiṁ ca mahāsvanā,
7.178.17: sa samāsthāya māyāṁ tu vavarṣa rudhiraṁ bahu,
7.178.19: tāṁ prekṣya mahatīṁ māyāṁ rākṣaso rākṣasasya ca,
7.178.20: so’bhivīkṣya hatāṁ māyāṁ māyāvī māyayaiva hi,
7.178.21: aśmavarṣaṁ sa taṁ ghoraṁ śaravarṣeṇa vīryavān,
7.178.35: atīva sā niśā teṣāṁ babhūva vijayāvahā,
7.178.39: dhruvaṁ sa tena hantavya ityamanyata pārthivaḥ,
7.178.40: sa taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā vinihataṁ bhīmasenātmajena vai,
7.179.1: nanāda vividhān nādān vāhinyāḥ pramukhe tava ॥1॥
7.179.2: tasya taṁ tumulaṁ śabdaṁ śrutvā kuñjarakampanam,
7.179.18: ghaṭotkacaṁ yadā karṇo na viśeṣayate nr̥pa,
7.179.22: na vai kiñcit prāpatat tatra bhūtaṁ
7.179.57: sā tāṁ māyāṁ bhasma kr̥tvā jvalantī
7.179.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe ghaṭotkacavadhe ekonāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥179॥
7.180.6: śokasthāne tu samprāpte haiḍimbasya vadhena tu ॥6॥
7.180.8: tadadya śaṁsa me pr̥ṣṭaḥ satyaṁ satyavatāṁ vara ॥8॥
7.180.11: atiharṣamimaṁ prāptaṁ śr̥ṇu me tvaṁ dhanañjaya,
7.180.13: śaktihastaṁ punaḥ karṇaṁ ko loke’sti pumāniha,
7.180.15: yadi hi syāt sakavacastathaiva syāt sakuṇḍalaḥ,
7.180.16: vāsavo vā kubero vā varuṇo vā jaleśvaraḥ,
yamo vā notsahet karṇaṁ raṇe pratisamāsitum ॥16॥
7.180.17: na śaktau svo raṇe jetuṁ tathāyuktaṁ nararṣabham ॥17॥
7.180.19: utkr̥tya kavacaṁ yasmāt kuṇḍale vimale ca te,
prādācchakrāya karṇo vai tena vaikartanaḥ smr̥taḥ ॥19॥
7.180.20: tathādya bhāti karṇo me śāntajvāla ivānalaḥ ॥20॥
7.180.22: tāṁ prāpyāmanyata vr̥ṣaḥ satataṁ tvāṁ hataṁ raṇe ॥22॥
7.180.23: r̥te tvāṁ puruṣavyāghra śape satyena cānagha ॥23॥
7.180.24: ripuṣvapi dayāvāṁśca tasmāt karṇo vr̥ṣaḥ smr̥taḥ ॥24॥
7.180.25: kesarīva vane nardan mātaṅga iva yūthapān ॥25॥
7.180.26: madhyaṁ gata ivādityo yo na śakyo nirīkṣitum ॥26॥
7.180.31: hanyāḥ pūrvaṁ tvaṁ tu sañjñāṁ vicārya ॥31॥
7.180.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe ghaṭotkacavadhe śrīkr̥ṣṇaharṣe’śītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥180॥
7.181.4: te hi vīrā maheṣvāsāḥ kr̥tāstrā dr̥ḍhayodhinaḥ,
7.181.6: yogairapi hatā yaiste tanme śr̥ṇu dhanañjaya,
ajayyā hi vinā yogairmr̥dhe te daivatairapi ॥6॥
7.181.7: ekaiko hi pr̥thak teṣāṁ samastāṁ suravāhinīm,
7.181.12: tatra sā rākṣasī ghorā jarānāmnī suvikramā,
7.181.13: dvābhyāṁ jāto hi mātr̥bhyāmardhadehaḥ pr̥thak pr̥thak,
7.181.14: sā tu bhūmiṁ gatā pārtha hatā sasutabāndhavā,
7.181.16: sendrā devā na taṁ hantuṁ raṇe śaktā narottama ॥16॥
7.181.21: tvaddhitārthaṁ tu sa mayā hataḥ saṅgrāmamūrdhani,
7.181.25: yadi hyenaṁ nāhaniṣyat karṇaḥ śaktyā mahāmr̥dhe ॥25॥
7.181.27: eṣa hi brāhmaṇadveṣī yajñadveṣī ca rākṣasaḥ,
7.181.28: ye hi dharmasya loptāro vadhyāste mama pāṇḍava ॥28॥
7.181.29: brahma satyaṁ damaḥ śaucaṁ dharmo hrīḥ śrīrdhr̥tiḥ kṣamā ॥29॥
7.181.30: yatra tatra rame nityamahaṁ satyena te śape,
na viṣādastvayā kāryaḥ karṇaṁ vaikartanaṁ prati ॥30॥
7.181.32: tasyāpi ca vadhopāyaṁ vakṣyāmi tava pāṇḍava,
7.181.33: vidravanti ca sainyāni tvadīyāni diśo daśa,
labdhalakṣyā hi kauravyā vidhamanti camūṁ tava,
dahatyeṣa ca vaḥ sainyaṁ droṇaḥ praharatāṁ varaḥ ॥33॥
7.181.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe kr̥ṣṇavākye ekāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥181॥
7.182.1: kasmāt sarvān samutsr̥jya sa tāṁ pārthe na muktavān ॥1॥
7.182.2: tasmin hate hatā hi syuḥ sarve pāṇḍavasr̥ñjayāḥ,
7.182.4: jaghāna na vr̥ṣaḥ kasmāt tanmamācakṣva sañjaya ॥4॥
7.182.5: śatrubhirvyaṁsitaḥ pāpaḥ kathaṁ nu sa jayedarīn ॥5॥
7.182.6: yā hyasya paramā śaktirjayasya ca parāyaṇam,
7.182.13: tadaiva kr̥takāryā hi vayaṁ syāma kurūdvaha,
na rakṣed yadi kr̥ṣṇastaṁ pārthaṁ karṇānmahārathāt ॥13॥
7.182.17: virodhī ca kumantrī ca prājñamānī mamātmajaḥ,
7.182.18: sa vā karṇo mahābuddhiḥ sarvaśastrabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ,
na muktavān kathaṁ sūta tāmamoghāṁ dhanañjaye ॥18॥
7.182.23: kr̥ṣṇo hi mūlaṁ pāpaḍūnāṁ pārthaḥ skandha ivodgataḥ,
7.182.25: tasmāt parṇāni śākhāśca skandhaṁ cotsr̥jya sūtaja,
kr̥ṣṇaṁ hi viddhi pāṇḍūnāṁ mūlaṁ sarvatra sarvadā ॥25॥
7.182.26: hanyād yadi hi dāśārhaṁ karṇo yādavanandanam,
kr̥tsnā vasumatī rājan vaśe tasya na saṁśayaḥ ॥26॥
7.182.27: yadi hi sa nihataḥ śayīta bhūmau
7.182.28: sā tu buddhiḥ kr̥tāpyevaṁ jāgrati tridaśeśvare,
7.182.29: arjunaṁ cāpi rādheyāt sadā rakṣati keśavaḥ,
na hyenamaicchat pramukhe sauteḥ sthāpayituṁ raṇe ॥29॥
7.182.30: amoghāṁ tāṁ kathaṁ śaktiṁ moghāṁ kuryāmiti prabho ॥30॥
7.182.31: yaścaivaṁ rakṣate pārthaṁ karṇāt kr̥ṣṇo mahāmanāḥ,
ātmānaṁ sa kathaṁ rājan na rakṣet puruṣottamaḥ ॥31॥
7.182.32: na so’sti triṣu lokeṣu yo jayeta janārdanam ॥32॥
7.182.34: kimarthaṁ sūtaputreṇa na muktā phālgune tu sā ॥34॥
7.182.36: nānyasya śaktireṣā te moktavyā jayatāṁ vara ॥36॥
7.182.38: tasmin vinihate pārthe pāṇḍavāḥ sr̥ñjayaiḥ saha,
7.182.39: hr̥di nityaṁ ca karṇasya vadho gāṇḍīvadhanvanaḥ ॥39॥
7.182.40: ahameva tu rādheyaṁ mohayāmi yudhāṁ vara,
7.182.41: na nidrā na ca me harṣo manaso’sti yudhāṁ vara ॥41॥
7.182.42: ghaṭotkace vyaṁsitāṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvā tāṁ śinipuṅgava,
7.182.43: na pitā na ca me mātā na yūyaṁ bhrātarastathā,
na ca prāṇāstathā rakṣyā yathā bībhatsurāhave ॥43॥
7.182.44: neccheyaṁ sātvatāhaṁ tad vinā pārthaṁ dhanañjayam ॥44॥
7.182.46: ataśca prahito yuddhe mayā karṇāya rākṣasaḥ,
na hyanyaḥ samare rātrau śaktaḥ karṇaṁ prabādhitum ॥46॥
7.182.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe kr̥ṣṇavākye dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥182॥
7.183.1: apanītaṁ mahat tāta tava caiva viśeṣataḥ ॥1॥
7.183.2: yadi jānītha tāṁ śaktimekaghnīṁ satataṁ raṇe,
7.183.3: sā kimarthaṁ tu karṇena pravr̥tte samare purā,
na devakīsute muktā phālgune vāpi sañjaya ॥3॥
7.183.5: śaktireṣā hi moktavyā karṇa karṇeti nityaśaḥ ॥5॥
7.183.6: anyeṣāṁ caiva yodhānāṁ sā buddhirnāśyate punaḥ ॥6॥
7.183.7: daivameva paraṁ manye yat karṇo hastasaṁsthayā,
na jaghāna raṇe pārthaṁ kr̥ṣṇaṁ vā devakīsutam ॥7॥
7.183.9: pārthe vā śakrakalpe vai vadhārthaṁ vāsavīṁ prabho ॥9॥
7.183.10: gatā hi vāsavī hatvā tr̥ṇabhūtaṁ ghaṭotkacam ॥10॥
7.183.11: karṇaśca mama putrāśca sarve cānye ca pārthivāḥ,
7.183.12: bhūya eva tu me śaṁsa yathā yuddhamavartata,
kurūṇāṁ pāṇḍavānāṁ ca haiḍimbe nihate tadā ॥12॥
7.183.13: ye ca te’bhyadravan droṇaṁ vyūḍhānīkāḥ prahāriṇaḥ,
7.183.17: samārcchan māmakā yuddhe kathaṁ sañjaya śaṁsa me ॥17॥
7.183.18: amarṣitāḥ susaṅkruddhā raṇaṁ cakruḥ kathaṁ niśi ॥18॥
7.183.19: hate ghaṭotkace rājan karṇena niśi rākṣase,
7.183.20: āpatatsu ca vegena vadhyamāne bale’pi ca,
vigāḍhāyāṁ rajanyāṁ ca rājā dainyaṁ paraṁ gataḥ ॥20॥
7.183.23: kaśmalaṁ prāviśad ghoraṁ dr̥ṣṭvā karṇasya vikramam ॥23॥
7.183.24: taṁ tathā vyathitaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kr̥ṣṇo vacanamabravīt,
mā vyathāṁ kuru kaunteya naitat tvayyupapadyate ॥24॥
7.183.25: uttiṣṭha rājan yuddhyasva vaha gurvīṁ dhuraṁ vibho ॥25॥
7.183.27: viditā me mahābāho dharmāṇāṁ paramā gatiḥ ॥27॥
7.183.28: brahmahatyā phalaṁ tasya yaiḥ kr̥taṁ nāvabudhyate,
7.183.29: bālenāpi satā tena kr̥taṁ sāhyaṁ janārdana,
7.183.32: madarthe duṣkaraṁ karma kr̥taṁ tena mahāhave ॥32॥
7.183.33: svabhāvād yā ca me prītiḥ sahadeve janārdana,
saiva me paramā prītī rākṣasendre ghaṭotkace ॥33॥
7.183.34: bhaktaśca me mahābāhuḥ priyo’syāhaṁ priyaśca me,
7.183.35: droṇakarṇau tu saṁyattau paśya yuddhe mahārathau ॥35॥
7.183.37: citrāstratāṁ ca pārthasya vikramanti sma kauravāḥ ॥37॥
7.183.38: eṣa droṇaśca karṇaśca rājā caiva suyodhanaḥ,
nihatya rākṣasaṁ yuddhe hr̥ṣṭāḥ nardanti saṁyuge ॥38॥
7.183.39: kathaṁ vāsmāsu jīvatsu tvayi caiva janārdana,
7.183.41: nāsīt tatra raṇe kr̥ṣṇa savyasācī mahārathaḥ ॥41॥
7.183.43: vyāyacchataśca khaḍgena dvidhā khaḍgaṁ cakāra ha ॥43॥
7.183.45: alpe ca kāraṇe kr̥ṣṇa hato gāṇḍīvadhanvanā ॥45॥
7.183.46: yadi śatruvadho nyāyyo bhavet kartuṁ hi pāṇḍavaiḥ ॥46॥
7.183.47: karṇadroṇau raṇe pūrvaṁ hantavyāviti me matiḥ,
7.183.48: yatra vadhyo bhaved droṇaḥ sūtaputraśca sānugaḥ ॥48॥
7.183.49: avaśyaṁ tu mayā kāryaḥ sūtaputrasya nigrahaḥ ॥49॥
7.183.51: sa visphārya mahaccāpaṁ śaṅkhaṁ pradhmāpya bhairavam ॥51॥
7.183.59: na cāgād dvairathaṁ jiṣṇurdiṣṭyā tena mahāraṇe ॥59॥
7.183.61: vāsavīṁ samare śaktiṁ dhruvaṁ muñced yudhiṣṭhira,
tato bhavet te vyasanaṁ ghoraṁ bharatasattama ॥61॥
7.183.62: diṣṭyā rakṣo hataṁ yuddhe sūtaputreṇa mānada,
7.183.63: tavaiva kāraṇād rakṣo nihataṁ tāta saṁyuge,
mā krudho bharataśreṣṭha mā ca śoke manaḥ kr̥thāḥ ॥63॥
7.183.65: pañcame divase tāta pr̥thivī te bhaviṣyati ॥65॥
7.183.66: ānr̥śaṁsyaṁ tapo dānaṁ kṣamāṁ satyaṁ ca pāṇḍava ॥66॥
7.183.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi ghaṭotkacavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe vyāsavākye tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥183॥
7.184.2: ghaṭotkace tu nihate sūtaputreṇa tāṁ niśām,
7.184.3: dr̥ṣṭvā bhīmena mahatīṁ vāryamāṇāṁ camūṁ tava,
7.184.4: saśaraḥ kavacī khaḍgī dhanvī ca paratāpanaḥ ॥4॥
7.184.5: abhidrava raṇe hr̥ṣṭo mā ca te bhīḥ kathañcana,
7.184.8: tathaiva rathinaḥ sarve hastyaśvaṁ yacca kiñcana ॥8॥
7.184.15: vadhyatāṁ ca tathā teṣāṁ kṣatānāṁ ca viśeṣataḥ ॥15॥
7.184.17: tava caiva pareṣāṁ ca gatāstrā vigateṣavaḥ,
7.184.21: ātmānaṁ samare jaghnuḥ svāneva ca parānapi,
7.184.22: asmākaṁ ca mahārāja parebhyo bahavo janāḥ,
7.184.26: śrāntā bhavanto nidrāndhāḥ sarva eva savāhanāḥ,
tamasā ca vr̥te sainye rajasā bahulena ca ॥26॥
7.184.30: cukruśuḥ karṇa karṇeti tathā duryodhaneti ca,
7.184.31: upāramata pāṇḍūnāṁ senā tava ca bhārata ॥31॥
7.184.34: sā tu samprāpya viśrāmaṁ dhvajinī tava bhārata,
7.184.37: iti te taṁ naravyāghraṁ praśaṁsanto mahārathāḥ,
7.184.42: samāṁ ca viṣamāṁ cakruḥ khurāgrairvikr̥tāṁ mahīm,
7.184.44: tat tathā nidrayā bhagnamabodhaṁ prāsvapad bhr̥śam,
7.184.51: paryagacchan śanaiḥ sarvā diśaḥ khaṁ ca kṣitiṁ tathā ॥51॥
7.184.54: bodhyamānaṁ tu tat sainyaṁ rājaṁścandrasya raśmibhiḥ,
7.184.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇavadhaparvaṇi rātriyuddhe sainyanidrāyāṁ caturaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥184॥
7.185.4: sarvathā parihīnāḥ sma tejasā ca balena ca,
7.185.5: divyānyastrāṇi sarvāṇi brāhmādīni ca yāni ha,
7.185.6: na pāṇḍaveyā na vayaṁ nānye loke dhanurdharāḥ,
yudhyamānasya te tulyāḥ satyametad bravīmi te ॥6॥
7.185.8: śiṣyatvaṁ vā puraskr̥tya mama vā mandabhāgyatām ॥8॥
7.185.10: sthaviraḥ san paraṁ śaktyā ghaṭe duryodhanāhave,
ataḥ paraṁ mayā kāryaṁ kṣudraṁ vijayagr̥ddhinā ॥10॥
7.185.11: yad bhavān manyate cāpi śubhaṁ vā yadi vāśubham ॥11॥
7.185.12: tad vai kartāsmi kauravya vacanāt tava nānyathā,
7.185.14: tasya vīryaṁ mahābāho śr̥ṇu satyena kaurava,
taṁ na devā na gandharvā na yakṣā na ca rākṣasāḥ ॥14॥
7.185.16: yakṣā nāgāstathā daityā ye cānye balagarvitāḥ ॥16॥
7.185.20: vijigye puruṣavyāghraḥ sa śakyo mānuṣaiḥ katham,
pratyakṣaṁ caiva te sarvaṁ yathābalamidaṁ tava ॥20॥
7.185.23: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā bhāradvājo hasanniva ॥23॥
7.185.23d1: tiṣṭha sa tvaṁ mahābāho nityaṁ śiṣyaḥ priyastava.
7.185.25: taṁ na vittapatirnendro na yamo na jaleśvaraḥ ॥25॥
7.185.27: yuddhe hyarjunamāsādya svastimān ko vrajed gr̥hān,
7.185.28: gaccha tvamapi kaunteyamātmārthe jahi mā ciram ॥28॥
7.185.33: ahaṁ ca tāta karṇaśca bhrātā duḥśāsanaśca me ॥33॥
7.185.34: iti te katthamānasya śrutaṁ saṁsadi saṁsadi ॥34॥
7.185.35: anutiṣṭha pratijñāṁ tāṁ satyavāg bhava taiḥ saha,
7.185.37: ityuktvā samare droṇo nyavartata yataḥ pare,
dvaidhīkr̥tya tataḥ senāṁ yuddhaṁ samabhavat tadā ॥37॥
7.185.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇavadhaparvaṇi droṇaduryodhanabhāṣaṇe pañcāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥185॥
7.186.12: sa savyasācī bhīmena coditaḥ keśavena ca,
7.186.18: na dyaurna bhūmirna diśaḥ prājñāyanta tathāgate ॥18॥
7.186.19: naiva te na vayaṁ rājan prājñāsiṣma parasparam ॥19॥
7.186.20: uddeśena hi tena sma samayudhyanta pārthivāḥ,
7.186.22: jīvanta iva tatra sma vyadr̥śyanta bhayārditāḥ,
7.186.39: tato virāṭaḥ kupitaḥ samare tomarān daśa ॥39॥
7.186.40: daśa cikṣepa ca śarān droṇasya vadhakāṅkṣayā,
7.186.43: drupadaṁ ca virāṭaṁ ca preṣayāmāsa mr̥tyave,
hate virāṭe drupade kekayeṣu tathaiva ca ॥43॥
7.186.44: hateṣu triṣu vīreṣu drupadasya ca naptr̥ṣu ॥44॥
7.186.46: iṣṭāpūrtāt tathā kṣātrād brāhmaṇyācca sa naśyatu,
droṇo yasyādya mucyeta yaṁ vā droṇaḥ parābhavet ॥46॥
7.186.53: eṣa vaiśvānara iva samiddhaḥ svena tejasā ॥53॥
7.186.55: sthitāḥ paśyata me karma droṇameva vrajāmyaham,
7.186.57: naiva nastādr̥śaṁ yuddhaṁ dr̥ṣṭapūrvaṁ na ca śrutam ॥57॥
7.186.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe ṣaḍaśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥186॥
7.187.6: te rātrau kr̥takarmāṇaḥ śrāntāḥ sūryasya tejasā,
7.187.9: hayānāṁ hreṣatāṁ cāpi rathānāṁ ca nivartatām,
krośatāṁ garjatāṁ caiva tadā’’sīt tumulaṁ mahat ॥9॥
7.187.12: sve svāñjaghnuḥ pare svāṁśca svān pareṣāṁ pare parān ॥12॥
7.187.25: pañcālānāṁ ca saṁsaktaṁ na prājñāyata kiñcana,
7.187.26: na tatra karṇaṁ droṇaṁ vā nārjunaṁ na yudhiṣṭhiram ॥26॥
7.187.27: na bhīmasenaṁ na yamau na pāñcālyaṁ na sātyakim,
na ca duḥśāsanaṁ drauṇiṁ na duryodhanasaubalau ॥27॥
7.187.28: na kr̥paṁ madrarājaṁ ca kr̥tavarmāṇameva ca,
na cānyān naiva cātmānaṁ na kṣitiṁ na diśastathā ॥28॥
7.187.30: na jñāyante kauraveyā na pañcālā na pāṇḍavāḥ ॥30॥
7.187.31: na diśo dyaurna corvī ca na samaṁ viṣamaṁ tathā,
7.187.33: tatra nāgā hayā yodhā rathino’tha padātayaḥ ॥33॥
7.187.36: tad ghoraṁ mahadāścaryaṁ sarve praikṣanta sarvataḥ ॥36॥
7.187.42: yatra sarve na yugapad vyaśīryanta mahārathāḥ ॥42॥
7.187.55: tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti nakulo babhāṣe tanayaṁ tava,
saṁsmr̥tya sarvaduḥkhāni tava durmantritaṁ ca tat ॥55॥
7.187.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇavadhaparvaṇi nakulayuddhe saptāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥187॥
7.188.3: nainaṁ duḥśāsanaḥ sūtaṁ nāpi kaścana sainikaḥ,
7.188.5: yuyudhe rathināṁ śreṣṭho laghu citraṁ ca suṣṭhu ca ॥5॥
7.188.6: tadasyāpūjayan karma sve pare cāpi saṁyuge,
7.188.16: avāsr̥jad rathe tāṁ tu bibheda gadayā gadām,
7.188.17: tāṁ gadāṁ bahubhiḥ karṇaḥ supuṅkhaiḥ supravejitaiḥ,
7.188.21: dhvajaṁ śarāsanaṁ caiva śarāvāpaṁ ca bhārata,
7.188.25: mohayantau manuṣyāṇāṁ cakṣūṁṣi ca manāṁsi ca ॥25॥
7.188.30: yadā droṇo na śaknoti pāṇḍavaṁ sma viśeṣitum ॥30॥
7.188.33: yad yadastraṁ sa pārthāya prayuṅkte vijigīṣayā ॥33॥
7.188.34: tasya tasya vighātāya tat taddhi kurute’rjunaḥ,
7.188.39: tatra smāntarhitā vāco vyacaranta punaḥ punaḥ ॥39॥
7.188.41: naivedaṁ mānuṣaṁ yuddhaṁ nāsuraṁ na ca rākṣasam ॥41॥
7.188.42: na daivaṁ na ca gāndharvaṁ brāhmaṁ dhruvamidaṁ param,
vicitramidamāścaryaṁ na no dr̥ṣṭaṁ na ca śrutam ॥42॥
7.188.44: tatra śakyopamā kartumanyatra tu na vidyate ॥44॥
7.188.46: nemau śakyau maheṣvāsau yuddhe kṣapayituṁ paraiḥ,
7.188.49: vavau ca viṣamo vāyuḥ sāgarāścāpi cukṣubhuḥ ॥49॥
7.188.52: yadā na gamyate pāraṁ tayoranyatarasya vā,
7.188.53d1: arjuno’pi raṇe droṇaṁ tyaktvā prādrāvayat kurūn.
7.188.53d2: tumulaṁ prababhau rājan sarvasya jagato bhayam.
7.188.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe aṣṭāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥188॥
7.189.11: nātra karṇī na nālīko na lipto na ca bastikaḥ ॥11॥
7.189.12: na sūcī kapiśo naiva na gavāsthirgajāsthijaḥ,
iṣurāsīnna saṁśliṣṭo na pūtirna ca jihmagaḥ ॥12॥
7.189.14: caturṇāṁ tava yodhānāṁ taistribhiḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha ॥14॥
7.189.15: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnastu tān dr̥ṣṭvā tava rājan ratharṣabhān,
7.189.17: dvābhyāṁ dvābhyāṁ yamau sārdhaṁ rathābhyāṁ rathapuṅgavau,
7.189.21: anyonyaṁ prekṣamāṇau ca smayamānau punaḥ punaḥ ॥21॥
7.189.23: dhik krodhaṁ dhik sakhe lobhaṁ dhiṅmohaṁ dhigamarṣitam,
7.189.24: tvaṁ hi prāṇaiḥ priyataro mamāhaṁ ca sadā tava ॥24॥
7.189.25: smarāmi tāni sarvāṇi bālyavr̥ttāni yāni nau,
tāni sarvāṇi jīrṇāni sāmprataṁ no raṇājire ॥25॥
7.189.28: kva sā krīḍā gatāsmākaṁ bālye vai śinipuṅgava ॥28॥
7.189.29: kva ca yuddhamidaṁ bhūyaḥ ‘kālo hi duratikramaḥ’,
kiṁ nu no vidyate kr̥tyaṁ dhanena dhanalipsayā ॥29॥
7.189.31: yadi te’haṁ priyo rājan jahi māṁ mā ciraṁ kr̥thāḥ ॥31॥
7.189.32: yā te śaktirbalaṁ yacca tat kṣipraṁ mayi darśaya ॥32॥
7.189.33: necchāmi tadahaṁ draṣṭuṁ mitrāṇāṁ vyasanaṁ mahat,
7.189.50: na tu taṁ marṣayāmāsa bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ,
7.189.51: tasya karṇaḥ śitān bāṇān pratihatya hasanniva,
7.189.52: dhvajaṁ dhanuśca sūtaṁ ca sammamardāhave ripoḥ ॥52॥
7.189.53: rathacakraṁ ca karṇasya babhañja sa mahābalaḥ,
7.189.54: ekacakraṁ rathaṁ tasya tamūhuḥ suciraṁ hayāḥ,
7.189.57: ye naḥ prāṇāḥ śiro ye ca ye no yodhā mahārathāḥ ॥57॥
7.189.58: kiṁ tiṣṭhata yathā mūḍhāḥ sarve vigatacetasaḥ ॥58॥
7.189.59: tatra gacchata yatraite yudhyante māmakā rathāḥ,
7.189.61: hatā vā devasād bhūtvā lokān prāpsyatha puṣkalān,
te rājñā coditā vīrā yotsyamānā mahārathāḥ ॥61॥
7.189.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe ekonanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥189॥
7.190.1: yathā kruddho raṇe śakro dānavānāṁ kṣayaṁ purā ॥1॥
7.190.7: kaccid droṇo na naḥ sarvān kṣapayet paramāstravit,
7.190.8: na cainaṁ saṁyuge kaścit samarthaḥ prativīkṣitum,
7.190.10: naiṣa yuddhe na saṅgrāme jetuṁ śakyaḥ kathañcana,
7.190.12: yathā vaḥ saṁyuge sarvān na hanyād rukmavāhanaḥ,
7.190.13: taṁ hataṁ saṁyuge kaścidasmai śaṁsatu mānavaḥ,
7.190.14: anye tvarocayan sarve kr̥cchreṇa tu yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
7.190.17: aśvatthāmeti hi gajaḥ khyāto nāmnā hato’bhavat,
kr̥tvā manasi taṁ bhīmo mithyā vyāhr̥tavāṁstadā ॥17॥
7.190.19: śaṅkamānaḥ sa tanmithyā vīryajñaḥ svasutasya vai,
hataḥ sa iti ca śrutvā naiva dhairyādakampata ॥19॥
7.190.20: sa labdhvā cetanāṁ droṇaḥ kṣaṇenaiva samāśvasat,
7.190.28: kuñjarāṇāṁ ca patatāṁ hayaughānāṁ ca bhārata,
7.190.30: tathaiva ca punaḥ kruddho bhāradvājaḥ pratāpavān,
7.190.35: adharmataḥ kr̥taṁ yuddhaṁ samayo nidhanasya te ॥35॥
7.190.39: brahmāstreṇa tvayā dagdhā anastrajñā narā bhuvi,
yadetadīdr̥śaṁ vipra kr̥taṁ karma na sādhu tat ॥39॥
7.190.40: nyasyāyudhaṁ raṇe vipra droṇa mā tvaṁ ciraṁ kr̥thāḥ,
7.190.41: iti teṣāṁ vacaḥ śrutvā bhīmasenavacaśca tat,
dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca samprekṣya raṇe sa vimanā’bhavat ॥41॥
7.190.42: ahataṁ vā hataṁ veti papraccha sutamātmanaḥ ॥42॥
7.190.43: sthirā buddhirhi droṇasya na pārtho vakṣyate’nr̥tam,
7.190.44: tasmāt taṁ paripapraccha nānyaṁ kañcid dvijarṣabhaḥ,
tasmiṁstasya hi satyāśā bālyāt prabhr̥ti pāṇḍave ॥44॥
7.190.46: satyaṁ bravīmi te senā vināśaṁ samupaiṣyati ॥46॥
7.190.47: sa bhavāṁstrātu no droṇāt satyājjyāyo’nr̥taṁ vacaḥ,
7.190.53: tvayokto naiva yudhyeta jātu rājan dvijarṣabhaḥ,
satyavān hi triloke’smin bhavān khyāto janādhipa ॥53॥
7.190.56: babhūvaivaṁ ca tenokte tasya vāhāḥ spr̥śanmahīm ॥56॥
7.190.57: yudhiṣṭhirāt tu tad vākyaṁ śrutvā droṇo mahārathaḥ,
7.190.58: r̥ṣivākyena manvānaḥ śrutvā ca nihataṁ sutam ॥58॥
7.190.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇavadhaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhirāsatyakathane navatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥190॥
7.191.9: tasya tvahāni catvāri kṣapā caikāsyato gatā,
7.191.11: tejasā pūryamāṇaśca yuyudhe na yathā purā ॥11॥
7.191.17: sarvaṁ ciccheda durdharṣo gadāṁ khaḍgaṁ ca varjayan ॥17॥
7.191.25: tāṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvā naravyāghro droṇena nihatāṁ śaraiḥ,
7.191.28: iyeṣa vakṣo bhettuṁ sa bhāradvājasya saṁyuge ॥28॥
7.191.33: te hatā nyapatan bhūmau dhr̥ṣṭadyumnasya vājinaḥ,
7.191.34: tān hayān nihatān dr̥ṣṭvā dvijāgryeṇa sa pārṣataḥ,
7.191.35: virathaḥ sa gr̥hītvā tu khaḍgaṁ khaḍgabhr̥tāṁ vara,
7.191.36: tasya rūpaṁ babhau rājan bhāradvājaṁ jighāṁsataḥ,
7.191.38: parivr̥ttaṁ nivr̥ttaṁ ca khaḍgaṁ carma ca dhārayan ॥38॥
7.191.39: bhārataṁ kauśikaṁ caiva sātvataṁ caiva śikṣayā ॥39॥
7.191.42: carma khaḍgaṁ ca sambādhe dhr̥ṣṭadyumnasya sa dvijaḥ,
ye tu vaitastikā nāma śarā āsannayodhinaḥ ॥42॥
7.191.43: nikr̥ṣṭayuddhe droṇasya nānyeṣāṁ santi te śarāḥ,
7.191.51: mādrīputrau ca bhīmaṁ ca rājānaṁ ca yudhiṣṭhiram ॥51॥
7.191.53: ajayyaṁ samare dr̥ṣṭvā sādhu sādhviti sātyakim,
7.191.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇavadhaparvaṇi saṅkulayuddhe ekanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥191॥
7.192.1: sātvatasya tu tat karma dr̥ṣṭvā duryodhanādayaḥ,
7.192.2: kr̥pakarṇau ca samare putrāśca tava māriṣa,
7.192.7: rudrasyeva hi kruddhasya nighnatastān paśūn purā ॥7॥
7.192.9: rāśayaḥ sma vyadr̥śyanta tatra tatra raṇājire,
7.192.13: eṣo hi pārṣato vīro bhāradvājena saṅgataḥ,
7.192.14: adya droṇaṁ raṇe kruddho ghātayiṣyati pārṣataḥ ॥14॥
7.192.15: te yūyaṁ sahitā bhūtvā yudhyadhvaṁ kumbhasambhavam,
7.192.19: dīpayantī ubhe sene śaṁsantīva mahad bhayam,
7.192.28: tvarasva prāg vadhāyaiva tvayi bhāraḥ samāhitaḥ ॥28॥
7.192.35: tasya droṇo dhanuśchittvā viddhvā cainaṁ śilīmukhaiḥ,
7.192.36: tato bhīmo dr̥ḍhakrodho droṇasyāśliṣya taṁ ratham,
7.192.37: yadi nāma na yudhyeran śikṣitā brahmabandhavaḥ,
svakarmabhirasantuṣṭā na sma kṣatraṁ kṣayaṁ vrajet ॥37॥
7.192.38: tasya ca brāhmaṇo mūlaṁ bhavāṁśca brahmavittamaḥ ॥38॥
7.192.41: sa cādya patitaḥ śete pr̥ṣṭhe nāveditastava ॥41॥
7.192.43: karṇa karṇa maheṣvāsa kr̥pa duryodhaneti ca ॥43॥
7.192.44: saṅgrāme kriyatāṁ yatno bravīmyeṣa punaḥ punaḥ,
7.192.45: iti tatra mahārāja prākrośad drauṇimeva ca,
utsr̥jya ca raṇe śastraṁ rathopasthe niviśya ca ॥45॥
7.192.47: saśaraṁ tad dhanurghoraṁ saṁnyasyātha rathe tataḥ,
7.192.50: purāṇaṁ puruṣaṁ viṣṇuṁ jagāma manasā param ॥50॥
7.192.58: anye tu sarve nāpaśyan bhāradvājasya dhīmataḥ ॥58॥
7.192.59: brahmalokaṁ mahad divyaṁ devaguhyaṁ hi tat param ॥59॥
7.192.65: tvatkr̥te vyacarat saṅkhye sa tu ṣoḍaśavarṣavat,
7.192.66: na hantavyo na hantavya iti te sainikāśca ha ॥66॥
7.192.69: evaṁ taṁ nihataṁ saṅkhye dadr̥śe sainiko janaḥ ॥69॥
7.192.71: te tu dr̥ṣṭvā śiro rājan bhāradvājasya tāvakāḥ,
7.192.73: r̥ṣeḥ prasādāt kr̥ṣṇasya satyavatyāḥ sutasya ca,
7.192.74: apaśyāma divaṁ stabdhvā gacchantaṁ taṁ mahādyutim,
7.192.78: pāṇḍavāstu jayaṁ labdhvā paratra ca mahad yaśaḥ ॥78॥
7.192.81: sūtaputre hate pāpe dhārtarāṣṭre ca saṁyuge ॥81॥
7.192.84: pāṇḍavāstu jayaṁ labdhvā hr̥ṣṭā hyāsan viśāmpate,
arikṣayaṁ ca saṅgrāme tena te sukhamāpnuvan ॥84॥
7.192.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi droṇavadhaparvaṇi droṇavadhe dvinavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥192॥
7.193.1: tato droṇe hate rājan kuravaḥ śastrapīḍitāḥ,
7.193.2: udīrṇāṁśca parān dr̥ṣṭvā kampamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ,
7.193.4: aśrukaṇṭhā yathā daityā hiraṇyākṣe purā hate ॥4॥
7.193.5: sa taiḥ parivr̥to rājā trastaiḥ kṣudramr̥gairiva,
7.193.9: hataṁ rukmarathaṁ śrutvā prādravat sahito rathaiḥ ॥9॥
7.193.14: ulūkaḥ prādravat tatra dr̥ṣṭvā droṇaṁ nipātitam ॥14॥
7.193.16: vr̥ṣaseno yayau tūrṇaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā droṇaṁ nipātitam ॥16॥
7.193.18: suśarmā prādravad rājan dr̥ṣṭvā droṇaṁ nipātitam ॥18॥
7.193.19: gajān rathān samāruhya vyudasya ca hayāñjanāḥ,
prādravan sarvataḥ saṅkhye dr̥ṣṭvā rukmarathaṁ hatam ॥19॥
7.193.24: tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti na ca te svayaṁ tatrāvatasthire,
7.193.30: tvaṁ cāpi na yathāpūrvaṁ prakr̥tistho narādhipa,
7.193.31: anyeṣvapi ca yuddheṣu naiva senādravat tadā,
kaccit kṣemaṁ mahābāho tava sainyasya bhārata ॥31॥
7.193.32: kasminnidaṁ hate rājan rathasiṁhe balaṁ tava,
7.193.34: bhinnā nauriva te putro magnaḥ śokamahārṇave,
7.193.35: śaṁsātra bhadraṁ te sarvaṁ yathā sainyamidaṁ drutam ॥35॥
7.193.37: vayaṁ droṇaṁ puraskr̥tya pr̥thivyāṁ pravaraṁ ratham,
7.193.46: sa madhyaṁ prāpya pāṇḍūnāṁ śararaśmiḥ pratāpavān,
7.193.49: naiṣa jātu naraiḥ śakyo jetuṁ śastrabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ,
7.193.50: te yūyaṁ dharmamutsr̥jya jayaṁ rakṣata pāṇḍavāḥ,
yathā vaḥ saṁyuge sarvān na hanyād rukmavāhanaḥ ॥50॥
7.193.51: hataṁ taṁ saṁyuge kaścidākhyātvasmai mr̥ṣā naraḥ ॥51॥
7.193.53: aśvatthāmā hata iti taṁ nābudhyata te pitā ॥53॥
7.193.54: hataṁ vāpyahataṁ vā’’jau tvāṁ pitā putravatsalaḥ ॥54॥
7.193.63: tato’sya keśān savyena gr̥hītvā pāṇinā tadā,
7.193.64: na hantavyo na hantavya iti te sarvato’bruvan,
7.193.65: udyamya tvarito bāhuṁ bruvāṇaśca punaḥ punaḥ,
7.193.66: hata eva nr̥śaṁsena pitā tava nararṣabha ॥66॥
7.193.67: vayaṁ cāpi nirutsāhā hate pitari te’nagha ॥67॥
7.193.69: tataḥ kruddho raṇe drauṇirbhr̥śaṁ jajvāla māriṣa,
7.194.2: aindraṁ nārāyaṇaṁ caiva yasmin nityaṁ pratiṣṭhitam ॥2॥
7.194.5: icchanti puruṣāḥ putraṁ loke nānyaṁ kathañcana ॥5॥
7.194.6: tāni putrāya vā dadyuḥ śiṣyāyānugatāya vā ॥6॥
7.194.7: sa śiṣyaḥ prāpya tat sarvaṁ saviśeṣaṁ ca sañjaya,
7.194.8: rāmasya tu samaḥ śastre purandarasamo yudhi,
7.194.10: sa rathī prathamo loke dr̥ḍhadhanvā jitaklamaḥ,
7.194.11: yo na vyathati saṅgrāme vīraḥ satyaparākramaḥ ॥11॥
7.194.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi nārāyaṇāstramokṣaparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭrapraśne caturnavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥194॥
7.195.3: aśrupūrṇe tato netre vyapamr̥jya punaḥ punaḥ,
7.195.4: dharmadhvajavatā pāpaṁ kr̥taṁ tad viditaṁ mama ॥4॥
7.195.5: anāryaṁ sunr̥śaṁsaṁ ca dharmaputrasya me śrutam,
7.195.6: nyāyavr̥tto vadho yastu saṅgrāme yudhyato bhavet ॥6॥
7.195.7: na sa duḥkhāya bhavati tathā dr̥ṣṭo hi sa dvijaiḥ,
gataḥ sa vīralokāya pitā mama na saṁśayaḥ ॥7॥
7.195.8: na śocyaḥ puruṣavyāghra yastadā nidhanaṁ gataḥ,
7.195.12: avajñāya ca māṁ nūnaṁ nr̥śaṁsena durātmanā,
7.195.13: akāryaṁ paramaṁ kr̥tvā mithyāvādī ca pāṇḍavaḥ,
yo hyasau chadmanā’’cāryaṁ śastraṁ saṁnyāsayat tadā ॥13॥
7.195.14: śape satyena kauravya iṣṭāpūrtena caiva ha ॥14॥
7.195.16: karmaṇā yena teneha mr̥dunā dāruṇena ca ॥16॥
7.195.17: pañcālānāṁ vadhaṁ kr̥tvā śāntiṁ labdhāsmi kaurava,
7.195.18: pretya ceha ca samprāptāstrāyante mahato bhayāt,
pitrā tu mama sāvasthā prāptā nirbandhunā yathā ॥18॥
7.195.19: mayi śailapratīkāśe putre śiṣye ca jīvati,
dhiṅmamāstrāṇi divyāni dhig bāhū dhik parākramam ॥19॥
7.195.20: yaṁ sma droṇaḥ sutaṁ prāpya keśagrahamavāptavān,
7.195.21: āryeṇa hi na vaktavyā kadācit stutirātmanaḥ ॥21॥
7.195.22: adya paśyantu me vīryaṁ pāṇḍavāḥ sajanārdanāḥ ॥22॥
7.195.23: na hi devā na gandharvā nāsurā na ca rākṣasāḥ ॥23॥
7.195.24: adya śaktā raṇe jetuṁ rathasthaṁ māṁ nararṣabhāḥ,
7.195.27: adya sarvā diśo rājan dhārābhiriva saṅkulāḥ,
7.195.29: na hi jānāti bībhatsustadastraṁ na janārdanaḥ,
na bhīmaseno na yamau na ca rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥29॥
7.195.30: na pārṣato durātmāsau na śikhaṇḍī na sātyakiḥ,
7.195.32: taṁ svayaṁ pratigr̥hyātha bhagavān sa varaṁ dadau,
vavre pitā me paramamastraṁ nārāyaṇaṁ tataḥ ॥32॥
7.195.33: bhavitā tvatsamo nānyaḥ kaścid yudhi naraḥ kvacit ॥33॥
7.195.34: na tvidaṁ sahasā brahman prayoktavyaṁ kathañcana,
7.195.35: na caitacchakyate jñātuṁ kaṁ na vadhyediti prabho,
7.195.36: atha saṅkhye rathasyaiva śastrāṇāṁ ca visarjanam,
prayācatāṁ ca śatrūṇāṁ gamanaṁ śaraṇasya ca ॥36॥
7.195.37: sarvathā pīḍito hi syādavadhyān pīḍayan raṇe ॥37॥
7.195.41: yathā yathāhamiccheyaṁ tathā bhūtvā śarā mama ॥41॥
7.195.48: sa śabdastumulaḥ khaṁ dyāṁ pr̥thivīṁ ca vyanādayat,
7.195.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi nārāyaṇāstramokṣaparvaṇi aśvatthāmakrodhe pañcanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥195॥
7.196.2: cacāla pr̥thivī cāpi cukṣubhe ca mahodadhiḥ,
7.196.5: kathaṅkathābhavat tīvrā dr̥ṣṭvā tad vyākulaṁ mahat ॥5॥
7.196.6: tad dr̥ṣṭvā ghorarūpaṁ vai drauṇerastraṁ bhayāvaham ॥6॥
7.196.11: ātmatrāṇe matiṁ kr̥tvā prādravan kuravo raṇāt ॥11॥
7.196.14: bhītāḥ pādairhayān kecit tvarayantaḥ svayaṁ rathān,
7.196.18: putrān pitr̥̄n sakhīn bhrātr̥̄n samāropya dr̥ḍhakṣatān ॥18॥
7.196.19: avasthāṁ tādr̥śīṁ prāpya hate droṇe drutaṁ balam ॥19॥
7.196.20: punarāvartitaṁ kena yadi jānāsi śaṁsa me,
hayānāṁ hreṣatāṁ śabdaḥ kuñjarāṇāṁ ca br̥ṁhatām ॥20॥
7.196.21: ete śabdā bhr̥śaṁ tīvrāḥ pravr̥ttāḥ kurusāgare ॥21॥
7.196.22: ya eṣa tumulaḥ śabdaḥ śrūyate lomaharṣaṇaḥ ॥22॥
7.196.25: dhanañjaya guruṁ śrutvā tatra nādaṁ subhīṣaṇam,
7.196.27: dhamanti kauravāḥ śaṅkhān yasya vīryaṁ samāśritāḥ,
yatra te saṁśayo rājan nyastaśastre gurau hate ॥27॥
7.196.29: yasmiñjāte dadau droṇo gavāṁ daśaśataṁ dhanam ॥29॥
7.196.33: guruṁ me yatra pāñcālyaḥ keśapakṣe parāmr̥śat ॥33॥
7.196.35: dharmajñena satā nāma so’dharmaḥ sumahān kr̥taḥ,
7.196.38: ācārya ukto bhavatā hataḥ kuñjara ityuta,
7.196.39: āsīt suvihvalo rājan yathā dr̥ṣṭastvayā vibhuḥ,
7.196.42: sarve vayaṁ paritrātuṁ na śakṣyāmo’dya pārṣatam,
so’dya keśagrahaṁ śrutvā piturdhakṣyati no raṇe ॥42॥
7.196.43: apākīrya svayaṁ dharmaṁ śiṣyeṇa nihato guruḥ ॥43॥
7.196.44: yadā gataṁ vayo bhūyaḥ śiṣṭamalpataraṁ ca naḥ,
7.196.45: piteva nityaṁ sauhārdāt piteva hi ca dharmataḥ,
7.196.46: visr̥ṣṭā pr̥thivī sarvā saha putraiśca tatparaiḥ ॥46॥
7.196.47: samprāpya tādr̥śīṁ vr̥ttiṁ satkr̥taḥ satataṁ paraiḥ,
7.196.48: na tvenaṁ yudhyamānaṁ vai hanyādapi śatakratuḥ ॥48॥
7.196.50: aho bata mahat pāpaṁ kr̥taṁ karma sudāruṇam,
7.196.51: putrān bhrātr̥̄n pitr̥̄n dārāñjīvitaṁ caiva vāsaviḥ,
tyajet sarvaṁ mama premṇā jānātyevaṁ hi me guruḥ ॥51॥
7.196.53: ghātayitvādya rājyārthe mr̥taṁ śreyo na jīvitam ॥53॥
7.196.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi nārāyaṇāstramokṣaparvaṇi arjunavākye ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥196॥
7.197.1: apriyaṁ vā priyaṁ vāpi mahārāja dhanañjayam ॥1॥
7.197.4: kṣatriyaḥ kṣitimāpnoti kṣipraṁ dharmaṁ yaśaḥ śriyaḥ ॥4॥
7.197.5: avipaścid yathā vācaṁ vyāharan nādya śobhase ॥5॥
7.197.6: na cāti vartase dharmaṁ velāmiva mahodadhiḥ ॥6॥
7.197.7: na pūjayet tvāṁ ko nvadya yat trayodaśavārṣikam,
7.197.8: ānr̥śaṁsye ca te diṣṭyā buddhiḥ satatamacyuta ॥8॥
7.197.13: tvayā hi kathitaṁ pūrvaṁ yuddhāyābhyāgatā vayam,
ghaṭāmahe yathāśakti tvaṁ tu no’dya jugupsase ॥13॥
7.197.16: adharmamenaṁ vipulaṁ dhārmikaḥ san na buddhyase,
7.197.17: yaḥ kalāṁ ṣoḍaśīṁ pūrṇāṁ dhanañjaya na te’rhati ॥17॥
7.197.18: dārayeyaṁ mahīṁ krodhād vikireyaṁ ca parvatān ॥18॥
7.197.21: sa tvamevaṁvidhaṁ jānan bhrātaraṁ māṁ nararṣabha,
7.197.22: athavā tiṣṭha bībhatso saha sarvaiḥ sahodaraiḥ,
7.197.25: hato droṇo mayā hyevaṁ kiṁ māṁ pārtha vigarhase ॥25॥
7.197.27: māyayaiva vihanyād yo na yuktaṁ pārtha tatra kim ॥27॥
7.197.28: tasmiṁstathā mayā śaste yadi drauṇāyanī ruṣā,
kurute bhairavaṁ nādaṁ tatra kiṁ mama hīyate ॥28॥
7.197.30: yacca māṁ dhārmiko bhūtvā bravīṣi gurughātinam,
7.197.31: yasya kāryamakāryaṁ vā yudhyataḥ syāt samaṁ raṇe,
taṁ kathaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ brūyāḥ kṣatriyaṁ vā dhanañjaya ॥31॥
7.197.34: nr̥śaṁsaḥ sa mayā’’kramya ratha eva nipātitaḥ,
7.197.35: bhīmaṁ droṇaśiraśchinnaṁ na praśaṁsasi me katham ॥35॥
7.197.36: yo’sau mamaiva nānyasya bāndhavān yudhi jaghnivān,
7.197.37: tacca me kr̥ntate marma yanna tasya śiro mayā,
7.197.38: kṣatriyasya hi dharmo’yaṁ hanyāddhanyeta vā punaḥ ॥38॥
7.197.39: sa śatrurnihataḥ saṅkhye mayā dharmeṇa pāṇḍava,
yathā tvayā hataḥ śūro bhagadattaḥ pituḥ sakhā ॥39॥
7.197.40: mayā śatrau hate kasmāt pāpe dharmaṁ na manyase ॥40॥
7.197.41: sambandhāvanataṁ pārtha na māṁ tvaṁ vaktumarhasi,
7.197.43: tathā jānātyayaṁ loko na yūyaṁ pāṇḍunandanāḥ ॥43॥
7.197.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi nārāyaṇāstramokṣaparvaṇi dhr̥ṣṭadyumnavākye saptanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥197॥
7.198.4: nāmarṣaṁ tatra kurvanti dhik kṣātraṁ dhigamarṣitām,
pārthāḥ sarve ca rājānaḥ pr̥thivyāṁ ye dhanurdharāḥ ॥4॥
7.198.6: tūṣṇīṁ babhūvū rājānaḥ sarva eva viśāmpate,
7.198.8: nehāsti puruṣaḥ kaścid ya imaṁ pāpapūruṣam ॥8॥
7.198.9: ete tvāṁ pāṇḍavāḥ sarve kutsayanti vikutsayā ॥9॥
7.198.10: karmaṇā tena pāpena śvapākaṁ brāhmaṇā iva,
etat kr̥tvā mahat pāpaṁ ninditaḥ sarvasādhubhiḥ ॥10॥
7.198.11: na lajjase kathaṁ vaktuṁ samitiṁ prāpya śobhanām,
kathaṁ ca śatadhā jihvā na te mūrdhā ca dīryate ॥11॥
7.198.13: yat karma kaluṣaṁ kr̥tvā ślāghase janasaṁsadi,
akāryaṁ tādr̥śaṁ kr̥tvā punareva guruṁ kṣipan ॥13॥
7.198.16: uktavāṁścāpi yat pārthe bhīṣmaṁ prati nararṣabham ॥16॥
7.198.18: sa cāpi sr̥ṣṭaḥ pitrā te bhīṣmasyāntakaraḥ kila ॥18॥
7.198.21: tvāṁ ca brahmahaṇaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā janaḥ sūryamavekṣate ॥21॥
7.198.23: gurorguruṁ ca bhūyo’pi kṣipannaiva hi lajjase,
7.198.25: śrūyate śrūyate ceti kṣamyate ceti mādhava ॥25॥
7.198.26: kṣamā praśasyate loke na tu pāpo’rhati kṣamām ॥26॥
7.198.29: vāryamāṇena hi hatastataḥ pāpataraṁ nu kim,
7.198.30: visr̥ṣṭaśastro nihataḥ kiṁ tatra krūra duṣkr̥tam,
7.198.31: chinnabāhuṁ parairhanyāt sātyake sa kathaṁ vadet,
nihatya tvāṁ padā bhūmau sa vikarṣati vīryavān ॥31॥
7.198.32: kiṁ tadā na nihaṁsyenaṁ bhūtvā puruṣasattamaḥ,
7.198.33: yadā tadā hataḥ śūraḥ saumadattiḥ pratāpavān,
yatra yatra tu pāṇḍūnāṁ droṇo drāvayate camūm ॥33॥
7.198.34: sa tvamevaṁvidhaṁ kr̥tvā karma cāṇḍālavat svayam ॥34॥
7.198.35: kartā tvaṁ karmaṇo hyasya nāhaṁ vr̥ṣṇikulādhama ॥35॥
7.198.36: pāpānāṁ ca tvamāvāsaḥ karmaṇāṁ mā punarvada,
joṣamāssva na māṁ bhūyo vaktumarhasyataḥ param ॥36॥
7.198.37: atha vakṣyasi māṁ maurkhyād bhūyaḥ paruṣamīdr̥śam ॥37॥
7.198.38: na caivaṁ mūrkha dharmeṇa kevalenaiva śakyate ॥38॥
7.198.40: pravrājitā vanaṁ sarve pāṇḍavāḥ saha kr̥ṣṇayā ॥40॥
7.198.45: yudhyasva kauravaiḥ sārdhaṁ mā gā pitr̥niveśanam,
7.198.47: viniḥśvasya yathā sarpaḥ praṇidhāya rathe dhanuḥ,
7.198.48: na tvāṁ vakṣyāmi paruṣaṁ haniṣye tvāṁ vadhakṣamam,
7.198.50: dravamāṇaṁ tathā kruddhaṁ sātyakiṁ pāṇḍavo balī ॥50॥
7.198.52: nigr̥hītaḥ pade ṣaṣṭhe balena balināṁ varaḥ,
7.198.56: sa bhavānīdr̥śaṁ mitraṁ manyate ca yathā bhavān ॥56॥
7.198.57: bhavantaśca yathāsmākaṁ bhavatāṁ ca tathā vayam,
7.198.58: pārṣatasya kṣama tvaṁ vai kṣamatāṁ pārṣataśca te ॥58॥
7.198.60: muñca muñca śineḥ pautraṁ bhīma yuddhamadānvitam ॥60॥
7.198.62: yuddhaśraddhāṁ ca kaunteya jīvitaṁ cāsya saṁyuge,
kiṁ nu śakyaṁ mayā kartuṁ kāryaṁ yadidamudyatam ॥62॥
7.199.1: tataḥ sa kadanaṁ cakre ripūṇāṁ droṇanandanaḥ,
7.199.4: tato vegena mahatā vinadya sa nararṣabhaḥ,
7.199.6: vidrāvya sarvān hantāsmi jālmaṁ pāñcālyameva tu ॥6॥
7.199.7: sarvānetān haniṣyāmi yadi yotsyanti māṁ raṇe,
7.199.12: yathā śiloccaye śailaḥ sāgare sāgaro yathā,
7.199.17: te diśaḥ khaṁ ca sainyaṁ ca samāvr̥ṇvan mahāhave,
7.199.21: tathā tathā tadastraṁ vai vyavardhata janādhipa ॥21॥
7.199.23: yathā hi śiśirāpāye dahet kakṣaṁ hutāśanaḥ,
tathā tadastraṁ pāṇḍūnāṁ dadāha dhvajinīṁ prabho ॥23॥
7.199.25: dravamāṇaṁ tu tat sainyaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā vigatacetanam,
7.199.26: sātyake tvaṁ ca gacchasva vr̥ṣṇyandhakavr̥to gr̥hān ॥26॥
7.199.28: saṅgrāmastu na kartavyaḥ sarvasainyān bravīmi vaḥ,
ahaṁ hi saha sodaryaiḥ pravekṣye havyavāhanam ॥28॥
7.199.32: yenāvibruvatā praśnaṁ tathā kr̥ṣṇā sabhāṁ gatā,
7.199.32d1: rakṣaṇe ca mahān yatnaḥ saindhavasya kr̥to yudhi,
7.199.32d2: vyūhadvāri vayaṁ caiva dhr̥tā yena jigīṣavaḥ,
vāritaṁ ca mahat sainyaṁ praviśat tad yathābalam.
7.199.33: kavacena tathā gupto rakṣārthaṁ saindhavasya ca ॥33॥
7.199.40: yathā yathā hi yudhyante yodhā hyastramidaṁ prati,
7.199.41d1: ye’ñjaliṁ kurvate vīrā namanti ca vivāhanāḥ,
7.199.43: īṣuḥ sarve samutsraṣṭuṁ manobhiḥ karaṇena ca ॥43॥
7.199.47: na hi me vikrame tulyaḥ kaścidasti pumāniha,
7.199.50: adya paśyata me vīryaṁ bāhvoḥ pīnāṁsayoryudhi,
7.199.52: arjunārjuna bībhatso na nyasyaṁ gāṇḍivaṁ tvayā,
7.199.53: bhīma nārāyaṇāstre me goṣu ca brāhmaṇeṣu ca,
7.199.54d1: kampayan medinīṁ sarvāṁ trāsayaṁśca camūṁ tava,
śaṅkhaśabdaṁ mahat kr̥tvā bhujaśabdaṁ ca pāṇḍavaḥ.
7.199.54d2: tasya śaṅkhasvanaṁ śrutvā bāhuśabdaṁ ca tāvakāḥ,
7.199.61: tataḥ śastrāṇi te sarve samutsr̥jya mahītale,
7.199.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi nārāyaṇāstramokṣaparvaṇi pāṇḍavasainyāstratyāge navanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥199॥
7.200.5: sa hi bhīmo rathaścāsya hayāḥ sūtaśca māriṣa,
7.200.6: yathā dagdhvā jagat kr̥tsnaṁ samaye sacarācaram,
7.200.7: sūryamagniḥ praviṣṭaḥ syād yathā cāgniṁ divākaraḥ,
tathā praviṣṭaṁ tat tejo na prājñāyata pāṇḍavaḥ ॥7॥
7.200.8: vikīrṇamastraṁ tad dr̥ṣṭvā tathā bhīmarathaṁ prati,
7.200.14: vardhate caiva tad ghoraṁ drauṇerastraṁ sudurjayam ॥14॥
7.200.17: rathebhyastvavatīrṇāḥ sma sarva eva hi tāvakāḥ,
7.200.18: evamuktvā tu taṁ kr̥ṣṇo rathād bhūmimavartayat,
7.200.20: tasmin praśānte vidhinā tena tejasi duḥsahe,
babhūvurvimalāḥ sarvā diśaḥ pradiśa eva ca ॥20॥
7.200.22: vyapoḍhe ca tato ghore tasmiṁstejasi bhārata,
babhau bhīmo niśāpāye dhīmān sūrya ivoditaḥ ॥22॥
7.200.27: āvr̥taṁ hi nivarteta prayoktāraṁ na saṁśayaḥ ॥27॥
7.200.29: parājayo vā mr̥tyurvā śreyān mr̥tyune nirjayaḥ,
7.200.31: icchato na hi te mucyet saṅkruddho hi purandaraḥ ॥31॥
7.200.36: droṇaputraṁ triṣaṣṭyā tu rājan vivyādha patriṇām ॥36॥
7.200.41: taṁ drauṇiḥ samare kruddhaṁ chādayāmāsa patribhiḥ,
7.200.45: dr̥ṣṭvā tu vimukhān yodhān dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca pīḍitam,
7.200.47: vivyādha ca tathā sūtaṁ caturbhiścaturo hayān,
7.200.50: evaṁ gate guroḥ putre tava putro mahārathaḥ,
7.200.53: tataḥ sa sātyakī rājan sarvāneva mahārathān,
7.200.58: evaṁ taṁ virathaṁ kr̥tvā sātyakiḥ satyavikramaḥ,
7.200.59: ayutaṁ dantināṁ sārdhaṁ kr̥pasya nijaghāna saḥ,
7.200.63: na cainaṁ trāsyasi mayā grastamātmānameva ca ॥63॥
