7.200.65: yad balaṁ pāṇḍaveyānāṁ vr̥ṣṇīnāmapi yad balam,
7.200.66: vyasr̥jyat sātvate drauṇirvajraṁ vr̥tre yathā hariḥ ॥66॥
7.200.67: sa taṁ nirbhidya tenāstaḥ sāyakaḥ saśarāvaram,
7.200.71: sasādātha ca pāñcālyo vyapāśrayata ca dhvajam ॥71॥
7.200.72: taṁ nāgamiva siṁhena dr̥ṣṭvā rājan śarārditam,
7.200.78: tataste vivyadhuḥ sarve drauṇiṁ rājan mahārathāḥ,
7.200.81: rdvābhyāṁ viddhvā kārmukaṁ ca dhvajaṁ ca,
7.200.86: mālavaṁ pauravaṁ caiva yuvarājaṁ ca cedipam,
7.200.98: sa muhūrtāt punaḥ sañjñāṁ labdhvā drauṇirnarādhipa ॥98॥
7.200.112: balaṁ vīryaṁ prabhāvaṁ ca vyavasāyaṁ ca bhārata ॥112॥
7.200.129: tataḥ sarve ca pañcālā bhīmasenaśca pāṇḍavaḥ ॥129॥
7.200.130: tān prabhagnāṁstato droṇiḥ pr̥ṣṭhato vikiran śarān ॥130॥
7.201.1: tat prabhagnaṁ balaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kuntīputro dhanañjayaḥ,
7.201.3: eka eva ca bībhatsuḥ somakāvayavaiḥ saha,
7.201.5: yā śaktiryacca vijñānaṁ yad vīryaṁ yacca pauruṣam,
dhārtarāṣṭreṣu yā prītirdveṣo’smāsu ca yaśca te ॥5॥
7.201.6: yacca bhūyo’sti tejaste tat sarvaṁ mayi darśaya,
sa eva droṇahantā te darpaṁ chetsyati pārṣataḥ ॥6॥
7.201.9: atha kasmāt sa kaunteyaḥ sakhāyaṁ rūkṣamuktavān ॥9॥
7.201.10: yuvarāje hate caiva vr̥ddhakṣatre ca paurave,
7.201.11: dhr̥ṣṭadyumne sātyakau ca bhīme cāpi parājite,
7.201.12: antarbhede ca sañjāte duḥkhaṁ saṁsmr̥tya ca prabho,
7.201.15: sa tu yatto rathe sthitvā vāryupaspr̥śya vīryavān ॥15॥
7.201.20: vavuścāśiśirā vātāḥ sūryo naiva tatāpa ca ॥20॥
7.201.26: digbhyaḥ pradigbhyaḥ khād bhūmeḥ sarvataḥ śaravr̥ṣṭayaḥ,
7.201.31: tat sainyaṁ bhayasaṁvignaṁ dadāha yudhi bhārata ॥31॥
7.201.32: dr̥ṣṭvā tu pāṇḍavīṁ senā dahyamānāṁ mahāhave ॥32॥
7.201.34: kr̥tsnā hyakṣauhiṇī rājan savyasācī ca pāṇḍavaḥ ॥34॥
7.201.35: naiva nastādr̥śaṁ rājan dr̥ṣṭapūrvaṁ na ca śrutam ॥35॥
7.201.37: tato muhūrtādiva tat tamo vyupaśaśāma ha ॥37॥
7.201.38: pravavau cānilaḥ śīto diśaśca vimalā babhuḥ,
7.201.45: vimuktau ca mahātmānau dr̥ṣṭvā drauṇiḥ suduḥkhitaḥ,
7.201.47: dhig dhik sarvamidaṁ mithyetyuktvā samprādravad raṇāt ॥47॥
7.201.50: bho bho māyā yadr̥cchā vā na vidmaḥ kimidaṁ bhavet,
astraṁ tvidaṁ kathaṁ mithyā mama kaśca vyatikramaḥ ॥50॥
7.201.51: yadimau jīvataḥ kr̥ṣṇau kālo hi duratikramaḥ ॥51॥
7.201.52: nāsurā na ca gandharvā na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ,
na sarpā yakṣapatagā na manuṣyāḥ kathañcana ॥52॥
7.201.55: etat prabrūhi bhagavan mayā pr̥ṣṭo yathātatham,
7.201.56: mahāntamevamatha māṁ yaṁ tvaṁ pr̥cchasi vismayāt,
taṁ pravakṣyāmi te sarvaṁ samādhāya manaḥ śr̥ṇu ॥56॥
7.201.57: ajāyata ca kāryārthaṁ putro dharmasya viśvakr̥t ॥57॥
7.201.57d2: vyākurvate yasya tattvaṁ śrutayo munayaśca ha,
7.201.61: sa tena tapasā tāta brahmabhūto yadābhavat,
tato viśveśvaraṁ yoniṁ viśvasya jagataḥ patim ॥61॥
7.201.63: cekitānaṁ parāṁ yoniṁ tiṣṭhato gacchataśca ha ॥63॥
7.201.71d1: svajānubhyāṁ mahīṁ gatvā kr̥tvā śirasi cāñjalim,
7.201.73: paitraṁ tvāṣṭraṁ karma saumyaṁ ca tubhyam ॥73॥
7.201.76: tvayā sr̥ṣṭāstvaṁ hi tebhyaḥ paro hi ॥76॥
7.201.81: na piśācā na gandharvā na yakṣā na ca rākṣasāḥ ॥81॥
7.201.82: na suparṇāstathā nāgā na ca viśve viyonijāḥ,
na kaścit tvāṁ ca devo’pi samareṣu vijeṣyati ॥82॥
7.201.83: na śastreṇa na vajreṇa nāgninā na ca vāyunā,
na cārdreṇa na śuṣkeṇa trasena sthāvareṇa ca ॥83॥
7.201.84: kaścit tava rujāṁ kartā matprasādāt kathañcana,
api vai samaraṁ gatvā bhaviṣyasi mamādhikaḥ ॥84॥
7.201.85: evamete varā labdhāḥ purastād viddhi śauriṇā,
7.201.86: tasyaiva tapasā jātaṁ naraṁ nāma mahāmunim,
7.201.88: tejo manyuṁ ca bibhrattvaṁ jāto raudro mahāmate ॥88॥
7.201.89: sa bhavān devavat prājño jñātvā bhavamayaṁ jagat,
7.201.91: puṣkalāṁśca varān prādāt tava vidvan hr̥di sthitān ॥91॥
7.201.93: sarvarūpaṁ bhavaṁ jñātvā liṅge yo’rcayati prabhum,
7.201.94: evaṁ devā yajanto hi siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ,
prārthayante paraṁ loke sthāṇumekaṁ sa sarvakr̥t ॥94॥
7.201.95: kr̥ṣṇa eva hi yaṣṭavyo yajñaiścaiva sanātanaḥ ॥95॥
7.201.97: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā droṇaputro mahārathaḥ,
namaścakāra rudrāya bahu mene ca keśavam ॥97॥
7.201.99: kauravāṇāṁ ca dīnānāṁ droṇe yudhi nipātite ॥99॥
7.201.100: yuddhaṁ kr̥tvā dinān pañca droṇo hatvā varūthinīm,
7.201.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi nārāyaṇāstramokṣaparvaṇi vyāsavākye śatarudriye ekādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥201॥
7.202.5: tasyāṁ diśi vidīryante śatravo me mahāmune ॥5॥
7.202.6: tena bhagnānarīn sarvān madbhagnān manyate janaḥ,
7.202.8: na padbhyāṁ spr̥śate bhūmiṁ na ca śūlaṁ vimuñcati,
7.202.10: taṁ gaccha śaraṇaṁ devaṁ varadaṁ bhuvaneśvaram ॥10॥
7.202.21: sa śivastāta tejasvī prasādād yāti te’grataḥ ॥21॥
7.202.22: tasmin ghore sadā pārtha saṅgrāme romaharṣaṇe,
7.202.23: kastāṁ senāṁ tadā pārtha manasāpi pradharṣayet,
7.202.24: na hi bhūtaṁ samaṁ tena triṣu lokeṣu vidyate ॥24॥
7.202.25: gandhenāpi hi saṅgrāme tasya kruddhasya śatravaḥ,
visañjñā hatabhūyiṣṭhā vepanti ca patanti ca ॥25॥
7.202.26: tasmai namastu kurvanto devāstiṣṭhanti vai divi,
ye cānye mānavā loke te ca svargajito narāḥ ॥26॥
7.202.27: ye bhaktā varadaṁ devaṁ śivaṁ rudramumāpatim,
7.202.28: ihaloke sukhaṁ prāpya te yānti paramāṁ gatim,
namaskuruṣva kaunteya tasmai śāntāya vai sadā ॥28॥
7.202.34: vr̥kṣāṇāṁ pataye caiva gavāṁ ca pataye namaḥ ॥34॥
7.202.47: namo’stu tripuraghnāya bhagaghnāya ca vai namaḥ,
7.202.48: mātr̥̄ṇāṁ pataye caiva gaṇānāṁ pataye namaḥ,
gavāṁ ca pataye nityaṁ yajñānāṁ pataye namaḥ ॥48॥
7.202.49: apāṁ ca pataye nityaṁ devānāṁ pataye namaḥ,
7.202.51: na surā nāsurā loke na gandharvā na rākṣasāḥ ॥51॥
7.202.54: te na śarma kutaḥ śāntiṁ lebhire sma surāstadā,
vidrute sahasā yajñe kupite ca maheśvare ॥54॥
7.202.57: andhena tamasā lokā na prākāśanta saṁvr̥tāḥ,
jaghnivān saha sūryeṇa sarveṣāṁ jyotiṣāṁ prabhāḥ ॥57॥
7.202.60: tato niścakramurdevā vepamānā natāḥ sma te,
7.202.61: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tu surāḥ sarve praṇipatya maheśvaram ॥61॥
7.202.62: rudrasya yajñabhāgaṁ ca viśiṣṭaṁ te tvakalpayan,
7.202.63: bhagnāścāpi surā āsan bhītāścādyāpi taṁ prati ॥63॥
7.202.64: āyasaṁ rājataṁ caiva sauvarṇaṁ paramaṁ mahat ॥64॥
7.202.65: tr̥tīyaṁ tu puraṁ teṣāṁ vidyunmālina āyasam ॥65॥
7.202.66: atha sarve surā rudraṁ jagmuḥ śaraṇamarditāḥ ॥66॥
7.202.69: hantuṁ daityān mahādeva jahi tāṁstvaṁ suradviṣaḥ,
7.202.71: pr̥thvīṁ sasāgaravanāṁ rathaṁ kr̥tvā tu śaṅkaraḥ ॥71॥
7.202.72: akṣaṁ kr̥tvā tu nāgendraṁ śeṣaṁ nāma trilocanaḥ,
cakre kr̥tvā tu candrārkau devadevaḥ pinākadhr̥k ॥72॥
7.202.73: aṇī kr̥tvailapatraṁ ca puṣpadantaṁ ca tryambakaḥ,
yūpaṁ kr̥tvā tu malayamavanāhaṁ ca takṣakam ॥73॥
7.202.74: yoktrāṅgāni ca sattvāni kr̥tvā śarvaḥ pratāpavān,
7.202.75: gāyatrīṁ pragrahaṁ kr̥tvā sāvitrīṁ ca maheśvaraḥ ॥75॥
7.202.76: kr̥tvoṅkāraṁ pratodaṁ ca brahmāṇaṁ caiva sārathim,
gāṇḍīvaṁ mandaraṁ kr̥tvā guṇaṁ kr̥tvā tu vāsukim ॥76॥
7.202.77: viṣṇuṁ śarottamaṁ kr̥tvā śalyamagniṁ tathaiva ca,
vāyuṁ kr̥tvātha vājābhyāṁ puṅkhe vaivasvataṁ yamam ॥77॥
7.202.78: vidyut kr̥tvātha niśrāṇaṁ meruṁ kr̥tvātha vai dhvajam,
āruhya sa rathaṁ divyaṁ sarvadevamayaṁ śivaḥ ॥78॥
7.202.81: yadā trīṇi sametāni antarikṣe purāṇi ca ॥81॥
7.202.82: triparvaṇā triśalyena tadā tāni bibheda saḥ,
purāṇi na ca taṁ śekurdānavāḥ prativīkṣitum ॥82॥
7.202.83: purāṇi dagdhavantaṁ taṁ devī yātā pravīkṣitum ॥83॥
7.202.85: bāhuṁ savajraṁ taṁ tasya kruddhasyāstambhayat prabhuḥ ॥85॥
7.202.87: te taṁ praṇamya śirasā procuḥ prāñcalayastadā ॥87॥
7.202.89: tasmāt tvāṁ praṣṭumicchāmo nirjitā yena vai vayam,
7.202.90: teṣāṁ tad vacanaṁ śrutvā brahmā brahmavidāṁ varaḥ,
dhyātvā sa śambhuṁ bhagavān bālaṁ cāmitatejasam ॥90॥
7.202.91: carācarasya jagataḥ prabhuḥ sa bhagavān haraḥ ॥91॥
7.202.93: sa pārvatyāḥ kr̥te śarvaḥ kr̥tavān bālarūpatām,
te mayā sahitā yūyaṁ prāpayadhvaṁ tameva hi ॥93॥
7.202.94: sa eṣa bhagavān devaḥ sarvalokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ,
7.202.95: athābhyetya tato brahmā dr̥ṣṭvā sa ca maheśvaram ॥95॥
7.202.96: ayaṁ śreṣṭha iti jñātvā vavande taṁ pitāmahaḥ,
tvaṁ yajño bhuvanasyāsya tvaṁ gatistvaṁ parāyaṇam ॥96॥
7.202.97: tvaṁ bhavastvaṁ mahādevastvaṁ dhāma paramaṁ padam,
7.202.98: prasādaṁ kuru śakrasya tvayā krodhārditasya vai ॥98॥
7.202.100: tataḥ prasādayāmāsurumāṁ rudraṁ ca te surāḥ,
7.202.102: sa vai rudraḥ sa ca śivaḥ so’gniḥ sarvaśca sarvavit,
sa cendraścaiva vāyuśca so’śvinau ca sa vidyutaḥ ॥102॥
7.202.103: sa bhavaḥ sa ca parjanyo mahādevaḥ sanātanaḥ,
sa candramāḥ sa ceśānaḥ sa sūryo varuṇaśca saḥ ॥103॥
7.202.104: sa kālaḥ so’ntako mr̥tyuḥ sa yamo rātryahāni tu,
7.202.105: dhātā ca sa vidhātā ca viśvātmā viśvakarmakr̥t,
7.202.106: sarvadevaiḥ stuto devaḥ saikadhā bahudhā ca saḥ,
7.202.107: dve tanū tasya devasya vedajñā brāhmaṇā viduḥ,
ghorā cānyā śivā cānyā te tanū bahudhā punaḥ ॥107॥
7.202.108: ghorā tu yā tanustasya so’gnirviṣṇuḥ sa bhāskaraḥ,
saumyā tu punarevāsya āpo jyotīṁṣi candramāḥ ॥108॥
7.202.109: yadatra paramaṁ guhyaṁ sa vai devo maheśvaraḥ ॥109॥
7.202.110: na hi sarve mayā śakyā vaktuṁ bhagavato guṇāḥ ॥110॥
7.202.113: sa dadāti manuṣyebhyaḥ sa caivākṣipate punaḥ,
7.202.114: sa caiva vyāpr̥to loke manuṣyāṇāṁ śubhāśubhe,
7.202.116: tasya devasya yad vaktraṁ samudre tadadhiṣṭhitam,
7.202.117: eṣa caiva śmaśāneṣu devo vasati nityaśaḥ,
7.202.118: asya dīptāni rūpāṇi ghorāṇi ca bahūni ca,
loke yānyasya pūjyante manuṣyāḥ pravadanti ca ॥118॥
7.202.121: sa kāmānāṁ prabhurdevo ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ,
sa vibhuḥ sa prabhurdevo viśvaṁ vyāpnoti vai mahat ॥121॥
7.202.123: sarvathā yat paśūn pāti taiśca yad ramate punaḥ,
7.202.124: divyaṁ ca brahmacaryeṇa liṅgamasya yathā sthitam,
7.202.129: dhūmrarūpaṁ ca yat tasya dhūrjaṭistena cocyate,
7.202.130: dyāmapaḥ pr̥thivīṁ caiva tryambakaśca tataḥ smr̥taḥ ॥130॥
7.202.132: yacca viśvaṁ mahat pāti mahādevastataḥ smr̥taḥ ॥132॥
7.202.133: mahat pūrvaṁ sthito yacca prāṇotpattisthitaśca yat,
7.202.135: bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ bhaviṣyaṁ ca sarvaṁ jagadaśeṣataḥ,
7.202.136: kapiḥ śreṣṭha iti prokto dharmaśca vr̥ṣa ucyate,
7.202.137: nigr̥hya harate yasmāt tasmāddhara iti smr̥taḥ ॥137॥
7.202.138: lalāṭe netramasr̥jat tena tryakṣaḥ sa ucyate ॥138॥
7.202.140: pūjayed vigrahaṁ yastu liṅgaṁ cāpi mahātmanaḥ,
7.202.142: taijasī mahatī dīptā devebhyo’sya śivā tanuḥ,
7.202.144: yannirdahati yat tīkṣṇo yadugro yat pratāpavān,
7.202.145: eṣa devo mahādevo yo’sau pārtha tavāgrataḥ,
7.202.147: eṣa vai bhagavān devaḥ saṅgrāme yāti te’grataḥ,
yena dattāni te’strāṇi yaistvayā dānavā hatāḥ ॥147॥
7.202.150: caturvidhamidaṁ stotraṁ yaḥ śr̥ṇoti naraḥ sadā,
vijitya śatrūn sarvān sa rudraloke mahīyate ॥150॥
7.202.152: bhakto viśveśvaraṁ devaṁ mānuṣeṣu ca yaḥ sadā,
varān kāmān sa labhate prasanne tryambake naraḥ ॥152॥
7.202.153: gaccha yuddhyasva kaunteya na tavāsti parājayaḥ,
yasya mantrī ca goptā ca pārśvastho hi janārdanaḥ ॥153॥
7.202.155: yuddhaṁ kr̥tvā mahad ghoraṁ pañcāhāni mahābalaḥ,
7.202.156: svadhīte yat phalaṁ vede tadasminnapi parvaṇi,
7.202.157: ya idaṁ paṭhate parva śr̥ṇuyād vāpi nityaśaḥ,
